verses.textZh: 大卫王老了，年事已高，他们虽用许多衣服盖着他，他仍不感到暖和。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫王老了，年事已高，他们虽用许多衣服盖着他，他仍不感到暖和。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫王年纪老迈，虽用被遮盖，仍不觉暖。
verses.textEnNiv: When King David was very old, he could not keep warm even when they put covers over him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now King David was old and advanced in years. And although they covered him with clothes, he could not get warm.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now King David was old, advanced in years; and they put covers on him, but he could not get warm.
verses.textEnNlt: King David was now very old, and no matter how many blankets covered him, he could not keep warm.
verses.textEnNasb: Now King David was old, advanced in age; and they covered him with garments, but he could not keep warm.
verses.textEn: When King David was very old, he could not keep warm even when they put covers over him.

verses.textZh: 所以他的臣仆对他说："不如为我主我王寻找一个年轻的处女，使她侍候在王面前，照顾王，睡在王的怀中，好使我主我王得到暖和。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以他的臣仆对他说："不如为我主我王寻找一个年轻的处女，使她侍候在王面前，照顾王，睡在王的怀中，好使我主我王得到暖和。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以臣仆对他说：「不如为我主我王寻找一个处女，使她伺候王，奉养王，睡在王的怀中，好叫我主我王得暖。」
verses.textEnNiv: So his attendants said to him, "Let us look for a young virgin to serve the king and take care of him. She can lie beside him so that our lord the king may keep warm."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore his servants said to him, "Let a young woman be sought for my lord the king, and let her wait on the king and be in his service. Let her lie in your arms, that my lord the king may be warm."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore his servants said to him, "Let a young woman, a virgin, be sought for our lord the king, and let her stand before the king, and let her care for him; and let her lie in your bosom, that our lord the king may be warm."
verses.textEnNlt: So his advisers told him, "Let us find a young virgin to wait on you and look after you, my lord. She will lie in your arms and keep you warm."
verses.textEnNasb: So his servants said to him, "Have them search for a young virgin for my lord the king, and have her attend the king and become his nurse; and have her lie on your chest, so that my lord the king may keep warm."
verses.textEn: So his attendants said to him, "Let us look for a young virgin to serve the king and take care of him. She can lie beside him so that our lord the king may keep warm."

verses.textZh: 于是他们在以色列全境寻找一个美貌的少女，结果找着了一个书念的女子亚比煞，就把她带到王面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们在以色列全境寻找一个美貌的少女，结果找着了一个书念的女子亚比煞，就把她带到王面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是在以色列全境寻找美貌的童女，寻得书念的一个童女亚比煞，就带到王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they searched throughout Israel for a beautiful young woman and found Abishag, a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: So they sought for a beautiful young woman throughout all the territory of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they sought for a lovely young woman throughout all the territory of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.textEnNlt: So they searched throughout the land of Israel for a beautiful girl, and they found Abishag from Shunem and brought her to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: So they searched for a beautiful girl throughout the territory of Israel, and found Abishag the Shunammite, and brought her to the king.
verses.textEn: Then they searched throughout Israel for a beautiful young woman and found Abishag, a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

verses.textZh: 这少女极其美丽。她照顾王，服事他，可是王没有与她发生过关系。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这少女极其美丽。她照顾王，服事他，可是王没有与她发生过关系。
verses.textZhCuv: 这童女极其美貌，她奉养王，伺候王，王却没有与她亲近。
verses.textEnNiv: The woman was very beautiful; she took care of the king and waited on him, but the king had no sexual relations with her.
verses.textEnEsv: The young woman was very beautiful, and she was of service to the king and attended to him, but the king knew her not.
verses.textEnNkjv: The young woman was very lovely; and she cared for the king, and served him; but the king did not know her.
verses.textEnNlt: The girl was very beautiful, and she looked after the king and took care of him. But the king had no sexual relations with her.
verses.textEnNasb: The girl was very beautiful; and she became the king’s nurse and served him, but the king did not become intimate with her.
verses.textEn: The woman was very beautiful; she took care of the king and waited on him, but the king had no sexual relations with her.

verses.textZh: 那时哈及的儿子亚多尼雅妄自尊大，说："我必作王。"就为自己预备了战车、骑兵，又有五十人在他前面奔走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时哈及的儿子亚多尼雅妄自尊大，说："我必作王。"就为自己预备了战车、骑兵，又有五十人在他前面奔走。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，哈及的儿子亚多尼雅自尊，说：「我必作王」，就为自己预备车辆、马兵，又派五十人在他前头奔走。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, put himself forward and said, "I will be king." So he got chariots and horses ready, with fifty men to run ahead of him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, "I will be king." And he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, "I will be king"; and he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.textEnNlt: About that time David’s son Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, began boasting, "I will make myself king." So he provided himself with chariots and charioteers and recruited fifty men to run in front of him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, "I will be king." So he prepared for himself chariots and horsemen, with fifty men to run before him.
verses.textEn: Now Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, put himself forward and said, "I will be king." So he got chariots and horses ready, with fifty men to run ahead of him.

verses.textZh: 他的父亲从来没有责难他说："你为甚么这样作呢？"他的容貌也很英俊，他是在押沙龙之后生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的父亲从来没有责难他说："你为甚么这样作呢？"他的容貌也很英俊，他是在押沙龙之后生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他父亲素来没有使他忧闷，说：「你是做什么呢？」他甚俊美，生在押沙龙之后。
verses.textEnNiv: (His father had never rebuked him by asking, "Why do you behave as you do?" He was also very handsome and was born next after Absalom.)
verses.textEnEsv: His father had never at any time displeased him by asking, "Why have you done thus and so?" He was also a very handsome man, and he was born next after Absalom.
verses.textEnNkjv: (And his father had not rebuked him at any time by saying, "Why have you done so?" He was also very good-looking. Hismother had borne him after Absalom.)
verses.textEnNlt: Now his father, King David, had never disciplined him at any time, even by asking, "Why are you doing that?" Adonijah had been born next after Absalom, and he was very handsome.
verses.textEnNasb: And his father had never rebuked him at any time by asking, "Why have you done so?" And he was also a very handsome man, and he was born after Absalom.
verses.textEn: (His father had never rebuked him by asking, "Why do you behave as you do?" He was also very handsome and was born next after Absalom.)

verses.textZh: 亚多尼雅与洗鲁雅的儿子约押和亚比亚他祭司商议以后，二人都答应支持他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚多尼雅与洗鲁雅的儿子约押和亚比亚他祭司商议以后，二人都答应支持他。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多尼雅与洗鲁雅的儿子约押，和祭司亚比亚他商议；二人就顺从他，帮助他。
verses.textEnNiv: Adonijah conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they gave him their support.
verses.textEnEsv: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest. And they followed Adonijah and helped him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they followed and helped Adonijah.
verses.textEnNlt: Adonijah took Joab son of Zeruiah and Abiathar the priest into his confidence, and they agreed to help him become king.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he had conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they allied themselves with Adonijah.
verses.textEn: Adonijah conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they gave him their support.

verses.textZh: 但撒督祭司、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，拿单先知、示每、利以和大卫的勇士都不拥护亚多尼雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但撒督祭司、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，拿单先知、示每、利以和大卫的勇士都不拥护亚多尼雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 但祭司撒督、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅、先知拿单、示每、利以，并大卫的勇士都不顺从亚多尼雅。
verses.textEnNiv: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei and Rei and David’s special guard did not join Adonijah.
verses.textEnEsv: But Zadok the priest and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada and Nathan the prophet and Shimei and Rei and David’s mighty men were not with Adonijah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David were not with Adonijah.
verses.textEnNlt: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David’s personal bodyguard refused to support Adonijah.
verses.textEnNasb: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
verses.textEn: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei and Rei and David’s special guard did not join Adonijah.

verses.textZh: 有一天，亚多尼雅在隐．罗结旁边，琐希列的盘石那里，宰杀牛羊和肥畜，邀请他所有的兄弟，就是王的众子和所有作王的臣仆的犹大人，来参加筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，亚多尼雅在隐．罗结旁边，琐希列的盘石那里，宰杀牛羊和肥畜，邀请他所有的兄弟，就是王的众子和所有作王的臣仆的犹大人，来参加筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，亚多尼雅在隐‧罗结旁、琐希列磐石那里宰了牛羊、肥犊，请他的诸弟兄，就是王的众子，并所有作王臣仆的犹大人；
verses.textEnNiv: Adonijah then sacrificed sheep, cattle and fattened calves at the Stone of Zoheleth near En Rogel. He invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the royal officials of Judah,
verses.textEnEsv: Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fattened cattle by the Serpent’s Stone, which is beside En-rogel, and he invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the royal officials of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Adonijah sacrificed sheep and oxen and fattened cattle by the stone of Zoheleth, which is by En Rogel; he also invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants.
verses.textEnNlt: Adonijah went to the Stone of Zoheleth near the spring of En-rogel, where he sacrificed sheep, cattle, and fattened calves. He invited all his brothers—the other sons of King David—and all the royal officials of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Adonijah sacrificed sheep, oxen, and fattened steers by the stone of Zoheleth, which is beside En-rogel; and he invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the men of Judah, the king’s servants.
verses.textEn: Adonijah then sacrificed sheep, cattle and fattened calves at the Stone of Zoheleth near En Rogel. He invited all his brothers, the king’s sons, and all the royal officials of Judah,

verses.textZh: 只是没有邀请拿单先知、比拿雅、众勇士和他的兄弟所罗门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是没有邀请拿单先知、比拿雅、众勇士和他的兄弟所罗门。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独先知拿单和比拿雅并勇士，与他的兄弟所罗门，他都没有请。
verses.textEnNiv: but he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the special guard or his brother Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: but he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the mighty men or Solomon his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet, Benaiah, the mighty men, or Solomon his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the king’s bodyguard or his brother Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: But he did not invite Nathan the prophet, Benaiah, the mighty men, or his brother Solomon.
verses.textEn: but he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the special guard or his brother Solomon.

verses.textZh: 拿单对所罗门的母亲拔示巴说："哈及的儿子亚多尼雅作了王，而我们的主大卫还不知道，你难道没有听见吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿单对所罗门的母亲拔示巴说："哈及的儿子亚多尼雅作了王，而我们的主大卫还不知道，你难道没有听见吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 拿单对所罗门的母亲拔示巴说：「哈及的儿子亚多尼雅作王了，你没有听见吗？我们的主大卫却不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Nathan asked Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother, "Have you not heard that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has become king, and our lord David knows nothing about it?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Nathan said to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, "Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has become king and David our lord does not know it?
verses.textEnNkjv: So Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, "Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has become king, and David our lord does not know it?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nathan went to Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother, and asked her, "Haven’t you heard that Haggith’s son, Adonijah, has made himself king, and our lord David doesn’t even know about it?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, "Have you not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has become king, and David our lord does not know it?
verses.textEn: Then Nathan asked Bathsheba, Solomon’s mother, "Have you not heard that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has become king, and our lord David knows nothing about it?

verses.textZh: 现在你来，我可以给你出一个主意，好救你的性命和你儿子所罗门的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你来，我可以给你出一个主意，好救你的性命和你儿子所罗门的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我可以给你出个主意，好保全你和你儿子所罗门的性命。
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, let me advise you how you can save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore come, let me give you advice, that you may save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, please, let me now give you advice, that you may save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: If you want to save your own life and the life of your son Solomon, follow my advice.
verses.textEnNasb: So now come, please let me give you advice, and save your life and the life of your son Solomon.
verses.textEn: Now then, let me advise you how you can save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.

verses.textZh: 你进去见大卫王，对他说：‘我主我王，你不是曾经向婢女起誓，说："你的儿子所罗门必接续我作王，他要坐在我的王位上"吗？现在为甚么亚多尼雅作了王呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你进去见大卫王，对他说：‘我主我王，你不是曾经向婢女起誓，说："你的儿子所罗门必接续我作王，他要坐在我的王位上"吗？现在为甚么亚多尼雅作了王呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 你进去见大卫王，对他说：『我主我王啊，你不曾向婢女起誓说：你儿子所罗门必接续我作王，坐在我的位上吗？现在亚多尼雅怎么作了王呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: Go in to King David and say to him, ‘My lord the king, did you not swear to me your servant: "Surely Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
verses.textEnEsv: Go in at once to King David, and say to him, ‘Did you not, my lord the king, swear to your servant, saying, "Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne"? Why then is Adonijah king?’
verses.textEnNkjv: Go immediately to King David and say to him, ‘Did you not, my lord, O king, swear to your maidservant, saying, "Assuredly your son Solomon shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
verses.textEnNlt: Go at once to King David and say to him, ‘My lord the king, didn’t you make a vow and say to me, "Your son Solomon will surely be the next king and will sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
verses.textEnNasb: Go at once to King David and say to him, ‘Have you not, my lord the king, sworn to your servant, saying, "Solomon your son certainly shall be king after me, and he shall sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
verses.textEn: Go in to King David and say to him, ‘My lord the king, did you not swear to me your servant: "Surely Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?’

verses.textZh: 你还在那里与王说话的时候，我会随后进来，证实你的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你还在那里与王说话的时候，我会随后进来，证实你的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你还与王说话的时候，我也随后进去，证实你的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: While you are still there talking to the king, I will come in and add my word to what you have said."
verses.textEnEsv: Then while you are still speaking with the king, I also will come in after you and confirm your words."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, while you are still talking there with the king, I also will come in after you and confirm your words."
verses.textEnNlt: And while you are still talking with him, I will come and confirm everything you have said."
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, while you are still there speaking with the king, I will come in after you and confirm your words."
verses.textEn: While you are still there talking to the king, I will come in and add my word to what you have said."

verses.textZh: 于是拔示巴进到内室去见王。王很老了，书念的女子亚比煞正在服事王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是拔示巴进到内室去见王。王很老了，书念的女子亚比煞正在服事王。
verses.textZhCuv: 拔示巴进入内室见王，王甚老迈，书念的童女亚比煞正伺候王。
verses.textEnNiv: So Bathsheba went to see the aged king in his room, where Abishag the Shunammite was attending him.
verses.textEnEsv: So Bathsheba went to the king in his chamber (now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was attending to the king).
verses.textEnNkjv: So Bathsheba went into the chamber to the king. (Now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.)
verses.textEnNlt: So Bathsheba went into the king’s bedroom. (He was very old now, and Abishag was taking care of him.)
verses.textEnNasb: So Bathsheba entered to the king in the bedroom. Now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was serving the king.
verses.textEn: So Bathsheba went to see the aged king in his room, where Abishag the Shunammite was attending him.

verses.textZh: 拔示巴向王俯伏叩拜，王问："你要甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拔示巴向王俯伏叩拜，王问："你要甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 拔示巴向王屈身下拜；王说：「你要什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: Bathsheba bowed down, prostrating herself before the king. "What is it you want?" the king asked.
verses.textEnEsv: Bathsheba bowed and paid homage to the king, and the king said, "What do you desire?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Bathsheba bowed and did homage to the king. Then the king said, "What is your wish?"
verses.textEnNlt: Bathsheba bowed down before the king. "What can I do for you?" he asked her.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Bathsheba bowed and prostrated herself before the king. And the king said, "What is on your mind?"
verses.textEn: Bathsheba bowed down, prostrating herself before the king. "What is it you want?" the king asked.

verses.textZh: 她回答说："我主啊，你曾经指着耶和华你的神向婢女起誓，说：‘你的儿子所罗门必接续我作王，他要坐在我的王位上’，
verses.textZhCnvs: 她回答说："我主啊，你曾经指着耶和华你的神向婢女起誓，说：‘你的儿子所罗门必接续我作王，他要坐在我的王位上’，
verses.textZhCuv: 她说：「我主啊，你曾向婢女指着耶和华－你的神起誓说：『你儿子所罗门必接续我作王，坐在我的位上。』
verses.textEnNiv: She said to him, "My lord, you yourself swore to me your servant by the Lord your God: ‘Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne.’
verses.textEnEsv: She said to him, "My lord, you swore to your servant by the Lord your God, saying, ‘Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said to him, "My lord, you swore by the Lord your God to your maidservant, saying, ‘Assuredly Solomon your son shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’
verses.textEnNlt: She replied, "My lord, you made a vow before the Lord your God when you said to me, ‘Your son Solomon will surely be the next king and will sit on my throne.’
verses.textEnNasb: So she said to him, "My lord, you yourself swore to your servant by the Lord your God, saying, ‘Your son Solomon certainly shall be king after me, and he shall sit on my throne.’
verses.textEn: She said to him, "My lord, you yourself swore to me your servant by the Lord your God: ‘Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne.’

verses.textZh: 可是，现在亚多尼雅作了王了；而我主我王，你还不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，现在亚多尼雅作了王了；而我主我王，你还不知道。

verses.textZh: 我主我王啊，现在以色列众人的眼睛都看着你，等你告诉他们谁要坐在我主我王的王位上，接续你作王。

verses.textEnNiv: My lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, to learn from you who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

verses.textEnNasb: Then you shall come up after him, and he shall come and sit on my throne, and he shall be king in my place; for I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and Judah."
verses.textEn: Then you are to go up with him, and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place. I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah."

verses.textEn: Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king, "Amen! May the Lord , the God of my lord the king, so declare it.

verses.textEnNiv: As the Lord was with my lord the king, so may he be with Solomon to make his throne even greater than the throne of my lord King David!"

verses.textEnNkjv: As the Lord has been with my lord the king, even so may He be with Solomon, and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord King David."
verses.textEnNlt: And may the Lord be with Solomon as he has been with you, my lord the king, and may he make Solomon’s reign even greater than yours!"

verses.textEn: As the Lord was with my lord the king, so may he be with Solomon to make his throne even greater than the throne of my lord King David!"

verses.textZh: 于是撒督祭司、拿单先知和耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，以及基利提人和比利提人都下去，使所罗门骑上大卫王的骡子，送他到基训去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是撒督祭司、拿单先知和耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，以及基利提人和比利提人都下去，使所罗门骑上大卫王的骡子，送他到基训去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，祭司撒督、先知拿单、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都下去使所罗门骑大卫王的骡子，将他送到基训。
verses.textEnNiv: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon mount King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.
verses.textEnEsv: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule and brought him to Gihon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and took him to Gihon.
verses.textEnNlt: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and the king’s bodyguard took Solomon down to Gihon Spring, with Solomon riding on King David’s own mule.
verses.textEnNasb: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon ride on King David’s mule, and brought him to Gihon.
verses.textEn: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites went down and had Solomon mount King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.

verses.textZh: 撒督祭司从帐幕里拿出那盛膏油的角，膏立所罗门；然后有人吹角，众民就说："所罗门王万岁！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒督祭司从帐幕里拿出那盛膏油的角，膏立所罗门；然后有人吹角，众民就说："所罗门王万岁！"
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司撒督就从帐幕中取了盛膏油的角来，用膏膏所罗门。人就吹角，众民都说：「愿所罗门王万岁！」
verses.textEnNiv: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon. Then they sounded the trumpet and all the people shouted, "Long live King Solomon!"
verses.textEnEsv: There Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the trumpet, and all the people said, "Long live King Solomon!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Zadok the priest took a horn of oil from the tabernacle and anointed Solomon. And they blew the horn, and all the people said, "Long live King Solomon!"
verses.textEnNlt: There Zadok the priest took the flask of olive oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon with the oil. Then they sounded the ram’s horn and all the people shouted, "Long live King Solomon!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Zadok the priest then took the horn of oil from the tent and anointed Solomon. Then they blew the trumpet, and all the people said, "Long live King Solomon!"
verses.textEn: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon. Then they sounded the trumpet and all the people shouted, "Long live King Solomon!"

verses.textZh: 众民都跟随他上去，吹着笛子，十分欢乐，以致大地也因他们的声音震裂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众民都跟随他上去，吹着笛子，十分欢乐，以致大地也因他们的声音震裂。
verses.textZhCuv: 众民跟随他上来，且吹笛，大大欢呼，声音震地。
verses.textEnNiv: And all the people went up after him, playing pipes and rejoicing greatly, so that the ground shook with the sound.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the people went up after him, playing on pipes, and rejoicing with great joy, so that the earth was split by their noise.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the people went up after him; and the people played the flutes and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth seemedto split with their sound.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the people followed Solomon into Jerusalem, playing flutes and shouting for joy. The celebration was so joyous and noisy that the earth shook with the sound.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the people went up after him, and the people were playing on flutes and rejoicing with great joy, so that the earth shook at their noise.
verses.textEn: And all the people went up after him, playing pipes and rejoicing greatly, so that the ground shook with the sound.

verses.textZh: 亚多尼雅和所有与他在一起的宾客刚刚吃完了饭，听到这声音；约押听到角声，就说："城里为甚么有这样喧嚷的声音呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚多尼雅和所有与他在一起的宾客刚刚吃完了饭，听到这声音；约押听到角声，就说："城里为甚么有这样喧嚷的声音呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多尼雅和所请的众客筵宴方毕，听见这声音；约押听见角声就说：「城中为何有这响声呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they were finishing their feast. On hearing the sound of the trumpet, Joab asked, "What’s the meaning of all the noise in the city?"
verses.textEnEsv: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they finished feasting. And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, "What does this uproar in the city mean?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they finished eating. And when Joab heard the sound of the horn, he said, "Why is the city in such a noisy uproar?"
verses.textEnNlt: Adonijah and his guests heard the celebrating and shouting just as they were finishing their banquet. When Joab heard the sound of the ram’s horn, he asked, "What’s going on? Why is the city in such an uproar?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard this as they finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the trumpet, he said, "Why is the city making such an uproar?"
verses.textEn: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they were finishing their feast. On hearing the sound of the trumpet, Joab asked, "What’s the meaning of all the noise in the city?"

verses.textZh: 他还在说话的时候，亚比亚他祭司的儿子约拿单来了。亚多尼雅对他说："进来吧！你是个忠义的人，一定带来了好消息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他还在说话的时候，亚比亚他祭司的儿子约拿单来了。亚多尼雅对他说："进来吧！你是个忠义的人，一定带来了好消息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他正说话的时候，祭司亚比亚他的儿子约拿单来了。亚多尼雅对他说：「进来吧！你是个忠义的人，必是报好信息。」
verses.textEnNiv: Even as he was speaking, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest arrived. Adonijah said, "Come in. A worthy man like you must be bringing good news."
verses.textEnEsv: While he was still speaking, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came. And Adonijah said, "Come in, for you are a worthy man and bring good news."
verses.textEnNkjv: While he was still speaking, there came Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest. And Adonijah said to him, "Come in, for you are a prominent man, and bring good news."
verses.textEnNlt: And while he was still speaking, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest arrived. "Come in," Adonijah said to him, "for you are a good man. You must have good news."
verses.textEnNasb: While he was still speaking, behold, Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came. Then Adonijah said, "Come in, for you are a valiant man and you bring good news."
verses.textEn: Even as he was speaking, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest arrived. Adonijah said, "Come in. A worthy man like you must be bringing good news."

verses.textZh: 约拿单对亚多尼雅说："不好了，我们的主大卫王已经立了所罗门为王了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿单对亚多尼雅说："不好了，我们的主大卫王已经立了所罗门为王了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿单对亚多尼雅说：「我们的主大卫王诚然立所罗门为王了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Not at all!" Jonathan answered. "Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
verses.textEnEsv: Jonathan answered Adonijah, "No, for our lord King David has made Solomon king,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonathan answered and said to Adonijah, "No! Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
verses.textEnNlt: "Not at all!" Jonathan replied. "Our lord King David has just declared Solomon king!
verses.textEnNasb: But Jonathan replied to Adonijah, "On the contrary! Our lord King David has made Solomon king!
verses.textEn: "Not at all!" Jonathan answered. "Our lord King David has made Solomon king.

verses.textZh: 王差派撒督祭司、拿单先知和耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，以及基利提人和比利提人，与所罗门同去。他们使所罗门骑上王的骡子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王差派撒督祭司、拿单先知和耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，以及基利提人和比利提人，与所罗门同去。他们使所罗门骑上王的骡子。
verses.textZhCuv: 王差遣祭司撒督、先知拿单、耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，和基利提人、比利提人都去使所罗门骑王的骡子。
verses.textEnNiv: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites, and they have put him on the king’s mule,

verses.textEnNkjv: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites; and they have made him ride on the king’s mule.
verses.textEnNlt: The king sent him down to Gihon Spring with Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, protected by the king’s bodyguard. They had him ride on the king’s own mule,
verses.textEnNasb: The king has also sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the Cherethites, and the Pelethites; and they have mounted him on the king’s mule.
verses.textEn: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites, and they have put him on the king’s mule,

verses.textZh: 撒督祭司和拿单先知已经在基训膏立他作王。众人都从那里欢欢喜喜上路；你们听见的声音，就是城里的喧闹声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒督祭司和拿单先知已经在基训膏立他作王。众人都从那里欢欢喜喜上路；你们听见的声音，就是城里的喧闹声。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司撒督和先知拿单在基训已经膏他作王。众人都从那里欢呼着上来，声音使城震动，这就是你们所听见的声音；
verses.textEnNiv: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon. From there they have gone up cheering, and the city resounds with it. That’s the noise you hear.
verses.textEnEsv: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon, and they have gone up from there rejoicing, so that the city is in an uproar. This is the noise that you have heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon; and they have gone up from there rejoicing, so that the city is in an uproar. This is the noise that you have heard.
verses.textEnNlt: and Zadok and Nathan have anointed him at Gihon Spring as the new king. They have just returned, and the whole city is celebrating and rejoicing. That’s what all the noise is about.
verses.textEnNasb: Furthermore, Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon, and they have come up from there rejoicing, so that the city is going wild. This is the noise which you have heard.
verses.textEn: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon. From there they have gone up cheering, and the city resounds with it. That’s the noise you hear.

verses.textZh: 不但所罗门已经坐在这王国的王位上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但所罗门已经坐在这王国的王位上，
verses.textZhCuv: 并且所罗门登了国位。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon sits on the royal throne.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Solomon sits on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: What’s more, Solomon is now sitting on the royal throne as king.
verses.textEnNasb: Besides, Solomon has even taken his seat on the throne of the kingdom.
verses.textEn: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.

verses.textZh: 而且王的臣仆也来为我们的主大卫王祝福说：‘愿你的神使所罗门的名声比你的更尊荣，使他的王位比你的更伟大。’王就在床上屈身下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且王的臣仆也来为我们的主大卫王祝福说：‘愿你的神使所罗门的名声比你的更尊荣，使他的王位比你的更伟大。’王就在床上屈身下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 王的臣仆也来为我们的主大卫王祝福，说：『愿王的神使所罗门的名比王的名更尊荣；使他的国位比王的国位更大。』王就在床上屈身下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Also, the royal officials have come to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make Solomon’s name more famous than yours and his throne greater than yours!’ And the king bowed in worship on his bed
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the king’s servants came to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than yours, and make his throne greater than your throne.’ And the king bowed himself on the bed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And moreover the king’s servants have gone to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and may He make his throne greater than your throne.’ Then the king bowed himself on the bed.
verses.textEnNlt: And all the royal officials have gone to King David and congratulated him, saying, ‘May your God make Solomon’s fame even greater than your own, and may Solomon’s reign be even greater than yours!’ Then the king bowed his head in worship as he lay in his bed,
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the king’s servants came to bless our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and his throne greater than your throne!’ And the king bowed himself on the bed.
verses.textEn: Also, the royal officials have come to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make Solomon’s name more famous than yours and his throne greater than yours!’ And the king bowed in worship on his bed

verses.textZh: 王又这样说：‘耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的，因为他今天赐了一人坐在我的王位上，也使我亲眼看见这事。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又这样说：‘耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的，因为他今天赐了一人坐在我的王位上，也使我亲眼看见这事。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 王又说：『耶和华－以色列的神是应当称颂的；因他赐我一人今日坐在我的位上，我也亲眼看见了。』」
verses.textEnNiv: and said, ‘Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who has allowed my eyes to see a successor on my throne today.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the king also said, ‘Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, who has granted someone to sit on my throne this day, my own eyes seeing it.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Also the king said thus, ‘Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne this day, while my eyes see it!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: and he said, ‘Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who today has chosen a successor to sit on my throne while I am still alive to see it.’"
verses.textEnNasb: The king has also said this: ‘Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who has granted one to sit on my throne today while my own eyes see it.’ "

verses.textZh: 亚多尼雅所有的宾客都惧怕，大家起身，各自逃走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚多尼雅所有的宾客都惧怕，大家起身，各自逃走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多尼雅的众客听见这话就都惊惧，起来四散。
verses.textEnNiv: At this, all Adonijah’s guests rose in alarm and dispersed.
verses.textEnEsv: Then all the guests of Adonijah trembled and rose, and each went his own way.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the guests who were with Adonijah were afraid, and arose, and each one went his way.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all of Adonijah’s guests jumped up in panic from the banquet table and quickly scattered.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the guests of Adonijah trembled and got up, and each went on his way.
verses.textEn: At this, all Adonijah’s guests rose in alarm and dispersed.

verses.textZh: 亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门，就起来，去抓紧祭坛的角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门，就起来，去抓紧祭坛的角。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门，就起来，去抓住祭坛的角。
verses.textEnNiv: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, went and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And Adonijah feared Solomon. So he arose and went and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Adonijah was afraid of Solomon; so he arose, and went and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Adonijah was afraid of Solomon, so he rushed to the sacred tent and grabbed on to the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Adonijah also was afraid of Solomon, and he got up, and went, and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEn: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, went and took hold of the horns of the altar.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉所罗门说："亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门王。他现在抓紧祭坛的角说：‘愿所罗门王今天向我起誓，决不会用刀杀死他的仆人。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉所罗门说："亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门王。他现在抓紧祭坛的角说：‘愿所罗门王今天向我起誓，决不会用刀杀死他的仆人。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉所罗门说：「亚多尼雅惧怕所罗门王，现在抓住祭坛的角，说：『愿所罗门王今日向我起誓，必不用刀杀仆人。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon was told, "Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon and is clinging to the horns of the altar. He says, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then it was told Solomon, "Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon, for behold, he has laid hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me first that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was told Solomon, saying, "Indeed Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon; for look, he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Word soon reached Solomon that Adonijah had seized the horns of the altar in fear, and that he was pleading, "Let King Solomon swear today that he will not kill me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was reported to Solomon, saying, "Behold, Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon, for behold, he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘May King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ "
verses.textEn: Then Solomon was told, "Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon and is clinging to the horns of the altar. He says, ‘Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.’ "

verses.textZh: 所罗门说："他若是作一个忠义的人，他的头发连一根也不会掉在地上；但在他身上若是发现有甚么恶行，他必定死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门说："他若是作一个忠义的人，他的头发连一根也不会掉在地上；但在他身上若是发现有甚么恶行，他必定死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门说：「他若作忠义的人，连一根头发也不致落在地上；他若行恶，必要死亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon replied, "If he shows himself to be worthy, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground; but if evil is found in him, he will die."
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon said, "If he will show himself a worthy man, not one of his hairs shall fall to the earth, but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon said, "If he proves himself a worthy man, not one hair of him shall fall to the earth; but if wickedness is found in him, he shall die."
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon replied, "If he proves himself to be loyal, not a hair on his head will be touched. But if he makes trouble, he will die."
verses.textEnNasb: And Solomon said, "If he is a worthy man, not one of his hairs will fall to the ground; but if wickedness is found in him, he will die."
verses.textEn: Solomon replied, "If he shows himself to be worthy, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground; but if evil is found in him, he will die."

verses.textZh: 于是所罗门派人去把亚多尼雅从祭坛上带下来。他来向所罗门叩拜；所罗门对他说："回你的家去吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是所罗门派人去把亚多尼雅从祭坛上带下来。他来向所罗门叩拜；所罗门对他说："回你的家去吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是所罗门王差遣人，使亚多尼雅从坛上下来，他就来，向所罗门王下拜；所罗门对他说：「你回家去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Solomon sent men, and they brought him down from the altar. And Adonijah came and bowed down to King Solomon, and Solomon said, "Go to your home."
verses.textEnEsv: So King Solomon sent, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and paid homage to King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, "Go to your house."
verses.textEnNkjv: So King Solomon sent them to bring him down from the altar. And he came and fell down before King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, "Go to your house."
verses.textEnNlt: So King Solomon summoned Adonijah, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and bowed respectfully before King Solomon, who dismissed him, saying, "Go on home."
verses.textEnNasb: So King Solomon sent men, and they brought him down from the altar. And he came and prostrated himself before King Solomon, and Solomon said to him, "Go to your house."
verses.textEn: Then King Solomon sent men, and they brought him down from the altar. And Adonijah came and bowed down to King Solomon, and Solomon said, "Go to your home."

verses.textZh: 谨守耶和华你神所吩咐的，遵行他的道，按摩西律法所写的，谨守他的律例、诫命、典章和法度；这样，无论你作甚么，无论你往哪里去，都可以亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谨守耶和华你神所吩咐的，遵行他的道，按摩西律法所写的，谨守他的律例、诫命、典章和法度；这样，无论你作甚么，无论你往哪里去，都可以亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 遵守耶和华－你神所吩咐的，照着摩西律法上所写的行主的道，谨守他的律例、诫命、典章、法度。这样，你无论做什么事，不拘往何处去，尽都亨通。
verses.textEnNiv: and observe what the Lord your God requires: Walk in obedience to him, and keep his decrees and commands, his laws and regulations, as written in the Law of Moses. Do this so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you go
verses.textEnEsv: and keep the charge of the Lord your God, walking in his ways and keeping his statutes, his commandments, his rules, and his testimonies, as it is written in the Law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn,
verses.textEnNkjv: And keep the charge of the Lord your God: to walk in His ways, to keep His statutes, His commandments, His judgments, and His testimonies, as it is written in the Law of Moses, that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn;
verses.textEnNlt: Observe the requirements of the Lord your God, and follow all his ways. Keep the decrees, commands, regulations, and laws written in the Law of Moses so that you will be successful in all you do and wherever you go.
verses.textEnNasb: Do your duty to the Lord your God, to walk in His ways, to keep His statutes, His commandments, His ordinances, and His testimonies, according to what is written in the Law of Moses, so that you may succeed in all that you do and wherever you turn,
verses.textEn: and observe what the Lord your God requires: Walk in obedience to him, and keep his decrees and commands, his laws and regulations, as written in the Law of Moses. Do this so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you go

verses.textZh: 这样，耶和华必坚立他所说有关我的话，说：‘如果你的子孙谨慎自己所行的，一心一意、诚诚实实行在我面前，就不断有人坐以色列的王位了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，耶和华必坚立他所说有关我的话，说：‘如果你的子孙谨慎自己所行的，一心一意、诚诚实实行在我面前，就不断有人坐以色列的王位了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必成就向我所应许的话说：『你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，尽心尽意诚诚实实地行在我面前，就不断人坐以色列的国位。』
verses.textEnNiv: and that the Lord may keep his promise to me: ‘If your descendants watch how they live, and if they walk faithfully before me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnEsv: that the Lord may establish his word that he spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your sons pay close attention to their way, to walk before me in faithfulness with all their heart and with all their soul, you shall not lack a man on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: that the Lord may fulfill His word which He spoke concerning me, saying, ‘If your sons take heed to their way, to walk before Me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul,’ He said, ‘you shall not lack a man on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnNlt: If you do this, then the Lord will keep the promise he made to me. He told me, ‘If your descendants live as they should and follow me faithfully with all their heart and soul, one of them will always sit on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnNasb: so that the Lord may fulfill His promise which He spoke regarding me, saying, ‘If your sons are careful about their way, to walk before Me in truth with all their heart and all their soul, you shall not be deprived of a man to occupy the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEn: and that the Lord may keep his promise to me: ‘If your descendants watch how they live, and if they walk faithfully before me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’

verses.textZh: 你也要知道洗鲁雅的儿子约押对我所行的，就是对以色列的两个元帅：尼珥的儿子押尼珥和益帖的儿子亚玛撒所行的。他杀了他们，在和平的时候流他们的血，像作战时一样，把战争的血染在他腰间所束的带子上和脚上所穿的鞋子上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你也要知道洗鲁雅的儿子约押对我所行的，就是对以色列的两个元帅：尼珥的儿子押尼珥和益帖的儿子亚玛撒所行的。他杀了他们，在和平的时候流他们的血，像作战时一样，把战争的血染在他腰间所束的带子上和脚上所穿的鞋子上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你知道洗鲁雅的儿子约押向我所行的，就是杀了以色列的两个元帅：尼珥的儿子押尼珥和益帖的儿子亚玛撒。他在太平之时流这二人的血，如在争战之时一样，将这血染了腰间束的带和脚上穿的鞋。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now you yourself know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me—what he did to the two commanders of Israel’s armies, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He killed them, shedding their blood in peacetime as if in battle, and with that blood he stained the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: "Moreover, you also know what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, how he dealt with the two commanders of the armies of Israel, Abner the son of Ner, and Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, avenging in time of peace for blood that had been shed in war, and putting the blood of war on the belt around his waist and on the sandals on his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover you know also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, and what he did to the two commanders of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed. And he shed the blood of war in peacetime, and put the blood of war on his belt that was around his waist, and on his sandals that were on his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: "And there is something else. You know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me when he murdered my two army commanders, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He pretended that it was an act of war, but it was done in a time of peace, staining his belt and sandals with innocent blood.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now you yourself also know what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me, what he did to the two commanders of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed; he also shed the blood of war in peace. And he put the blood of war on his belt that was on his waist, and on his sandals that were on his feet.
verses.textEn: "Now you yourself know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me—what he did to the two commanders of Israel’s armies, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He killed them, shedding their blood in peacetime as if in battle, and with that blood he stained the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.

verses.textZh: 所以你要凭你的智慧而行，不要让他白发到老，平平安安下到阴间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你要凭你的智慧而行，不要让他白发到老，平平安安下到阴间。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你要照你的智慧行，不容他白头安然下阴间。
verses.textEnNiv: Deal with him according to your wisdom, but do not let his gray head go down to the grave in peace.
verses.textEnEsv: Act therefore according to your wisdom, but do not let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do according to your wisdom, and do not let his gray hair go down to the grave in peace.
verses.textEnNlt: Do with him what you think best, but don’t let him grow old and go to his grave in peace.
verses.textEnNasb: So act as your wisdom dictates, and do not let his gray hair go down to Sheol in peace.
verses.textEn: Deal with him according to your wisdom, but do not let his gray head go down to the grave in peace.

verses.textZh: 但是你要恩待基列人巴西莱的众子，使他们与你同席吃饭，因为我逃避你哥哥押沙龙的时候，他们拿食物来迎接我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是你要恩待基列人巴西莱的众子，使他们与你同席吃饭，因为我逃避你哥哥押沙龙的时候，他们拿食物来迎接我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当恩待基列人巴西莱的众子，使他们常与你同席吃饭；因为我躲避你哥哥押沙龙的时候，他们拿食物来迎接我。
verses.textEnNiv: "But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai of Gilead and let them be among those who eat at your table. They stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
verses.textEnEsv: But deal loyally with the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, for with such loyalty they met me when I fled from Absalom your brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, for so they came to me when I fled from Absalom your brother.
verses.textEnNlt: "Be kind to the sons of Barzillai of Gilead. Make them permanent guests at your table, for they took care of me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
verses.textEnNasb: However, show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table; for they assisted me when I fled from Absalom your brother.
verses.textEn: "But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai of Gilead and let them be among those who eat at your table. They stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.

verses.textZh: 与你在一起的有巴户琳的便雅悯人基拉的儿子示每；我往玛哈念去的那天，他用狠毒的咒语咒骂我。后来他下到约旦河来迎接我的时候，我就指着耶和华向他起誓，说：‘我必不用刀杀死你。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 与你在一起的有巴户琳的便雅悯人基拉的儿子示每；我往玛哈念去的那天，他用狠毒的咒语咒骂我。后来他下到约旦河来迎接我的时候，我就指着耶和华向他起誓，说：‘我必不用刀杀死你。’
verses.textZhCuv: 在你这里有巴户琳的便雅悯人，基拉的儿子示每；我往玛哈念去的那日，他用狠毒的言语咒骂我，后来却下约旦河迎接我，我就指着耶和华向他起誓说：『我必不用刀杀你。』
verses.textEnNiv: "And remember, you have with you Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, who called down bitter curses on me the day I went to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the Lord : ‘I will not put you to death by the sword.’
verses.textEnEsv: And there is also with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjaminite from Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse on the day when I went to Mahanaim. But when he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the Lord , saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And see, youhave with you Shimei the son of Gera, a Benjamite from Bahurim, who cursed me with a malicious curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim. But he came down to meet me at the Jordan, and I swore to him by the Lord, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And remember Shimei son of Gera, the man from Bahurim in Benjamin. He cursed me with a terrible curse as I was fleeing to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan River, I swore by the Lord that I would not kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, you have with you Shimei the son of Gera the Benjaminite, of Bahurim; now it was he who cursed me with a painful curse on the day I went to Mahanaim. But when he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the Lord, saying, ‘I will not put you to death with the sword.’
verses.textEn: "And remember, you have with you Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, who called down bitter curses on me the day I went to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the Lord : ‘I will not put you to death by the sword.’

verses.textZh: 大卫与他的列祖同睡，葬在大卫城里。

verses.textEnNiv: Then David rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: Then David slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: So David rested with his fathers, and was buried in the City of David.
verses.textEnNlt: Then David died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David.
verses.textEnNasb: Then David lay down with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David.

verses.textZh: 大卫作以色列王四十年：在希伯仑作王七年；在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫作以色列王四十年：在希伯仑作王七年；在耶路撒冷作王三十三年。

verses.textEnNiv: He had reigned forty years over Israel—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And the time that David reigned over Israel was forty years. He reigned seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: The period that David reigned over Israel was forty years; seven years he reigned in Hebron, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years.
verses.textEnNlt: David had reigned over Israel for forty years, seven of them in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the days that David reigned over Israel were forty years: in Hebron he reigned for seven years, and in Jerusalem he reigned for thirty-three years.
verses.textEn: He had reigned forty years over Israel—seven years in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 于是所罗门坐在他父亲的王位上，他的国非常稳固。

verses.textEnNlt: Solomon became king and sat on the throne of David his father, and his kingdom was firmly established.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his kingdom was firmly established.
verses.textEn: So Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his rule was firmly established.

verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "I have something to say to you." And she said, "Speak."
verses.textEn: Then he added, "I have something to say to you." "You may say it," she replied.

verses.textZh: 亚多尼雅说："你知道这国位原是我的，以色列众人都希望我作王；不料国位反归了我的弟弟，因为他得着国位是出于耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚多尼雅说："你知道这国位原是我的，以色列众人都希望我作王；不料国位反归了我的弟弟，因为他得着国位是出于耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚多尼雅说：「你知道国原是归我的，以色列众人也都仰望我作王，不料，国反归了我兄弟，因他得国是出乎耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: "As you know," he said, "the kingdom was mine. All Israel looked to me as their king. But things changed, and the kingdom has gone to my brother; for it has come to him from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel fully expected me to reign. However, the kingdom has turned about and become my brother’s, for it was his from the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "You know that the kingdom was mine, and all Israel had set their expectations on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom has been turned over, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "As you know, the kingdom was rightfully mine; all Israel wanted me to be the next king. But the tables were turned, and the kingdom went to my brother instead; for that is the way the Lord wanted it.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "You yourself know that the kingdom was mine and that all Israel intended for me to be king; however, the kingdom has turned around and become my brother’s, for it was his from the Lord.
verses.textEn: "As you know," he said, "the kingdom was mine. All Israel looked to me as their king. But things changed, and the kingdom has gone to my brother; for it has come to him from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 现在我有一事请求你，请你不要拒绝。"拔示巴对他说："你说吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我有一事请求你，请你不要拒绝。"拔示巴对他说："你说吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我有一件事求你，望你不要推辞。」拔示巴说：「你说吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now I have one request to make of you. Do not refuse me." "You may make it," she said.
verses.textEnEsv: And now I have one request to make of you; do not refuse me." She said to him, "Speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I ask one petition of you; do not deny me." And she said to him, "Say it."
verses.textEnNlt: So now I have just one favor to ask of you. Please don’t turn me down." "What is it?" she asked.
verses.textEnNasb: So now I am making one request of you; do not refuse me." And she said to him, "Speak."
verses.textEn: Now I have one request to make of you. Do not refuse me." "You may make it," she said.

verses.textZh: 他说："求你向所罗门王说，请他把书念的女子亚比煞赐给我作妻子，因为他必不会拒绝你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："求你向所罗门王说，请他把书念的女子亚比煞赐给我作妻子，因为他必不会拒绝你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「求你请所罗门王将书念的女子亚比煞赐我为妻，因他必不推辞你。」
verses.textEnNiv: So he continued, "Please ask King Solomon—he will not refuse you—to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Please ask King Solomon—he will not refuse you—to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Please speak to King Solomon, for he will not refuse you, that he may give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife."
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "Speak to King Solomon on my behalf, for I know he will do anything you request. Ask him to let me marry Abishag, the girl from Shunem."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Please speak to Solomon the king—for he will not refuse you—that he may give me Abishag the Shunammite as a wife."
verses.textEn: So he continued, "Please ask King Solomon—he will not refuse you—to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife."

verses.textZh: 拔示巴说："好吧，我必为你向王请求。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拔示巴说："好吧，我必为你向王请求。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拔示巴说：「好，我必为你对王提说。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Very well," Bathsheba replied, "I will speak to the king for you."
verses.textEnEsv: Bathsheba said, "Very well; I will speak for you to the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Bathsheba said, "Very well, I will speak for you to the king."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Bathsheba replied. "I will speak to the king for you."
verses.textEnNasb: And Bathsheba said, "Very well; I will speak to the king for you."
verses.textEn: "Very well," Bathsheba replied, "I will speak to the king for you."

verses.textZh: 于是拔示巴去见所罗门王，为亚多尼雅的事向他请求。王起来迎接她，向她下拜，然后坐在自己的王座上，又吩咐人为王的母亲摆设一个座位；她就坐在王的右边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是拔示巴去见所罗门王，为亚多尼雅的事向他请求。王起来迎接她，向她下拜，然后坐在自己的王座上，又吩咐人为王的母亲摆设一个座位；她就坐在王的右边。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，拔示巴去见所罗门王，要为亚多尼雅提说；王起来迎接，向她下拜，就坐在位上，吩咐人为王母设一座位，她便坐在王的右边。
verses.textEnNiv: When Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah, the king stood up to meet her, bowed down to her and sat down on his throne. He had a throne brought for the king’s mother, and she sat down at his right hand.
verses.textEnEsv: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him on behalf of Adonijah. And the king rose to meet her and bowed down to her. Then he sat on his throne and had a seat brought for the king’s mother, and she sat on his right.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bathsheba therefore went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. And the king rose up to meet her and bowed down to her, and sat down on his throne and had a throne set for the king’s mother; so she sat at his right hand.
verses.textEnNlt: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak on Adonijah’s behalf. The king rose from his throne to meet her, and he bowed down before her. When he sat down on his throne again, the king ordered that a throne be brought for his mother, and she sat at his right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. And the king stood to meet her, bowed to her, and sat on his throne; then he had a throne set up for the king’s mother, and she sat on his right.
verses.textEn: When Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah, the king stood up to meet her, bowed down to her and sat down on his throne. He had a throne brought for the king’s mother, and she sat down at his right hand.

verses.textZh: 拔示巴说："我有一件小事求你，请不要拒绝我。"王对她说："母亲，你说吧，我必不会拒绝你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拔示巴说："我有一件小事求你，请不要拒绝我。"王对她说："母亲，你说吧，我必不会拒绝你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拔示巴说：「我有一件小事求你，望你不要推辞。」王说：「请母亲说，我必不推辞。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I have one small request to make of you," she said. "Do not refuse me." The king replied, "Make it, my mother; I will not refuse you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then she said, "I have one small request to make of you; do not refuse me." And the king said to her, "Make your request, my mother, for I will not refuse you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said, "I desire one small petition of you; do not refuse me." And the king said to her, "Ask it, my mother, for I will not refuse you."
verses.textEnNlt: "I have one small request to make of you," she said. "I hope you won’t turn me down." "What is it, my mother?" he asked. "You know I won’t refuse you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said, "I am making one small request of you; do not refuse me." And the king said to her, "Ask, my mother, for I will not refuse you."
verses.textEn: "I have one small request to make of you," she said. "Do not refuse me." The king replied, "Make it, my mother; I will not refuse you."

verses.textZh: 拔示巴说："请把书念的女子亚比煞赐给你哥哥亚多尼雅作妻子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拔示巴说："请把书念的女子亚比煞赐给你哥哥亚多尼雅作妻子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拔示巴说：「求你将书念的女子亚比煞赐给你哥哥亚多尼雅为妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: So she said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given in marriage to your brother Adonijah."
verses.textEnEsv: She said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as his wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife."
verses.textEnNlt: "Then let your brother Adonijah marry Abishag, the girl from Shunem," she replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So she said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as a wife."
verses.textEn: So she said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given in marriage to your brother Adonijah."

verses.textZh: 所罗门王回答他母亲，说："你为甚么要为亚多尼雅求书念的女子亚比煞呢？你也可以为他求这个国位，因为他是我的哥哥，又有亚比亚他祭司和洗鲁雅的儿子约押拥护他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王回答他母亲，说："你为甚么要为亚多尼雅求书念的女子亚比煞呢？你也可以为他求这个国位，因为他是我的哥哥，又有亚比亚他祭司和洗鲁雅的儿子约押拥护他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王对他母亲说：「为何单替他求书念的女子亚比煞呢？也可以为他求国吧！他是我的哥哥，他有祭司亚比亚他和洗鲁雅的儿子约押为辅佐。」
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon answered his mother, "Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? You might as well request the kingdom for him—after all, he is my older brother—yes, for him and for Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah!"
verses.textEnEsv: King Solomon answered his mother, "And why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also, for he is my older brother, and on his side are Abiathar the priest and Joab the son of Zeruiah."
verses.textEnNkjv: And King Solomon answered and said to his mother, "Now why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also—for he is my older brother—for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah."
verses.textEnNlt: "How can you possibly ask me to give Abishag to Adonijah?" King Solomon demanded. "You might as well ask me to give him the kingdom! You know that he is my older brother, and that he has Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah on his side."
verses.textEnNasb: But King Solomon answered and said to his mother, "And why are you requesting Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Request for him the kingdom as well—since he is my older brother—for him, for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah!"
verses.textEn: King Solomon answered his mother, "Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? You might as well request the kingdom for him—after all, he is my older brother—yes, for him and for Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah!"

verses.textZh: 于是所罗门王指着耶和华起誓，说："如果亚多尼雅不因说了这话而送命，愿神惩罚我，并且加倍惩罚我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是所罗门王指着耶和华起誓，说："如果亚多尼雅不因说了这话而送命，愿神惩罚我，并且加倍惩罚我。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王就指着耶和华起誓说：「亚多尼雅这话是自己送命，不然，愿神重重地降罚与我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord : "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if Adonijah does not pay with his life for this request!
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord , saying, "God do so to me and more also if this word does not cost Adonijah his life!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord, saying, "May God do so to me, and more also, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life!
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Solomon made a vow before the Lord : "May God strike me and even kill me if Adonijah has not sealed his fate with this request.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord, saying, "May God do so to me and more so, if Adonijah has not spoken this word against his own life!
verses.textEn: Then King Solomon swore by the Lord : "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if Adonijah does not pay with his life for this request!

verses.textZh: 现在，我指着永活的耶和华─那位坚立了我，使我坐在我父亲大卫的王位上，又照他所应许，为我建立家室的─起誓，今天亚多尼雅必被处死！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，我指着永活的耶和华─那位坚立了我，使我坐在我父亲大卫的王位上，又照他所应许，为我建立家室的─起誓，今天亚多尼雅必被处死！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华坚立我，使我坐在父亲大卫的位上，照着所应许的话为我建立家室；现在我指着永生的耶和华起誓，亚多尼雅今日必被治死。」
verses.textEnNiv: And now, as surely as the Lord lives—he who has established me securely on the throne of my father David and has founded a dynasty for me as he promised—Adonijah shall be put to death today!"
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore as the Lord lives, who has established me and placed me on the throne of David my father, and who has made me a house, as he promised, Adonijah shall be put to death today."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, as the Lord lives, who has confirmed me and set me on the throne of David my father, and who has established a house for me, as He promised, Adonijah shall be put to death today!"
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord has confirmed me and placed me on the throne of my father, David; he has established my dynasty as he promised. So as surely as the Lord lives, Adonijah will die this very day!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, as the Lord lives, who has established me and set me on the throne of David my father, and has made me a house just as He promised, Adonijah certainly shall be put to death today!"
verses.textEn: And now, as surely as the Lord lives—he who has established me securely on the throne of my father David and has founded a dynasty for me as he promised—Adonijah shall be put to death today!"

verses.textZh: 于是，所罗门王差派耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅去击杀亚多尼雅，他就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，所罗门王差派耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅去击杀亚多尼雅，他就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是所罗门王差遣耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，将亚多尼雅杀死。
verses.textEnNiv: So King Solomon gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he struck down Adonijah and he died.
verses.textEnEsv: So King Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he struck him down, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So King Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he struck him down, and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Solomon ordered Benaiah son of Jehoiada to execute him, and Adonijah was put to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Solomon sent the order by Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he struck him so that he died.
verses.textEn: So King Solomon gave orders to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he struck down Adonijah and he died.

verses.textZh: 王对亚比亚他祭司说："你回亚拿突自己的田地去吧！你本来是该死的，但我今天不杀死你，因为你在我父亲大卫面前抬过主耶和华的约柜，又与我父亲同受一切苦难。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对亚比亚他祭司说："你回亚拿突自己的田地去吧！你本来是该死的，但我今天不杀死你，因为你在我父亲大卫面前抬过主耶和华的约柜，又与我父亲同受一切苦难。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对祭司亚比亚他说：「你回亚拿突归自己的田地去吧！你本是该死的，但因你在我父亲大卫面前抬过主耶和华的约柜，又与我父亲同受一切苦难，所以我今日不将你杀死。」
verses.textEnNiv: To Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go back to your fields in Anathoth. You deserve to die, but I will not put you to death now, because you carried the ark of the Sovereign Lord before my father David and shared all my father’s hardships."
verses.textEnEsv: And to Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go to Anathoth, to your estate, for you deserve death. But I will not at this time put you to death, because you carried the ark of the Lord God before David my father, and because you shared in all my father’s affliction."
verses.textEnNkjv: And to Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go to Anathoth, to your own fields, for you are deserving of death; but I will not put you to death at this time, because you carried the ark of the Lord God before my father David, and because you were afflicted every time my father was afflicted."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king said to Abiathar the priest, "Go back to your home in Anathoth. You deserve to die, but I will not kill you now, because you carried the Ark of the Sovereign Lord for David my father and you shared all his hardships."
verses.textEnNasb: Then to Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go to Anathoth to your own field, for you deserve to die; but I will not put you to death at this time, because you carried the ark of the Lord God before my father David, and because you were afflicted in everything with which my father was afflicted."
verses.textEn: To Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go back to your fields in Anathoth. You deserve to die, but I will not put you to death now, because you carried the ark of the Sovereign Lord before my father David and shared all my father’s hardships."

verses.textZh: 所罗门就罢免了亚比亚他，不准他作耶和华的祭司，这样就应验了耶和华在示罗所说有关以利家的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门就罢免了亚比亚他，不准他作耶和华的祭司，这样就应验了耶和华在示罗所说有关以利家的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门就革除亚比亚他，不许他作耶和华的祭司。这样，便应验耶和华在示罗论以利家所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: So Solomon removed Abiathar from the priesthood of the Lord , fulfilling the word the Lord had spoken at Shiloh about the house of Eli.
verses.textEnEsv: So Solomon expelled Abiathar from being priest to the Lord , thus fulfilling the word of the Lord that he had spoken concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Solomon removed Abiathar from being priest to the Lord, that he might fulfill the word of the Lord which He spoke concerning the house of Eli at Shiloh.
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon deposed Abiathar from his position as priest of the Lord , thereby fulfilling the prophecy the Lord had given at Shiloh concerning the descendants of Eli.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon dismissed Abiathar from being priest to the Lord, to fulfill the word of the Lord, which He had spoken regarding the house of Eli in Shiloh.
verses.textEn: So Solomon removed Abiathar from the priesthood of the Lord , fulfilling the word the Lord had spoken at Shiloh about the house of Eli.

verses.textZh: 约押虽然没有拥护过押沙龙，但曾拥护亚多尼雅；这消息传到约押那里，他就逃到耶和华的帐幕里去，抓紧祭坛的角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押虽然没有拥护过押沙龙，但曾拥护亚多尼雅；这消息传到约押那里，他就逃到耶和华的帐幕里去，抓紧祭坛的角。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押虽然没有归从押沙龙，却归从了亚多尼雅。他听见这风声，就逃到耶和华的帐幕，抓住祭坛的角。
verses.textEnNiv: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah though not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the Lord and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnEsv: When the news came to Joab—for Joab had supported Adonijah although he had not supported Absalom—Joab fled to the tent of the Lord and caught hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then news came to Joab, for Joab had defected to Adonijah, though he had not defected to Absalom. So Joab fled to the tabernacle of the Lord, and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Joab had not joined Absalom’s earlier rebellion, but he had joined Adonijah’s rebellion. So when Joab heard about Adonijah’s death, he ran to the sacred tent of the Lord and grabbed on to the horns of the altar.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the news came to Joab because Joab had followed Adonijah, though he had not followed Absalom. So Joab fled to the tent of the Lord and took hold of the horns of the altar.
verses.textEn: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah though not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the Lord and took hold of the horns of the altar.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉所罗门王约押逃到耶和华的帐幕里去了，现在就在祭坛的旁边。于是所罗门差派耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅去说："你去把他杀死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉所罗门王约押逃到耶和华的帐幕里去了，现在就在祭坛的旁边。于是所罗门差派耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅去说："你去把他杀死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉所罗门王说：「约押逃到耶和华的帐幕，现今在祭坛的旁边。」所罗门就差遣耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，说：「你去将他杀死。」
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the tent of the Lord and was beside the altar. Then Solomon ordered Benaiah son of Jehoiada, "Go, strike him down!"
verses.textEnEsv: And when it was told King Solomon, "Joab has fled to the tent of the Lord , and behold, he is beside the altar," Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, "Go, strike him down."
verses.textEnNkjv: And King Solomon was told, "Joab has fled to the tabernacle of the Lord; there heis, by the altar." Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, "Go, strike him down."
verses.textEnNlt: When this was reported to King Solomon, he sent Benaiah son of Jehoiada to execute him.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was reported to King Solomon that Joab had fled to the tent of the Lord, and was beside the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, saying, "Go, execute him."
verses.textEn: King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the tent of the Lord and was beside the altar. Then Solomon ordered Benaiah son of Jehoiada, "Go, strike him down!"

verses.textZh: 比拿雅来到耶和华的帐幕那里，对约押说："王这样吩咐说：‘你出来！’"约押说："我不出去！我要死在这里。"于是比拿雅回复王说："约押这样说，他这样回答我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 比拿雅来到耶和华的帐幕那里，对约押说："王这样吩咐说：‘你出来！’"约押说："我不出去！我要死在这里。"于是比拿雅回复王说："约押这样说，他这样回答我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 比拿雅来到耶和华的帐幕，对约押说：「王吩咐说，你出来吧！」他说：「我不出去，我要死在这里。」比拿雅就去回复王，说约押如此如此回答我。
verses.textEnNiv: So Benaiah entered the tent of the Lord and said to Joab, "The king says, ‘Come out!’ " But he answered, "No, I will die here." Benaiah reported to the king, "This is how Joab answered me."
verses.textEnEsv: So Benaiah came to the tent of the Lord and said to him, "The king commands, ‘Come out.’" But he said, "No, I will die here." Then Benaiah brought the king word again, saying, "Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Benaiah went to the tabernacle of the Lord, and said to him, "Thus says the king, ‘Come out!’ " And he said, "No, but I will die here." And Benaiah brought back word to the king, saying, "Thus said Joab, and thus he answered me."
verses.textEnNlt: Benaiah went to the sacred tent of the Lord and said to Joab, "The king orders you to come out!" But Joab answered, "No, I will die here." So Benaiah returned to the king and told him what Joab had said.
verses.textEnNasb: So Benaiah came to the tent of the Lord and said to him, "This is what the king has said: ‘Come out.’ " But he said, "No, for I will die here." So Benaiah brought back word to the king, saying, "This is what Joab spoke, and so he answered me."
verses.textEn: So Benaiah entered the tent of the Lord and said to Joab, "The king says, ‘Come out!’ " But he answered, "No, I will die here." Benaiah reported to the king, "This is how Joab answered me."

verses.textZh: 王对比拿雅说："你照着约押的话行吧！杀死他，把他埋葬，好叫约押所流无辜人的血，从我和我父的家除去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对比拿雅说："你照着约押的话行吧！杀死他，把他埋葬，好叫约押所流无辜人的血，从我和我父的家除去。
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「你可以照着他的话行，杀死他，将他葬埋，好叫约押流无辜人血的罪不归我和我的父家了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king commanded Benaiah, "Do as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so clear me and my whole family of the guilt of the innocent blood that Joab shed.
verses.textEnEsv: The king replied to him, "Do as he has said, strike him down and bury him, and thus take away from me and from my father’s house the guilt for the blood that Joab shed without cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to him, "Do as he has said, and strike him down and bury him, that you may take away from me and from the house of my father the innocent blood which Joab shed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Do as he said," the king replied. "Kill him there beside the altar and bury him. This will remove the guilt of Joab’s senseless murders from me and from my father’s family.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king said to him, "Do just as he has spoken, and execute him and bury him, so that you may remove from me and from my father’s house the blood which Joab shed without justification.
verses.textEn: Then the king commanded Benaiah, "Do as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so clear me and my whole family of the guilt of the innocent blood that Joab shed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必使约押流无辜人的血的罪归到他自己头上，因为他击杀了两个比他又公义又良善的人，就是用刀杀了以色列的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥，和犹大的元帅益帖的儿子亚玛撒，这事我的父亲大卫一点都不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必使约押流无辜人的血的罪归到他自己头上，因为他击杀了两个比他又公义又良善的人，就是用刀杀了以色列的元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥，和犹大的元帅益帖的儿子亚玛撒，这事我的父亲大卫一点都不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必使约押流人血的罪归到他自己的头上；因为他用刀杀了两个比他又义又好的人，就是以色列元帅尼珥的儿子押尼珥和犹大元帅益帖的儿子亚玛撒，我父亲大卫却不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will repay him for the blood he shed, because without my father David knowing it he attacked two men and killed them with the sword. Both of them—Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army—were better men and more upright than he.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will bring back his bloody deeds on his own head, because, without the knowledge of my father David, he attacked and killed with the sword two men more righteous and better than himself, Abner the son of Ner, commander of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, commander of the army of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord will return his blood on his head, because he struck down two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword— Abner the son of Ner, the commander of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, the commander of the army of Judah—though my father David did not know it.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will repay him for the murders of two men who were more righteous and better than he. For my father knew nothing about the deaths of Abner son of Ner, commander of the army of Israel, and of Amasa son of Jether, commander of the army of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will return his blood on his own head, because he struck two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, while my father David did not know about it: Abner the son of Ner, commander of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, commander of the army of Judah.
verses.textEn: The Lord will repay him for the blood he shed, because without my father David knowing it he attacked two men and killed them with the sword. Both of them—Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army—were better men and more upright than he.

verses.textZh: 愿流这二人的血的罪归到约押和他后裔的头上，直到永远；但大卫和他的后裔，他的家和他的国却要从耶和华那里得享平安，直到永远。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿流这二人的血的罪归到约押和他后裔的头上，直到永远；但大卫和他的后裔，他的家和他的国却要从耶和华那里得享平安，直到永远。"
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，流这二人血的罪必归到约押和他后裔的头上，直到永远；惟有大卫和他的后裔，并他的家与国，必从耶和华那里得平安，直到永远。」
verses.textEnNiv: May the guilt of their blood rest on the head of Joab and his descendants forever. But on David and his descendants, his house and his throne, may there be the Lord ’s peace forever."
verses.textEnEsv: So shall their blood come back on the head of Joab and on the head of his descendants forever. But for David and for his descendants and for his house and for his throne there shall be peace from the Lord forevermore."
verses.textEnNkjv: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab and upon the head of his descendants forever. But upon David and his descendants, upon his house and his throne, there shall be peace forever from the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: May their blood be on Joab and his descendants forever, and may the Lord grant peace forever to David, his descendants, his dynasty, and his throne."
verses.textEnNasb: So their blood shall return on the head of Joab and on the head of his descendants forever; but for David and his descendants, and his house and his throne, may there be peace from the Lord forever."
verses.textEn: May the guilt of their blood rest on the head of Joab and his descendants forever. But on David and his descendants, his house and his throne, may there be the Lord ’s peace forever."

verses.textZh: 于是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅上去击杀他，把他杀死，葬在旷野约押自己的家中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅上去击杀他，把他杀死，葬在旷野约押自己的家中。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅上去，将约押杀死，葬在旷野约押自己的坟墓 里。
verses.textEnNiv: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck down Joab and killed him, and he was buried at his home out in the country.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and struck him down and put him to death. And he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and struck and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada returned to the sacred tent and killed Joab, and he was buried at his home in the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Benaiah the son of Jehoiada went up and struck him and put him to death, and he was buried at his own house in the wilderness.
verses.textEn: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck down Joab and killed him, and he was buried at his home out in the country.

verses.textZh: 王任命耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅取代约押统领军队；又任命撒督祭司取代亚比亚他的职位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王任命耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅取代约押统领军队；又任命撒督祭司取代亚比亚他的职位。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就立耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅作元帅，代替约押，又使祭司撒督代替亚比亚他。
verses.textEnNiv: The king put Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the army in Joab’s position and replaced Abiathar with Zadok the priest.
verses.textEnEsv: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the army in place of Joab, and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his place over the army, and the king put Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king appointed Benaiah to command the army in place of Joab, and he installed Zadok the priest to take the place of Abiathar.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king appointed Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the army in his place, and the king appointed Zadok the priest in place of Abiathar.
verses.textEn: The king put Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the army in Joab’s position and replaced Abiathar with Zadok the priest.

verses.textZh: 王派人去把示每召来，对他说："你要为自己在耶路撒冷建造一座房屋，住在那里，不可从那里出来到任何别的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王派人去把示每召来，对他说："你要为自己在耶路撒冷建造一座房屋，住在那里，不可从那里出来到任何别的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 王差遣人将示每召来，对他说：「你要在耶路撒冷建造房屋居住，不可出来往别处去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king sent for Shimei and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king sent and summoned Shimei and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and dwell there, and do not go out from there to any place whatever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and dwell there, and do not go out from there anywhere.
verses.textEnNlt: The king then sent for Shimei and told him, "Build a house here in Jerusalem and live there. But don’t step outside the city to go anywhere else.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king sent men and summoned Shimei, and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and live there, and do not leave there for any other place.
verses.textEn: Then the king sent for Shimei and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.

verses.textZh: 你必须知道，你哪一天出来，越过汲沦溪，你哪一天就要死。你流人血的罪必归到你自己的头上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必须知道，你哪一天出来，越过汲沦溪，你哪一天就要死。你流人血的罪必归到你自己的头上。"
