verses.textZhCuv: 你当确实地知道，你何日出来过汲沦溪，何日必死！你的罪 必归到自己的头上。」
verses.textEnNiv: The day you leave and cross the Kidron Valley, you can be sure you will die; your blood will be on your own head."
verses.textEnEsv: For on the day you go out and cross the brook Kidron, know for certain that you shall die. Your blood shall be on your own head."
verses.textEnNkjv: For it shall be, on the day you go out and cross the Brook Kidron, know for certain you shall surely die; your blood shall be on your own head."
verses.textEnNlt: On the day you so much as cross the Kidron Valley, you will surely die; and your blood will be on your own head."
verses.textEnNasb: For on the day you leave and cross the brook Kidron, you will know for certain that you will assuredly die; your blood will be on your own head."
verses.textEn: The day you leave and cross the Kidron Valley, you can be sure you will die; your blood will be on your own head."

verses.textZh: 示每对王说："这话很好，我主我王怎么说，你仆人就照着行。"于是示每在耶路撒冷住了很久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示每对王说："这话很好，我主我王怎么说，你仆人就照着行。"于是示每在耶路撒冷住了很久。
verses.textZhCuv: 示每对王说：「这话甚好！我主我王怎样说，仆人必怎样行。」于是示每多日住在耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Shimei answered the king, "What you say is good. Your servant will do as my lord the king has said." And Shimei stayed in Jerusalem for a long time.
verses.textEnEsv: And Shimei said to the king, "What you say is good; as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do." So Shimei lived in Jerusalem many days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Shimei said to the king, "The saying is good. As my lord the king has said, so your servant will do." So Shimei dwelt in Jerusalem many days.
verses.textEnNlt: Shimei replied, "Your sentence is fair; I will do whatever my lord the king commands." So Shimei lived in Jerusalem for a long time.
verses.textEnNasb: Shimei then said to the king, "The word is good. Just as my lord the king has spoken, so your servant shall do." So Shimei lived in Jerusalem for many days.
verses.textEn: Shimei answered the king, "What you say is good. Your servant will do as my lord the king has said." And Shimei stayed in Jerusalem for a long time.

verses.textZh: 三年以后，示每的两个仆人逃到迦特王玛迦的儿子亚吉那里。有人告诉示每说："你的仆人在迦特。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 三年以后，示每的两个仆人逃到迦特王玛迦的儿子亚吉那里。有人告诉示每说："你的仆人在迦特。"
verses.textZhCuv: 过了三年，示每的两个仆人逃到迦特王玛迦的儿子亚吉那里去。有人告诉示每说：「你的仆人在迦特。」
verses.textEnNiv: But three years later, two of Shimei’s slaves ran off to Achish son of Maakah, king of Gath, and Shimei was told, "Your slaves are in Gath."
verses.textEnEsv: But it happened at the end of three years that two of Shimei’s servants ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. And when it was told Shimei, "Behold, your servants are in Gath,"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened at the end of three years, that two slaves of Shimei ran away to Achish the son of Maachah, king of Gath. And they told Shimei, saying, "Look, your slaves are in Gath!"
verses.textEnNlt: But three years later two of Shimei’s slaves ran away to King Achish son of Maacah of Gath. When Shimei learned where they were,
verses.textEnNasb: But it came about at the end of three years, that two of Shimei’s servants ran away to Achish son of Maacah, king of Gath. And others told Shimei, saying, "Behold, your servants are in Gath."
verses.textEn: But three years later, two of Shimei’s slaves ran off to Achish son of Maakah, king of Gath, and Shimei was told, "Your slaves are in Gath."

verses.textZh: 于是示每起来，预备好自己的骡子，就往迦特亚吉王那里去寻找他的仆人。示每去了，又把他的仆人从迦特带回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是示每起来，预备好自己的骡子，就往迦特亚吉王那里去寻找他的仆人。示每去了，又把他的仆人从迦特带回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 示每起来，备上驴，往迦特到亚吉那里去找他的仆人，就从迦特带他仆人回来。
verses.textEnNiv: At this, he saddled his donkey and went to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves. So Shimei went away and brought the slaves back from Gath.
verses.textEnEsv: Shimei arose and saddled a donkey and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants. Shimei went and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Shimei arose, saddled his donkey, and went to Achish at Gath to seek his slaves. And Shimei went and brought his slaves from Gath.
verses.textEnNlt: he saddled his donkey and went to Gath to search for them. When he found them, he brought them back to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Shimei got up and saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish, to search for his servants. And Shimei went and brought his servants from Gath.
verses.textEn: At this, he saddled his donkey and went to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves. So Shimei went away and brought the slaves back from Gath.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉所罗门示每离开耶路撒冷往迦特去，又回来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉所罗门示每离开耶路撒冷往迦特去，又回来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉所罗门说：「示每出耶路撒冷往迦特去，回来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,
verses.textEnEsv: And when Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and returned,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had come back.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon heard that Shimei had left Jerusalem and had gone to Gath and returned.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was reported to Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath, and had returned.
verses.textEn: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,

verses.textZh: 王就派人把示每召来，对他说："我不是叫你指着耶和华起誓，并且警告你：‘你必须知道，你哪一天出去到任何别的地方，你哪一天就要死’吗？你也对我说过：‘这话很好，我必听从。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就派人把示每召来，对他说："我不是叫你指着耶和华起誓，并且警告你：‘你必须知道，你哪一天出去到任何别的地方，你哪一天就要死’吗？你也对我说过：‘这话很好，我必听从。’
verses.textZhCuv: 王就差遣人将示每召了来，对他说：「我岂不是叫你指着耶和华起誓，并且警戒你说『你当确实地知道，你哪日出来往别处去，那日必死』吗？你也对我说：『这话甚好，我必听从。』
verses.textEnNiv: the king summoned Shimei and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the Lord and warn you, ‘On the day you leave to go anywhere else, you can be sure you will die’? At that time you said to me, ‘What you say is good. I will obey.’
verses.textEnEsv: the king sent and summoned Shimei and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the Lord and solemnly warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and go to any place whatever, you shall die’? And you said to me, ‘What you say is good; I will obey.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the Lord, and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and travel anywhere, you shall surely die’? And you said to me, ‘The word I have heard is good.’
verses.textEnNlt: So the king sent for Shimei and demanded, "Didn’t I make you swear by the Lord and warn you not to go anywhere else or you would surely die? And you replied, ‘The sentence is fair; I will do as you say.’
verses.textEnNasb: So the king sent men and summoned Shimei, and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the Lord, and solemnly warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you depart and go anywhere, you shall assuredly die’? And you said to me, ‘The word I have heard is good.’
verses.textEn: the king summoned Shimei and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the Lord and warn you, ‘On the day you leave to go anywhere else, you can be sure you will die’? At that time you said to me, ‘What you say is good. I will obey.’

verses.textZh: 现在你为甚么不遵守你向耶和华所起的誓，和我吩咐你的命令呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你为甚么不遵守你向耶和华所起的誓，和我吩咐你的命令呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你为何不遵守你指着耶和华起的誓和我所吩咐你的命令呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Why then did you not keep your oath to the Lord and obey the command I gave you?"
verses.textEnEsv: Why then have you not kept your oath to the Lord and the commandment with which I commanded you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Why then have you not kept the oath of the Lord and the commandment that I gave you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then why haven’t you kept your oath to the Lord and obeyed my command?"
verses.textEnNasb: Why then have you not kept the oath of the Lord, and the command which I imposed on you?"
verses.textEn: Why then did you not keep your oath to the Lord and obey the command I gave you?"

verses.textZh: 王又对示每说："你自己知道你心里的一切恶事，就是你向我父亲大卫所行的；现在耶和华要把你的罪归到你的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又对示每说："你自己知道你心里的一切恶事，就是你向我父亲大卫所行的；现在耶和华要把你的罪归到你的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 王又对示每说：「你向我父亲大卫所行的一切恶事，你自己心里也知道，所以耶和华必使你的罪恶归到自己的头上；
verses.textEnNiv: The king also said to Shimei, "You know in your heart all the wrong you did to my father David. Now the Lord will repay you for your wrongdoing.
verses.textEnEsv: The king also said to Shimei, "You know in your own heart all the harm that you did to David my father. So the Lord will bring back your harm on your own head.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king said moreover to Shimei, "You know, as your heart acknowledges, all the wickedness that you did to my father David; therefore the Lord will return your wickedness on your own head.
verses.textEnNlt: The king also said to Shimei, "You certainly remember all the wicked things you did to my father, David. May the Lord now bring that evil on your own head.
verses.textEnNasb: The king also said to Shimei, "You yourself know all the evil that you acknowledge in your heart, which you did to my father David; therefore the Lord will return your evil on your own head.
verses.textEn: The king also said to Shimei, "You know in your heart all the wrong you did to my father David. Now the Lord will repay you for your wrongdoing.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王却要蒙福，大卫的王位必在耶和华眼前得坚立，直到永远。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王却要蒙福，大卫的王位必在耶和华眼前得坚立，直到永远。"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有所罗门王必得福，并且大卫的国位必在耶和华面前坚定，直到永远。」
verses.textEnNiv: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will remain secure before the Lord forever."
verses.textEnEsv: But King Solomon shall be blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: But King Solomon shallbe blessed, and the throne of David shall be established before the Lord forever."
verses.textEnNlt: But may I, King Solomon, receive the Lord ’s blessings, and may one of David’s descendants always sit on this throne in the presence of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: But King Solomon will be blessed, and the throne of David will be established before the Lord forever."
verses.textEn: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David’s throne will remain secure before the Lord forever."

verses.textZh: 于是王命令耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，比拿雅就出去击杀示每，示每就死了。这样，所罗门就巩固了他的国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王命令耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，比拿雅就出去击杀示每，示每就死了。这样，所罗门就巩固了他的国。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是王吩咐耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅，他就去杀死示每。这样，便坚定了所罗门的国位。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king gave the order to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck Shimei down and he died. The kingdom was now established in Solomon’s hands.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck him down, and he died. So the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada; and he went out and struck him down, and he died. Thus the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, at the king’s command, Benaiah son of Jehoiada took Shimei outside and killed him. So the kingdom was now firmly in Solomon’s grip.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck him so that he died. And the kingdom was established in the hands of Solomon.
verses.textEn: Then the king gave the order to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck Shimei down and he died. The kingdom was now established in Solomon’s hands.

verses.textZh: 所罗门与埃及王法老结亲，娶了法老的女儿，把她迎进大卫城，直等到他的王宫、耶和华的殿和耶路撒冷周围的城墙都建造完了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门与埃及王法老结亲，娶了法老的女儿，把她迎进大卫城，直等到他的王宫、耶和华的殿和耶路撒冷周围的城墙都建造完了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门与埃及王法老结亲，娶了法老的女儿为妻，接她进入大卫城，直等到造完了自己的宫和耶和华的殿，并耶路撒冷周围的城墙。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt and married his daughter. He brought her to the City of David until he finished building his palace and the temple of the Lord , and the wall around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt. He took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her into the city of David until he had finished building his own house and the house of the Lord and the wall around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Solomon made a treaty with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and married Pharaoh’s daughter; then he brought her to the City of David until he had finished building his own house, and the house of the Lord, and the wall all around Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and married one of his daughters. He brought her to live in the City of David until he could finish building his palace and the Temple of the Lord and the wall around the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon formed a marriage alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter and brought her to the city of David until he had finished building his own house and the house of the Lord, and the wall around Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt and married his daughter. He brought her to the City of David until he finished building his palace and the temple of the Lord , and the wall around Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 不过在那些日子，人民仍然在邱坛上献祭，因为还没有为耶和华的名建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过在那些日子，人民仍然在邱坛上献祭，因为还没有为耶和华的名建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那些日子，百姓仍在邱坛献祭，因为还没有为耶和华的名建殿。
verses.textEnNiv: The people, however, were still sacrificing at the high places, because a temple had not yet been built for the Name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The people were sacrificing at the high places, however, because no house had yet been built for the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Meanwhile the people sacrificed at the high places, because there was no house built for the name of the Lord until those days.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time the people of Israel sacrificed their offerings at local places of worship, for a temple honoring the name of the Lord had not yet been built.
verses.textEnNasb: The people were still sacrificing on the high places, because there was no house built for the name of the Lord until those days.
verses.textEn: The people, however, were still sacrificing at the high places, because a temple had not yet been built for the Name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 所罗门爱耶和华，遵行他父亲大卫的律例；只是他仍然在邱坛上宰杀和焚烧祭牲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门爱耶和华，遵行他父亲大卫的律例；只是他仍然在邱坛上宰杀和焚烧祭牲。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门爱耶和华，遵行他父亲大卫的律例，只是还在邱坛献祭烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon showed his love for the Lord by walking according to the instructions given him by his father David, except that he offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon loved the Lord , walking in the statutes of David his father, only he sacrificed and made offerings at the high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of his father David, except that he sacrificed and burned incense at the high places.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon loved the Lord and followed all the decrees of his father, David, except that Solomon, too, offered sacrifices and burned incense at the local places of worship.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon loved the Lord, walking in the statutes of his father David, except that he was sacrificing and burning incense on the high places.
verses.textEn: Solomon showed his love for the Lord by walking according to the instructions given him by his father David, except that he offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places.

verses.textZh: 有一次，王到基遍去献祭，因为那里有极大的邱坛。所罗门在那祭坛上献上了一千燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，王到基遍去献祭，因为那里有极大的邱坛。所罗门在那祭坛上献上了一千燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王上基遍去献祭；因为在那里有极大 的邱坛，他在那坛上献一千牺牲作燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: The king went to Gibeon to offer sacrifices, for that was the most important high place, and Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place. Solomon used to offer a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for that was the great high place: Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
verses.textEnNlt: The most important of these places of worship was at Gibeon, so the king went there and sacrificed 1,000 burnt offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, because that was the great high place; Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
verses.textEn: The king went to Gibeon to offer sacrifices, for that was the most important high place, and Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

verses.textZh: 那天晚上在基遍，耶和华在梦中向所罗门显现；神说："你无论求甚么，我必赐给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天晚上在基遍，耶和华在梦中向所罗门显现；神说："你无论求甚么，我必赐给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在基遍，夜间梦中，耶和华向所罗门显现，对他说：「你愿我赐你什么？你可以求。」
verses.textEnNiv: At Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon during the night in a dream, and God said, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."
verses.textEnEsv: At Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night, and God said, "Ask what I shall give you."
verses.textEnNkjv: At Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream by night; and God said, "Ask! What shall I give you?"
verses.textEnNlt: That night the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream, and God said, "What do you want? Ask, and I will give it to you!"
verses.textEnNasb: In Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream at night; and God said, "Ask what you wish Me to give you."
verses.textEn: At Gibeon the Lord appeared to Solomon during the night in a dream, and God said, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."

verses.textZh: 所罗门说："你仆人我父亲大卫以诚实、公义和正直的心在你面前行事为人，你就以极大的慈爱待他；你又为他存留这极大的慈爱，赐给他一个儿子坐在他的王位上，正如今日一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门说："你仆人我父亲大卫以诚实、公义和正直的心在你面前行事为人，你就以极大的慈爱待他；你又为他存留这极大的慈爱，赐给他一个儿子坐在他的王位上，正如今日一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门说：「你仆人－我父亲大卫用诚实、公义、正直的心行在你面前，你就向他大施恩典，又为他存留大恩，赐他一个儿子坐在他的位上，正如今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon answered, "You have shown great kindness to your servant, my father David, because he was faithful to you and righteous and upright in heart. You have continued this great kindness to him and have given him a son to sit on his throne this very day.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon said, "You have shown great and steadfast love to your servant David my father, because he walked before you in faithfulness, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart toward you. And you have kept for him this great and steadfast love and have given him a son to sit on his throne this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon said: "You have shown great mercy to Your servant David my father, because he walked before You in truth, in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with You; You have continued this great kindness for him, and You have given him a son to sit on his throne, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon replied, "You showed great and faithful love to your servant my father, David, because he was honest and true and faithful to you. And you have continued to show this great and faithful love to him today by giving him a son to sit on his throne.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon said, "You have shown great faithfulness to Your servant David my father, according as he walked before You in truth, righteousness, and uprightness of heart toward You; and You have reserved for him this great faithfulness, that You have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
verses.textEn: Solomon answered, "You have shown great kindness to your servant, my father David, because he was faithful to you and righteous and upright in heart. You have continued this great kindness to him and have given him a son to sit on his throne this very day.

verses.textZh: 耶和华我的神啊，现在你使仆人接续我的父亲大卫作王，但我还年轻，不知道应当怎样处事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华我的神啊，现在你使仆人接续我的父亲大卫作王，但我还年轻，不知道应当怎样处事。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－我的神啊，如今你使仆人接续我父亲大卫作王；但我是幼童，不知道应当怎样出入。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, Lord my God, you have made your servant king in place of my father David. But I am only a little child and do not know how to carry out my duties.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O Lord my God, you have made your servant king in place of David my father, although I am but a little child. I do not know how to go out or come in.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now, O Lord my God, You have made Your servant king instead of my father David, but I am a little child; I do not know how to go out or come in.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now, O Lord my God, you have made me king instead of my father, David, but I am like a little child who doesn’t know his way around.
verses.textEnNasb: And now, Lord my God, You have made Your servant king in place of my father David, yet I am like a little boy; I do not know how to go out or come in.
verses.textEn: "Now, Lord my God, you have made your servant king in place of my father David. But I am only a little child and do not know how to carry out my duties.

verses.textZh: 仆人住在你拣选的子民中；这些子民很多，多得不能数算。
verses.textZhCnvs: 仆人住在你拣选的子民中；这些子民很多，多得不能数算。
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人住在你所拣选的民中，这民多得不可胜数。
verses.textEnNiv: Your servant is here among the people you have chosen, a great people, too numerous to count or number.
verses.textEnEsv: And your servant is in the midst of your people whom you have chosen, a great people, too many to be numbered or counted for multitude.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Your servant is in the midst of Your people whom You have chosen, a great people, too numerous to be numbered or counted.
verses.textEnNlt: And here I am in the midst of your own chosen people, a nation so great and numerous they cannot be counted!
verses.textEnNasb: And Your servant is in the midst of Your people whom You have chosen, a great people who are too many to be numbered or counted.
verses.textEn: Your servant is here among the people you have chosen, a great people, too numerous to count or number.

verses.textZh: 所以，求你赐给仆人一颗明辨的心，可以判断你的子民，能辨别是非，因为谁能判断你这众多的子民呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，求你赐给仆人一颗明辨的心，可以判断你的子民，能辨别是非，因为谁能判断你这众多的子民呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以求你赐我智慧，可以判断你的民，能辨别是非。不然，谁能判断这众多的民呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people and to distinguish between right and wrong. For who is able to govern this great people of yours?"
verses.textEnEsv: Give your servant therefore an understanding mind to govern your people, that I may discern between good and evil, for who is able to govern this your great people?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore give to Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people, that I may discern between good and evil. For who is able to judge this great people of Yours?"
verses.textEnNlt: Give me an understanding heart so that I can govern your people well and know the difference between right and wrong. For who by himself is able to govern this great people of yours?"
verses.textEnNasb: So give Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people, to discern between good and evil. For who is capable of judging this great people of Yours?"
verses.textEn: So give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people and to distinguish between right and wrong. For who is able to govern this great people of yours?"

verses.textZh: 所罗门因为求这些事，就蒙主的喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门因为求这些事，就蒙主的喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门因为求这事，就蒙主喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.
verses.textEnEsv: It pleased the Lord that Solomon had asked this.
verses.textEnNkjv: The speech pleased the Lord, that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for wisdom.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was pleasing in the sight of the Lord that Solomon had asked this thing.
verses.textEn: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.

verses.textZh: 神对他说："因为你求这事，不为自己求长寿，不为自己求财富，也不求你仇敌的性命，单单为自己求聪明可以明辨是非公平，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对他说："因为你求这事，不为自己求长寿，不为自己求财富，也不求你仇敌的性命，单单为自己求聪明可以明辨是非公平，
verses.textZhCuv: 神对他说：「你既然求这事，不为自己求寿、求富，也不求灭绝你仇敌的性命，单求智慧可以听讼，
verses.textEnNiv: So God said to him, "Since you have asked for this and not for long life or wealth for yourself, nor have asked for the death of your enemies but for discernment in administering justice,
verses.textEnEsv: And God said to him, "Because you have asked this, and have not asked for yourself long life or riches or the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern what is right,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said to him: "Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked long life for yourself, nor have asked riches for yourself, nor have asked the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice,
verses.textEnNlt: So God replied, "Because you have asked for wisdom in governing my people with justice and have not asked for a long life or wealth or the death of your enemies—
verses.textEnNasb: And God said to him, "Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself a long life, nor have asked riches for yourself, nor have you asked for the lives of your enemies, but have asked for yourself discernment to understand justice,
verses.textEn: So God said to him, "Since you have asked for this and not for long life or wealth for yourself, nor have asked for the death of your enemies but for discernment in administering justice,

verses.textZh: 我就照着你所求的而行；赐给你一个智慧和明辨的心，在你以前没有人像你，在你以后也不会有人像你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就照着你所求的而行；赐给你一个智慧和明辨的心，在你以前没有人像你，在你以后也不会有人像你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就应允你所求的，赐你聪明智慧，甚至在你以前没有像你的，在你以后也没有像你的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there will never have been anyone like you, nor will there ever be.
verses.textEnEsv: behold, I now do according to your word. Behold, I give you a wise and discerning mind, so that none like you has been before you and none like you shall arise after you.
verses.textEnNkjv: behold, I have done according to your words; see, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has not been anyone like you before you, nor shall any like you arise after you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will give you what you asked for! I will give you a wise and understanding heart such as no one else has had or ever will have!
verses.textEnNasb: behold, I have done according to your words. Behold, I have given you a wise and discerning heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, nor shall one like you arise after you.
verses.textEn: I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there will never have been anyone like you, nor will there ever be.

verses.textZh: 连你所没有求的，我也赐给你，就是财富、尊荣，以至你一生的年日，在列王之中没有一人能像你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连你所没有求的，我也赐给你，就是财富、尊荣，以至你一生的年日，在列王之中没有一人能像你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所没有求的，我也赐给你，就是富足、尊荣，使你在世的日子，列王中没有一个能比你的。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, I will give you what you have not asked for—both wealth and honor—so that in your lifetime you will have no equal among kings.
verses.textEnEsv: I give you also what you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that no other king shall compare with you, all your days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I have also given you what you have not asked: both riches and honor, so that there shall not be anyone like you among the kings all your days.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will also give you what you did not ask for—riches and fame! No other king in all the world will be compared to you for the rest of your life!
verses.textEnNasb: I have also given you what you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there will not be any among the kings like you all your days.
verses.textEn: Moreover, I will give you what you have not asked for—both wealth and honor—so that in your lifetime you will have no equal among kings.

verses.textZh: 如果你遵行了我的道，谨守我的律例、诫命，正如你父亲大卫所行的，我就必延长你的寿数。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你遵行了我的道，谨守我的律例、诫命，正如你父亲大卫所行的，我就必延长你的寿数。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你若效法你父亲大卫，遵行我的道，谨守我的律例、诫命，我必使你长寿。」
verses.textEnNiv: And if you walk in obedience to me and keep my decrees and commands as David your father did, I will give you a long life."
verses.textEnEsv: And if you will walk in my ways, keeping my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days."
verses.textEnNkjv: So if you walk in My ways, to keep My statutes and My commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen your days."
verses.textEnNlt: And if you follow me and obey my decrees and my commands as your father, David, did, I will give you a long life."
verses.textEnNasb: And if you walk in My ways, keeping My statutes and commandments, as your father David walked, then I will prolong your days."
verses.textEn: And if you walk in obedience to me and keep my decrees and commands as David your father did, I will give you a long life."

verses.textZh: 所罗门醒来，原来是一个梦。于是他回到耶路撒冷，站在耶和华的约柜前，献上燔祭，又献上平安祭，也为他的众臣仆摆设筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门醒来，原来是一个梦。于是他回到耶路撒冷，站在耶和华的约柜前，献上燔祭，又献上平安祭，也为他的众臣仆摆设筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门醒了，不料是个梦。他就回到耶路撒冷，站在耶和华的约柜前，献燔祭和平安祭，又为他众臣仆设摆筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon awoke—and he realized it had been a dream. He returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark of the Lord’s covenant and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then he gave a feast for all his court.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon awoke, and behold, it was a dream. Then he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered up burnt offerings and peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon awoke; and indeed it had been a dream. And he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, offered up burnt offerings, offered peace offerings, and made a feast for all his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon woke up and realized it had been a dream. He returned to Jerusalem and stood before the Ark of the Lord’s Covenant, where he sacrificed burnt offerings and peace offerings. Then he invited all his officials to a great banquet.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon awoke, and behold, it was a dream. And he came to Jerusalem and stood before the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and made peace offerings, and held a feast for all his servants.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon awoke—and he realized it had been a dream. He returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark of the Lord’s covenant and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then he gave a feast for all his court.

verses.textZh: 有一天，有两个作妓女的妇人来见王，站在他面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，有两个作妓女的妇人来见王，站在他面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，有两个妓女来，站在王面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Now two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now two women whowere harlots came to the king, and stood before him.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later two prostitutes came to the king to have an argument settled.
verses.textEnNasb: Then two women who were prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.
verses.textEn: Now two prostitutes came to the king and stood before him.

verses.textZh: 其中一个妇人说："我主啊，我和这妇人同住；她与我在房子里的时候，我生了一个孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中一个妇人说："我主啊，我和这妇人同住；她与我在房子里的时候，我生了一个孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 一个说：「我主啊，我和这妇人同住一房；她在房中的时候，我生了一个男孩。
verses.textEnNiv: One of them said, "Pardon me, my lord. This woman and I live in the same house, and I had a baby while she was there with me.
verses.textEnEsv: The one woman said, "Oh, my lord, this woman and I live in the same house, and I gave birth to a child while she was in the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And one woman said, "O my lord, this woman and I dwell in the same house; and I gave birth while she was in the house.
verses.textEnNlt: "Please, my lord," one of them began, "this woman and I live in the same house. I gave birth to a baby while she was with me in the house.
verses.textEnNasb: The one woman said, "Pardon me, my lord: this woman and I live in the same house; and I gave birth to a child while she was in the house.
verses.textEn: One of them said, "Pardon me, my lord. This woman and I live in the same house, and I had a baby while she was there with me.

verses.textZh: 我生了孩子以后的第三天，这妇人也生了一个孩子。我们都住在一起。除了我们两个人在房子里以外，再没有别人与我们一起在这房子里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我生了孩子以后的第三天，这妇人也生了一个孩子。我们都住在一起。除了我们两个人在房子里以外，再没有别人与我们一起在这房子里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我生孩子后第三日，这妇人也生了孩子。我们是同住的，除了我们二人之外，房中再没有别人。
verses.textEnNiv: The third day after my child was born, this woman also had a baby. We were alone; there was no one in the house but the two of us.
verses.textEnEsv: Then on the third day after I gave birth, this woman also gave birth. And we were alone. There was no one else with us in the house; only we two were in the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, the third day after I had given birth, that this woman also gave birth. And we were together; no one was with us in the house, except the two of us in the house.
verses.textEnNlt: Three days later this woman also had a baby. We were alone; there were only two of us in the house.
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened on the third day after I gave birth, that this woman also gave birth to a child, and we were together. There was no stranger with us in the house, only the two of us in the house.
verses.textEn: The third day after my child was born, this woman also had a baby. We were alone; there was no one in the house but the two of us.

verses.textZh: 夜间，这妇人睡觉的时候，压死了她的孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夜间，这妇人睡觉的时候，压死了她的孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 夜间，这妇人睡着的时候，压死了她的孩子。
verses.textEnNiv: "During the night this woman’s son died because she lay on him.
verses.textEnEsv: And this woman’s son died in the night, because she lay on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this woman’s son died in the night, because she lay on him.
verses.textEnNlt: "But her baby died during the night when she rolled over on it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then this woman’s son died in the night, because she lay on him.
verses.textEn: "During the night this woman’s son died because she lay on him.

verses.textZh: 她却在半夜，趁着婢女睡着的时候，起来，从我身旁把儿子抱去，放在她的怀里；又把她死了的儿子放在我的怀里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她却在半夜，趁着婢女睡着的时候，起来，从我身旁把儿子抱去，放在她的怀里；又把她死了的儿子放在我的怀里。
verses.textZhCuv: 她半夜起来，趁我睡着，从我旁边把我的孩子抱去，放在她怀里，将她的死孩子放在我怀里。
verses.textEnNiv: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I your servant was asleep. She put him by her breast and put her dead son by my breast.
verses.textEnEsv: And she arose at midnight and took my son from beside me, while your servant slept, and laid him at her breast, and laid her dead son at my breast.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she arose in the middle of the night and took my son from my side, while your maidservant slept, and laid him in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she got up in the night and took my son from beside me while I was asleep. She laid her dead child in my arms and took mine to sleep beside her.
verses.textEnNasb: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from beside me while your servant was asleep, and she laid him at her breast, and laid her dead son at my breast.
verses.textEn: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I your servant was asleep. She put him by her breast and put her dead son by my breast.

verses.textZh: 第二天早上我起来，要给我的儿子吃奶的时候，发觉他死了。那天早晨我再仔细察看，发觉他并不是我所生的儿子！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天早上我起来，要给我的儿子吃奶的时候，发觉他死了。那天早晨我再仔细察看，发觉他并不是我所生的儿子！"
verses.textZhCuv: 天要亮的时候，我起来要给我的孩子吃奶，不料，孩子死了；及至天亮，我细细地察看，不是我所生的孩子。」
verses.textEnNiv: The next morning, I got up to nurse my son—and he was dead! But when I looked at him closely in the morning light, I saw that it wasn’t the son I had borne."
verses.textEnEsv: When I rose in the morning to nurse my child, behold, he was dead. But when I looked at him closely in the morning, behold, he was not the child that I had borne."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when I rose in the morning to nurse my son, there he was, dead. But when I had examined him in the morning, indeed, he was not my son whom I had borne."
verses.textEnNlt: And in the morning when I tried to nurse my son, he was dead! But when I looked more closely in the morning light, I saw that it wasn’t my son at all."
verses.textEnNasb: When I got up in the morning to nurse my son, behold, he was dead! But when I examined him closely in the morning, behold, he was not my son, whom I had borne!"
verses.textEn: The next morning, I got up to nurse my son—and he was dead! But when I looked at him closely in the morning light, I saw that it wasn’t the son I had borne."

verses.textZh: 那一个妇人说："不！活的儿子是我的，死的儿子才是你的。"但这一个妇人说："不！死的儿子是你的，活的儿子才是我的。"她们在王面前彼此争辩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一个妇人说："不！活的儿子是我的，死的儿子才是你的。"但这一个妇人说："不！死的儿子是你的，活的儿子才是我的。"她们在王面前彼此争辩。
verses.textZhCuv: 那妇人说：「不然，活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的。」这妇人说：「不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的。」她们在王面前如此争论。
verses.textEnNiv: The other woman said, "No! The living one is my son; the dead one is yours." But the first one insisted, "No! The dead one is yours; the living one is mine." And so they argued before the king.
verses.textEnEsv: But the other woman said, "No, the living child is mine, and the dead child is yours." The first said, "No, the dead child is yours, and the living child is mine." Thus they spoke before the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the other woman said, "No! But the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son." And the first woman said, "No! But the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son." Thus they spoke before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the other woman interrupted, "It certainly was your son, and the living child is mine." "No," the first woman said, "the living child is mine, and the dead one is yours." And so they argued back and forth before the king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the other woman said, "No! For the living one is my son, and the dead one is your son." But the first woman said, "No! For the dead one is your son, and the living one is my son." So they spoke before the king.
verses.textEn: The other woman said, "No! The living one is my son; the dead one is yours." But the first one insisted, "No! The dead one is yours; the living one is mine." And so they argued before the king.

verses.textZh: 王说："这个妇人说：‘活的儿子是我的，死的儿子才是你的’，那个妇人却说：‘不！死的儿子是你的，活的儿子才是我的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王说："这个妇人说：‘活的儿子是我的，死的儿子才是你的’，那个妇人却说：‘不！死的儿子是你的，活的儿子才是我的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「这妇人说『活孩子是我的，死孩子是你的』，那妇人说『不然，死孩子是你的，活孩子是我的』」，
verses.textEnNiv: The king said, "This one says, ‘My son is alive and your son is dead,’ while that one says, ‘No! Your son is dead and mine is alive.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king said, "The one says, ‘This is my son that is alive, and your son is dead’; and the other says, ‘No; but your son is dead, and my son is the living one.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said, "The one says, ‘This is my son, who lives, and your son is the dead one’; and the other says, ‘No! But your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king said, "Let’s get the facts straight. Both of you claim the living child is yours, and each says that the dead one belongs to the other.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said, " The one says, ‘This is my son who is living, and your son is the dead one’; and the other says, ‘No! For your son is the dead one, and my son is the living one.’ "
verses.textEn: The king said, "This one says, ‘My son is alive and your son is dead,’ while that one says, ‘No! Your son is dead and mine is alive.’ "

verses.textZh: 王就吩咐："给我拿一把刀来！"人就把刀带到王面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就吩咐："给我拿一把刀来！"人就把刀带到王面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 就吩咐说：「拿刀来！」人就拿刀来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king said, "Bring me a sword." So they brought a sword for the king.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said, "Bring me a sword." So a sword was brought before the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said, "Bring me a sword." So they brought a sword before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: All right, bring me a sword." So a sword was brought to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king said, "Get me a sword." So they brought a sword before the king.
verses.textEn: Then the king said, "Bring me a sword." So they brought a sword for the king.

verses.textZh: 王说："把活的孩子劈成两半，一半给这个妇人，一半给那个妇人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王说："把活的孩子劈成两半，一半给这个妇人，一半给那个妇人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「将活孩子劈成两半，一半给那妇人，一半给这妇人。」
verses.textEnNiv: He then gave an order: "Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said, "Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one and half to the other."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said, "Divide the living child in two, and give half to one, and half to the other."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Cut the living child in two, and give half to one woman and half to the other!"
verses.textEnNasb: And the king said, "Cut the living child in two, and give half to the one and half to the other."
verses.textEn: He then gave an order: "Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other."

verses.textZh: 那活孩子的母亲因为爱子心切，就对王说："我主啊，把那活的孩子给她吧，千万不可杀死他！"另一个妇人却说："这孩子也不归我，也不归你，把他劈开吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那活孩子的母亲因为爱子心切，就对王说："我主啊，把那活的孩子给她吧，千万不可杀死他！"另一个妇人却说："这孩子也不归我，也不归你，把他劈开吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 活孩子的母亲为自己的孩子心里急痛，就说：「求我主将活孩子给那妇人吧，万不可杀他！」那妇人说：「这孩子也不归我，也不归你，把他劈了吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: The woman whose son was alive was deeply moved out of love for her son and said to the king, "Please, my lord, give her the living baby! Don’t kill him!" But the other said, "Neither I nor you shall have him. Cut him in two!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the woman whose son was alive said to the king, because her heart yearned for her son, "Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and by no means put him to death." But the other said, "He shall be neither mine nor yours; divide him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman whose son was living spoke to the king, for she yearned with compassion for her son; and she said, "O my lord, give her the living child, and by no means kill him!" But the other said, "Let him be neither mine nor yours, but divide him."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the woman who was the real mother of the living child, and who loved him very much, cried out, "Oh no, my lord! Give her the child—please do not kill him!" But the other woman said, "All right, he will be neither yours nor mine; divide him between us!"
verses.textEnNasb: But the woman whose child was the living one spoke to the king, for she was deeply stirred over her son, and she said, "Pardon me, my lord! Give her the living child, and by no means kill him!" But the other woman was saying, "He shall be neither mine nor yours; cut him!"
verses.textEn: The woman whose son was alive was deeply moved out of love for her son and said to the king, "Please, my lord, give her the living baby! Don’t kill him!" But the other said, "Neither I nor you shall have him. Cut him in two!"

verses.textZh: 王回答说："把活孩子给这个妇人，千万不可杀死他，这个妇人实在是他的母亲。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王回答说："把活孩子给这个妇人，千万不可杀死他，这个妇人实在是他的母亲。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「将活孩子给这妇人，万不可杀他；这妇人实在是他的母亲。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king gave his ruling: "Give the living baby to the first woman. Do not kill him; she is his mother."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king answered and said, "Give the living child to the first woman, and by no means put him to death; she is his mother."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king answered and said, "Give the first woman the living child, and by no means kill him; she is his mother."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king said, "Do not kill the child, but give him to the woman who wants him to live, for she is his mother!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king replied, "Give the first woman the living child, and by no means kill him. She is his mother."
verses.textEn: Then the king gave his ruling: "Give the living baby to the first woman. Do not kill him; she is his mother."

verses.textZh: 以色列众人听见王判断的这案件，就都敬畏他，因为看见他心里有神的智慧，能够判案。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人听见王判断的这案件，就都敬畏他，因为看见他心里有神的智慧，能够判案。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人听见王这样判断，就都敬畏他；因为见他心里有神的智慧，能以断案。
verses.textEnNiv: When all Israel heard the verdict the king had given, they held the king in awe, because they saw that he had wisdom from God to administer justice.
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel heard of the judgment that the king had rendered, and they stood in awe of the king, because they perceived that the wisdom of God was in him to do justice.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had rendered; and they feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to administer justice.
verses.textEnNlt: When all Israel heard the king’s decision, the people were in awe of the king, for they saw the wisdom God had given him for rendering justice.
verses.textEnNasb: When all Israel heard about the judgment which the king had handed down, they feared the king, because they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to administer justice.
verses.textEn: When all Israel heard the verdict the king had given, they held the king in awe, because they saw that he had wisdom from God to administer justice.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王作了全以色列的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王作了全以色列的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门作以色列众人的王。
verses.textEnNiv: So King Solomon ruled over all Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: King Solomon was king over all Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: So King Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon now ruled over all Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: Now King Solomon was king over all Israel.
verses.textEn: So King Solomon ruled over all Israel.

verses.textZh: 以下这些人是他的官员：撒督的儿子亚撒利雅作祭司；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下这些人是他的官员：撒督的儿子亚撒利雅作祭司；
verses.textZhCuv: 他的臣子记在下面：撒督的儿子亚撒利雅作祭司，
verses.textEnNiv: And these were his chief officials: Azariah son of Zadok—the priest;
verses.textEnEsv: and these were his high officials: Azariah the son of Zadok was the priest;
verses.textEnNkjv: And these were his officials: Azariah the son of Zadok, the priest;
verses.textEnNlt: and these were his high officials: Azariah son of Zadok was the priest.
verses.textEnNasb: These were his officials: Azariah the son of Zadok was the priest;
verses.textEn: And these were his chief officials: Azariah son of Zadok—the priest;

verses.textZh: 示沙的两个儿子以利何烈和亚希亚作书记；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
verses.textZhCnvs: 示沙的两个儿子以利何烈和亚希亚作书记；亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官；
verses.textZhCuv: 示沙的两个儿子以利何烈、亚希亚作书记，亚希律的儿子约沙法作史官，
verses.textEnNiv: Elihoreph and Ahijah, sons of Shisha—secretaries; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud—recorder;
verses.textEnEsv: Elihoreph and Ahijah the sons of Shisha were secretaries; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.textEnNkjv: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
verses.textEnNlt: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, were court secretaries. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the royal historian.
verses.textEnNasb: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha were scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the secretary;
verses.textEn: Elihoreph and Ahijah, sons of Shisha—secretaries; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud—recorder;

verses.textZh: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统领军队；撒督和亚比亚他作祭司；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅统领军队；撒督和亚比亚他作祭司；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶何耶大的儿子比拿雅作元帅，撒督和亚比亚他作祭司长，
verses.textEnNiv: Benaiah son of Jehoiada—commander in chief; Zadok and Abiathar—priests;
verses.textEnEsv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was in command of the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
verses.textEnNkjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, over the army; Zadok and Abiathar, the priests;
verses.textEnNlt: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was commander of the army. Zadok and Abiathar were priests.
verses.textEnNasb: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the army; and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
verses.textEn: Benaiah son of Jehoiada—commander in chief; Zadok and Abiathar—priests;

verses.textZh: 拿单的儿子亚撒利雅作幕僚长；拿单的儿子撒布得作祭司，他也是王的朋友；
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿单的儿子亚撒利雅作幕僚长；拿单的儿子撒布得作祭司，他也是王的朋友；
verses.textZhCuv: 拿单的儿子亚撒利雅作众吏长，王的朋友拿单的儿子撒布得作领袖，
verses.textEnNiv: Azariah son of Nathan—in charge of the district governors; Zabud son of Nathan—a priest and adviser to the king;
verses.textEnEsv: Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan was priest and king’s friend;
verses.textEnNkjv: Azariah the son of Nathan, over the officers; Zabud the son of Nathan, a priest and the king’s friend;
verses.textEnNlt: Azariah son of Nathan was in charge of the district governors. Zabud son of Nathan, a priest, was a trusted adviser to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: and Azariah the son of Nathan was over the deputies; and Zabud the son of Nathan, a priest, was the king’s confidant;
verses.textEn: Azariah son of Nathan—in charge of the district governors; Zabud son of Nathan—a priest and adviser to the king;

verses.textZh: 亚希煞作家宰；亚比大的儿子亚多尼兰掌管服劳役的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希煞作家宰；亚比大的儿子亚多尼兰掌管服劳役的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希煞作家宰，亚比大的儿子亚多尼兰掌管服苦的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahishar—palace administrator; Adoniram son of Abda—in charge of forced labor.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahishar was in charge of the palace; and Adoniram the son of Abda was in charge of the forced labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahishar, over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda, over the labor force.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahishar was manager of the palace property. Adoniram son of Abda was in charge of forced labor.
verses.textEnNasb: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the forced labor.
verses.textEn: Ahishar—palace administrator; Adoniram son of Abda—in charge of forced labor.

verses.textZh: 所罗门在全以色列立了十二个官员；他们为王和王家供应食物，每人每年供应一个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在全以色列立了十二个官员；他们为王和王家供应食物，每人每年供应一个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门在以色列全地立了十二个官吏，使他们供给王和王家的食物，每年各人供给一月。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon had twelve district governors over all Israel, who supplied provisions for the king and the royal household. Each one had to provide supplies for one month in the year.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household. Each man had to make provision for one month in the year.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon had twelve governors over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household; each one made provision for one month of the year.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also had twelve district governors who were over all Israel. They were responsible for providing food for the king’s household. Each of them arranged provisions for one month of the year.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon had twelve deputies over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household; each deputy had to provide food for a month in the year.
verses.textEn: Solomon had twelve district governors over all Israel, who supplied provisions for the king and the royal household. Each one had to provide supplies for one month in the year.

verses.textZh: 以下是他们的名字：便．户珥在以法莲山地；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是他们的名字：便．户珥在以法莲山地；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的名字记在下面：在以法莲山地有便‧户珥；
verses.textEnNiv: These are their names: Ben-Hur—in the hill country of Ephraim;
verses.textEnEsv: These were their names: Ben-hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;
verses.textEnNkjv: These are their names: Ben-Hur, in the mountains of Ephraim;
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of the twelve governors: Ben-hur, in the hill country of Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: And these were their names: Ben-hur, in the hill country of Ephraim;
verses.textEn: These are their names: Ben-Hur—in the hill country of Ephraim;

verses.textZh: 便．底甲在玛迦斯、沙宾、伯．示麦、以伦和伯．哈南；
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．底甲在玛迦斯、沙宾、伯．示麦、以伦和伯．哈南；
verses.textZhCuv: 在玛迦斯、沙宾、伯‧示麦、以伦‧伯‧哈南有便‧底甲；
verses.textEnNiv: Ben-Deker—in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh and Elon Bethhanan;
verses.textEnEsv: Ben-deker, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, and Elonbeth-hanan;
verses.textEnNkjv: Ben-Deker, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-deker, in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-shemesh, and Elon-bethhanan.
verses.textEnNasb: Ben-deker in Makaz and Shaalbim, and Beth-shemesh, and Elonbeth-hanan;
verses.textEn: Ben-Deker—in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh and Elon Bethhanan;

verses.textZh: 便．希悉在亚鲁泊，梭哥和希弗全地是属他管理的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．希悉在亚鲁泊，梭哥和希弗全地是属他管理的；
verses.textZhCuv: 在亚鲁泊有便‧希悉，他管理梭哥和希弗全地；
verses.textEnNiv: Ben-Hesed—in Arubboth (Sokoh and all the land of Hepher were his);
verses.textEnEsv: Ben-hesed, in Arubboth (to him belonged Socoh and all the land of Hepher);
verses.textEnNkjv: Ben-Hesed, in Arubboth; to him belonged Sochoh and all the land of Hepher;
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-hesed, in Arubboth, including Socoh and all the land of Hepher.
verses.textEnNasb: Ben-hesed in Arubboth (Socoh was his and all the land of Hepher);
verses.textEn: Ben-Hesed—in Arubboth (Sokoh and all the land of Hepher were his);

verses.textZh: 便．亚比拿达在拿法多珥全境，他娶了所罗门的女儿他法为妻；
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．亚比拿达在拿法多珥全境，他娶了所罗门的女儿他法为妻；
verses.textZhCuv: 在多珥山冈 有便‧亚比拿达，他娶了所罗门的女儿她法为妻；
verses.textEnNiv: Ben-Abinadab—in Naphoth Dor (he was married to Taphath daughter of Solomon);
verses.textEnEsv: Ben-abinadab, in all Naphath-dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon as his wife);
verses.textEnNkjv: Ben-Abinadab, in all the regions of Dor; he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon as wife;
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-abinadab, in all of Naphoth-dor. (He was married to Taphath, one of Solomon’s daughters.)
verses.textEnNasb: Ben-abinadab in all the hills of Dor (Taphath the daughter of Solomon was his wife);
verses.textEn: Ben-Abinadab—in Naphoth Dor (he was married to Taphath daughter of Solomon);

verses.textZh: 亚希律的儿子巴拿在他纳、米吉多和那靠近撒利但、在耶斯列下边的伯．善全地，由伯．善到亚伯．米何拉，再到约克米暗之外；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希律的儿子巴拿在他纳、米吉多和那靠近撒利但、在耶斯列下边的伯．善全地，由伯．善到亚伯．米何拉，再到约克米暗之外；
verses.textZhCuv: 在他纳和米吉多，并靠近撒拉他拿、耶斯列下边的伯‧善全地，从伯‧善到亚伯‧米何拉直到约念之外，有亚希律的儿子巴拿；
verses.textEnNiv: Baana son of Ahilud—in Taanach and Megiddo, and in all of Beth Shan next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth Shan to Abel Meholah across to Jokmeam;
verses.textEnEsv: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach, Megiddo, and all Beth-shean that is beside Zarethan below Jezreel, and from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as the other side of Jokmeam;
verses.textEnNkjv: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach, Megiddo, and all Beth Shean, which is beside Zaretan below Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as the other side of Jokneam;
verses.textEnNlt: Baana son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, all of Beth-shan near Zarethan below Jezreel, and all the territory from Beth-shan to Abel-meholah and over to Jokmeam.
verses.textEnNasb: Baana the son of Ahilud in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is beside Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah as far as the other side of Jokmeam;
verses.textEn: Baana son of Ahilud—in Taanach and Megiddo, and in all of Beth Shan next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth Shan to Abel Meholah across to Jokmeam;

verses.textZh: 便．基列在基列的拉末；玛拿西的子孙睚珥在基列的村落是属他的，巴珊的亚珥歌伯地的六十座有城墙和铜闩的大城也是属他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．基列在基列的拉末；玛拿西的子孙睚珥在基列的村落是属他的，巴珊的亚珥歌伯地的六十座有城墙和铜闩的大城也是属他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在基列的拉末有便‧基别，他管理在基列的玛拿西子孙睚珥的城邑，巴珊的亚珥歌伯地的大城六十座，都有城墙和铜闩；
verses.textEnNiv: Ben-Geber—in Ramoth Gilead (the settlements of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead were his, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan and its sixty large walled cities with bronze gate bars);
verses.textEnEsv: Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead (he had the villages of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, and he had the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars);
verses.textEnNkjv: Ben-Geber, in Ramoth Gilead; to him belonged the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, in Gilead; to him alsobelonged the region of Argob in Bashan—sixty large cities with walls and bronze gate-bars;
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-geber, in Ramoth-gilead, including the Towns of Jair (named for Jair of the tribe of Manasseh ) in Gilead, and in the Argob region of Bashan, including sixty large fortified towns with bronze bars on their gates.
verses.textEnNasb: Ben-geber in Ramoth-gilead (the villages of Jair, the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead were his: the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars were his);
verses.textEn: Ben-Geber—in Ramoth Gilead (the settlements of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead were his, as well as the region of Argob in Bashan and its sixty large walled cities with bronze gate bars);

verses.textZh: 易多的儿子亚希拿达在玛哈念；
verses.textZhCnvs: 易多的儿子亚希拿达在玛哈念；
verses.textZhCuv: 在玛哈念有易多的儿子亚希拿达；
verses.textEnNiv: Ahinadab son of Iddo—in Mahanaim;
verses.textEnEsv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
verses.textEnNlt: Ahinadab son of Iddo, in Mahanaim.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahinadab the son of Iddo in Mahanaim;
verses.textEn: Ahinadab son of Iddo—in Mahanaim;

verses.textZh: 亚希玛斯在拿弗他利，他娶了所罗门的女儿巴实抹为妻；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希玛斯在拿弗他利，他娶了所罗门的女儿巴实抹为妻；
verses.textZhCuv: 在拿弗他利有亚希玛斯，他也娶了所罗门的一个女儿巴实抹为妻；
verses.textEnNiv: Ahimaaz—in Naphtali (he had married Basemath daughter of Solomon);
verses.textEnEsv: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he had taken Basemath the daughter of Solomon as his wife);
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali; he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife;
verses.textEnNlt: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali. (He was married to Basemath, another of Solomon’s daughters.)
verses.textEnNasb: Ahimaaz in Naphtali (he also married Basemath the daughter of Solomon);
verses.textEn: Ahimaaz—in Naphtali (he had married Basemath daughter of Solomon);

verses.textZh: 户筛的儿子巴拿在亚设和亚录；
verses.textZhCnvs: 户筛的儿子巴拿在亚设和亚录；
verses.textZhCuv: 在亚设和亚禄有户筛的儿子巴拿；
verses.textEnNiv: Baana son of Hushai—in Asher and in Aloth;
verses.textEnEsv: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;
verses.textEnNkjv: Baanah the son of Hushai, in Asher and Aloth;
verses.textEnNlt: Baana son of Hushai, in Asher and in Aloth.
verses.textEnNasb: Baana the son of Hushai in Asher and Bealoth;
verses.textEn: Baana son of Hushai—in Asher and in Aloth;

verses.textZh: 帕路亚的儿子约沙法在以萨迦；
verses.textZhCnvs: 帕路亚的儿子约沙法在以萨迦；
verses.textZhCuv: 在以萨迦有帕路亚的儿子约沙法；
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah—in Issachar;
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah, in Issachar.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah in Issachar;
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah—in Issachar;

verses.textZh: 以拉的儿子示每在便雅悯；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以拉的儿子示每在便雅悯；
verses.textZhCuv: 在便雅悯有以拉的儿子示每；
verses.textEnNiv: Shimei son of Ela—in Benjamin;
verses.textEnEsv: Shimei the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
verses.textEnNkjv: Shimei the son of Elah, in Benjamin;
verses.textEnNlt: Shimei son of Ela, in Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: Shimei the son of Ela in Benjamin;
verses.textEn: Shimei son of Ela—in Benjamin;

verses.textZh: 乌利的儿子基别在基列地，就是从前亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地。这地只有一个官员管理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌利的儿子基别在基列地，就是从前亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地。这地只有一个官员管理。
verses.textZhCuv: 在基列地，就是从前属亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩之地，有乌利的儿子基别一人管理。
verses.textEnNiv: Geber son of Uri—in Gilead (the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and the country of Og king of Bashan). He was the only governor over the district.
verses.textEnEsv: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan. And there was one governor who was over the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, in the country of Sihon king of the Amorites, and of Og king of Bashan. Hewas the only governor who was in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Geber son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, including the territories of King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. There was also one governor over the land of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Geber the son of Uri in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only deputy who was in the land.
verses.textEn: Geber son of Uri—in Gilead (the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and the country of Og king of Bashan). He was the only governor over the district.

verses.textZh: 犹大人和以色列人很多，像海边的沙那样多；他们都吃喝、快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人和以色列人很多，像海边的沙那样多；他们都吃喝、快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人和以色列人如同海边的沙那样多，都吃喝快乐。
verses.textEnNiv: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore; they ate, they drank and they were happy.
verses.textEnEsv: Judah and Israel were as many as the sand by the sea. They ate and drank and were happy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and rejoicing.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They were very contented, with plenty to eat and drink.
verses.textEnNasb: Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand that is on the seashore in abundance; they were eating, drinking, and rejoicing.
verses.textEn: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the sand on the seashore; they ate, they drank and they were happy.

verses.textZh: 所罗门统治列国，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。这些国家，在所罗门在世的日子，都向他进贡，服事他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门统治列国，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。这些国家，在所罗门在世的日子，都向他进贡，服事他。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门统管诸国，从大河到非利士地，直到埃及的边界。所罗门在世的日子，这些国都进贡服事他。
verses.textEnNiv: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These countries brought tribute and were Solomon’s subjects all his life.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. They brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of the Philistines and the border of Egypt in the south. The conquered peoples of those lands sent tribute money to Solomon and continued to serve him throughout his lifetime.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon was ruling over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt; they brought tribute and served Solomon all the days of his life.
verses.textEn: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These countries brought tribute and were Solomon’s subjects all his life.

verses.textZh: 所罗门每天的食物是细面粉五千公升、粗面粉一万公升、
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门每天的食物是细面粉五千公升、粗面粉一万公升、
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门每日所用的食物：细面三十歌珥，粗面六十歌珥，
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon’s daily provisions were thirty cors of the finest flour and sixty cors of meal,
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty cors of fine flour and sixty cors of meal,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty kors of fine flour, sixty kors of meal,
verses.textEnNlt: The daily food requirements for Solomon’s palace were 150 bushels of choice flour and 300 bushels of meal ;
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty kors of fine flour and sixty kors of meal,
verses.textEn: Solomon’s daily provisions were thirty cors of the finest flour and sixty cors of meal,

verses.textZh: 肥牛十头、草场的牛二十头、羊一百只，此外还有鹿、羚羊、狍子和肥禽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 肥牛十头、草场的牛二十头、羊一百只，此外还有鹿、羚羊、狍子和肥禽。
verses.textZhCuv: 肥牛十只，草场的牛二十只，羊一百只，还有鹿、羚羊、狍子，并肥禽。
verses.textEnNiv: ten head of stall-fed cattle, twenty of pasture-fed cattle and a hundred sheep and goats, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks and choice fowl.
verses.textEnEsv: ten fat oxen, and twenty pasture-fed cattle, a hundred sheep, besides deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened fowl.
verses.textEnNkjv: ten fatted oxen, twenty oxen from the pastures, and one hundred sheep, besides deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fatted fowl.
verses.textEnNlt: also 10 oxen from the fattening pens, 20 pasture-fed cattle, 100 sheep or goats, as well as deer, gazelles, roe deer, and choice poultry.
verses.textEnNasb: ten fat oxen, twenty pasture-fed oxen, and a hundred sheep, besides deer, gazelles, roebucks, and fattened geese.
verses.textEn: ten head of stall-fed cattle, twenty of pasture-fed cattle and a hundred sheep and goats, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks and choice fowl.

verses.textZh: 因为所罗门统治大河西边，从提弗萨直到迦萨的全境和大河西边的列王，所以他的四境都平安无事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为所罗门统治大河西边，从提弗萨直到迦萨的全境和大河西边的列王，所以他的四境都平安无事。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门管理大河西边的诸王，以及从提弗萨直到迦萨的全地，四境尽都平安。
verses.textEnNiv: For he ruled over all the kingdoms west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and had peace on all sides.
verses.textEnEsv: For he had dominion over all the region west of the Euphrates from Tiphsah to Gaza, over all the kings west of the Euphrates. And he had peace on all sides around him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he had dominion over all theregion on this side of the River from Tiphsah even to Gaza, namely over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on every side all around him.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon’s dominion extended over all the kingdoms west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza. And there was peace on all his borders.
verses.textEnNasb: For he was ruling over everything west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings west of the River; and he had peace on all sides surrounding him.
verses.textEn: For he ruled over all the kingdoms west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and had peace on all sides.

verses.textZh: 所罗门在世的日子，犹大和以色列人从但到别是巴，都各在自己的葡萄树下和无花果树下安然居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在世的日子，犹大和以色列人从但到别是巴，都各在自己的葡萄树下和无花果树下安然居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门在世的日子，从但到别是巴的犹大人和以色列人都在自己的葡萄树下和无花果树下安然居住。
verses.textEnNiv: During Solomon’s lifetime Judah and Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, lived in safety, everyone under their own vine and under their own fig tree.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah and Israel lived in safety, from Dan even to Beersheba, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, all the days of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, each man under his vine and his fig tree, from Dan as far as Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: During the lifetime of Solomon, all of Judah and Israel lived in peace and safety. And from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, each family had its own home and garden.
verses.textEnNasb: So Judah and Israel lived securely, everyone under his vine and his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.
verses.textEn: During Solomon’s lifetime Judah and Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, lived in safety, everyone under their own vine and under their own fig tree.

verses.textZh: 所罗门有套车的马四万匹和骑兵一万二千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门有套车的马四万匹和骑兵一万二千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门有套车的马四万，还有马兵一万二千。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon had four thousand stalls for chariot horses, and twelve thousand horses.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon also had 40,000 stalls of horses for his chariots, and 12,000 horsemen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon had 4,000 stalls for his chariot horses, and he had 12,000 horses.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
verses.textEn: Solomon had four thousand stalls for chariot horses, and twelve thousand horses.

verses.textZh: 那些官员分别每月供应所罗门王和所有与所罗门王一同坐席的人的食物，从没有缺少。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些官员分别每月供应所罗门王和所有与所罗门王一同坐席的人的食物，从没有缺少。
verses.textZhCuv: 那十二个官吏各按各月供给所罗门王，并一切与他同席之人的食物，一无所缺。
verses.textEnNiv: The district governors, each in his month, supplied provisions for King Solomon and all who came to the king’s table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.
verses.textEnEsv: And those officers supplied provisions for King Solomon, and for all who came to King Solomon’s table, each one in his month. They let nothing be lacking.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these governors, each man in his month, provided food for King Solomon and for all who came to King Solomon’s table. There was no lack in their supply.
verses.textEnNlt: The district governors faithfully provided food for King Solomon and his court; each made sure nothing was lacking during the month assigned to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And those deputies provided food for King Solomon and all who came to King Solomon’s table, each in his month; they allowed nothing to be lacking.
verses.textEn: The district governors, each in his month, supplied provisions for King Solomon and all who came to the king’s table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.

verses.textZh: 他们也各按各的职分供给拉车的马和快马吃的大麦和干草，送到指定的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们也各按各的职分供给拉车的马和快马吃的大麦和干草，送到指定的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人各按各分，将养马与快马的大麦和干草送到官吏那里。
verses.textEnNiv: They also brought to the proper place their quotas of barley and straw for the chariot horses and the other horses.
verses.textEnEsv: Barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds they brought to the place where it was required, each according to his duty.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also brought barley and straw to the proper place, for the horses and steeds, each man according to his charge.
verses.textEnNlt: They also brought the necessary barley and straw for the royal horses in the stables.
verses.textEnNasb: They also brought barley and straw for the war horses and baggage horses to the place where it was required, each deputy according to his duty.
verses.textEn: They also brought to the proper place their quotas of barley and straw for the chariot horses and the other horses.

verses.textZh: 神赐给所罗门智慧、极大的聪明和广大的心，好象海边的沙那样无限无量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神赐给所罗门智慧、极大的聪明和广大的心，好象海边的沙那样无限无量。
verses.textZhCuv: 神赐给所罗门极大的智慧聪明和广大的心，如同海沙不可测量。
verses.textEnNiv: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.
verses.textEnEsv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding beyond measure, and breadth of mind like the sand on the seashore,
verses.textEnNkjv: And God gave Solomon wisdom and exceedingly great understanding, and largeness of heart like the sand on the seashore.
verses.textEnNlt: God gave Solomon very great wisdom and understanding, and knowledge as vast as the sands of the seashore.
verses.textEnNasb: Now God gave Solomon wisdom and very great discernment and breadth of mind, like the sand that is on the seashore.
verses.textEn: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.

verses.textZh: 所罗门的智慧大过所有东方人的智慧，大过埃及人的一切智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的智慧大过所有东方人的智慧，大过埃及人的一切智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的智慧超过东方人和埃及人的一切智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the people of the East, and greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: so that Solomon’s wisdom surpassed the wisdom of all the people of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Solomon’s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the men of the East and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, his wisdom exceeded that of all the wise men of the East and the wise men of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon’s wisdom surpassed the wisdom of all the people of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Solomon’s wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the people of the East, and greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 他比万人都有智慧，胜过以斯拉人以探和玛曷的三个儿子希幔、甲各、达大的智慧。他的名声传遍了四周列国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他比万人都有智慧，胜过以斯拉人以探和玛曷的三个儿子希幔、甲各、达大的智慧。他的名声传遍了四周列国。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的智慧胜过万人，胜过以斯拉人以探，并玛曷的儿子希幔、甲各、达大的智慧。他的名声传扬在四围的列国。
verses.textEnNiv: He was wiser than anyone else, including Ethan the Ezrahite—wiser than Heman, Kalkol and Darda, the sons of Mahol. And his fame spread to all the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnEsv: For he was wiser than all other men, wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol, and his fame was in all the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he was wiser than all men— than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, Chalcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was in all the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnNlt: He was wiser than anyone else, including Ethan the Ezrahite and the sons of Mahol—Heman, Calcol, and Darda. His fame spread throughout all the surrounding nations.
verses.textEnNasb: For he was wiser than all other people, more than Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol; and his fame was known in all the surrounding nations.
verses.textEn: He was wiser than anyone else, including Ethan the Ezrahite—wiser than Heman, Kalkol and Darda, the sons of Mahol. And his fame spread to all the surrounding nations.

verses.textZh: 他说了箴言三千句，他的诗歌有一千零五首；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说了箴言三千句，他的诗歌有一千零五首；
verses.textZhCuv: 他作箴言三千句，诗歌一千零五首。
verses.textEnNiv: He spoke three thousand proverbs and his songs numbered a thousand and five.
verses.textEnEsv: He also spoke 3,000 proverbs, and his songs were 1,005.
verses.textEnNkjv: He spoke three thousand proverbs, and his songs were one thousand and five.
verses.textEnNlt: He composed some 3,000 proverbs and wrote 1,005 songs.
verses.textEnNasb: He also told three thousand proverbs, and his songs numbered 1,005.
verses.textEn: He spoke three thousand proverbs and his songs numbered a thousand and five.

verses.textZh: 他讲论草木，从黎巴嫩的香柏木到生长在墙上的牛膝草；他也讲论走兽、飞禽、爬行的动物和鱼类。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他讲论草木，从黎巴嫩的香柏木到生长在墙上的牛膝草；他也讲论走兽、飞禽、爬行的动物和鱼类。
verses.textZhCuv: 他讲论草木，自黎巴嫩的香柏树直到墙上长的牛膝草，又讲论飞禽走兽、昆虫水族。
verses.textEnNiv: He spoke about plant life, from the cedar of Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of walls. He also spoke about animals and birds, reptiles and fish.
verses.textEnEsv: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of the wall. He spoke also of beasts, and of birds, and of reptiles, and of fish.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he spoke of trees, from the cedar tree of Lebanon even to the hyssop that springs out of the wall; he spoke also of animals, of birds, of creeping things, and of fish.
verses.textEnNlt: He could speak with authority about all kinds of plants, from the great cedar of Lebanon to the tiny hyssop that grows from cracks in a wall. He could also speak about animals, birds, small creatures, and fish.
verses.textEnNasb: He told of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon even to the hyssop that grows on the wall; he told also of animals, birds, crawling things, and fish.
verses.textEn: He spoke about plant life, from the cedar of Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of walls. He also spoke about animals and birds, reptiles and fish.

verses.textZh: 万族之中和地上列王之中，听闻所罗门的智慧的，都有人来听所罗门的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万族之中和地上列王之中，听闻所罗门的智慧的，都有人来听所罗门的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 天下列王听见所罗门的智慧，就都差人来听他的智慧话。
verses.textEnNiv: From all nations people came to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, sent by all the kings of the world, who had heard of his wisdom.
verses.textEnEsv: And people of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and from all the kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: And men of all nations, from all the kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom, came to hear the wisdom of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: And kings from every nation sent their ambassadors to listen to the wisdom of Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: People came from all the nations to hear the wisdom of Solomon, from all the kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom.
verses.textEn: From all nations people came to listen to Solomon’s wisdom, sent by all the kings of the world, who had heard of his wisdom.

verses.textZh: 推罗王希兰听见以色列人膏立了所罗门接续他父亲作王，就派遣自己的臣仆来见所罗门；因为希兰一向爱大卫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 推罗王希兰听见以色列人膏立了所罗门接续他父亲作王，就派遣自己的臣仆来见所罗门；因为希兰一向爱大卫。
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔王希兰，平素爱大卫；他听见以色列人膏所罗门，接续他父亲作王，就差遣臣仆来见他。
verses.textEnNiv: When Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king to succeed his father David, he sent his envoys to Solomon, because he had always been on friendly terms with David.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon when he heard that they had anointed him king in place of his father, for Hiram always loved David.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, because he heard that they had anointed him king in place of his father, for Hiram had always loved David.
verses.textEnNlt: King Hiram of Tyre had always been a loyal friend of David. When Hiram learned that David’s son Solomon was the new king of Israel, he sent ambassadors to congratulate him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon when he heard that they had anointed him king in place of his father, for Hiram had always been a friend of David.
verses.textEn: When Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king to succeed his father David, he sent his envoys to Solomon, because he had always been on friendly terms with David.

verses.textZh: 所罗门也派遣人去见希兰，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门也派遣人去见希兰，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门也差遣人去见希兰，说：
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon sent back this message to Hiram:
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon sent word to Hiram,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon sent to Hiram, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon sent this message back to Hiram:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon sent word to Hiram, saying,
verses.textEn: Solomon sent back this message to Hiram:

verses.textZh: "你知道我的父亲大卫为了四周的战事，在耶和华使敌人都服在他的脚下以前，他不能为耶和华他的神的名建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你知道我的父亲大卫为了四周的战事，在耶和华使敌人都服在他的脚下以前，他不能为耶和华他的神的名建造殿宇。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你知道我父亲大卫因四围的争战，不能为耶和华－他神的名建殿，直等到耶和华使仇敌都服在他脚下。
verses.textEnNiv: "You know that because of the wars waged against my father David from all sides, he could not build a temple for the Name of the Lord his God until the Lord put his enemies under his feet.
verses.textEnEsv: "You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of the Lord his God because of the warfare with which his enemies surrounded him, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: You know how my father David could not build a house for the name of the Lord his God because of the wars which were fought against him on every side, until the Lord put hisfoes under the soles of his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: "You know that my father, David, was not able to build a Temple to honor the name of the Lord his God because of the many wars waged against him by surrounding nations. He could not build until the Lord gave him victory over all his enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "You know that David my father was unable to build a house for the name of the Lord his God because of the wars which surrounded him, until the Lord put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.textEn: "You know that because of the wars waged against my father David from all sides, he could not build a temple for the Name of the Lord his God until the Lord put his enemies under his feet.

verses.textZh: 但是，现在耶和华我的神使我四境太平，没有仇敌，也没有灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，现在耶和华我的神使我四境太平，没有仇敌，也没有灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在耶和华－我的神使我四围平安，没有仇敌，没有灾祸。
verses.textEnNiv: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or disaster.
verses.textEnEsv: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side. There is neither adversary nor misfortune.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side; thereis neither adversary nor evil occurrence.
verses.textEnNlt: But now the Lord my God has given me peace on every side; I have no enemies, and all is well.
verses.textEnNasb: But now the Lord my God has secured me rest on every side; there is neither adversary nor misfortune.
verses.textEn: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or disaster.

verses.textZh: 所以我有意要为耶和华我的神的名建造殿宇，正如耶和华曾对我的父亲大卫说：‘你的儿子，就是我要使他接续你坐在王位上的，要为我的名建造殿宇。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我有意要为耶和华我的神的名建造殿宇，正如耶和华曾对我的父亲大卫说：‘你的儿子，就是我要使他接续你坐在王位上的，要为我的名建造殿宇。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我定意要为耶和华－我神的名建殿，是照耶和华应许我父亲大卫的话说：『我必使你儿子接续你坐你的位，他必为我的名建殿。』
verses.textEnNiv: I intend, therefore, to build a temple for the Name of the Lord my God, as the Lord told my father David, when he said, ‘Your son whom I will put on the throne in your place will build the temple for my Name.’
verses.textEnEsv: And so I intend to build a house for the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord said to David my father, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place, shall build the house for my name.’
