verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, I propose to build a house for the name of the Lord my God, as the Lord spoke to my father David, saying, "Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place, he shall build the house for My name."
verses.textEnNlt: So I am planning to build a Temple to honor the name of the Lord my God, just as he had instructed my father, David. For the Lord told him, ‘Your son, whom I will place on your throne, will build the Temple to honor my name.’
verses.textEnNasb: So behold, I intend to build a house for the name of the Lord my God, just as the Lord spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will put on your throne in your place, he will build the house for My name.’
verses.textEn: I intend, therefore, to build a temple for the Name of the Lord my God, as the Lord told my father David, when he said, ‘Your son whom I will put on the throne in your place will build the temple for my Name.’

verses.textZh: 现在请你命令人从黎巴嫩为我砍伐香柏木；我的仆人要与你的仆人一起工作；至于你的仆人的工资，我必按照你所说的付给你，因为你也知道，我们中间没有人像西顿人那样善于砍伐树木。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在请你命令人从黎巴嫩为我砍伐香柏木；我的仆人要与你的仆人一起工作；至于你的仆人的工资，我必按照你所说的付给你，因为你也知道，我们中间没有人像西顿人那样善于砍伐树木。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以求你吩咐你的仆人在黎巴嫩为我砍伐香柏木，我的仆人也必帮助他们，我必照你所定的，给你仆人的工价；因为你知道，在我们中间没有人像西顿人善于砍伐树木。」
verses.textEnNiv: "So give orders that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me. My men will work with yours, and I will pay you for your men whatever wages you set. You know that we have no one so skilled in felling timber as the Sidonians."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore command that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me. And my servants will join your servants, and I will pay you for your servants such wages as you set, for you know that there is no one among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, command that they cut down cedars for me from Lebanon; and my servants will be with your servants, and I will pay you wages for your servants according to whatever you say. For you know thereis none among us who has skill to cut timber like the Sidonians.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, please command that cedars from Lebanon be cut for me. Let my men work alongside yours, and I will pay your men whatever wages you ask. As you know, there is no one among us who can cut timber like you Sidonians!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, issue orders that they cut cedars from Lebanon for me, and my servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants in accordance with all that you say, for you yourself know that there is no one among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians."
verses.textEn: "So give orders that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me. My men will work with yours, and I will pay you for your men whatever wages you set. You know that we have no one so skilled in felling timber as the Sidonians."

verses.textZh: 希兰听见了所罗门的话，就十分欢喜，说："今天耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他赐给了大卫一个有智慧的儿子治理这么众多的人民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希兰听见了所罗门的话，就十分欢喜，说："今天耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他赐给了大卫一个有智慧的儿子治理这么众多的人民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 希兰听见所罗门的话，就甚喜悦，说：「今日应当称颂耶和华；因他赐给大卫一个有智慧的儿子，治理这众多的民。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was greatly pleased and said, "Praise be to the Lord today, for he has given David a wise son to rule over this great nation."
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly and said, "Blessed be the Lord this day, who has given to David a wise son to be over this great people."
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly and said, Blessed be the Lord this day, for He has given David a wise son over this great people!
verses.textEnNlt: When Hiram received Solomon’s message, he was very pleased and said, "Praise the Lord today for giving David a wise son to be king of the great nation of Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he greatly rejoiced; and he said, "Blessed be the Lord today, who has given to David a wise son over this great people."
verses.textEn: When Hiram heard Solomon’s message, he was greatly pleased and said, "Praise be to the Lord today, for he has given David a wise son to rule over this great nation."

verses.textZh: 于是希兰派遣人去见所罗门，说："你派人来向我所传的消息，我都听到了。关于香柏木和松木的事，你心所愿的，我都照办。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是希兰派遣人去见所罗门，说："你派人来向我所传的消息，我都听到了。关于香柏木和松木的事，你心所愿的，我都照办。
verses.textZhCuv: 希兰打发人去见所罗门，说：「你差遣人向我所提的那事，我都听见了；论到香柏木和松木，我必照你的心愿而行。
verses.textEnNiv: So Hiram sent word to Solomon: "I have received the message you sent me and will do all you want in providing the cedar and juniper logs.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, "I have heard the message that you have sent to me. I am ready to do all you desire in the matter of cedar and cypress timber.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hiram sent to Solomon, saying: I have considered themessage which you sent me, and I will do all you desire concerning the cedar and cypress logs.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he sent this reply to Solomon: "I have received your message, and I will supply all the cedar and cypress timber you need.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hiram sent word to Solomon, saying, "I have heard the message which you sent me; I will do everything you wish concerning the cedar and juniper timber.
verses.textEn: So Hiram sent word to Solomon: "I have received the message you sent me and will do all you want in providing the cedar and juniper logs.

verses.textZh: 我的仆人要把这些木材从黎巴嫩运下海中；我会把木材扎成木筏，从海上运到你指定我的地方去。我在那里把木材拆开，你就可以运走。你也要成全我的心愿，用粮食供应我家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的仆人要把这些木材从黎巴嫩运下海中；我会把木材扎成木筏，从海上运到你指定我的地方去。我在那里把木材拆开，你就可以运走。你也要成全我的心愿，用粮食供应我家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仆人必将这木料从黎巴嫩运到海里，扎成筏子，浮海运到你所指定我的地方，在那里拆开，你就可以收取；你也要成全我的心愿，将食物给我的家。」
verses.textEnNiv: My men will haul them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate them and you can take them away. And you are to grant my wish by providing food for my royal household."
verses.textEnEsv: My servants shall bring it down to the sea from Lebanon, and I will make it into rafts to go by sea to the place you direct. And I will have them broken up there, and you shall receive it. And you shall meet my wishes by providing food for my household."
verses.textEnNkjv: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon to the sea; I will float them in rafts by sea to the place you indicate to me, and will have them broken apart there; then you can take them away. And you shall fulfill my desire by giving food for my household.
verses.textEnNlt: My servants will bring the logs from the Lebanon mountains to the Mediterranean Sea and make them into rafts and float them along the coast to whatever place you choose. Then we will break the rafts apart so you can carry the logs away. You can pay me by supplying me with food for my household."
verses.textEnNasb: My servants will bring the timbers down from Lebanon to the sea; and I will have them made into rafts to go by sea to the place where you direct me, and I will have them broken up there, and you will carry them away. Then you shall do what I wish, by giving food to my household."
verses.textEn: My men will haul them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate them and you can take them away. And you are to grant my wish by providing food for my royal household."

verses.textZh: 于是希兰照所罗门所想要的，供给他香柏木和松木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是希兰照所罗门所想要的，供给他香柏木和松木。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是希兰照着所罗门所要的，给他香柏木和松木；
verses.textEnNiv: In this way Hiram kept Solomon supplied with all the cedar and juniper logs he wanted,
verses.textEnEsv: So Hiram supplied Solomon with all the timber of cedar and cypress that he desired,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hiram gave Solomon cedar and cypress logs accordingto all his desire.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hiram supplied as much cedar and cypress timber as Solomon desired.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hiram gave Solomon all that he wished of the cedar and juniper timber.
verses.textEn: In this way Hiram kept Solomon supplied with all the cedar and juniper logs he wanted,

verses.textZh: 所罗门也给了希兰麦子四百万公升，纯油四十万公升 ，作为他家的食物。所罗门年年都这样供给希兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门也给了希兰麦子四百万公升，纯油四十万公升 ，作为他家的食物。所罗门年年都这样供给希兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门给希兰麦子二万歌珥，清油二十歌珥，作他家的食物。所罗门每年都是这样给希兰。
verses.textEnNiv: and Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat as food for his household, in addition to twenty thousand baths of pressed olive oil. Solomon continued to do this for Hiram year after year.
verses.textEnEsv: while Solomon gave Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, and 20,000 cors of beaten oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand kors of wheat as food for his household, and twenty kors of pressed oil. Thus Solomon gave to Hiram year by year.
verses.textEnNlt: In return, Solomon sent him an annual payment of 100,000 bushels of wheat for his household and 110,000 gallons of pure olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon then gave Hiram twenty thousand kors of wheat as food for his household, and twenty kors of pure oil; this is what Solomon would give Hiram year by year.
verses.textEn: and Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat as food for his household, in addition to twenty thousand baths of pressed olive oil. Solomon continued to do this for Hiram year after year.

verses.textZh: 耶和华照着他应许所罗门的，把智慧赐给他。希兰与所罗门之间，彼此和平相处，二人互相立约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华照着他应许所罗门的，把智慧赐给他。希兰与所罗门之间，彼此和平相处，二人互相立约。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华照着所应许的赐智慧给所罗门。希兰与所罗门和好，彼此立约。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord gave Solomon wisdom, just as he had promised him. There were peaceful relations between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. And there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord gave Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord gave wisdom to Solomon, just as he had promised. And Hiram and Solomon made a formal alliance of peace.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord gave wisdom to Solomon, just as He promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a covenant.
verses.textEn: The Lord gave Solomon wisdom, just as he had promised him. There were peaceful relations between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.

verses.textZh: 所罗门从以色列众人中征召作苦工的人，这些作苦工的人共有三万，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门从以色列众人中征召作苦工的人，这些作苦工的人共有三万，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王从以色列人中挑取服苦的人共有三万，
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon conscripted laborers from all Israel—thirty thousand men.
verses.textEnEsv: King Solomon drafted forced labor out of all Israel, and the draft numbered 30,000 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Solomon raised up a labor force out of all Israel; and the labor force was thirty thousand men.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Solomon conscripted a labor force of 30,000 men from all Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now King Solomon conscripted forced laborers from all Israel; and the forced laborers numbered thirty thousand men.
verses.textEn: King Solomon conscripted laborers from all Israel—thirty thousand men.

verses.textZh: 派他们轮班上黎巴嫩山去，每月一万人；他们一个月在黎巴嫩山上，两个月在家里。管理这些作苦工的是亚多尼兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 派他们轮班上黎巴嫩山去，每月一万人；他们一个月在黎巴嫩山上，两个月在家里。管理这些作苦工的是亚多尼兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 派他们轮流每月一万人上黎巴嫩去；一个月在黎巴嫩，两个月在家里。亚多尼兰掌管他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He sent them off to Lebanon in shifts of ten thousand a month, so that they spent one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent them to Lebanon, 10,000 a month in shifts. They would be a month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the draft.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month in shifts: they were one month in Lebanon and two months at home; Adoniram was in charge of the labor force.
verses.textEnNlt: He sent them to Lebanon in shifts, 10,000 every month, so that each man would be one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of this labor force.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month in shifts; they were in Lebanon for a month, and two months at home. And Adoniram was in charge of the forced laborers.
verses.textEn: He sent them off to Lebanon in shifts of ten thousand a month, so that they spent one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.

verses.textZh: 所罗门有七万个搬运重物的工人，有八万个在山上凿石的石匠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门有七万个搬运重物的工人，有八万个在山上凿石的石匠。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门用七万扛抬的，八万在山上凿石头的。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon had seventy thousand carriers and eighty thousand stonecutters in the hills,
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon also had 70,000 burden-bearers and 80,000 stonecutters in the hill country,
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon had seventy thousand who carried burdens, and eighty thousand who quarried stone in the mountains,
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also had 70,000 common laborers, 80,000 quarry workers in the hill country,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon had seventy thousand porters, and eighty thousand stonemasons in the mountains,
verses.textEn: Solomon had seventy thousand carriers and eighty thousand stonecutters in the hills,

verses.textZh: 除此以外，所罗门还有三千三百个监管工作的官长，管理作工的人民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 除此以外，所罗门还有三千三百个监管工作的官长，管理作工的人民。
verses.textZhCuv: 此外，所罗门用三千三百督工的，监管工人。
verses.textEnNiv: as well as thirty-three hundred foremen who supervised the project and directed the workers.
verses.textEnEsv: besides Solomon’s 3,300 chief officers who were over the work, who had charge of the people who carried on the work.
verses.textEnNkjv: besides three thousand three hundred from the chiefs of Solomon’s deputies, who supervised the people who labored in the work.
verses.textEnNlt: and 3,600 foremen to supervise the work.
verses.textEnNasb: besides Solomon’s 3,300 chief deputies who were in charge of the project and ruled over the people who were doing the work.
verses.textEn: as well as thirty-three hundred foremen who supervised the project and directed the workers.

verses.textZh: 王下令，人就开凿出又大又贵重的石头，用凿好的石头作殿的地基。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王下令，人就开凿出又大又贵重的石头，用凿好的石头作殿的地基。
verses.textZhCuv: 王下令，人就凿出又大又宝贵的石头来，用以立殿的根基。
verses.textEnNiv: At the king’s command they removed from the quarry large blocks of high-grade stone to provide a foundation of dressed stone for the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: At the king’s command they quarried out great, costly stones in order to lay the foundation of the house with dressed stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king commanded them to quarry large stones, costly stones, and hewn stones, to lay the foundation of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: At the king’s command, they quarried large blocks of high-quality stone and shaped them to make the foundation of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king issued orders, and they quarried large stones, valuable stones, to lay the foundation of the house with cut stones.
verses.textEn: At the king’s command they removed from the quarry large blocks of high-grade stone to provide a foundation of dressed stone for the temple.

verses.textZh: 所罗门的工匠、希兰的工匠和迦巴勒人把石头凿好，又预备建造殿宇用的木料和石料。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的工匠、希兰的工匠和迦巴勒人把石头凿好，又预备建造殿宇用的木料和石料。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的匠人和希兰的匠人，并迦巴勒人，都将石头凿好，预备木料和石头建殿。
verses.textEnNiv: The craftsmen of Solomon and Hiram and workers from Byblos cut and prepared the timber and stone for the building of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: So Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the men of Gebal did the cutting and prepared the timber and the stone to build the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Solomon’s builders, Hiram’s builders, and the Gebalites quarried them; and they prepared timber and stones to build the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Men from the city of Gebal helped Solomon’s and Hiram’s builders prepare the timber and stone for the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut the stones, and they prepared the timbers and the stones to build the house.
verses.textEn: The craftsmen of Solomon and Hiram and workers from Byblos cut and prepared the timber and stone for the building of the temple.

verses.textZh: 以色列人出埃及地以后四百八十年，所罗门作以色列王的第四年西弗月，就是二月，他动工建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人出埃及地以后四百八十年，所罗门作以色列王的第四年西弗月，就是二月，他动工建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人出埃及地后四百八十年，所罗门作以色列王第四年西弗月，就是二月，开工建造耶和华的殿。
verses.textEnNiv: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, the second month, he began to build the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the people of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, which is the second month, he began to build the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: It was in midspring, in the month of Ziv, during the fourth year of Solomon’s reign, that he began to construct the Temple of the Lord . This was 480 years after the people of Israel were rescued from their slavery in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the four hundred and eightieth year after the sons of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, that is, the second month, that he began to build the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, the second month, he began to build the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 所罗门为耶和华所建的殿，长二十七公尺，宽九公尺，高十三公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门为耶和华所建的殿，长二十七公尺，宽九公尺，高十三公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王为耶和华所建的殿，长六十肘，宽二十肘，高三十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The temple that King Solomon built for the Lord was sixty cubits long, twenty wide and thirty high.
verses.textEnEsv: The house that King Solomon built for the Lord was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the house which King Solomon built for the Lord, its length was sixty cubits, its width twenty, and its height thirty cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: The Temple that King Solomon built for the Lord was 90 feet long, 30 feet wide, and 45 feet high.
verses.textEnNasb: And the house which King Solomon built for the Lordwas sixty cubits in its length, and twenty cubits in its width, and its height was thirty cubits.
verses.textEn: The temple that King Solomon built for the Lord was sixty cubits long, twenty wide and thirty high.

verses.textZh: 殿的前廊长九公尺，和殿的宽度一样，宽四公尺半。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殿的前廊长九公尺，和殿的宽度一样，宽四公尺半。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿前的廊子长二十肘，与殿的宽窄一样，阔十肘；
verses.textEnNiv: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple extended the width of the temple, that is twenty cubits, and projected ten cubits from the front of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: The vestibule in front of the nave of the house was twenty cubits long, equal to the width of the house, and ten cubits deep in front of the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: The vestibule in front of the sanctuary of the house was twenty cubits long across the width of the house, and the width of thevestibuleextended ten cubits from the front of the house.
verses.textEnNlt: The entry room at the front of the Temple was 30 feet wide, running across the entire width of the Temple. It projected outward 15 feet from the front of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: The porch in front of the main room of the house was twenty cubits in length, corresponding to the width of the house, and its width along the front of the house was ten cubits.
verses.textEn: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple extended the width of the temple, that is twenty cubits, and projected ten cubits from the front of the temple.

verses.textZh: 又为殿做了窗架子内宽外窄的窗户。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又为殿做了窗架子内宽外窄的窗户。
verses.textZhCuv: 又为殿做了严紧的窗棂。
verses.textEnNiv: He made narrow windows high up in the temple walls.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made for the house windows with recessed frames.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made for the house windows with beveled frames.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also made narrow recessed windows throughout the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Also for the house he made windows with artistic frames.
verses.textEn: He made narrow windows high up in the temple walls.

verses.textZh: 紧靠殿墙，就是围着外殿和内殿的墙，他又建造平台，围绕殿的四周，做成厢房。
verses.textZhCnvs: 紧靠殿墙，就是围着外殿和内殿的墙，他又建造平台，围绕殿的四周，做成厢房。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠着殿墙，围着外殿内殿，造了三层旁屋；
verses.textEnNiv: Against the walls of the main hall and inner sanctuary he built a structure around the building, in which there were side rooms.
verses.textEnEsv: He also built a structure against the wall of the house, running around the walls of the house, both the nave and the inner sanctuary. And he made side chambers all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: Against the wall of the temple he built chambers all around, against the walls of the temple, all around the sanctuary and the inner sanctuary. Thus he made side chambers all around it.
verses.textEnNlt: He built a complex of rooms against the outer walls of the Temple, all the way around the sides and rear of the building.
verses.textEnNasb: Against the wall of the house he built stories encompassing the walls of the house around both the main room and the inner sanctuary; so he made side chambers all around.
verses.textEn: Against the walls of the main hall and inner sanctuary he built a structure around the building, in which there were side rooms.

verses.textZh: 厢房的下层宽两公尺两公寸；中层宽两公尺七公寸；第三层宽三公尺一公寸。他在殿墙外面四周留有暗架，所以梁木不必插入殿墙里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 厢房的下层宽两公尺两公寸；中层宽两公尺七公寸；第三层宽三公尺一公寸。他在殿墙外面四周留有暗架，所以梁木不必插入殿墙里。
verses.textZhCuv: 下层宽五肘，中层宽六肘，上层宽七肘。殿外旁屋的梁木搁在殿墙坎上，免得插入殿墙。
verses.textEnNiv: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits and the third floor seven. He made offset ledges around the outside of the temple so that nothing would be inserted into the temple walls.
verses.textEnEsv: The lowest story was five cubits broad, the middle one was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad. For around the outside of the house he made offsets on the wall in order that the supporting beams should not be inserted into the walls of the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: The lowest chamber was five cubits wide, the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for he made narrow ledges around the outside of the temple, so that thesupportbeams would not be fastened into the walls of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: The complex was three stories high, the bottom floor being 7-1/2 feet wide, the second floor 9 feet wide, and the top floor 10-1/2 feet wide. The rooms were connected to the walls of the Temple by beams resting on ledges built out from the wall. So the beams were not inserted into the walls themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: The lowest story was five cubits wide, the middle was six cubits wide, and the third was seven cubits wide; for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house all around so that the beams would not be inserted into the walls of the house.
verses.textEn: The lowest floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits and the third floor seven. He made offset ledges around the outside of the temple so that nothing would be inserted into the temple walls.

verses.textZh: 建殿是用采石场预备好了的石料；所以建殿的时候，在殿里听不到锤子、斧头或任何铁器的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 建殿是用采石场预备好了的石料；所以建殿的时候，在殿里听不到锤子、斧头或任何铁器的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 建殿是用山中凿成的石头。建殿的时候，锤子、斧子，和别样铁器的响声都没有听见。
verses.textEnNiv: In building the temple, only blocks dressed at the quarry were used, and no hammer, chisel or any other iron tool was heard at the temple site while it was being built.
verses.textEnEsv: When the house was built, it was with stone prepared at the quarry, so that neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was being built.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the temple, when it was being built, was built with stone finished at the quarry, so that no hammer or chisel or any iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built.
verses.textEnNlt: The stones used in the construction of the Temple were finished at the quarry, so there was no sound of hammer, ax, or any other iron tool at the building site.
verses.textEnNasb: The house, while it was being built, was built of stone finished at the quarry, and neither hammer, nor axe, nor any iron tool was heard in the house while it was being built.
verses.textEn: In building the temple, only blocks dressed at the quarry were used, and no hammer, chisel or any other iron tool was heard at the temple site while it was being built.

verses.textZh: 厢房的下层门在殿的右边，人可以从螺旋形梯子上厢房的中层，再从中层上到第三层。
verses.textZhCnvs: 厢房的下层门在殿的右边，人可以从螺旋形梯子上厢房的中层，再从中层上到第三层。
verses.textZhCuv: 在殿右边当中的旁屋有门，门内有旋螺的楼梯，可以上到第二层，从第二层可以上到第三层。
verses.textEnNiv: The entrance to the lowest floor was on the south side of the temple; a stairway led up to the middle level and from there to the third.
verses.textEnEsv: The entrance for the lowest story was on the south side of the house, and one went up by stairs to the middle story, and from the middle story to the third.
verses.textEnNkjv: The doorway for the middle story was on the right side of the temple. They went up by stairs to the middle story, and from the middle to the third.
verses.textEnNlt: The entrance to the bottom floor was on the south side of the Temple. There were winding stairs going up to the second floor, and another flight of stairs between the second and third floors.
verses.textEnNasb: The doorway for the lowest side chamber was on the right side of the house; and they would go up by a winding staircase to the middle story, and from the middle to the third.
verses.textEn: The entrance to the lowest floor was on the south side of the temple; a stairway led up to the middle level and from there to the third.

verses.textZh: 所罗门建殿，建造完成以后，就用香柏木的栋梁和香柏木的木板做殿的天花板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门建殿，建造完成以后，就用香柏木的栋梁和香柏木的木板做殿的天花板。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建殿，安置香柏木的栋梁，又用香柏木板遮盖。
verses.textEnNiv: So he built the temple and completed it, roofing it with beams and cedar planks.
verses.textEnEsv: So he built the house and finished it, and he made the ceiling of the house of beams and planks of cedar.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he built the temple and finished it, and he paneled the temple with beams and boards of cedar.
verses.textEnNlt: After completing the Temple structure, Solomon put in a ceiling made of cedar beams and planks.
verses.textEnNasb: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
verses.textEn: So he built the temple and completed it, roofing it with beams and cedar planks.

verses.textZh: 靠着圣殿所建的厢房，每层高两公尺两公寸，都用香柏木的梁木与殿连接。
verses.textZhCnvs: 靠着圣殿所建的厢房，每层高两公尺两公寸，都用香柏木的梁木与殿连接。
verses.textZhCuv: 靠着殿所造的旁屋，每层高五肘，香柏木的栋梁搁在殿墙坎上。
verses.textEnNiv: And he built the side rooms all along the temple. The height of each was five cubits, and they were attached to the temple by beams of cedar.
verses.textEnEsv: He built the structure against the whole house, five cubits high, and it was joined to the house with timbers of cedar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built side chambers against the entire temple, each five cubits high; they were attached to the temple with cedar beams.
verses.textEnNlt: As already stated, he built a complex of rooms along the sides of the building, attached to the Temple walls by cedar timbers. Each story of the complex was 7-1/2 feet high.
verses.textEnNasb: He also built the stories against the whole house, each five cubits high; and they were attached to the house with timbers of cedar.
verses.textEn: And he built the side rooms all along the temple. The height of each was five cubits, and they were attached to the temple by beams of cedar.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到所罗门说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到所罗门说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到所罗门说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to Solomon:
verses.textEnEsv: Now the word of the Lord came to Solomon,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave this message to Solomon:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to Solomon:

verses.textZh: "关于你正在建造的这殿，如果你遵行我的律例，实行我的典章，谨守我的一切诫命，并且照着去行，我就必向你实现我应许你父亲大卫的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: "关于你正在建造的这殿，如果你遵行我的律例，实行我的典章，谨守我的一切诫命，并且照着去行，我就必向你实现我应许你父亲大卫的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 「论到你所建的这殿，你若遵行我的律例，谨守我的典章，遵从我的一切诫命，我必向你应验我所应许你父亲大卫的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "As for this temple you are building, if you follow my decrees, observe my laws and keep all my commands and obey them, I will fulfill through you the promise I gave to David your father.
verses.textEnEsv: "Concerning this house that you are building, if you will walk in my statutes and obey my rules and keep all my commandments and walk in them, then I will establish my word with you, which I spoke to David your father.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Concerning this temple which you are building, if you walk in My statutes, execute My judgments, keep all My commandments, and walk in them, then I will perform My word with you, which I spoke to your father David.
verses.textEnNlt: "Concerning this Temple you are building, if you keep all my decrees and regulations and obey all my commands, I will fulfill through you the promise I made to your father, David.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for this house which you are building, if you will walk in My statutes and execute My ordinances and keep all My commandments by walking in them, then I will fulfill My word with you which I spoke to David your father.
verses.textEn: "As for this temple you are building, if you follow my decrees, observe my laws and keep all my commands and obey them, I will fulfill through you the promise I gave to David your father.

verses.textZh: 我必住在以色列人中间，也必不离弃我的子民以色列。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必住在以色列人中间，也必不离弃我的子民以色列。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必住在以色列人中间，并不丢弃我民以色列。」
verses.textEnNiv: And I will live among the Israelites and will not abandon my people Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel and will not forsake my people Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake My people Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: I will live among the Israelites and will never abandon my people Israel."
verses.textEnNasb: And I will dwell among the sons of Israel, and will not abandon My people Israel."
verses.textEn: And I will live among the Israelites and will not abandon my people Israel."

verses.textZh: 所罗门建殿，并且建造完成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门建殿，并且建造完成。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建造殿宇。
verses.textEnNiv: So Solomon built the temple and completed it.
verses.textEnEsv: So Solomon built the house and finished it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Solomon built the temple and finished it.
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon finished building the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon built the house and finished it.
verses.textEn: So Solomon built the temple and completed it.

verses.textZh: 殿内的墙壁，从地面到天花板，都贴上香柏木，殿内的地面，都铺上松木板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殿内的墙壁，从地面到天花板，都贴上香柏木，殿内的地面，都铺上松木板。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿里面用香柏木板贴墙，从地到棚顶都用木板遮蔽，又用松木板铺地。
verses.textEnNiv: He lined its interior walls with cedar boards, paneling them from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and covered the floor of the temple with planks of juniper.
verses.textEnEsv: He lined the walls of the house on the inside with boards of cedar. From the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood, and he covered the floor of the house with boards of cypress.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built the inside walls of the temple with cedar boards; from the floor of the temple to the ceiling he paneled the inside with wood; and he covered the floor of the temple with planks of cypress.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire inside, from floor to ceiling, was paneled with wood. He paneled the walls and ceilings with cedar, and he used planks of cypress for the floors.
verses.textEnNasb: He built the walls of the house on the inside with boards of cedar; from the floor of the house to the ceiling he paneled the walls on the inside with wood, and he paneled the floor of the house with boards of juniper.
verses.textEn: He lined its interior walls with cedar boards, paneling them from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and covered the floor of the temple with planks of juniper.

verses.textZh: 又建内殿长九公尺，从地面到天花板，他用香柏木板隔开，成为至圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又建内殿长九公尺，从地面到天花板，他用香柏木板隔开，成为至圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 内殿，就是至圣所，长二十肘，从地到棚顶用香柏木板遮蔽 。
verses.textEnNiv: He partitioned off twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnEsv: He built twenty cubits of the rear of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the walls, and he built this within as an inner sanctuary, as the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he built the twenty-cubit room at the rear of the temple, from floor to ceiling, with cedar boards; he built it inside as the inner sanctuary, as the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNlt: He partitioned off an inner sanctuary—the Most Holy Place—at the far end of the Temple. It was 30 feet deep and was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.
verses.textEnNasb: He also built twenty cubits on the rear part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the ceiling; he built them for it on the inside as an inner sanctuary, as the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEn: He partitioned off twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.

verses.textZh: 内殿前面的外殿长十八公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 内殿前面的外殿长十八公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 内殿前的外殿，长四十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: The main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.
verses.textEnEsv: The house, that is, the nave in front of the inner sanctuary, was forty cubits long.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in front of it the temple sanctuary was forty cubits long.
verses.textEnNlt: The main room of the Temple, outside the Most Holy Place, was 60 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: The house, that is, the main room in front of the inner sanctuary, was forty cubits long.
verses.textEn: The main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.

verses.textZh: 殿的内部都贴上香柏木，上面刻有匏瓜和初开的花朵，全部都是香柏木，一块石头都看不见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殿的内部都贴上香柏木，上面刻有匏瓜和初开的花朵，全部都是香柏木，一块石头都看不见。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿里一点石头都不显露，一概用香柏木遮蔽；上面刻着野瓜和初开的花。
verses.textEnNiv: The inside of the temple was cedar, carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; no stone was to be seen.
verses.textEnEsv: The cedar within the house was carved in the form of gourds and open flowers. All was cedar; no stone was seen.
verses.textEnNkjv: The inside of the temple was cedar, carved with ornamental buds and open flowers. All was cedar; there was no stone tobe seen.
verses.textEnNlt: Cedar paneling completely covered the stone walls throughout the Temple, and the paneling was decorated with carvings of gourds and open flowers.
verses.textEnNasb: There was cedar inside the house, carved in the shape of gourds and open flowers; everything was cedar, there was no stone visible.
verses.textEn: The inside of the temple was cedar, carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; no stone was to be seen.

verses.textZh: 他在殿中预备了内殿，好把耶和华的约柜安放在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在殿中预备了内殿，好把耶和华的约柜安放在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 殿里预备了内殿，好安放耶和华的约柜。
verses.textEnNiv: He prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the Lord there.
verses.textEnEsv: The inner sanctuary he prepared in the innermost part of the house, to set there the ark of the covenant of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he prepared the inner sanctuary inside the temple, to set the ark of the covenant of the Lord there.
verses.textEnNlt: He prepared the inner sanctuary at the far end of the Temple, where the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant would be placed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he prepared an inner sanctuary inside the house in order to place there the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.textEn: He prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the Lord there.

verses.textZh: 内殿长九公尺，宽九公尺，高九公尺；内部都贴上精金，用香柏木做的坛也贴上精金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 内殿长九公尺，宽九公尺，高九公尺；内部都贴上精金，用香柏木做的坛也贴上精金。
verses.textZhCuv: 内殿长二十肘，宽二十肘，高二十肘，墙面都贴上精金；又用香柏木做坛，包上精金。
verses.textEnNiv: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty wide and twenty high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.
verses.textEnEsv: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high, and he overlaid it with pure gold. He also overlaid an altar of cedar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high. He overlaid it with pure gold, and overlaid the altar of cedar.
verses.textEnNlt: This inner sanctuary was 30 feet long, 30 feet wide, and 30 feet high. He overlaid the inside with solid gold. He also overlaid the altar made of cedar.
verses.textEnNasb: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits in length, twenty cubits in width, and twenty cubits in height; and he overlaid it with pure gold. He also paneled the altar with cedar.
verses.textEn: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty wide and twenty high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.

verses.textZh: 殿的内部所罗门都贴上精金，把金炼挂在内殿的前面，内殿也都贴上精金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 殿的内部所罗门都贴上精金，把金炼挂在内殿的前面，内殿也都贴上精金。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门用精金贴了殿内的墙，又用金链子挂在内殿前门扇，用金包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon covered the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon overlaid the inside of the house with pure gold, and he drew chains of gold across, in front of the inner sanctuary, and overlaid it with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Solomon overlaid the inside of the temple with pure gold. He stretched gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, and overlaid it with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon overlaid the rest of the Temple’s interior with solid gold, and he made gold chains to protect the entrance to the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon overlaid the inside of the house with pure gold. And he extended chains of gold across the front of the inner sanctuary, and he overlaid it with gold.
verses.textEn: Solomon covered the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.

verses.textZh: 他把整个的殿都贴上金子，直到整个的殿都贴完；在内殿的坛，整个都贴上了金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把整个的殿都贴上金子，直到整个的殿都贴完；在内殿的坛，整个都贴上了金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 全殿都贴上金子，直到贴完；内殿前的坛，也都用金包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: So he overlaid the whole interior with gold. He also overlaid with gold the altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: And he overlaid the whole house with gold, until all the house was finished. Also the whole altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary he overlaid with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: The whole temple he overlaid with gold, until he had finished all the temple; also he overlaid with gold the entire altar that was by the inner sanctuary.
verses.textEnNlt: So he finished overlaying the entire Temple with gold, including the altar that belonged to the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: He overlaid the entire house with gold, until all the house was finished. Also the entire altar which was by the inner sanctuary he overlaid with gold.
verses.textEn: So he overlaid the whole interior with gold. He also overlaid with gold the altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 在内殿，他用橄榄木做了两个基路伯，各高四公尺四公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在内殿，他用橄榄木做了两个基路伯，各高四公尺四公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用橄榄木做两个基路伯，各高十肘，安在内殿。
verses.textEnNiv: For the inner sanctuary he made a pair of cherubim out of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
verses.textEnEsv: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olivewood, each ten cubits high.
verses.textEnNkjv: Inside the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
verses.textEnNlt: He made two cherubim of wild olive wood, each 15 feet tall, and placed them in the inner sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
verses.textEn: For the inner sanctuary he made a pair of cherubim out of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

verses.textZh: 第一个基路伯一边的翅膀长两公尺两公寸，另一边的翅膀也是两公尺两公寸；由这翅膀尖到那翅膀尖共有四公尺四公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一个基路伯一边的翅膀长两公尺两公寸，另一边的翅膀也是两公尺两公寸；由这翅膀尖到那翅膀尖共有四公尺四公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一个基路伯有两个翅膀，各长五肘，从这翅膀尖到那翅膀尖共有十肘；
verses.textEnNiv: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing five cubits—ten cubits from wing tip to wing tip.
verses.textEnEsv: Five cubits was the length of one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the length of the other wing of the cherub; it was ten cubits from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other.
verses.textEnNkjv: One wing of the cherub was five cubits, and the other wing of the cherub five cubits: ten cubits from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other.
verses.textEnNlt: The wingspan of each of the cherubim was 15 feet, each wing being 7-1/2 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: The one wing of the first cherub was five cubits, and the other wing of the first cherub was five cubits; from the end of one wing to the end of the other wing were ten cubits.
verses.textEn: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing five cubits—ten cubits from wing tip to wing tip.

verses.textZh: 第二个基路伯的两个翅膀也是四公尺四公寸长。两个基路伯的大小和样式都是一样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二个基路伯的两个翅膀也是四公尺四公寸长。两个基路伯的大小和样式都是一样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那一个基路伯的两个翅膀也是十肘，两个基路伯的尺寸、形象都是一样。
verses.textEnNiv: The second cherub also measured ten cubits, for the two cherubim were identical in size and shape.
verses.textEnEsv: The other cherub also measured ten cubits; both cherubim had the same measure and the same form.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the other cherub was ten cubits; both cherubim were of the same size and shape.
verses.textEnNlt: The two cherubim were identical in shape and size;
verses.textEnNasb: The second cherub was ten cubits; both of the cherubim were of the same measurement and the same form.
verses.textEn: The second cherub also measured ten cubits, for the two cherubim were identical in size and shape.

verses.textZh: 第一个基路伯高四公尺四公寸，第二个基路伯也是一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一个基路伯高四公尺四公寸，第二个基路伯也是一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 这基路伯高十肘，那基路伯也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: The height of each cherub was ten cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: The height of one cherub was ten cubits, and so was that of the other cherub.
verses.textEnNkjv: The height of one cherub was ten cubits, and so was the other cherub.
verses.textEnNlt: each was 15 feet tall.
verses.textEnNasb: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was that of the other cherub.
verses.textEn: The height of each cherub was ten cubits.

verses.textZh: 他把两个基路伯安放在内殿里面，基路伯的翅膀是张开的；这一个基路伯的一个翅膀接到这边的墙壁，另一个基路伯的一个翅膀接到另一边的墙壁，他们另外的两个翅膀在殿的中间彼此相接。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把两个基路伯安放在内殿里面，基路伯的翅膀是张开的；这一个基路伯的一个翅膀接到这边的墙壁，另一个基路伯的一个翅膀接到另一边的墙壁，他们另外的两个翅膀在殿的中间彼此相接。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将两个基路伯安在内殿里；基路伯的翅膀是张开的，这基路伯的一个翅膀挨着这边的墙，那基路伯的一个翅膀挨着那边的墙，里边的两个翅膀在殿中间彼此相接；
verses.textEnNiv: He placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple, with their wings spread out. The wing of one cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the other touched the other wall, and their wings touched each other in the middle of the room.
verses.textEnEsv: He put the cherubim in the innermost part of the house. And the wings of the cherubim were spread out so that a wing of one touched the one wall, and a wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; their other wings touched each other in the middle of the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he set the cherubim inside the inner room; and they stretched out the wings of the cherubim so that the wing of the one touched one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall. And their wings touched each other in the middle of the room.
verses.textEnNlt: He placed them side by side in the inner sanctuary of the Temple. Their outspread wings reached from wall to wall, while their inner wings touched at the center of the room.
verses.textEnNasb: He placed the cherubim in the midst of the inner house, and the wings of the cherubim spread out so that the wing of the one was touching the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub was touching the other wall. And their wings were touching end to end in the center of the house.
verses.textEn: He placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple, with their wings spread out. The wing of one cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the other touched the other wall, and their wings touched each other in the middle of the room.

verses.textZh: 他又把这两个基路伯贴上金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把这两个基路伯贴上金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用金子包裹二基路伯。
verses.textEnNiv: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: And he overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He overlaid the two cherubim with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: He also overlaid the cherubim with gold.
verses.textEn: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.

verses.textZh: 内殿和外殿周围的墙壁上，他都刻上基路伯、棕树和初开的花朵的雕刻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 内殿和外殿周围的墙壁上，他都刻上基路伯、棕树和初开的花朵的雕刻。
verses.textZhCuv: 内殿、外殿周围的墙上都刻着基路伯、棕树，和初开的花。
verses.textEnNiv: On the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer rooms, he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers.
verses.textEnEsv: Around all the walls of the house he carved engraved figures of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, in the inner and outer rooms.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he carved all the walls of the temple all around, both the inner and outer sanctuaries, with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers.
verses.textEnNlt: He decorated all the walls of the inner sanctuary and the main room with carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he carved all the surrounding walls of the house with engravings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, for the inner and outer sanctuaries.
verses.textEn: On the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer rooms, he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers.

verses.textZh: 内殿和外殿的地板上也都贴上金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 内殿和外殿的地板上也都贴上金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 内殿、外殿的地板都贴上金子。
verses.textEnNiv: He also covered the floors of both the inner and outer rooms of the temple with gold.
verses.textEnEsv: The floor of the house he overlaid with gold in the inner and outer rooms.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the floor of the temple he overlaid with gold, both the inner and outer sanctuaries.
verses.textEnNlt: He overlaid the floor in both rooms with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And he overlaid the floor of the house with gold, for the inner and outer sanctuaries.
verses.textEn: He also covered the floors of both the inner and outer rooms of the temple with gold.

verses.textZh: 内殿的入口，他用橄榄木做了门扇、门楣和五根门柱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 内殿的入口，他用橄榄木做了门扇、门楣和五根门柱。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用橄榄木制造内殿的门扇、门楣、门框；门口有墙的五分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary he made doors out of olive wood that were one fifth of the width of the sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary he made doors of olivewood; the lintel and the doorposts were five-sided.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary he made doors of olive wood; the lintel and doorposts were one-fifth ofthewall.
verses.textEnNlt: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary, he made double doors of wild olive wood with five-sided doorposts.
verses.textEnNasb: And for the entrance of the inner sanctuary he made doors of olive wood, the lintel, and five-sided doorposts.
verses.textEn: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary he made doors out of olive wood that were one fifth of the width of the sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 他在橄榄木做的两门上，雕刻上基路伯、棕树和初开的花朵。他又在基路伯和棕树上包上了金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在橄榄木做的两门上，雕刻上基路伯、棕树和初开的花朵。他又在基路伯和棕树上包上了金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 在橄榄木做的两门扇上刻着基路伯、棕树，和初开的花，都贴上金子。
verses.textEnNiv: And on the two olive-wood doors he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with hammered gold.
verses.textEnEsv: He covered the two doors of olivewood with carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers. He overlaid them with gold and spread gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.
verses.textEnNkjv: The two doors wereof olive wood; and he carved on them figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he spread gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees.
verses.textEnNlt: These double doors were decorated with carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers. The doors, including the decorations of cherubim and palm trees, were overlaid with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: So he made two doors of olive wood, and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he overlaid the cherubim and the palm trees with gold.
verses.textEn: And on the two olive-wood doors he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with hammered gold.

verses.textZh: 他又照样为外殿的门，用橄榄木做了四根门柱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又照样为外殿的门，用橄榄木做了四根门柱。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用橄榄木制造外殿的门框，门口有墙的四分之一。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, for the entrance to the main hall he made doorframes out of olive wood that were one fourth of the width of the hall.
verses.textEnEsv: So also he made for the entrance to the nave doorposts of olivewood, in the form of a square,
verses.textEnNkjv: So for the door of the sanctuary he also made doorposts of olive wood, one-fourth ofthewall.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he made four-sided doorposts of wild olive wood for the entrance to the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: So too he made for the entrance of the main room four-sided doorposts of olive wood,
verses.textEn: In the same way, for the entrance to the main hall he made doorframes out of olive wood that were one fourth of the width of the hall.

verses.textZh: 用松木做的两扇门，这一扇有两叶，是叠合在一起的，那一扇也有两叶，也是叠合在一起的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用松木做的两扇门，这一扇有两叶，是叠合在一起的，那一扇也有两叶，也是叠合在一起的。
verses.textZhCuv: 用松木做门两扇。这扇分两扇，是折叠的；那扇分两扇，也是折叠的。
verses.textEnNiv: He also made two doors out of juniper wood, each having two leaves that turned in sockets.
verses.textEnEsv: and two doors of cypress wood. The two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the two doors wereof cypress wood; two panels comprised one folding door, and two panels comprised the other folding door.
verses.textEnNlt: There were two folding doors of cypress wood, and each door was hinged to fold back upon itself.
verses.textEnNasb: and two doors of juniper wood; the two leaves of the one door turned on pivots, and the two leaves of the other door turned on pivots.
verses.textEn: He also made two doors out of juniper wood, each having two leaves that turned in sockets.

verses.textZh: 他又在上面刻上了基路伯、棕树和初开的花朵；又在雕刻上紧贴上金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又在上面刻上了基路伯、棕树和初开的花朵；又在雕刻上紧贴上金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 上面刻着基路伯、棕树，和初开的花，都用金子贴了。
verses.textEnNiv: He carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers on them and overlaid them with gold hammered evenly over the carvings.
verses.textEnEsv: On them he carved cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, and he overlaid them with gold evenly applied on the carved work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers onthem, and overlaid them with gold applied evenly on the carved work.
verses.textEnNlt: These doors were decorated with carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers—all overlaid evenly with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: He carved on it cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold plated on the carved work.
verses.textEn: He carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers on them and overlaid them with gold hammered evenly over the carvings.

verses.textZh: 他又用凿好了的石头三层，香柏木一层建造内院。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又用凿好了的石头三层，香柏木一层建造内院。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又用凿成的石头三层、香柏木一层建筑内院。
verses.textEnNiv: And he built the inner courtyard of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams.
verses.textEnEsv: He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and one course of cedar beams.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built the inner court with three rows of hewn stone and a row of cedar beams.
verses.textEnNlt: The walls of the inner courtyard were built so that there was one layer of cedar beams between every three layers of finished stone.
verses.textEnNasb: And he built the inner courtyard with three rows of cut stone and a row of cedar beams.
verses.textEn: And he built the inner courtyard of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams.

verses.textZh: 所罗门在位第四年西弗月，奠定了耶和华殿的根基。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在位第四年西弗月，奠定了耶和华殿的根基。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门在位第四年西弗月，立了耶和华殿的根基。
verses.textEnNiv: The foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid in the fourth year, in the month of Ziv.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fourth year the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid, in the month of Ziv.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the fourth year the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid, in the month of Ziv.
verses.textEnNlt: The foundation of the Lord ’s Temple was laid in midspring, in the month of Ziv, during the fourth year of Solomon’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: In the fourth year the foundation of the house of the Lord was laid, in the month of Ziv.
verses.textEn: The foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid in the fourth year, in the month of Ziv.

verses.textZh: 第十一年布勒月，就是八月，圣殿各部分都按照计划完工了。所罗门共用了七年的时间建造圣殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第十一年布勒月，就是八月，圣殿各部分都按照计划完工了。所罗门共用了七年的时间建造圣殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 到十一年布勒月，就是八月，殿和一切属殿的都按着样式造成。他建殿的工夫共有七年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the eleventh year in the month of Bul, the eighth month, the temple was finished in all its details according to its specifications. He had spent seven years building it.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished in all its parts, and according to all its specifications. He was seven years in building it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, which is the eighth month, the house was finished in all its details and according to all its plans. So he was seven years in building it.
verses.textEnNlt: The entire building was completed in every detail by midautumn, in the month of Bul, during the eleventh year of his reign. So it took seven years to build the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the eleventh year, in the month of Bul, that is, the eighth month, the house was finished in all its parts and in accordance with all its plans. So he was seven years in building it.
verses.textEn: In the eleventh year in the month of Bul, the eighth month, the temple was finished in all its details according to its specifications. He had spent seven years building it.

verses.textZh: 所罗门为自己建造宫殿花了十三年才完成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门为自己建造宫殿花了十三年才完成。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门为自己建造宫室，十三年方才造成；
verses.textEnNiv: It took Solomon thirteen years, however, to complete the construction of his palace.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished his entire house.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Solomon took thirteen years to build his own house; so he finished all his house.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also built a palace for himself, and it took him thirteen years to complete the construction.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon built his own house over the course of thirteen years, and he finished all of his house.
verses.textEn: It took Solomon thirteen years, however, to complete the construction of his palace.

verses.textZh: 他又建造黎巴嫩林宫，长四十四公尺，宽二十二公尺，高十三公尺半。有四行香柏木的柱子，柱子上有香柏木的横梁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又建造黎巴嫩林宫，长四十四公尺，宽二十二公尺，高十三公尺半。有四行香柏木的柱子，柱子上有香柏木的横梁。
verses.textZhCuv: 又建造黎巴嫩林宫，长一百肘，宽五十肘，高三十肘，有香柏木柱三 行，柱上有香柏木柁梁。
verses.textEnNiv: He built the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty wide and thirty high, with four rows of cedar columns supporting trimmed cedar beams.
verses.textEnEsv: He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was a hundred cubits and its breadth fifty cubits and its height thirty cubits, and it was built on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also built the House of the Forest of Lebanon; its length was one hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, with four rows of cedar pillars, and cedar beams on the pillars.
verses.textEnNlt: One of Solomon’s buildings was called the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon. It was 150 feet long, 75 feet wide, and 45 feet high. There were four rows of cedar pillars, and great cedar beams rested on the pillars.
verses.textEnNasb: He built the house of the timber from Lebanon; its length was a hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars with cedar beams on the pillars.
verses.textEn: He built the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty wide and thirty high, with four rows of cedar columns supporting trimmed cedar beams.

verses.textZh: 柱子每行十五根，共四十五根；柱子上有厢房，是用香柏木盖屋顶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 柱子每行十五根，共四十五根；柱子上有厢房，是用香柏木盖屋顶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 其上以香柏木为盖，每行柱子十五根，共有四十五根。
verses.textEnNiv: It was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the columns—forty-five beams, fifteen to a row.
verses.textEnEsv: And it was covered with cedar above the chambers that were on the forty-five pillars, fifteen in each row.
verses.textEnNkjv: And itwas paneled with cedar above the beams that were on forty-five pillars, fifteen to a row.
verses.textEnNlt: The hall had a cedar roof. Above the beams on the pillars were forty-five side rooms, arranged in three tiers of fifteen each.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was paneled with cedar above the side chambers which were on the forty-five pillars, fifteen in each row.
verses.textEn: It was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the columns—forty-five beams, fifteen to a row.

verses.textZh: 有窗框三行，窗与窗相对，共有三层。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有窗框三行，窗与窗相对，共有三层。
verses.textZhCuv: 有窗户三层，窗与窗相对。
verses.textEnNiv: Its windows were placed high in sets of three, facing each other.
verses.textEnEsv: There were window frames in three rows, and window opposite window in three tiers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewere windows withbeveledframesin three rows, and window was opposite window in three tiers.
verses.textEnNlt: On each end of the long hall were three rows of windows facing each other.
verses.textEnNasb: There were artistic window frames in three rows, and window was opposite window at three intervals.
verses.textEn: Its windows were placed high in sets of three, facing each other.

verses.textZh: 所有的门和窗都有四方的框子，有窗三层，窗与窗相对。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的门和窗都有四方的框子，有窗三层，窗与窗相对。
verses.textZhCuv: 所有的门框都是厚木见方的，有窗户三层，窗与窗相对。
verses.textEnNiv: All the doorways had rectangular frames; they were in the front part in sets of three, facing each other.
verses.textEnEsv: All the doorways and windows had square frames, and window was opposite window in three tiers.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the doorways and doorposts had rectangular frames; and window was opposite window in three tiers.
verses.textEnNlt: All the doorways and doorposts had rectangular frames and were arranged in sets of three, facing each other.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the doorways and doorposts had squared artistic frames, and window was opposite window at three intervals.
verses.textEn: All the doorways had rectangular frames; they were in the front part in sets of three, facing each other.

verses.textZh: 他又建造柱廊，长二十二公尺，宽十三公尺半。在柱廊前有廊子，在廊子前又有柱子和台阶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又建造柱廊，长二十二公尺，宽十三公尺半。在柱廊前有廊子，在廊子前又有柱子和台阶。
verses.textZhCuv: 并建造有柱子的廊子，长五十肘，宽三十肘；在这廊前又有廊子，廊外有柱子和台阶。
verses.textEnNiv: He made a colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty wide. In front of it was a portico, and in front of that were pillars and an overhanging roof.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the Hall of Pillars; its length was fifty cubits, and its breadth thirty cubits. There was a porch in front with pillars, and a canopy in front of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made the Hall of Pillars: its length was fifty cubits, and its width thirty cubits; and in front of them was a portico with pillars, and a canopy was in front of them.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also built the Hall of Pillars, which was 75 feet long and 45 feet wide. There was a porch in front, along with a canopy supported by pillars.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the hall of pillars; its length was fifty cubits and its width thirty cubits, and a porch was in front of them and pillars and a threshold in front of them.
verses.textEn: He made a colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty wide. In front of it was a portico, and in front of that were pillars and an overhanging roof.

verses.textZh: 又建造王室座廊，就是审判廊，他在这里执行审判。由地板到天花板，都贴上香柏木板。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又建造王室座廊，就是审判廊，他在这里执行审判。由地板到天花板，都贴上香柏木板。
verses.textZhCuv: 又建造一廊，其中设立审判的座位，这廊从地到顶都用香柏木遮蔽。
verses.textEnNiv: He built the throne hall, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge, and he covered it with cedar from floor to ceiling.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the Hall of the Throne where he was to pronounce judgment, even the Hall of Judgment. It was finished with cedar from floor to rafters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he made a hall for the throne, the Hall of Judgment, where he might judge; and itwas paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also built the throne room, known as the Hall of Justice, where he sat to hear legal matters. It was paneled with cedar from floor to ceiling.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made the hall of the throne where he was to judge, the hall of judgment, and it was paneled with cedar from floor to floor.
verses.textEn: He built the throne hall, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge, and he covered it with cedar from floor to ceiling.

verses.textZh: 所罗门自己住的宫殿，是在廊后的另一个院内，建造法相同。他又为他娶法老的女儿建造一座宫院，建法与这廊子一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门自己住的宫殿，是在廊后的另一个院内，建造法相同。他又为他娶法老的女儿建造一座宫院，建法与这廊子一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 廊后院内有所罗门住的宫室；工作与这工作相同。所罗门又为所娶法老的女儿建造一宫，做法与这廊子一样。
verses.textEnNiv: And the palace in which he was to live, set farther back, was similar in design. Solomon also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.
verses.textEnEsv: His own house where he was to dwell, in the other court at the back of the hall, was of like workmanship. Solomon also made a house like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter whom he had taken in marriage.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the house where he dwelt had another court inside the hall, of like workmanship. Solomon also made a house like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had taken aswife.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon’s living quarters surrounded a courtyard behind this hall, and they were constructed the same way. He also built similar living quarters for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.
verses.textEnNasb: And his house where he was to live, the other courtyard inward from the hall, was of this same workmanship. He also made a house like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom Solomon had married.
verses.textEn: And the palace in which he was to live, set farther back, was similar in design. Solomon also made a palace like this hall for Pharaoh’s daughter, whom he had married.

verses.textZh: 从根基到屋檐，从外院到大院，这一切都是用贵重的石块，按尺寸凿好，用锯子内外锯齐的石块建成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从根基到屋檐，从外院到大院，这一切都是用贵重的石块，按尺寸凿好，用锯子内外锯齐的石块建成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 建造这一切所用的石头都是宝贵的，是按着尺寸凿成的，是用锯里外锯齐的；从根基直到檐石，从外头直到大院，都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: All these structures, from the outside to the great courtyard and from foundation to eaves, were made of blocks of high-grade stone cut to size and smoothed on their inner and outer faces.
verses.textEnEsv: All these were made of costly stones, cut according to measure, sawed with saws, back and front, even from the foundation to the coping, and from the outside to the great court.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these wereof costly stones cut to size, trimmed with saws, inside and out, from the foundation to the eaves, and also on the outside to the great court.
verses.textEnNlt: From foundation to eaves, all these buildings were built from huge blocks of high-quality stone, cut with saws and trimmed to exact measure on all sides.
verses.textEnNasb: All of these were made of valuable stones, of stone cut according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside; even from the foundation to the coping, and from the outside to the large courtyard.
verses.textEn: All these structures, from the outside to the great courtyard and from foundation to eaves, were made of blocks of high-grade stone cut to size and smoothed on their inner and outer faces.

verses.textZh: 根基也都是用贵重的大石块；有长四公尺的，也有长三公尺半的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 根基也都是用贵重的大石块；有长四公尺的，也有长三公尺半的。
verses.textZhCuv: 根基是宝贵的大石头，有长十肘的，有长八肘的；
verses.textEnNiv: The foundations were laid with large stones of good quality, some measuring ten cubits and some eight.
verses.textEnEsv: The foundation was of costly stones, huge stones, stones of eight and ten cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: The foundation wasof costly stones, large stones, some ten cubits and some eight cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: Some of the huge foundation stones were 15 feet long, and some were 12 feet long.
verses.textEnNasb: And the foundation was of valuable stones, large stones, stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits.
verses.textEn: The foundations were laid with large stones of good quality, some measuring ten cubits and some eight.

verses.textZh: 上面有按着尺寸凿好的贵重石块和香柏木。
verses.textZhCnvs: 上面有按着尺寸凿好的贵重石块和香柏木。
verses.textZhCuv: 上面有香柏木和按着尺寸凿成宝贵的石头。
verses.textEnNiv: Above were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.
verses.textEnEsv: And above were costly stones, cut according to measurement, and cedar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And above were costly stones, hewn to size, and cedar wood.
verses.textEnNlt: The blocks of high-quality stone used in the walls were also cut to measure, and cedar beams were also used.
verses.textEnNasb: And above were valuable stones, cut according to measure, and cedar.
verses.textEn: Above were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.

verses.textZh: 大院的周围有凿好的石头三层，香柏木一层，与耶和华的内院和殿廊一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大院的周围有凿好的石头三层，香柏木一层，与耶和华的内院和殿廊一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 大院周围有凿成的石头三层、香柏木一层，都照耶和华殿的内院和殿廊的样式。
verses.textEnNiv: The great courtyard was surrounded by a wall of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams, as was the inner courtyard of the temple of the Lord with its portico.
verses.textEnEsv: The great court had three courses of cut stone all around, and a course of cedar beams; so had the inner court of the house of the Lord and the vestibule of the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: The great court was enclosed with three rows of hewn stones and a row of cedar beams. So were the inner court of the house of the Lord and the vestibule of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: The walls of the great courtyard were built so that there was one layer of cedar beams between every three layers of finished stone, just like the walls of the inner courtyard of the Lord ’s Temple with its entry room.
verses.textEnNasb: So the large courtyard all around had three rows of cut stone and a row of cedar beams as well as the inner courtyard of the house of the Lord, and the porch of the house.
verses.textEn: The great courtyard was surrounded by a wall of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams, as was the inner courtyard of the temple of the Lord with its portico.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王派人去把户兰从推罗接来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王派人去把户兰从推罗接来。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王差遣人往泰尔去，将户兰召了来。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon sent to Tyre and brought Huram,
verses.textEnEsv: And King Solomon sent and brought Hiram from Tyre.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now King Solomon sent and brought Huram from Tyre.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon then asked for a man named Huram to come from Tyre.
verses.textEnNasb: Now King Solomon sent word and had Hiram brought from Tyre.
verses.textEn: King Solomon sent to Tyre and brought Huram,

verses.textZh: 户兰是拿弗他利支派中一个寡妇的儿子；他父亲是推罗人，是个铜匠。户兰满有智慧、聪明和知识，能作各样铜工；他来到所罗门王那里，作王的一切工作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户兰是拿弗他利支派中一个寡妇的儿子；他父亲是推罗人，是个铜匠。户兰满有智慧、聪明和知识，能作各样铜工；他来到所罗门王那里，作王的一切工作。
verses.textZhCuv: 他是拿弗他利支派中一个寡妇的儿子，他父亲是泰尔人，作铜匠的。户兰满有智慧、聪明、技能，善于各样铜作。他来到所罗门王那里，做王一切所要做的。
verses.textEnNiv: whose mother was a widow from the tribe of Naphtali and whose father was from Tyre and a skilled craftsman in bronze. Huram was filled with wisdom, with understanding and with knowledge to do all kinds of bronze work. He came to King Solomon and did all the work assigned to him.
verses.textEnEsv: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in bronze. And he was full of wisdom, understanding, and skill for making any work in bronze. He came to King Solomon and did all his work.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was the son of a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a bronze worker; he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill in working with all kinds of bronze work. So he came to King Solomon and did all his work.
verses.textEnNlt: He was half Israelite, since his mother was a widow from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father had been a craftsman in bronze from Tyre. Huram was extremely skillful and talented in any work in bronze, and he came to do all the metal work for King Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: He was a widow’s son from the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, an artisan in bronze; and he was filled with wisdom, skill, and knowledge for doing any work in bronze. So he came to King Solomon and performed all his work.
verses.textEn: whose mother was a widow from the tribe of Naphtali and whose father was from Tyre and a skilled craftsman in bronze. Huram was filled with wisdom, with understanding and with knowledge to do all kinds of bronze work. He came to King Solomon and did all the work assigned to him.

verses.textZh: 他铸造了两根铜柱，每根高八公尺，圆周五公尺三公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他铸造了两根铜柱，每根高八公尺，圆周五公尺三公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 他制造两根铜柱，每根高十八肘，围十二肘；
verses.textEnNiv: He cast two bronze pillars, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.
verses.textEnEsv: He cast two pillars of bronze. Eighteen cubits was the height of one pillar, and a line of twelve cubits measured its circumference. It was hollow, and its thickness was four fingers. The second pillar was the same.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he cast two pillars of bronze, each one eighteen cubits high, and a line of twelve cubits measured the circumference of each.
verses.textEnNlt: Huram cast two bronze pillars, each 27 feet tall and 18 feet in circumference.
verses.textEnNasb: He fashioned the two pillars of bronze; eighteen cubits was the height of each pillar, and a line of twelve cubits measured the circumference of both.
verses.textEn: He cast two bronze pillars, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference.

verses.textZh: 他又用铜铸造了两个柱顶，安放在柱头上，每个柱顶高两公尺两公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又用铜铸造了两个柱顶，安放在柱头上，每个柱顶高两公尺两公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用铜铸了两个柱顶安在柱上，各高五肘。
verses.textEnNiv: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on the tops of the pillars; each capital was five cubits high.
verses.textEnEsv: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of the one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he made two capitals of cast bronze, to set on the tops of the pillars. The height of one capital was five cubits, and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: For the tops of the pillars he cast bronze capitals, each 7-1/2 feet tall.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to put on the tops of the pillars; the height of the one capital was five cubits and the height of the other capital was five cubits.
verses.textEn: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on the tops of the pillars; each capital was five cubits high.

verses.textZh: 他又为柱头上的柱头顶做了两块网子和辫结成的链子，每个柱顶有七块。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又为柱头上的柱头顶做了两块网子和辫结成的链子，每个柱顶有七块。
verses.textZhCuv: 柱顶上有装修的网子和拧成的链索，每顶七个。
verses.textEnNiv: A network of interwoven chains adorned the capitals on top of the pillars, seven for each capital.
verses.textEnEsv: There were lattices of checker work with wreaths of chain work for the capitals on the tops of the pillars, a lattice for the one capital and a lattice for the other capital.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hemade a lattice network, with wreaths of chainwork, for the capitals which were on top of the pillars: seven chains for one capital and seven for the other capital.
verses.textEnNlt: Each capital was decorated with seven sets of latticework and interwoven chains.
verses.textEnNasb: There were lattices of latticework and wreaths of chainwork for the capitals which were on the top of the pillars; seven for the one capital and seven for the other capital.
verses.textEn: A network of interwoven chains adorned the capitals on top of the pillars, seven for each capital.

verses.textZh: 他又做了两行石榴围绕在柱头上，柱顶的网子上，两个柱顶都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做了两行石榴围绕在柱头上，柱顶的网子上，两个柱顶都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 网子周围有两行石榴遮盖柱顶，两个柱顶都是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: He made pomegranates in two rows encircling each network to decorate the capitals on top of the pillars. He did the same for each capital.
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise he made pomegranates in two rows around the one latticework to cover the capital that was on the top of the pillar, and he did the same with the other capital.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he made the pillars, and two rows of pomegranates above the network all around to cover the capitals that were on top; and thus he did for the other capital.
verses.textEnNlt: He also encircled the latticework with two rows of pomegranates to decorate the capitals over the pillars.
verses.textEnNasb: So he made the pillars, and two rows around on the one lattice to cover the capitals which were on the top of the pomegranates; and so he did for the other capital.
verses.textEn: He made pomegranates in two rows encircling each network to decorate the capitals on top of the pillars. He did the same for each capital.

verses.textZh: 廊子里柱头上的柱顶，刻有百合花细工，一公尺八公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 廊子里柱头上的柱顶，刻有百合花细工，一公尺八公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 廊子的柱顶径四肘，刻着百合花。
verses.textEnNiv: The capitals on top of the pillars in the portico were in the shape of lilies, four cubits high.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars in the vestibule were of lily-work, four cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: The capitals which were on top of the pillars in the hall were in the shape of lilies, four cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: The capitals on the columns inside the entry room were shaped like water lilies, and they were six feet tall.
verses.textEnNasb: The capitals which were on the tops of the pillars in the porch were of lily design, four cubits.
verses.textEn: The capitals on top of the pillars in the portico were in the shape of lilies, four cubits high.

verses.textZh: 两根柱子上柱顶的鼓肚上，网子旁边，各有石榴二百个，分两行环绕着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两根柱子上柱顶的鼓肚上，网子旁边，各有石榴二百个，分两行环绕着。
verses.textZhCuv: 两柱顶的鼓肚上挨着网子，各有两行石榴环绕，两行共有二百。
verses.textEnNiv: On the capitals of both pillars, above the bowl-shaped part next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows all around.
verses.textEnEsv: The capitals were on the two pillars and also above the rounded projection which was beside the latticework. There were two hundred pomegranates in two rows all around, and so with the other capital.
verses.textEnNkjv: The capitals on the two pillars also hadpomegranates above, by the convex surface which was next to the network; and there were two hundred such pomegranates in rows on each of the capitals all around.
verses.textEnNlt: The capitals on the two pillars had 200 pomegranates in two rows around them, beside the rounded surface next to the latticework.
verses.textEnNasb: So there were capitals on the two pillars, also above and close to the rounded projection which was beside the lattice; and the pomegranates totaled two hundred in rows around both capitals.
verses.textEn: On the capitals of both pillars, above the bowl-shaped part next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows all around.

verses.textZh: 他把这两根柱子竖立在殿廊的前面。竖立在南边的柱子，他起名叫雅斤；竖立在北面的柱子，起名叫波阿斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把这两根柱子竖立在殿廊的前面。竖立在南边的柱子，他起名叫雅斤；竖立在北面的柱子，起名叫波阿斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 他将两根柱子立在殿廊前头：右边立一根，起名叫雅斤；左边立一根，起名叫波阿斯。
verses.textEnNiv: He erected the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.
verses.textEnEsv: He set up the pillars at the vestibule of the temple. He set up the pillar on the south and called its name Jachin, and he set up the pillar on the north and called its name Boaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he set up the pillars by the vestibule of the temple; he set up the pillar on the right and called its name Jachin, and he set up the pillar on the left and called its name Boaz.
verses.textEnNlt: Huram set the pillars at the entrance of the Temple, one toward the south and one toward the north. He named the one on the south Jakin, and the one on the north Boaz.
verses.textEnNasb: And he set up the pillars at the porch of the main room: he set up the right pillar and named it Jachin, and he set up the left pillar and named it Boaz.
verses.textEn: He erected the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.

verses.textZh: 在柱子的上头刻有百合花的细工。这样，做柱子的工作就完成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在柱子的上头刻有百合花的细工。这样，做柱子的工作就完成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 在柱顶上刻着百合花。这样，造柱子的工就完毕了。
verses.textEnNiv: The capitals on top were in the shape of lilies. And so the work on the pillars was completed.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the tops of the pillars was lily-work. Thus the work of the pillars was finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: The tops of the pillars were in the shape of lilies. So the work of the pillars was finished.
verses.textEnNlt: The capitals on the pillars were shaped like water lilies. And so the work on the pillars was finished.
verses.textEnNasb: On the top of the pillars was the lily design. So the work of the pillars was finished.
verses.textEn: The capitals on top were in the shape of lilies. And so the work on the pillars was completed.

verses.textZh: 他又铸造了一座圆形的铜海，从这边到那边四公尺四公寸，高两公尺两公寸，圆周十三公尺两公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又铸造了一座圆形的铜海，从这边到那边四公尺四公寸，高两公尺两公寸，圆周十三公尺两公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又铸一个铜海，样式是圆的，高五肘，径十肘，围三十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he made the sea of cast metal. It was round, ten cubits from brim to brim, and five cubits high, and a line of thirty cubits measured its circumference.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made the Sea of cast bronze, ten cubits from one brim to the other; itwas completely round. Its height was five cubits, and a line of thirty cubits measured its circumference.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Huram cast a great round basin, 15 feet across from rim to rim, called the Sea. It was 7-1/2 feet deep and about 45 feet in circumference.
verses.textEnNasb: He also made the Sea of cast metal ten cubits from brim to brim, circular in shape, and its height was five cubits, and it was thirty cubits in circumference.
