verses.textEn: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.

verses.textZh: 在铜海边缘以下有匏瓜围绕着，每四十五公分十个。匏瓜共有两行，是铸造铜海的时候，一并铸造上去的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在铜海边缘以下有匏瓜围绕着，每四十五公分十个。匏瓜共有两行，是铸造铜海的时候，一并铸造上去的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在海边之下，周围有野瓜的样式；每肘十瓜，共有两行，是铸海的时候铸上的。
verses.textEnNiv: Below the rim, gourds encircled it—ten to a cubit. The gourds were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Under its brim were gourds, for ten cubits, compassing the sea all around. The gourds were in two rows, cast with it when it was cast.
verses.textEnNkjv: Below its brim were ornamental buds encircling it all around, ten to a cubit, all the way around the Sea. The ornamental buds were cast in two rows when it was cast.
verses.textEnNlt: It was encircled just below its rim by two rows of decorative gourds. There were about six gourds per foot all the way around, and they were cast as part of the basin.
verses.textEnNasb: Under its brim gourds went around encircling it ten to a cubit, completely surrounding the Sea; the gourds were in two rows, cast with the rest.
verses.textEn: Below the rim, gourds encircled it—ten to a cubit. The gourds were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.

verses.textZh: 铜海安放在十二头铜牛背上，三头向北，三头向西，三头向南，三头向东，铜海是在铜牛之上，牛尾都向内。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铜海安放在十二头铜牛背上，三头向北，三头向西，三头向南，三头向东，铜海是在铜牛之上，牛尾都向内。
verses.textZhCuv: 有十二只铜牛驮海：三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东；海在牛上，牛尾都向内。
verses.textEnNiv: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.
verses.textEnEsv: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east. The sea was set on them, and all their rear parts were inward.
verses.textEnNkjv: It stood on twelve oxen: three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; the Sea wasset upon them, and all their back parts pointed inward.
verses.textEnNlt: The Sea was placed on a base of twelve bronze oxen, all facing outward. Three faced north, three faced west, three faced south, and three faced east, and the Sea rested on them.
verses.textEnNasb: It was standing on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east; and the Sea was set on top of them, and all their rear parts turned inward.
verses.textEn: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.

verses.textZh: 铜海厚七公分半，边缘好象杯子的边缘，又好象百合花蕾，能盛水四万公升。
verses.textZhCnvs: 铜海厚七公分半，边缘好象杯子的边缘，又好象百合花蕾，能盛水四万公升。
verses.textZhCuv: 海厚一掌，边如杯边，又如百合花，可容二千罢特。
verses.textEnNiv: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held two thousand baths.
verses.textEnEsv: Its thickness was a handbreadth, and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily. It held two thousand baths.
verses.textEnNkjv: It was a handbreadth thick; and its brim was shaped like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It contained two thousand baths.
verses.textEnNlt: The walls of the Sea were about three inches thick, and its rim flared out like a cup and resembled a water lily blossom. It could hold about 11,000 gallons of water.
verses.textEnNasb: And it was a hand width thick, and its brim was made like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom; it could hold two thousand baths.
verses.textEn: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held two thousand baths.

verses.textZh: 他又做了十个铜盆座；每个长一公尺八公寸，宽一公尺八公寸，高一公尺三公寸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做了十个铜盆座；每个长一公尺八公寸，宽一公尺八公寸，高一公尺三公寸。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用铜制造十个盆座，每座长四肘，宽四肘，高三肘。
verses.textEnNiv: He also made ten movable stands of bronze; each was four cubits long, four wide and three high.
verses.textEnEsv: He also made the ten stands of bronze. Each stand was four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made ten carts of bronze; four cubits was the length of each cart, four cubits its width, and three cubits its height.
verses.textEnNlt: Huram also made ten bronze water carts, each 6 feet long, 6 feet wide, and 4-1/2 feet tall.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made the ten stands of bronze; the length of each stand was four cubits, its width four cubits, and its height was three cubits.
verses.textEn: He also made ten movable stands of bronze; each was four cubits long, four wide and three high.

verses.textZh: 盆座的做法是这样：盆座有数边，各边都连接在盆架中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 盆座的做法是这样：盆座有数边，各边都连接在盆架中。
verses.textZhCuv: 座的造法是这样：四面都有心子，心子在边子当中，
verses.textEnNiv: This is how the stands were made: They had side panels attached to uprights.
verses.textEnEsv: This was the construction of the stands: they had panels, and the panels were set in the frames,
verses.textEnNkjv: And this was the design of the carts: They had panels, and the panels were between frames;
verses.textEnNlt: They were constructed with side panels braced with crossbars.
verses.textEnNasb: This was the design of the stands: they had borders, that is, borders between the crossbars,
verses.textEn: This is how the stands were made: They had side panels attached to uprights.

verses.textZh: 在盆架间的各边上，有狮子、牛和基路伯。盆架上有座，狮子和牛的上下都有花纹的浮雕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在盆架间的各边上，有狮子、牛和基路伯。盆架上有座，狮子和牛的上下都有花纹的浮雕。
verses.textZhCuv: 心子上有狮子和牛，并基路伯；边上有小座，狮子和牛以下有垂下的璎珞。
verses.textEnNiv: On the panels between the uprights were lions, bulls and cherubim—and on the uprights as well. Above and below the lions and bulls were wreaths of hammered work.
verses.textEnEsv: and on the panels that were set in the frames were lions, oxen, and cherubim. On the frames, both above and below the lions and oxen, there were wreaths of beveled work.
verses.textEnNkjv: on the panels that were between the frames were lions, oxen, and cherubim. And on the frames was a pedestal on top. Below the lions and oxen were wreaths of plaited work.
verses.textEnNlt: Both the panels and the crossbars were decorated with carved lions, oxen, and cherubim. Above and below the lions and oxen were wreath decorations.
verses.textEnNasb: and on the borders which were between the crossbars were lions, oxen, and cherubim; and on the crossbars there was a pedestal above, and beneath the lions and oxen were wreaths of hanging work.
verses.textEn: On the panels between the uprights were lions, bulls and cherubim—and on the uprights as well. Above and below the lions and bulls were wreaths of hammered work.

verses.textZh: 每个盆座都有四个铜轮和铜轴，在盆座以下的四脚上有铸成的支架，各边都刻有花纹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每个盆座都有四个铜轮和铜轴，在盆座以下的四脚上有铸成的支架，各边都刻有花纹。
verses.textZhCuv: 每盆座有四个铜轮和铜轴。小座的四角上在盆以下，有铸成的盆架，其旁都有璎珞。
verses.textEnNiv: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles, and each had a basin resting on four supports, cast with wreaths on each side.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, each stand had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze, and at the four corners were supports for a basin. The supports were cast with wreaths at the side of each.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every cart had four bronze wheels and axles of bronze, and its four feet had supports. Under the laver were supports of cast bronze beside each wreath.
verses.textEnNlt: Each of these carts had four bronze wheels and bronze axles. There were supporting posts for the bronze basins at the corners of the carts; these supports were decorated on each side with carvings of wreaths.
verses.textEnNasb: Now each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles, and its four feet had supports; beneath the basin were cast supports with wreaths at each side.
verses.textEn: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles, and each had a basin resting on four supports, cast with wreaths on each side.

verses.textZh: 盆座的口从内缘到顶，高四十五公分。盆口作圆形，照盆架上那座的样式，直径六十六公分。盆口的边上也有雕刻，盆座的边是四方形，不是圆形的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 盆座的口从内缘到顶，高四十五公分。盆口作圆形，照盆架上那座的样式，直径六十六公分。盆口的边上也有雕刻，盆座的边是四方形，不是圆形的。
verses.textZhCuv: 小座高一肘，口是圆的，仿佛座的样式，径一肘半，在口上有雕工，心子是方的，不是圆的。
verses.textEnNiv: On the inside of the stand there was an opening that had a circular frame one cubit deep. This opening was round, and with its basework it measured a cubit and a half. Around its opening there was engraving. The panels of the stands were square, not round.
verses.textEnEsv: Its opening was within a crown that projected upward one cubit. Its opening was round, as a pedestal is made, a cubit and a half deep. At its opening there were carvings, and its panels were square, not round.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its opening inside the crown at the top was one cubit in diameter; and the opening was round, shaped like a pedestal, one and a half cubits in outside diameter; and also on the opening were engravings, but the panels were square, not round.
verses.textEnNlt: The top of each cart had a rounded frame for the basin. It projected 1-1/2 feet above the cart’s top like a round pedestal, and its opening was 2-1/4 feet across; it was decorated on the outside with carvings of wreaths. The panels of the carts were square, not round.
verses.textEnNasb: And its opening inside the crown at the top was a cubit, and its opening was round like the design of a pedestal, a cubit and a half; and on its opening also there were engravings, and their borders were square, not round.
verses.textEn: On the inside of the stand there was an opening that had a circular frame one cubit deep. This opening was round, and with its basework it measured a cubit and a half. Around its opening there was engraving. The panels of the stands were square, not round.

verses.textZh: 盆座的四个轮子是在盆边的下面，轮座与轴相接，每个轮子高六十六公分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 盆座的四个轮子是在盆边的下面，轮座与轴相接，每个轮子高六十六公分。
verses.textZhCuv: 四个轮子在心子以下，轮轴与座相连，每轮高一肘半。
verses.textEnNiv: The four wheels were under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand. The diameter of each wheel was a cubit and a half.
verses.textEnEsv: And the four wheels were underneath the panels. The axles of the wheels were of one piece with the stands, and the height of a wheel was a cubit and a half.
verses.textEnNkjv: Under the panels were the four wheels, and the axles of the wheels werejoined to the cart. The height of a wheel was one and a half cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: Under the panels were four wheels that were connected to axles that had been cast as one unit with the cart. The wheels were 2-1/4 feet in diameter
verses.textEnNasb: The four wheels were underneath the borders, and the axles of the wheels were on the stand. And the height of a wheel was a cubit and a half.
verses.textEn: The four wheels were under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand. The diameter of each wheel was a cubit and a half.

verses.textZh: 轮子的形状，好象车轮的做法，轮轴、轮辋、轮辐、轮毂都是铸成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 轮子的形状，好象车轮的做法，轮轴、轮辋、轮辐、轮毂都是铸成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 轮的样式如同车轮；轴、辋、辐、毂都是铸的。
verses.textEnNiv: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; the axles, rims, spokes and hubs were all of cast metal.
verses.textEnEsv: The wheels were made like a chariot wheel; their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all cast.
verses.textEnNkjv: The workmanship of the wheels was like the workmanship of a chariot wheel; their axle pins, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all of cast bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: and were similar to chariot wheels. The axles, spokes, rims, and hubs were all cast from molten bronze.
verses.textEnNasb: The workmanship of the wheels was like the workmanship of a chariot wheel. Their axles, their rims, their spokes, and their hubs were all cast.
verses.textEn: The wheels were made like chariot wheels; the axles, rims, spokes and hubs were all of cast metal.

verses.textZh: 每一个盆座的四角都有四个支架；支架是与盆座一块铸成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 每一个盆座的四角都有四个支架；支架是与盆座一块铸成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 每座四角上都有盆架，是与座一同铸成的。
verses.textEnNiv: Each stand had four handles, one on each corner, projecting from the stand.
verses.textEnEsv: There were four supports at the four corners of each stand. The supports were of one piece with the stands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And therewere four supports at the four corners of each cart; its supports were part of the cart itself.
verses.textEnNlt: There were handles at each of the four corners of the carts, and these, too, were cast as one unit with the cart.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there were four supports at the four corners of each stand; its supports were part of the stand itself.
verses.textEn: Each stand had four handles, one on each corner, projecting from the stand.

verses.textZh: 盆座顶上有一个圆圈，高二十二公分；在盆座顶的座的撑子和边缘是与座一块铸成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 盆座顶上有一个圆圈，高二十二公分；在盆座顶的座的撑子和边缘是与座一块铸成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 座上有圆架，高半肘；座上有撑子和心子，是与座一同铸的。
verses.textEnNiv: At the top of the stand there was a circular band half a cubit deep. The supports and panels were attached to the top of the stand.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the top of the stand there was a round band half a cubit high; and on the top of the stand its stays and its panels were of one piece with it.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the top of the cart, at the height of half a cubit, itwas perfectly round. And on the top of the cart, its flanges and its panels were of the same casting.
verses.textEnNlt: Around the top of each cart was a rim nine inches wide. The corner supports and side panels were cast as one unit with the cart.
verses.textEnNasb: And on the top of the stand there was a circular form half a cubit high, and on the top of the stand its stays and its borders were part of it.
verses.textEn: At the top of the stand there was a circular band half a cubit deep. The supports and panels were attached to the top of the stand.

verses.textZh: 又在撑子和边缘的上面刻有基路伯、狮子和棕树，又在各空处，周围刻上花纹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又在撑子和边缘的上面刻有基路伯、狮子和棕树，又在各空处，周围刻上花纹。
verses.textZhCuv: 在撑子和心子上刻着基路伯、狮子，和棕树，周围有璎珞。
verses.textEnNiv: He engraved cherubim, lions and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and on the panels, in every available space, with wreaths all around.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the surfaces of its stays and on its panels, he carved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, according to the space of each, with wreaths all around.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the plates of its flanges and on its panels he engraved cherubim, lions, and palm trees, wherever there was a clear space on each, with wreaths all around.
verses.textEnNlt: Carvings of cherubim, lions, and palm trees decorated the panels and corner supports wherever there was room, and there were wreaths all around.
verses.textEnNasb: And he engraved on the plates of its stays and on its borders cherubim, lions, and palm trees, as there was clear space on each, with wreaths all around.
verses.textEn: He engraved cherubim, lions and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and on the panels, in every available space, with wreaths all around.

verses.textZh: 他这样做了十个盆座，铸法、尺寸和样式都是相同的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他这样做了十个盆座，铸法、尺寸和样式都是相同的。
verses.textZhCuv: 十个盆座都是这样，铸法、尺寸、样式相同。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the way he made the ten stands. They were all cast in the same molds and were identical in size and shape.
verses.textEnEsv: After this manner he made the ten stands. All of them were cast alike, of the same measure and the same form.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus he made the ten carts. All of them were of the same mold, one measure, and one shape.
verses.textEnNlt: All ten water carts were the same size and were made alike, for each was cast from the same mold.
verses.textEnNasb: He made the ten stands like this: all of them had the same casting, same measure, and same form.
verses.textEn: This is the way he made the ten stands. They were all cast in the same molds and were identical in size and shape.

verses.textZh: 他又做了十个铜盆，每个铜盆能盛水八百公升；每个铜盆的直径都是一公尺八公寸。在十个盆座上，每个都安放一个铜盆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又做了十个铜盆，每个铜盆能盛水八百公升；每个铜盆的直径都是一公尺八公寸。在十个盆座上，每个都安放一个铜盆。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用铜制造十个盆，每盆可容四十罢特。盆径四肘，在那十座上，每座安设一盆。
verses.textEnNiv: He then made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin to go on each of the ten stands.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made ten basins of bronze. Each basin held forty baths, each basin measured four cubits, and there was a basin for each of the ten stands.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he made ten lavers of bronze; each laver contained forty baths, and each laver was four cubits. On each of the ten carts was a laver.
verses.textEnNlt: Huram also made ten smaller bronze basins, one for each cart. Each basin was six feet across and could hold 220 gallons of water.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made ten basins of bronze, each holding forty baths; each basin was four cubits, and on each of the ten stands was one basin.
verses.textEn: He then made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin to go on each of the ten stands.

verses.textZh: 他把五个盆座放在殿的南边，五个放在殿的北边，又把铜海放在殿的南边，就是靠东南角的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把五个盆座放在殿的南边，五个放在殿的北边，又把铜海放在殿的南边，就是靠东南角的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 五个安在殿门的右边，五个放在殿门的左边；又将海放在殿门的右旁，就是南边。
verses.textEnNiv: He placed five of the stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north. He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: And he set the stands, five on the south side of the house, and five on the north side of the house. And he set the sea at the southeast corner of the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he put five carts on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house. He set the Sea on the right side of the house, toward the southeast.
verses.textEnNlt: He set five water carts on the south side of the Temple and five on the north side. The great bronze basin called the Sea was placed near the southeast corner of the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he placed the stands, five on the right side of the house and five on the left side of the house; and he set the Sea of cast metal on the right side of the house eastward toward the south.
verses.textEn: He placed five of the stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north. He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.

verses.textZh: 户兰又做了盆子、铲子和碗。这样，户兰为所罗门王完成了在耶和华的殿里所要作的一切工程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户兰又做了盆子、铲子和碗。这样，户兰为所罗门王完成了在耶和华的殿里所要作的一切工程。
verses.textZhCuv: 户兰又造了盆、铲子，和盘子。这样，他为所罗门王做完了耶和华殿的一切工。
verses.textEnNiv: He also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of the Lord :
verses.textEnEsv: Hiram also made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. So Hiram finished all the work that he did for King Solomon on the house of the Lord :
verses.textEnNkjv: Huram made the lavers and the shovels and the bowls. So Huram finished doing all the work that he was to do for King Solomon for the house of the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: He also made the necessary washbasins, shovels, and bowls. So at last Huram completed everything King Solomon had assigned him to make for the Temple of the Lord :
verses.textEnNasb: Now Hiram made the basins and the shovels and the bowls. So Hiram finished doing all the work which he performed for King Solomon in the house of the Lord:
verses.textEn: He also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of the Lord :

verses.textZh: 所做的就是两根柱子和在柱子顶上碗形的柱顶；两块遮盖柱子顶上碗形柱顶的网子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所做的就是两根柱子和在柱子顶上碗形的柱顶；两块遮盖柱子顶上碗形柱顶的网子；
verses.textZhCuv: 所造的就是：两根柱子和柱上两个如球的顶；并两个盖柱顶的网子；
verses.textEnNiv: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;
verses.textEnEsv: the two pillars, the two bowls of the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars, and the two latticeworks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the tops of the pillars;
verses.textEnNkjv: the two pillars, the two bowl-shaped capitals that were on top of the two pillars; the two networks covering the two bowl-shaped capitals which were on top of the pillars;
verses.textEnNlt: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two networks of interwoven chains that decorated the capitals;
verses.textEnNasb: the two pillars and the two bowls of the capitals which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two lattices to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.textEn: the two pillars; the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars; the two sets of network decorating the two bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars;

verses.textZh: 在两块网子上的四百个石榴，每块网子上有两行石榴，遮盖在柱子上头两个碗形的柱顶；
verses.textZhCnvs: 在两块网子上的四百个石榴，每块网子上有两行石榴，遮盖在柱子上头两个碗形的柱顶；
verses.textZhCuv: 和四百石榴，安在两个网子上，每网两行，盖着两个柱上如球的顶；
verses.textEnNiv: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);
verses.textEnEsv: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two latticeworks, two rows of pomegranates for each latticework, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars;
verses.textEnNkjv: four hundred pomegranates for the two networks (two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowl-shaped capitals that were on top of the pillars);
verses.textEnNlt: the 400 pomegranates that hung from the chains on the capitals (two rows of pomegranates for each of the chain networks that decorated the capitals on top of the pillars);
verses.textEnNasb: and the four hundred pomegranates for the two lattices, two rows of pomegranates for each lattice to cover the two bowls of the capitals which were on the tops of the pillars;
verses.textEn: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);

verses.textZh: 十个盆座和盆座上的十个铜盆；
verses.textZhCnvs: 十个盆座和盆座上的十个铜盆；
verses.textZhCuv: 十个座和其上的十个盆；
verses.textEnNiv: the ten stands with their ten basins;
verses.textEnEsv: the ten stands, and the ten basins on the stands;
verses.textEnNkjv: the ten carts, and ten lavers on the carts;
verses.textEnNlt: the ten water carts holding the ten basins;
verses.textEnNasb: and the ten stands with the ten basins on the stands;
verses.textEn: the ten stands with their ten basins;

verses.textZh: 一个铜海和铜海下的十二头铜牛；
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个铜海和铜海下的十二头铜牛；
verses.textZhCuv: 海和海下的十二只牛；
verses.textEnNiv: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;
verses.textEnEsv: and the one sea, and the twelve oxen underneath the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: one Sea, and twelve oxen under the Sea;
verses.textEnNlt: the Sea and the twelve oxen under it;
verses.textEnNasb: and the one Sea and the twelve oxen under the Sea;
verses.textEn: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;

verses.textZh: 锅、铲子和盘子。以上这一切器皿都是户兰为所罗门在耶和华的殿里用磨亮的铜做成的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锅、铲子和盘子。以上这一切器皿都是户兰为所罗门在耶和华的殿里用磨亮的铜做成的。
verses.textZhCuv: 盆、铲子、盘子。这一切都是户兰给所罗门王用光亮的铜为耶和华的殿造成的，
verses.textEnNiv: the pots, shovels and sprinkling bowls. All these objects that Huram made for King Solomon for the temple of the Lord were of burnished bronze.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the pots, the shovels, and the basins, all these vessels in the house of the Lord , which Hiram made for King Solomon, were of burnished bronze.
verses.textEnNkjv: the pots, the shovels, and the bowls. All these articles which Huram made for King Solomon for the house of the Lordwereof burnished bronze.
verses.textEnNlt: the ash buckets, the shovels, and the bowls. Huram made all these things of burnished bronze for the Temple of the Lord , just as King Solomon had directed.
verses.textEnNasb: and the buckets, the shovels, and the bowls; indeed, all these utensils which Hiram made for King Solomon in the house of the Lordwere of polished bronze.
verses.textEn: the pots, shovels and sprinkling bowls. All these objects that Huram made for King Solomon for the temple of the Lord were of burnished bronze.

verses.textZh: 是王在约旦平原，在疏割与撒利但之间用泥模铸造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是王在约旦平原，在疏割与撒利但之间用泥模铸造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 是遵王命在约旦平原、疏割和撒拉但中间藉胶泥铸成的。
verses.textEnNiv: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Sukkoth and Zarethan.
verses.textEnEsv: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the plain of Jordan the king had them cast in clay molds, between Succoth and Zaretan.
verses.textEnNlt: The king had them cast in clay molds in the Jordan Valley between Succoth and Zarethan.
verses.textEnNasb: The king had them cast in the plain of the Jordan, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan.
verses.textEn: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Sukkoth and Zarethan.

verses.textZh: 这一切器皿所罗门都没有称算过；由于数量太多，铜的重量也无法估计。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切器皿所罗门都没有称算过；由于数量太多，铜的重量也无法估计。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切所罗门都没有过秤；因为甚多，铜的轻重也无法可查。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon left all these things unweighed, because there were so many; the weight of the bronze was not determined.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because there were so many of them; the weight of the bronze was not ascertained.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon did not weigh all the articles, because therewere so many; the weight of the bronze was not determined.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon did not weigh all these things because there were so many; the weight of the bronze could not be measured.
verses.textEnNasb: However, Solomon left all the utensils unweighed, because they were too many; the weight of the bronze could not be determined.
verses.textEn: Solomon left all these things unweighed, because there were so many; the weight of the bronze was not determined.

verses.textZh: 所罗门又做了耶和华殿里的一切器具，就是金坛和放陈设饼的桌子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门又做了耶和华殿里的一切器具，就是金坛和放陈设饼的桌子，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门又造耶和华殿里的金坛和陈设饼的金桌子；
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in the Lord ’s temple: the golden altar; the golden table on which was the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnEsv: So Solomon made all the vessels that were in the house of the Lord : the golden altar, the golden table for the bread of the Presence,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Solomon had all the furnishings made for the house of the Lord: the altar of gold, and the table of gold on which was the showbread;
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon also made all the furnishings of the Temple of the Lord : the gold altar; the gold table for the Bread of the Presence;
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon also made all the furniture that was in the house of the Lord: the golden altar and the golden table on which was set the bread of the Presence;
verses.textEn: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in the Lord ’s temple: the golden altar; the golden table on which was the bread of the Presence;

verses.textZh: 内殿前面的精金灯台，右边五行，左边五行；还有金花、金灯盏，
verses.textZhCnvs: 内殿前面的精金灯台，右边五行，左边五行；还有金花、金灯盏，
verses.textZhCuv: 内殿前的精金灯台：右边五个，左边五个，并其上的金花、灯盏、蜡剪，
verses.textEnNiv: the lampstands of pure gold (five on the right and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary); the gold floral work and lamps and tongs;
verses.textEnEsv: the lampstands of pure gold, five on the south side and five on the north, before the inner sanctuary; the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;
verses.textEnNkjv: the lampstands of pure gold, five on the right side and five on the left in front of the inner sanctuary, with the flowers and the lamps and the wick-trimmers of gold;
verses.textEnNlt: the lampstands of solid gold, five on the south and five on the north, in front of the Most Holy Place; the flower decorations, lamps, and tongs—all of gold;
verses.textEnNasb: and the lampstands of pure gold, five on the right side and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary; and the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of gold;
verses.textEn: the lampstands of pure gold (five on the right and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary); the gold floral work and lamps and tongs;

verses.textZh: 精金的碗盆、烛剪、盘子、调羹和火鼎，内殿至圣所的门框和外殿的门枢。
verses.textZhCnvs: 精金的碗盆、烛剪、盘子、调羹和火鼎，内殿至圣所的门框和外殿的门枢。
verses.textZhCuv: 与精金的杯、盘、镊子、调羹、火鼎，以及至圣所、内殿的门枢，和外殿的门枢。
verses.textEnNiv: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold sockets for the doors of the innermost room, the Most Holy Place, and also for the doors of the main hall of the temple.
verses.textEnEsv: the cups, snuffers, basins, dishes for incense, and fire pans, of pure gold; and the sockets of gold, for the doors of the innermost part of the house, the Most Holy Place, and for the doors of the nave of the temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: the basins, the trimmers, the bowls, the ladles, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner room (the Most Holy Place) and for the doors of the main hall of the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: the small bowls, lamp snuffers, bowls, ladles, and incense burners—all of solid gold; the doors for the entrances to the Most Holy Place and the main room of the Temple, with their fronts overlaid with gold.
verses.textEnNasb: also the cups, the shears, the bowls, the ladles, and the firepans, of pure gold; and the hinges both for the doors of the inner house, the Most Holy Place, and for the doors of the house, that is, for the main room, of gold.
verses.textEn: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold sockets for the doors of the innermost room, the Most Holy Place, and also for the doors of the main hall of the temple.

verses.textZh: 这样，所罗门为耶和华的殿所作的一切工程都完成了。所罗门把他父亲大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿，都运了来，存放在耶和华殿的库房里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，所罗门为耶和华的殿所作的一切工程都完成了。所罗门把他父亲大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿，都运了来，存放在耶和华殿的库房里。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王做完了耶和华殿的一切工，就把他父大卫分别为圣的金银和器皿都带来放在耶和华殿的府库里。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the work King Solomon had done for the temple of the Lord was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated—the silver and gold and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the work that King Solomon did on the house of the Lord was finished. And Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, the silver, the gold, and the vessels, and stored them in the treasuries of the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the work that King Solomon had done for the house of the Lord was finished; and Solomon brought in the things which his father David had dedicated: the silver and the gold and the furnishings. He put them in the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Solomon finished all his work on the Temple of the Lord . Then he brought all the gifts his father, David, had dedicated—the silver, the gold, and the various articles—and he stored them in the treasuries of the Lord ’s Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the work that King Solomon performed in the house of the Lord was finished. And Solomon brought in the offerings vowed by his father David, the silver and the gold and the utensils, and he put them in the treasuries of the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: When all the work King Solomon had done for the temple of the Lord was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated—the silver and gold and the furnishings—and he placed them in the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple.

verses.textZh: 那时，所罗门把以色列的长老、各支派的首领和以色列的族长，都召集到耶路撒冷自己面前，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城，就是锡安运上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，所罗门把以色列的长老、各支派的首领和以色列的族长，都召集到耶路撒冷自己面前，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城，就是锡安运上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，所罗门将以色列的长老和各支派的首领，并以色列的族长，招聚到耶路撒冷，要把耶和华的约柜从大卫城－就是锡安－运上来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Solomon summoned into his presence at Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Zion, the City of David.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the leaders of the fathers’ houses of the people of Israel, before King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the City of David, which is Zion.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon then summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes—the leaders of the ancestral families of the Israelites. They were to bring the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant to the Temple from its location in the City of David, also known as Zion.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes, the leaders of the fathers’ households of the sons of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord from the city of David, that is, Zion.
verses.textEn: Then King Solomon summoned into his presence at Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the Lord ’s covenant from Zion, the City of David.

verses.textZh: 于是，在以他念月，就是七月，在守节期的时候，以色列众人都聚集到所罗门王那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，在以他念月，就是七月，在守节期的时候，以色列众人都聚集到所罗门王那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 以他念月，就是七月，在节前，以色列人都聚集到所罗门王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: All the Israelites came together to King Solomon at the time of the festival in the month of Ethanim, the seventh month.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the men of Israel assembled to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore all the men of Israel assembled with King Solomon at the feast in the month of Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
verses.textEnNlt: So all the men of Israel assembled before King Solomon at the annual Festival of Shelters, which is held in early autumn in the month of Ethanim.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the men of Israel assembled themselves before King Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, that is, the seventh month.
verses.textEn: All the Israelites came together to King Solomon at the time of the festival in the month of Ethanim, the seventh month.

verses.textZh: 以色列的众长老都来到了，祭司们就把约柜抬起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的众长老都来到了，祭司们就把约柜抬起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列长老来到，祭司便抬起约柜，
verses.textEnNiv: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,
verses.textEnEsv: And all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the elders of Israel arrived, the priests picked up the Ark.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the elders of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.textEn: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,

verses.textZh: 祭司和利未人把耶和华的约柜、会幕和会幕里的一切圣器具都运上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司和利未人把耶和华的约柜、会幕和会幕里的一切圣器具都运上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司和利未人将耶和华的约柜运上来，又将会幕和会幕的一切圣器具都带上来。
verses.textEnNiv: and they brought up the ark of the Lord and the tent of meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The priests and Levites carried them up,
verses.textEnEsv: And they brought up the ark of the Lord , the tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the tent; the priests and the Levites brought them up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they brought up the ark of the Lord, the tabernacle of meeting, and all the holy furnishings that were in the tabernacle. The priests and the Levites brought them up.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests and Levites brought up the Ark of the Lord along with the special tent and all the sacred items that had been in it.
verses.textEnNasb: And they brought up the ark of the Lord, the tent of meeting, and all the holy utensils which were in the tent; the priests and the Levites brought them up.
verses.textEn: and they brought up the ark of the Lord and the tent of meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The priests and Levites carried them up,

verses.textZh: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全体会众，都一同在约柜前献牛羊为祭，数目多得不可胜数，无法计算。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全体会众，都一同在约柜前献牛羊为祭，数目多得不可胜数，无法计算。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王和聚集到他那里的以色列全会众，一同在约柜前献牛羊为祭，多得不可胜数。
verses.textEnNiv: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.
verses.textEnEsv: And King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who had assembled before him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also King Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel who were assembled with him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: There, before the Ark, King Solomon and the entire community of Israel sacrificed so many sheep, goats, and cattle that no one could keep count!
verses.textEnNasb: And King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were gathered together to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered.
verses.textEn: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.

verses.textZh: 祭司把耶和华的约柜抬进内殿为它预备的地方，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司把耶和华的约柜抬进内殿为它预备的地方，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司将耶和华的约柜抬进内殿，就是至圣所，放在两个基路伯的翅膀底下。
verses.textEnNiv: The priests then brought the ark of the Lord ’s covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the Lord to its place in the inner sanctuary of the house, in the Most Holy Place, underneath the wings of the cherubim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the temple, to the Most Holy Place, under the wings of the cherubim.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the priests carried the Ark of the Lord ’s Covenant into the inner sanctuary of the Temple—the Most Holy Place—and placed it beneath the wings of the cherubim.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the priests brought the ark of the covenant of the Lord to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the Most Holy Place, under the wings of the cherubim.
verses.textEn: The priests then brought the ark of the Lord ’s covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.

verses.textZh: 因为基路伯展开翅膀在约柜所在地的上面，遮掩约柜和抬柜的杠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为基路伯展开翅膀在约柜所在地的上面，遮掩约柜和抬柜的杠。
verses.textZhCuv: 基路伯张着翅膀在约柜之上，遮掩约柜和抬柜的杠。
verses.textEnNiv: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its carrying poles.
verses.textEnEsv: For the cherubim spread out their wings over the place of the ark, so that the cherubim overshadowed the ark and its poles.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the cherubim spread their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim overshadowed the ark and its poles.
verses.textEnNlt: The cherubim spread their wings over the Ark, forming a canopy over the Ark and its carrying poles.
verses.textEnNasb: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim made a covering over the ark and its carrying poles from above.
verses.textEn: The cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark and overshadowed the ark and its carrying poles.

verses.textZh: 这些杠很长，在内殿前的圣所可以看见杠头，在殿外却看不见；直到今日，这些杠还在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些杠很长，在内殿前的圣所可以看见杠头，在殿外却看不见；直到今日，这些杠还在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 这杠甚长，杠头在内殿前的圣所可以看见，在殿外却不能看见，直到如今还在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: These poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.
verses.textEnEsv: And the poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the Holy Place before the inner sanctuary; but they could not be seen from outside. And they are there to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: The poles extended so that the ends of the poles could be seen from the holy place, in front of the inner sanctuary; but they could not be seen from outside. And they are there to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: These poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place, which is in front of the Most Holy Place, but not from the outside. They are still there to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: But the poles were so long that the ends of the poles could be seen from the holy place in front of the inner sanctuary, but they could not be seen outside; they are there to this day.
verses.textEn: These poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.

verses.textZh: 约柜里面只有两块石版，这两块石版在以色列人出埃及地以后，耶和华与他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山放在那里的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约柜里面只有两块石版，这两块石版在以色列人出埃及地以后，耶和华与他们立约的时候，摩西在何烈山放在那里的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约柜里惟有两块石版，就是以色列人出埃及地后，耶和华与他们立约的时候摩西在何烈山所放的。除此以外，并无别物。
verses.textEnNiv: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets of stone that Moses put there at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the people of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nothing was in the ark except the two tablets of stone which Moses put there at Horeb, when the Lord made acovenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Nothing was in the Ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Mount Sinai, where the Lord made a covenant with the people of Israel when they left the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets of stone which Moses put there at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the sons of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the Lord made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 祭司从圣所里出来的时候，有云彩充满耶和华的殿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭司从圣所里出来的时候，有云彩充满耶和华的殿，
verses.textZhCuv: 祭司从圣所出来的时候，有云充满耶和华的殿；
verses.textEnNiv: When the priests withdrew from the Holy Place, the cloud filled the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And when the priests came out of the Holy Place, a cloud filled the house of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when the priests came out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of the Lord,
verses.textEnNlt: When the priests came out of the Holy Place, a thick cloud filled the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened that when the priests came from the holy place, the cloud filled the house of the Lord,
verses.textEn: When the priests withdrew from the Holy Place, the cloud filled the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 因为云彩的缘故，祭司不能站立服事，因为耶和华的荣光充满了圣殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为云彩的缘故，祭司不能站立服事，因为耶和华的荣光充满了圣殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至祭司不能站立供职，因为耶和华的荣光充满了殿。
verses.textEnNiv: And the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled his temple.
verses.textEnEsv: so that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: so that the priests could not continue ministering because of the cloud; for the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The priests could not continue their service because of the cloud, for the glorious presence of the Lord filled the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: so that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: And the priests could not perform their service because of the cloud, for the glory of the Lord filled his temple.

verses.textZh: 那时，所罗门说： "耶和华曾说，他要住在密云中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，所罗门说： "耶和华曾说，他要住在密云中。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时所罗门说： 耶和华曾说， 他必住在幽暗之处。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon said, "The Lord has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon said, "The Lord has said that he would dwell in thick darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon spoke: "The Lord said He would dwell in the dark cloud.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon prayed, "O Lord , you have said that you would live in a thick cloud of darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon said, "The Lord has said that He would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon said, "The Lord has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;

verses.textZh: 现在我果然为你建造了一座巍峨的殿， 作你永远的居所。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我果然为你建造了一座巍峨的殿， 作你永远的居所。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我已经建造殿宇作你的居所， 为你永远的住处。
verses.textEnNiv: I have indeed built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever."
verses.textEnEsv: I have indeed built you an exalted house, a place for you to dwell in forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: I have surely built You an exalted house, And a place for You to dwell in forever."
verses.textEnNlt: Now I have built a glorious Temple for you, a place where you can live forever! "
verses.textEnNasb: "I have truly built You a lofty house, A place for Your dwelling forever."
verses.textEn: I have indeed built a magnificent temple for you, a place for you to dwell forever."

verses.textZh: 于是王把脸转过来，为全体以色列会众祝福，全体以色列会众都站着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王把脸转过来，为全体以色列会众祝福，全体以色列会众都站着。
verses.textZhCuv: 王转脸为以色列会众祝福，以色列会众就都站立。
verses.textEnNiv: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel stood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king turned around and blessed the whole assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel was standing.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king turned around to the entire community of Israel standing before him and gave this blessing:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king turned around and blessed all the assembly of Israel, while all the assembly of Israel was standing.
verses.textEn: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.

verses.textZh: 所罗门说："耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的，因为他亲口对我父亲大卫应许过的，现在他亲手成全了。他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门说："耶和华以色列的神是应当称颂的，因为他亲口对我父亲大卫应许过的，现在他亲手成全了。他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门说：「耶和华－以色列的神是应当称颂的！因他亲口向我父大卫所应许的，也亲手成就了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said: "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his own hand has fulfilled what he promised with his own mouth to my father David. For he said,
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his hand has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to David my father, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said: "Blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who spoke with His mouth to my father David, and with His hand has fulfilled it, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who has kept the promise he made to my father, David. For he told my father,
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who spoke with His mouth to my father David, and fulfilled it with His hands, saying,
verses.textEn: Then he said: "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, who with his own hand has fulfilled what he promised with his own mouth to my father David. For he said,

verses.textZh: ‘自从我把我的子民以色列领出埃及的日子以来，我未曾在以色列的各支派中拣选一座城，建造殿宇，作我名的居所；但我拣选了大卫治理我的子民以色列。’
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘自从我把我的子民以色列领出埃及的日子以来，我未曾在以色列的各支派中拣选一座城，建造殿宇，作我名的居所；但我拣选了大卫治理我的子民以色列。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：『自从我领我民以色列出埃及以来，我未曾在以色列各支派中选择一城建造殿宇－为我名的居所，但拣选大卫治理我民以色列。』」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Since the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built so that my Name might be there, but I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.’
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel in which to build a house, that my name might be there. But I chose David to be over my people Israel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Since the day that I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I have chosen no city from any tribe of Israel inwhich to build a house, that My name might be there; but I chose David to be over My people Israel.’
verses.textEnNlt: ‘From the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I have never chosen a city among any of the tribes of Israel as the place where a Temple should be built to honor my name. But I have chosen David to be king over my people Israel.’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Since the day that I brought My people Israel from Egypt, I did not choose a city out of all the tribes of Israel in which to build a house so that My name would be there, but I chose David to be over My people Israel.’
verses.textEn: ‘Since the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built so that my Name might be there, but I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.’

verses.textZh: 我父大卫心里有意要为耶和华以色列的神的名建殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我父大卫心里有意要为耶和华以色列的神的名建殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门说：「我父大卫曾立意，要为耶和华－以色列神的名建殿。
verses.textEnNiv: "My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a temple for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon said, "My father, David, wanted to build this Temple to honor the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: "My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 但耶和华对我父大卫说：‘你心里有意为我的名建一座殿，你这心意是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但耶和华对我父大卫说：‘你心里有意为我的名建一座殿，你这心意是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华却对我父大卫说：『你立意为我的名建殿，这意思甚好。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘You did well to have it in your heart to build a temple for my Name.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a temple for My name, you did well that it was in your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord told him, ‘You wanted to build the Temple to honor my name. Your intention is good,
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘Because it was in your heart to build a house for My name, you did well that it was in your heart.
verses.textEn: But the Lord said to my father David, ‘You did well to have it in your heart to build a temple for my Name.

verses.textZh: 然而你不要建造这殿，只有你亲生的儿子，他必为我的名建造这殿。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而你不要建造这殿，只有你亲生的儿子，他必为我的名建造这殿。’
verses.textZhCuv: 只是你不可建殿，惟你所生的儿子必为我名建殿。』
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, your own flesh and blood—he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.’
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house, but your son who shall be born to you shall build the house for my name.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless you shall not build the temple, but your son who will come from your body, he shall build the temple for My name.’
verses.textEnNlt: but you are not the one to do it. One of your own sons will build the Temple to honor me.’
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless you shall not build the house, but your son who will be born to you, he will build the house for My name.’
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, your own flesh and blood—he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.’

verses.textZh: 现在耶和华已经实现了他说过的话，我已经起来继承我父大卫，坐在以色列的王位上，正如耶和华所说过的。我也已经为耶和华以色列的神的名建造了这殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在耶和华已经实现了他说过的话，我已经起来继承我父大卫，坐在以色列的王位上，正如耶和华所说过的。我也已经为耶和华以色列的神的名建造了这殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在耶和华成就了他所应许的话，使我接续我父大卫坐以色列的国位，又为耶和华－以色列神的名建造了殿。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord has kept the promise he made: I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Lord has fulfilled his promise that he made. For I have risen in the place of David my father, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised, and I have built the house for the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord has fulfilled His word which He spoke; and I have filled the position of my father David, and sit on the throne of Israel, as the Lord promised; and I have built a temple for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "And now the Lord has fulfilled the promise he made, for I have become king in my father’s place, and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised. I have built this Temple to honor the name of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord has fulfilled His word which He spoke; for I have risen in place of my father David and I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised, and I have built the house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.
verses.textEn: "The Lord has kept the promise he made: I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the Lord promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 我又为约柜预备了一个地方。这约柜里有耶和华的约，就是他领我们列祖出埃及地的时候与他们所立的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又为约柜预备了一个地方。这约柜里有耶和华的约，就是他领我们列祖出埃及地的时候与他们所立的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我也在其中为约柜预备一处。约柜内有耶和华的约，就是他领我们列祖出埃及地的时候，与他们所立的约。」
verses.textEnNiv: I have provided a place there for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: And there I have provided a place for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: And there I have made a place for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord which He made with our fathers, when He brought them out of the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: And I have prepared a place there for the Ark, which contains the covenant that the Lord made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: And there I have set a place for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord, which He made with our fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt."
verses.textEn: I have provided a place there for the ark, in which is the covenant of the Lord that he made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt."

verses.textZh: 所罗门当着以色列的全体会众，站在耶和华的祭坛前，向天伸开双手，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门当着以色列的全体会众，站在耶和华的祭坛前，向天伸开双手，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门当着以色列会众，站在耶和华的坛前，向天举手说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the entire community of Israel. He lifted his hands toward heaven,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and he spread out his hands toward heaven.
verses.textEn: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven

verses.textZh: 祷告说："耶和华以色列的神啊，天上地下没有别的神像你；你对一心在你面前行事为人的仆人守约施慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祷告说："耶和华以色列的神啊，天上地下没有别的神像你；你对一心在你面前行事为人的仆人守约施慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华－以色列的神啊，天上地下没有神可比你的！你向那尽心行在你面前的仆人守约施慈爱；
verses.textEnNiv: and said: " Lord , the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven above or on earth below—you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "O Lord , God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above or on earth beneath, keeping covenant and showing steadfast love to your servants who walk before you with all their heart;
verses.textEnNkjv: and he said: "Lord God of Israel, thereis no God in heaven above or on earth below like You, who keep Your covenant and mercy with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.
verses.textEnNlt: and he prayed, "O Lord , God of Israel, there is no God like you in all of heaven above or on the earth below. You keep your covenant and show unfailing love to all who walk before you in wholehearted devotion.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Lord, God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven above or on earth beneath, keeping the covenant and showing faithfulness to Your servants who walk before You with all their heart,
verses.textEn: and said: " Lord , the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven above or on earth below—you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

verses.textZh: 你谨守了你应许过你仆人我父大卫的话。你亲口说过，也亲手作成，正如今天一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你谨守了你应许过你仆人我父大卫的话。你亲口说过，也亲手作成，正如今天一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 向你仆人－我父大卫所应许的话现在应验了。你亲口应许，亲手成就，正如今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it—as it is today.
verses.textEnEsv: you have kept with your servant David my father what you declared to him. You spoke with your mouth, and with your hand have fulfilled it this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have kept what You promised Your servant David my father; You have both spoken with Your mouth and fulfilled it with Your hand, as itis this day.
verses.textEnNlt: You have kept your promise to your servant David, my father. You made that promise with your own mouth, and with your own hands you have fulfilled it today.
verses.textEnNasb: You who have kept with Your servant, my father David, that which You promised him; You have spoken with Your mouth and have fulfilled it with Your hand, as it is this day.
verses.textEn: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it—as it is today.

verses.textZh: 耶和华以色列的神啊，现在求你谨守你应许你仆人我父亲大卫的话：‘只要你的子孙谨守他们的行为，像你在我面前所行的一样，就必不断有人坐以色列的王位。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华以色列的神啊，现在求你谨守你应许你仆人我父亲大卫的话：‘只要你的子孙谨守他们的行为，像你在我面前所行的一样，就必不断有人坐以色列的王位。’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－以色列的神啊，你所应许你仆人－我父大卫的话说：『你的子孙若谨慎自己的行为，在我面前行事像你所行的一样，就不断人坐以色列的国位。』现在求你应验这话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now Lord , the God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants are careful in all they do to walk before me faithfully as you have done.’
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, O Lord , God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father what you have promised him, saying, ‘You shall not lack a man to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your sons pay close attention to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, Lord God of Israel, now keep what You promised Your servant David my father, saying, ‘You shall not fail to have a man sit before Me on the throne of Israel, only if your sons take heed to their way, that they walk before Me as you have walked before Me.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, O Lord , God of Israel, carry out the additional promise you made to your servant David, my father. For you said to him, ‘If your descendants guard their behavior and faithfully follow me as you have done, one of them will always sit on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, Lord, God of Israel, keep with Your servant David my father that which You have promised him, saying, ‘ You shall not be deprived of a man to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your sons are careful about their way, to walk before Me as you have walked.’
verses.textEn: "Now Lord , the God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants are careful in all they do to walk before me faithfully as you have done.’

verses.textZh: 以色列的神啊，现在求你成就你应许你仆人我父大卫的话吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的神啊，现在求你成就你应许你仆人我父大卫的话吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的神啊，求你成就向你仆人－我父大卫所应许的话。
verses.textEnNiv: And now, God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David my father come true.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, O God of Israel, let your word be confirmed, which you have spoken to your servant David my father.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now I pray, O God of Israel, let Your word come true, which You have spoken to Your servant David my father.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, O God of Israel, fulfill this promise to your servant David, my father.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, God of Israel, let Your words, please, be confirmed, which You have spoken to Your servant, my father David.
verses.textEn: And now, God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David my father come true.

verses.textZh: "神真的住在地上吗？看哪！天和天上的天尚且不能容纳你，何况我建造的这殿呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: "神真的住在地上吗？看哪！天和天上的天尚且不能容纳你，何况我建造的这殿呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 「神果真住在地上吗？看哪，天和天上的天尚且不足你居住的，何况我所建的这殿呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "But will God really dwell on earth? The heavens, even the highest heaven, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!
verses.textEnEsv: "But will God indeed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain you; how much less this house that I have built!
verses.textEnNkjv: "But will God indeed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain You. How much less this temple which I have built!
verses.textEnNlt: "But will God really live on earth? Why, even the highest heavens cannot contain you. How much less this Temple I have built!
verses.textEnNasb: "But will God indeed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the highest heaven cannot contain You, how much less this house which I have built!
verses.textEn: "But will God really dwell on earth? The heavens, even the highest heaven, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!

verses.textZh: 然而耶和华我的神啊，求你垂顾你仆人的祷告和恳求，垂听你仆人今天在你面前所作的呼吁和祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而耶和华我的神啊，求你垂顾你仆人的祷告和恳求，垂听你仆人今天在你面前所作的呼吁和祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟求耶和华－我的神垂顾仆人的祷告祈求，俯听仆人今日在你面前的祈祷呼吁。
verses.textEnNiv: Yet give attention to your servant’s prayer and his plea for mercy, Lord my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence this day.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet have regard to the prayer of your servant and to his plea, O Lord my God, listening to the cry and to the prayer that your servant prays before you this day,
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet regard the prayer of Your servant and his supplication, O Lord my God, and listen to the cry and the prayer which Your servant is praying before You today:
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, listen to my prayer and my plea, O Lord my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is making to you today.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless, turn Your attention to the prayer of Your servant and to his plea, Lord, my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which Your servant prays before You today,
verses.textEn: Yet give attention to your servant’s prayer and his plea for mercy, Lord my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence this day.

verses.textZh: 愿你的眼睛昼夜看顾这殿，看顾你所说‘我的名要留在那里’的地方。愿你垂听你仆人向这地方所发的祷告。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的眼睛昼夜看顾这殿，看顾你所说‘我的名要留在那里’的地方。愿你垂听你仆人向这地方所发的祷告。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你昼夜看顾这殿，就是你应许立为你名的居所；求你垂听仆人向此处祷告的话。
verses.textEnNiv: May your eyes be open toward this temple night and day, this place of which you said, ‘My Name shall be there,’ so that you will hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.
verses.textEnEsv: that your eyes may be open night and day toward this house, the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there,’ that you may listen to the prayer that your servant offers toward this place.
verses.textEnNkjv: that Your eyes may be open toward this temple night and day, toward the place of which You said, ‘My name shall be there,’ that You may hear the prayer which Your servant makes toward this place.
verses.textEnNlt: May you watch over this Temple night and day, this place where you have said, ‘My name will be there.’ May you always hear the prayers I make toward this place.
verses.textEnNasb: so that Your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, toward the place of which You have said, ‘My name shall be there,’ to listen to the prayer which Your servant will pray toward this place.
verses.textEn: May your eyes be open toward this temple night and day, this place of which you said, ‘My Name shall be there,’ so that you will hear the prayer your servant prays toward this place.

verses.textZh: 你仆人和你的子民以色列向这地方祷告的时候，求你垂听他们的恳求。求你在天上的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你仆人和你的子民以色列向这地方祷告的时候，求你垂听他们的恳求。求你在天上的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。
verses.textZhCuv: 你仆人和你民以色列向此处祈祷的时候，求你在天上你的居所垂听，垂听而赦免。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear the supplication of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive.
verses.textEnEsv: And listen to the plea of your servant and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. And listen in heaven your dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive.
verses.textEnNkjv: And may You hear the supplication of Your servant and of Your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Hear in heaven Your dwelling place; and when You hear, forgive.
verses.textEnNlt: May you hear the humble and earnest requests from me and your people Israel when we pray toward this place. Yes, hear us from heaven where you live, and when you hear, forgive.
verses.textEnNasb: And listen to the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel, when they pray toward this place; hear in heaven Your dwelling place; hear and forgive!
verses.textEn: Hear the supplication of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive.

verses.textZh: "如果有人得罪他的邻居被迫起誓，他来到这殿在你的祭坛前起誓的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果有人得罪他的邻居被迫起誓，他来到这殿在你的祭坛前起誓的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「人若得罪邻舍，有人叫他起誓，他来到这殿在你的坛前起誓，
verses.textEnNiv: "When anyone wrongs their neighbor and is required to take an oath and they come and swear the oath before your altar in this temple,
verses.textEnEsv: "If a man sins against his neighbor and is made to take an oath and comes and swears his oath before your altar in this house,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When anyone sins against his neighbor, and is forced to take an oath, and comes and takes an oath before Your altar in this temple,
verses.textEnNlt: "If someone wrongs another person and is required to take an oath of innocence in front of your altar in this Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: "If a person sins against his neighbor and is compelled to take an oath of innocence, and he comes and takes an oath before Your altar in this house,
verses.textEn: "When anyone wrongs their neighbor and is required to take an oath and they come and swear the oath before your altar in this temple,

verses.textZh: 求你在天上垂听，采取行动，审判你的仆人，定恶人有罪，使他所行的，都归到他自己的头上。定义人有理，照着他的公义赏赐他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在天上垂听，采取行动，审判你的仆人，定恶人有罪，使他所行的，都归到他自己的头上。定义人有理，照着他的公义赏赐他。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你在天上垂听，判断你的仆人：定恶人有罪，照他所行的报应在他头上；定义人有理，照他的义赏赐他。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty by bringing down on their heads what they have done, and vindicating the innocent by treating them in accordance with their innocence.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear in heaven and act and judge your servants, condemning the guilty by bringing his conduct on his own head, and vindicating the righteous by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge Your servants, condemning the wicked, bringing his way on his head, and justifying the righteous by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven and judge between your servants—the accuser and the accused. Punish the guilty as they deserve. Acquit the innocent because of their innocence.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear in heaven and act and judge Your servants, condemning the wicked by bringing his way on his own head, and acquitting the righteous by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty by bringing down on their heads what they have done, and vindicating the innocent by treating them in accordance with their innocence.

verses.textZh: "你的子民以色列若是得罪了你，以致在仇敌面前被打败，又回转归向你，承认你的名，在这殿里向你祷告恳求的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: "你的子民以色列若是得罪了你，以致在仇敌面前被打败，又回转归向你，承认你的名，在这殿里向你祷告恳求的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的民以色列若得罪你，败在仇敌面前，又归向你，承认你的名，在这殿里祈求祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: "When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you, and when they turn back to you and give praise to your name, praying and making supplication to you in this temple,
verses.textEnEsv: "When your people Israel are defeated before the enemy because they have sinned against you, and if they turn again to you and acknowledge your name and pray and plead with you in this house,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and when they turn back to You and confess Your name, and pray and make supplication to You in this temple,
verses.textEnNlt: "If your people Israel are defeated by their enemies because they have sinned against you, and if they turn to you and acknowledge your name and pray to you here in this Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: "When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, if they turn to You again and confess Your name and pray and implore Your favor in this house,
verses.textEn: "When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you, and when they turn back to you and give praise to your name, praying and making supplication to you in this temple,

verses.textZh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你的子民以色列的罪，领他们返回你赐给他们列祖之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你的子民以色列的罪，领他们返回你赐给他们列祖之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你民以色列的罪，使他们归回你赐给他们列祖之地。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to their ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear in heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them again to the land that you gave to their fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of Your people Israel, and bring them back to the land which You gave to their fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and return them to this land you gave their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of Your people Israel, and bring them back to the land which You gave their fathers.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to their ancestors.

verses.textZh: "如果他们因为得罪了你，天就闭塞不下雨；他们若是向这地方祷告，承认你的名；又因你苦待他们，就离开他们的罪，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果他们因为得罪了你，天就闭塞不下雨；他们若是向这地方祷告，承认你的名；又因你苦待他们，就离开他们的罪，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的民因得罪你，你惩罚他们，使天闭塞不下雨；他们若向此处祷告，承认你的名，离开他们的罪，
verses.textEnNiv: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and give praise to your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,
verses.textEnEsv: "When heaven is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and acknowledge your name and turn from their sin, when you afflict them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against You, when they pray toward this place and confess Your name, and turn from their sin because You afflict them,
verses.textEnNlt: "If the skies are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and if they pray toward this Temple and acknowledge your name and turn from their sins because you have punished them,
verses.textEnNasb: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and praise Your name, and turn from their sin when You afflict them,
verses.textEn: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and give praise to your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,

verses.textZh: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人和你的子民以色列的罪，指示他们当行的善道，赐雨水在你的地上，就是你赐给你子民的产业之地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人和你的子民以色列的罪，指示他们当行的善道，赐雨水在你的地上，就是你赐给你子民的产业之地。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你在天上垂听，赦免你仆人以色列民的罪，将当行的善道指教他们，且降雨在你的地，就是你赐给你民为业之地。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear in heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk, and grant rain upon your land, which you have given to your people as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on Your land which You have given to Your people as an inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven and forgive the sins of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them to follow the right path, and send rain on your land that you have given to your people as their special possession.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear in heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants and Your people Israel; indeed, teach them the good way in which they are to walk. And provide rain on Your land, which You have given to Your people as an inheritance.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.

verses.textZh: "如果这地有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或有仇敌把他们围困在城里，无论遭遇甚么灾祸，甚么疾病，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果这地有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或有仇敌把他们围困在城里，无论遭遇甚么灾祸，甚么疾病，
verses.textZhCuv: 「国中若有饥荒、瘟疫、旱风、霉烂、蝗虫、蚂蚱，或有仇敌犯境围困城邑，无论遭遇什么灾祸疾病，
verses.textEnNiv: "When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when an enemy besieges them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,
verses.textEnEsv: "If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence or blight or mildew or locust or caterpillar, if their enemy besieges them in the land at their gates, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When there is famine in the land, pestilence or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers; when their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness thereis;
verses.textEnNlt: "If there is a famine in the land or a plague or crop disease or attacks of locusts or caterpillars, or if your people’s enemies are in the land besieging their towns—whatever disaster or disease there is—
verses.textEnNasb: "If there is a famine in the land, if there is a plague, if there is blight or mildew, locust or grasshopper, if their enemy harasses them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,
verses.textEn: "When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when an enemy besieges them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,

verses.textZh: 你的子民以色列，或是众人，或是个人，知道自己心里的苦痛，向这殿伸开双手所作的一切祷告、一切恳求，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的子民以色列，或是众人，或是个人，知道自己心里的苦痛，向这殿伸开双手所作的一切祷告、一切恳求，
verses.textZhCuv: 你的民以色列，或是众人，或是一人，自觉有罪 ，向这殿举手，无论祈求什么，祷告什么，
verses.textEnNiv: and when a prayer or plea is made by anyone among your people Israel—being aware of the afflictions of their own hearts, and spreading out their hands toward this temple—
verses.textEnEsv: whatever prayer, whatever plea is made by any man or by all your people Israel, each knowing the affliction of his own heart and stretching out his hands toward this house,
verses.textEnNkjv: whatever prayer, whatever supplication is made by anyone, or by all Your people Israel, when each one knows the plague of his own heart, and spreads out his hands toward this temple:
verses.textEnNlt: and if your people Israel pray about their troubles, raising their hands toward this Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: whatever prayer or plea is offered by any person or by all Your people Israel, each knowing the affliction of his own heart, and spreading his hands toward this house;
verses.textEn: and when a prayer or plea is made by anyone among your people Israel—being aware of the afflictions of their own hearts, and spreading out their hands toward this temple—

verses.textZh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听而赦免，并且采取行动。你是知道人心的，只有你知道万人的心，求你照着各人所行的报应他，
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在天上你的居所垂听而赦免，并且采取行动。你是知道人心的，只有你知道万人的心，求你照着各人所行的报应他，
verses.textZhCuv: 求你在天上你的居所垂听赦免。你是知道人心的，要照各人所行的待他们（惟有你知道世人的心），
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive and act; deal with everyone according to all they do, since you know their hearts (for you alone know every human heart),
verses.textEnEsv: then hear in heaven your dwelling place and forgive and act and render to each whose heart you know, according to all his ways ( for you, you only, know the hearts of all the children of mankind),
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear in heaven Your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to everyone according to all his ways, whose heart You know (for You alone know the hearts of all the sons of men),
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven where you live, and forgive. Give your people what their actions deserve, for you alone know each human heart.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear in heaven, Your dwelling place, and forgive and act, and give to each in accordance with all his ways, whose heart You know—for You alone know the hearts of all mankind—
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive and act; deal with everyone according to all they do, since you know their hearts (for you alone know every human heart),

verses.textZh: 好使他们在你赐给我们列祖的地上，一生一世敬畏你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好使他们在你赐给我们列祖的地上，一生一世敬畏你。
verses.textZhCuv: 使他们在你赐给我们列祖之地上一生一世敬畏你。
verses.textEnNiv: so that they will fear you all the time they live in the land you gave our ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land that you gave to our fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they may fear You all the days that they live in the land which You gave to our fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they will fear you as long as they live in the land you gave to our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: so that they will fear You all the days that they live on the land which You have given to our fathers.
