verses.textEn: so that they will fear you all the time they live in the land you gave our ancestors.

verses.textZh: "至于不属于你的子民以色列的外族人，为了你的名的缘故从远地而来，
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于不属于你的子民以色列的外族人，为了你的名的缘故从远地而来，
verses.textZhCuv: 「论到不属你民以色列的外邦人，为你名从远方而来，
verses.textEnNiv: "As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your name—
verses.textEnEsv: "Likewise, when a foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, comes from a far country for your name’s sake
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover, concerning a foreigner, who is not of Your people Israel, but has come from a far country for Your name’s sake
verses.textEnNlt: "In the future, foreigners who do not belong to your people Israel will hear of you. They will come from distant lands because of your name,
verses.textEnNasb: "Also regarding the foreigner who is not of Your people Israel, when he comes from a far country on account of Your name
verses.textEn: "As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your name—

verses.textZh: 因为他们听到你的大名、大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，他们来向这殿祷告的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们听到你的大名、大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，他们来向这殿祷告的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: （他们听人论说你的大名和大能的手，并伸出来的膀臂）向这殿祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: for they will hear of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm—when they come and pray toward this temple,
verses.textEnEsv: (for they shall hear of your great name and your mighty hand, and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,
verses.textEnNkjv: (for they will hear of Your great name and Your strong hand and Your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this temple,
verses.textEnNlt: for they will hear of your great name and your strong hand and your powerful arm. And when they pray toward this Temple,
verses.textEnNasb: (for they will hear of Your great name and Your mighty hand, and of Your outstretched arm); when he comes and prays toward this house,
verses.textEn: for they will hear of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm—when they come and pray toward this temple,

verses.textZh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听，照着外族人向你呼求的一切而行，好使地上的万族万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，像你的子民以色列一样；又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你的名下的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在天上你的居所垂听，照着外族人向你呼求的一切而行，好使地上的万族万民都认识你的名，敬畏你，像你的子民以色列一样；又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你的名下的。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你在天上你的居所垂听，照着外邦人所祈求的而行，使天下万民都认识你的名，敬畏你像你的民以色列一样；又使他们知道我建造的这殿是称为你名下的。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.
verses.textEnEsv: hear in heaven your dwelling place and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to you, in order that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house that I have built is called by your name.
verses.textEnNkjv: hear in heaven Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You, that all peoples of the earth may know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and that they may know that this temple which I have built is called by Your name.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear from heaven where you live, and grant what they ask of you. In this way, all the people of the earth will come to know and fear you, just as your own people Israel do. They, too, will know that this Temple I have built honors your name.
verses.textEnNasb: hear in heaven Your dwelling place, and act in accordance with all for which the foreigner calls to You, in order that all the peoples of the earth may know Your name, to fear You, as do Your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by Your name.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.

verses.textZh: "如果你的子民出去与仇敌争战，无论你派他们到哪处，他们若是向你所拣选的这城，并向我为你的名建造的这殿祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你的子民出去与仇敌争战，无论你派他们到哪处，他们若是向你所拣选的这城，并向我为你的名建造的这殿祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的民若奉你的差遣，无论往何处去与仇敌争战，向耶和华所选择的城与我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: "When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to the Lord toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,
verses.textEnEsv: "If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to the Lord toward the city that you have chosen and the house that I have built for your name,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When Your people go out to battle against their enemy, wherever You send them, and when they pray to the Lord toward the city which You have chosen and the temple which I have built for Your name,
verses.textEnNlt: "If your people go out where you send them to fight their enemies, and if they pray to the Lord by turning toward this city you have chosen and toward this Temple I have built to honor your name,
verses.textEnNasb: "When Your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way You send them, and they pray to the Lord toward the city which You have chosen and the house which I have built for Your name,
verses.textEn: "When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to the Lord toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,

verses.textZh: 求你在天上垂听他们的祷告和恳求，为他们主持公道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在天上垂听他们的祷告和恳求，为他们主持公道。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你在天上垂听他们的祷告祈求，使他们得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear in heaven their prayer and their plea, and maintain their cause.
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.textEnNlt: then hear their prayers from heaven and uphold their cause.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear in heaven their prayer and their pleading, and maintain their cause.
verses.textEn: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

verses.textZh: "如果你的子民得罪了你 ，你向他们发怒，把他们交给仇敌，以致仇敌把他们掳到仇敌的地方，或是远或是近，
verses.textZhCnvs: "如果你的子民得罪了你 ，你向他们发怒，把他们交给仇敌，以致仇敌把他们掳到仇敌的地方，或是远或是近，
verses.textZhCuv: 「你的民若得罪你（世上没有不犯罪的人），你向他们发怒，将他们交给仇敌掳到仇敌之地，或远或近，
verses.textEnNiv: "When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to their enemies, who take them captive to their own lands, far away or near;
verses.textEnEsv: "If they sin against you— for there is no one who does not sin—and you are angry with them and give them to an enemy, so that they are carried away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near,
verses.textEnNkjv: "When they sin against You (for thereis no one who does not sin), and You become angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, and they take them captive to the land of the enemy, far or near;
verses.textEnNlt: "If they sin against you—and who has never sinned?—you might become angry with them and let their enemies conquer them and take them captive to their land far away or near.
verses.textEnNasb: "When they sin against You (for there is no person who does not sin) and You are angry with them and turn them over to an enemy, so that they take them away captive to the land of the enemy, distant or near;
verses.textEn: "When they sin against you—for there is no one who does not sin—and you become angry with them and give them over to their enemies, who take them captive to their own lands, far away or near;

verses.textZh: 在被掳的地方，他们若是回心转意，在他们被掳去之地回转，向你祈求，说：‘我们犯了罪了；我们犯了过了，我们作了恶事。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 在被掳的地方，他们若是回心转意，在他们被掳去之地回转，向你祈求，说：‘我们犯了罪了；我们犯了过了，我们作了恶事。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若在掳到之地想起罪来，回心转意，恳求你说：『我们有罪了，我们悖逆了，我们作恶了』；
verses.textEnNiv: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captors and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly’;
verses.textEnEsv: yet if they turn their heart in the land to which they have been carried captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captors, saying, ‘We have sinned and have acted perversely and wickedly,’
verses.textEnNkjv: yet when they come to themselves in the land where they were carried captive, and repent, and make supplication to You in the land of those who took them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong, we have committed wickedness’;
verses.textEnNlt: But in that land of exile, they might turn to you in repentance and pray, ‘We have sinned, done evil, and acted wickedly.’
verses.textEnNasb: if they take it to heart in the land where they have been taken captive, and repent and implore Your favor in the land of those who have taken them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong, we have acted wickedly’;
verses.textEn: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captors and say, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly’;

verses.textZh: 如果他们在俘掳他们的仇敌的地方，一心一意回转归向你，又向着你赐给他们列祖的地方，向你所拣选的这城，和我为你的名建造的这殿祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们在俘掳他们的仇敌的地方，一心一意回转归向你，又向着你赐给他们列祖的地方，向你所拣选的这城，和我为你的名建造的这殿祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们若在掳到之地尽心尽性归服你，又向自己的地，就是你赐给他们列祖之地和你所选择的城，并我为你名所建造的殿祷告，
verses.textEnNiv: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their enemies who took them captive, and pray to you toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name;
verses.textEnEsv: if they repent with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies, who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land, which you gave to their fathers, the city that you have chosen, and the house that I have built for your name,
verses.textEnNkjv: and when they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who led them away captive, and pray to You toward their land which You gave to their fathers, the city which You have chosen and the temple which I have built for Your name:
verses.textEnNlt: If they turn to you with their whole heart and soul in the land of their enemies and pray toward the land you gave to their ancestors—toward this city you have chosen, and toward this Temple I have built to honor your name—
verses.textEnNasb: if they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who have taken them captive, and pray to You toward their land which You have given to their fathers, the city which You have chosen, and the house which I have built for Your name;
verses.textEn: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their enemies who took them captive, and pray to you toward the land you gave their ancestors, toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name;

verses.textZh: 求你在天上你的居所垂听他们的祷告和恳求，为他们主持公道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你在天上你的居所垂听他们的祷告和恳求，为他们主持公道。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你在天上你的居所垂听他们的祷告祈求，为他们伸冤；
verses.textEnNiv: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.
verses.textEnEsv: then hear in heaven your dwelling place their prayer and their plea, and maintain their cause
verses.textEnNkjv: then hear in heaven Your dwelling place their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause,
verses.textEnNlt: then hear their prayers and their petition from heaven where you live, and uphold their cause.
verses.textEnNasb: then hear their prayer and their pleading in heaven, Your dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
verses.textEn: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

verses.textZh: 赦免得罪了你的子民，又赦免他们冒犯你的一切过犯，使他们在掳他们的人面前蒙怜悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 赦免得罪了你的子民，又赦免他们冒犯你的一切过犯，使他们在掳他们的人面前蒙怜悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 饶恕得罪你的民，赦免他们的一切过犯，使他们在掳他们的人面前蒙怜恤。
verses.textEnNiv: And forgive your people, who have sinned against you; forgive all the offenses they have committed against you, and cause their captors to show them mercy;
verses.textEnEsv: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions that they have committed against you, and grant them compassion in the sight of those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them
verses.textEnNkjv: and forgive Your people who have sinned against You, and all their transgressions which they have transgressed against You; and grant them compassion before those who took them captive, that they may have compassion on them
verses.textEnNlt: Forgive your people who have sinned against you. Forgive all the offenses they have committed against you. Make their captors merciful to them,
verses.textEnNasb: and forgive Your people who have sinned against You and all their wrongdoings which they have committed against You, and make them objects of compassion before those who have taken them captive, so that they will have compassion on them
verses.textEn: And forgive your people, who have sinned against you; forgive all the offenses they have committed against you, and cause their captors to show them mercy;

verses.textZh: 因为他们是你的子民、你的产业，是你从埃及、从铁炉中领出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们是你的子民、你的产业，是你从埃及、从铁炉中领出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们是你的子民，你的产业，是你从埃及领出来脱离铁炉的。
verses.textEnNiv: for they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out of Egypt, out of that iron-smelting furnace.
verses.textEnEsv: ( for they are your people, and your heritage, which you brought out of Egypt, from the midst of the iron furnace).
verses.textEnNkjv: (for they are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You brought out of Egypt, out of the iron furnace),
verses.textEnNlt: for they are your people—your special possession—whom you brought out of the iron-smelting furnace of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: (for they are Your people and Your inheritance which You have brought out of Egypt, from the midst of the iron furnace),
verses.textEn: for they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out of Egypt, out of that iron-smelting furnace.

verses.textZh: 愿你睁开眼睛看顾你仆人的祈求，和你的子民以色列的祈求，他们向你呼求的，愿你都垂听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你睁开眼睛看顾你仆人的祈求，和你的子民以色列的祈求，他们向你呼求的，愿你都垂听。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你的眼目看顾仆人，听你民以色列的祈求，无论何时向你祈求，愿你垂听。
verses.textEnNiv: "May your eyes be open to your servant’s plea and to the plea of your people Israel, and may you listen to them whenever they cry out to you.
verses.textEnEsv: Let your eyes be open to the plea of your servant and to the plea of your people Israel, giving ear to them whenever they call to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: that Your eyes may be open to the supplication of Your servant and the supplication of Your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they call to You.
verses.textEnNlt: "May your eyes be open to my requests and to the requests of your people Israel. May you hear and answer them whenever they cry out to you.
verses.textEnNasb: so that Your eyes may be open to the pleading of Your servant and to the pleading of Your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they call to You.
verses.textEn: "May your eyes be open to your servant’s plea and to the plea of your people Israel, and may you listen to them whenever they cry out to you.

verses.textZh: 主耶和华啊！因为你已经把他们从地上万族万民中分别出来，作自己的产业，正如你领我们的列祖出埃及的时候，借着你的仆人摩西所应许的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主耶和华啊！因为你已经把他们从地上万族万民中分别出来，作自己的产业，正如你领我们的列祖出埃及的时候，借着你的仆人摩西所应许的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主耶和华啊，你将他们从地上的万民中分别出来作你的产业，是照你领我们列祖出埃及的时候，藉你仆人摩西所应许的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: For you singled them out from all the nations of the world to be your own inheritance, just as you declared through your servant Moses when you, Sovereign Lord , brought our ancestors out of Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your heritage, as you declared through Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord God ."
verses.textEnNkjv: For You separated them from among all the peoples of the earth tobe Your inheritance, as You spoke by Your servant Moses, when You brought our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord God."
verses.textEnNlt: For when you brought our ancestors out of Egypt, O Sovereign Lord , you told your servant Moses that you had set Israel apart from all the nations of the earth to be your own special possession."
verses.textEnNasb: For You have singled them out from all the peoples of the earth as Your inheritance, just as You spoke through Moses Your servant, when You brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord God."
verses.textEn: For you singled them out from all the nations of the world to be your own inheritance, just as you declared through your servant Moses when you, Sovereign Lord , brought our ancestors out of Egypt."

verses.textZh: 所罗门在耶和华的祭坛前屈膝下跪，向天伸开双手，向耶和华献完了这一切祷告和恳求以后，就起来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在耶和华的祭坛前屈膝下跪，向天伸开双手，向耶和华献完了这一切祷告和恳求以后，就起来，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门在耶和华的坛前屈膝跪着，向天举手，在耶和华面前祷告祈求已毕，就起来，
verses.textEnNiv: When Solomon had finished all these prayers and supplications to the Lord , he rose from before the altar of the Lord , where he had been kneeling with his hands spread out toward heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: Now as Solomon finished offering all this prayer and plea to the Lord , he arose from before the altar of the Lord , where he had knelt with hands outstretched toward heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to the Lord, that he arose from before the altar of the Lord, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: When Solomon finished making these prayers and petitions to the Lord , he stood up in front of the altar of the Lord , where he had been kneeling with his hands raised toward heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: When Solomon had finished praying this entire prayer and plea to the Lord, he stood up from the altar of the Lord, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread toward heaven.
verses.textEn: When Solomon had finished all these prayers and supplications to the Lord , he rose from before the altar of the Lord , where he had been kneeling with his hands spread out toward heaven.

verses.textZh: 站着，大声给以色列的全体会众祝福，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 站着，大声给以色列的全体会众祝福，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 站着，大声为以色列全会众祝福，说：
verses.textEnNiv: He stood and blessed the whole assembly of Israel in a loud voice, saying:
verses.textEnEsv: And he stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: He stood and in a loud voice blessed the entire congregation of Israel:
verses.textEnNasb: And he stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying:
verses.textEn: He stood and blessed the whole assembly of Israel in a loud voice, saying:

verses.textZh: "耶和华是应当称颂的。他照着自己一切所应许的，赐安息给他的子民以色列人。借着他的仆人摩西所应许一切美好的话，一句都没有落空。
verses.textZhCnvs: "耶和华是应当称颂的。他照着自己一切所应许的，赐安息给他的子民以色列人。借着他的仆人摩西所应许一切美好的话，一句都没有落空。
verses.textZhCuv: 「耶和华是应当称颂的！因为他照着一切所应许的赐平安给他的民以色列人，凡藉他仆人摩西应许赐福的话，一句都没有落空。
verses.textEnNiv: "Praise be to the Lord , who has given rest to his people Israel just as he promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises he gave through his servant Moses.
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed be the Lord who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. Not one word has failed of all his good promise, which he spoke by Moses his servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed be the Lord, who has given rest to His people Israel, according to all that He promised. There has not failed one word of all His good promise, which He promised through His servant Moses.
verses.textEnNlt: "Praise the Lord who has given rest to his people Israel, just as he promised. Not one word has failed of all the wonderful promises he gave through his servant Moses.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed be the Lord, who has given rest to His people Israel in accordance with everything that He promised; not one word has failed of all His good promise, which He promised through Moses His servant.
verses.textEn: "Praise be to the Lord , who has given rest to his people Israel just as he promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises he gave through his servant Moses.

verses.textZh: 愿耶和华我们的神与我们同在，像与我们的列祖同在一样。愿他不离弃我们，也不撇下我们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿耶和华我们的神与我们同在，像与我们的列祖同在一样。愿他不离弃我们，也不撇下我们。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿耶和华－我们的神与我们同在，像与我们列祖同在一样，不撇下我们，不丢弃我们，
verses.textEnNiv: May the Lord our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us nor forsake us.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord our God be with us, as he was with our fathers. May he not leave us or forsake us,
verses.textEnNkjv: May the Lord our God be with us, as He was with our fathers. May He not leave us nor forsake us,
verses.textEnNlt: May the Lord our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us or abandon us.
verses.textEnNasb: May the Lord our God be with us, as He was with our fathers; may He not leave us nor forsake us,
verses.textEn: May the Lord our God be with us as he was with our ancestors; may he never leave us nor forsake us.

verses.textZh: 愿他使我们的心归向他，遵行他的一切道，谨守他吩咐我们列祖的诫命、律例和典章。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他使我们的心归向他，遵行他的一切道，谨守他吩咐我们列祖的诫命、律例和典章。
verses.textZhCuv: 使我们的心归向他，遵行他的道，谨守他吩咐我们列祖的诫命、律例、典章。
verses.textEnNiv: May he turn our hearts to him, to walk in obedience to him and keep the commands, decrees and laws he gave our ancestors.
verses.textEnEsv: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his rules, which he commanded our fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: that He may incline our hearts to Himself, to walk in all His ways, and to keep His commandments and His statutes and His judgments, which He commanded our fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: May he give us the desire to do his will in everything and to obey all the commands, decrees, and regulations that he gave our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: so that He may guide our hearts toward Himself, to walk in all His ways and to keep His commandments, His statutes, and His ordinances, which He commanded our fathers.
verses.textEn: May he turn our hearts to him, to walk in obedience to him and keep the commands, decrees and laws he gave our ancestors.

verses.textZh: 愿我在耶和华面前恳求的这些话，昼夜都不离耶和华我们的神，好使他天天为他仆人和他的子民以色列人主持公道，
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿我在耶和华面前恳求的这些话，昼夜都不离耶和华我们的神，好使他天天为他仆人和他的子民以色列人主持公道，
verses.textZhCuv: 我在耶和华面前祈求的这些话，愿耶和华－我们的神昼夜垂念，每日为他仆人与他民以色列伸冤，
verses.textEnNiv: And may these words of mine, which I have prayed before the Lord , be near to the Lord our God day and night, that he may uphold the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel according to each day’s need,
verses.textEnEsv: Let these words of mine, with which I have pleaded before the Lord , be near to the Lord our God day and night, and may he maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as each day requires,
verses.textEnNkjv: And may these words of mine, with which I have made supplication before the Lord, be near the Lord our God day and night, that He may maintain the cause of His servant and the cause of His people Israel, as each day may require,
verses.textEnNlt: And may these words that I have prayed in the presence of the Lord be before him constantly, day and night, so that the Lord our God may give justice to me and to his people Israel, according to each day’s needs.
verses.textEnNasb: And may these words of mine, with which I have implored the favor of the Lord, be near to the Lord our God day and night, so that He will maintain the cause of His servant and the cause of His people Israel, as each day requires,
verses.textEn: And may these words of mine, which I have prayed before the Lord , be near to the Lord our God day and night, that he may uphold the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel according to each day’s need,

verses.textZh: 使地上万族万民都知道耶和华是神，除他以外没有别的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使地上万族万民都知道耶和华是神，除他以外没有别的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 使地上的万民都知道惟独耶和华是神，并无别神。
verses.textEnNiv: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord is God and that there is no other.
verses.textEnEsv: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord is God; there is no other.
verses.textEnNkjv: that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lordis God; thereis no other.
verses.textEnNlt: Then people all over the earth will know that the Lord alone is God and there is no other.
verses.textEnNasb: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord is God; there is no one else.
verses.textEn: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord is God and that there is no other.

verses.textZh: 所以你们的心要完全归给耶和华我们的神，遵行他的律例，谨守他的诫命，像今天一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们的心要完全归给耶和华我们的神，遵行他的律例，谨守他的诫命，像今天一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你们当向耶和华－我们的神存诚实的心，遵行他的律例，谨守他的诫命，至终如今日一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: And may your hearts be fully committed to the Lord our God, to live by his decrees and obey his commands, as at this time."
verses.textEnEsv: Let your heart therefore be wholly true to the Lord our God, walking in his statutes and keeping his commandments, as at this day."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let your heart therefore be loyal to the Lord our God, to walk in His statutes and keep His commandments, as at this day."
verses.textEnNlt: And may you be completely faithful to the Lord our God. May you always obey his decrees and commands, just as you are doing today."
verses.textEnNasb: Your hearts therefore shall be wholly devoted to the Lord our God, to walk in His statutes and to keep His commandments, as at this day."
verses.textEn: And may your hearts be fully committed to the Lord our God, to live by his decrees and obey his commands, as at this time."

verses.textZh: 王和所有与他在一起的以色列人都在耶和华面前献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和所有与他在一起的以色列人都在耶和华面前献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 王和以色列众民一同在耶和华面前献祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifice before the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 所罗门向耶和华献平安祭，牛二万二千头，羊十二万只；这样，王和以色列众人为耶和华的殿举行了奉献典礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门向耶和华献平安祭，牛二万二千头，羊十二万只；这样，王和以色列众人为耶和华的殿举行了奉献典礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门向耶和华献平安祭，用牛二万二千，羊十二万。这样，王和以色列众民为耶和华的殿行奉献之礼。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon offered a sacrifice of fellowship offerings to the Lord : twenty-two thousand cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the Israelites dedicated the temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon offered as peace offerings to the Lord 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the people of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the Lord, twenty-two thousand bulls and one hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon offered to the Lord a peace offering of 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep and goats. And so the king and all the people of Israel dedicated the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: And Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to the Lord, twenty-two thousand oxen and 120,000 sheep. So the king and all the sons of Israel dedicated the house of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Solomon offered a sacrifice of fellowship offerings to the Lord : twenty-two thousand cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the Israelites dedicated the temple of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 那一天，因为耶和华面前的铜祭坛太小，容不下燔祭、素祭和平安祭牲的脂肪，王就把耶和华殿前院子当中的地方分别为圣，在那里献燔祭、素祭和平安祭牲的脂肪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，因为耶和华面前的铜祭坛太小，容不下燔祭、素祭和平安祭牲的脂肪，王就把耶和华殿前院子当中的地方分别为圣，在那里献燔祭、素祭和平安祭牲的脂肪。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，王因耶和华殿前的铜坛太小，容不下燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油，便将耶和华殿前院子当中分别为圣，在那里献燔祭、素祭，和平安祭牲的脂油。
verses.textEnNiv: On that same day the king consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the Lord , and there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar that stood before the Lord was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: The same day the king consecrated the middle of the court that was before the house of the Lord , for there he offered the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat pieces of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the Lord was too small to receive the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat pieces of the peace offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the same day the king consecrated the middle of the court that was in front of the house of the Lord; for there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before the Lordwas too small to receive the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.textEnNlt: That same day the king consecrated the central area of the courtyard in front of the Lord ’s Temple. He offered burnt offerings, grain offerings, and the fat of peace offerings there, because the bronze altar in the Lord ’s presence was too small to hold all the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: On the same day the king consecrated the middle of the courtyard that was in front of the house of the Lord, because there he offered the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the fat of the peace offerings; for the bronze altar that was before the Lordwas too small to hold the burnt offering, the grain offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.textEn: On that same day the king consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the Lord , and there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar that stood before the Lord was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings.

verses.textZh: 那时所罗门与从哈马口直到埃及小河的以色列人，都在耶和华我们的神面前举行盛大的集会，守节七天，又七天，一共十四天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时所罗门与从哈马口直到埃及小河的以色列人，都在耶和华我们的神面前举行盛大的集会，守节七天，又七天，一共十四天。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，所罗门和以色列众人，就是从哈马口直到埃及小河所有的以色列人，都聚集成为大会，在耶和华－我们的神面前守节七日又七日，共十四日。
verses.textEnNiv: So Solomon observed the festival at that time, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt. They celebrated it before the Lord our God for seven days and seven days more, fourteen days in all.
verses.textEnEsv: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from Lebo-hamath to the Brook of Egypt, before the Lord our God, seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Solomon held a feast, and all Israel with him, a great assembly from the entrance of Hamath to the Brook of Egypt, before the Lord our God, seven days and seven more days—fourteen days.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Solomon and all Israel celebrated the Festival of Shelters in the presence of the Lord our God. A large congregation had gathered from as far away as Lebo-hamath in the north and the Brook of Egypt in the south. The celebration went on for fourteen days in all—seven days for the dedication of the altar and seven days for the Festival of Shelters.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before the Lord our God, for seven days and seven more days, that is, fourteen days.
verses.textEn: So Solomon observed the festival at that time, and all Israel with him—a vast assembly, people from Lebo Hamath to the Wadi of Egypt. They celebrated it before the Lord our God for seven days and seven days more, fourteen days in all.

verses.textZh: 到了第八天，王遣散了众人；众人都祝福过王以后，就高高兴兴地回自己的家去。他们因为看见耶和华向他仆人大卫和他子民以色列所施的一切恩惠，心中都感到欢喜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第八天，王遣散了众人；众人都祝福过王以后，就高高兴兴地回自己的家去。他们因为看见耶和华向他仆人大卫和他子民以色列所施的一切恩惠，心中都感到欢喜。
verses.textZhCuv: 第八日，王遣散众民；他们都为王祝福。因见耶和华向他仆人大卫和他民以色列所施的一切恩惠，就都心中喜乐，各归各家去了。
verses.textEnNiv: On the following day he sent the people away. They blessed the king and then went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things the Lord had done for his servant David and his people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: On the eighth day he sent the people away, and they blessed the king and went to their homes joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the Lord had shown to David his servant and to Israel his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the good that the Lord had done for His servant David, and for Israel His people.
verses.textEnNlt: After the festival was over, Solomon sent the people home. They blessed the king and went to their homes joyful and glad because the Lord had been good to his servant David and to his people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: On the eighth day he dismissed the people, and they blessed the king. Then they went to their tents joyful and with happy hearts for all the goodness that the Lord had shown to David His servant, and to Israel His people.
verses.textEn: On the following day he sent the people away. They blessed the king and then went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things the Lord had done for his servant David and his people Israel.

verses.textZh: 所罗门建造完了耶和华的殿、王宫和所罗门渴想建造的一切以后，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门建造完了耶和华的殿、王宫和所罗门渴想建造的一切以后，
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，并一切所愿意建造的都完毕了，
verses.textEnNiv: When Solomon had finished building the temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and had achieved all he had desired to do,
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and the king’s house and all that Solomon desired to build,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he wanted to do,
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon finished building the Temple of the Lord , as well as the royal palace. He completed everything he had planned to do.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about when Solomon had finished building the house of the Lord and the king’s house, and all that Solomon desired to do,
verses.textEn: When Solomon had finished building the temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and had achieved all he had desired to do,

verses.textZh: 耶和华就第二次向所罗门显现，像先前在基遍向他显现一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华就第二次向所罗门显现，像先前在基遍向他显现一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就二次向所罗门显现，如先前在基遍向他显现一样，
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord appeared to him a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the Lord appeared to Solomon the second time, as He had appeared to him at Gibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, as he had done before at Gibeon.
verses.textEnNasb: that the Lord appeared to Solomon a second time, as He had appeared to him at Gibeon.
verses.textEn: the Lord appeared to him a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对他说："你在我面前所作的祷告和恳求，我都已经听见了。你建造的这殿，我已经把它分别为圣，要使我的名永远留在那里；我的眼和我的心也必常在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对他说："你在我面前所作的祷告和恳求，我都已经听见了。你建造的这殿，我已经把它分别为圣，要使我的名永远留在那里；我的眼和我的心也必常在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他说：「你向我所祷告祈求的，我都应允了。我已将你所建的这殿分别为圣，使我的名永远在其中；我的眼、我的心也必常在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to him: "I have heard the prayer and plea you have made before me; I have consecrated this temple, which you have built, by putting my Name there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, "I have heard your prayer and your plea, which you have made before me. I have consecrated this house that you have built, by putting my name there forever. My eyes and my heart will be there for all time.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to him: "I have heard your prayer and your supplication that you have made before Me; I have consecrated this house which you have built to put My name there forever, and My eyes and My heart will be there perpetually.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord said to him, "I have heard your prayer and your petition. I have set this Temple apart to be holy—this place you have built where my name will be honored forever. I will always watch over it, for it is dear to my heart.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to him, "I have heard your prayer and your plea which you have offered before Me; I have consecrated this house which you have built, by putting My name there forever, and My eyes and My heart will be there always.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to him: "I have heard the prayer and plea you have made before me; I have consecrated this temple, which you have built, by putting my Name there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

verses.textZh: 至于你，如果你像你父亲大卫那样，存诚实和正直的心在我面前行事为人，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例和典章，
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你，如果你像你父亲大卫那样，存诚实和正直的心在我面前行事为人，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例和典章，
verses.textZhCuv: 你若效法你父大卫，存诚实正直的心行在我面前，遵行我一切所吩咐你的，谨守我的律例典章，
verses.textEnNiv: "As for you, if you walk before me faithfully with integrity of heart and uprightness, as David your father did, and do all I command and observe my decrees and laws,
verses.textEnEsv: And as for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, with integrity of heart and uprightness, doing according to all that I have commanded you, and keeping my statutes and my rules,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if you walk before Me as your father David walked, in integrity of heart and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and My judgments,
verses.textEnNlt: "As for you, if you will follow me with integrity and godliness, as David your father did, obeying all my commands, decrees, and regulations,
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, in integrity of heart and honesty, acting in accordance with everything that I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and My ordinances,
verses.textEn: "As for you, if you walk before me faithfully with integrity of heart and uprightness, as David your father did, and do all I command and observe my decrees and laws,

verses.textZh: 我就必坚固你统治以色列的国位，直到永远，正如我应许你父亲大卫说：‘你的子孙，总不断有人坐以色列的王位。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就必坚固你统治以色列的国位，直到永远，正如我应许你父亲大卫说：‘你的子孙，总不断有人坐以色列的王位。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就必坚固你的国位在以色列中，直到永远，正如我应许你父大卫说：『你的子孙必不断人坐以色列的国位。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnEsv: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised David your father, saying, ‘You shall not lack a man on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I promised David your father, saying, ‘You shall not fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnNlt: then I will establish the throne of your dynasty over Israel forever. For I made this promise to your father, David: ‘One of your descendants will always sit on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEnNasb: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, just as I promised to your father David, saying, ‘ You shall not be deprived of a man on the throne of Israel.’
verses.textEn: I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised David your father when I said, ‘You shall never fail to have a successor on the throne of Israel.’

verses.textZh: 你们或是你们的子孙，若是转去不跟从我，不遵守我赐给你们的诫命和律例，去事奉别的神，敬拜他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们或是你们的子孙，若是转去不跟从我，不遵守我赐给你们的诫命和律例，去事奉别的神，敬拜他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你们和你们的子孙转去不跟从我，不守我指示你们的诫命律例，去事奉敬拜别神，
verses.textEnNiv: "But if you or your descendants turn away from me and do not observe the commands and decrees I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,
verses.textEnEsv: But if you turn aside from following me, you or your children, and do not keep my commandments and my statutes that I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you or your sons at all turn from following Me, and do not keep My commandments and My statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.textEnNlt: "But if you or your descendants abandon me and disobey the commands and decrees I have given you, and if you serve and worship other gods,
verses.textEnNasb: "But if you or your sons indeed turn away from following Me, and do not keep My commandments and My statutes which I have placed before you, but you go and serve other gods and worship them,
verses.textEn: "But if you or your descendants turn away from me and do not observe the commands and decrees I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,

verses.textZh: 我就必把以色列人从我赐给他们的这地上剪除，甚至为自己的名分别为圣的这殿，我也必从我面前把它丢弃不顾，使以色列人在万族中成为笑谈和讥笑的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就必把以色列人从我赐给他们的这地上剪除，甚至为自己的名分别为圣的这殿，我也必从我面前把它丢弃不顾，使以色列人在万族中成为笑谈和讥笑的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 我就必将以色列人从我赐给他们的地上剪除，并且我为己名所分别为圣的殿也必舍弃不顾，使以色列人在万民中作笑谈，被讥诮。
verses.textEnNiv: then I will cut off Israel from the land I have given them and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. Israel will then become a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: then I will cut off Israel from the land that I have given them, and the house that I have consecrated for my name I will cast out of my sight, and Israel will become a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: then I will cut off Israel from the land which I have given them; and this house which I have consecrated for My name I will cast out of My sight. Israel will be a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
verses.textEnNlt: then I will uproot Israel from this land that I have given them. I will reject this Temple that I have made holy to honor my name. I will make Israel an object of mockery and ridicule among the nations.
verses.textEnNasb: then I will cut Israel off from the land which I have given them, and the house which I have consecrated for My name, I will expel from My sight. So Israel will become a saying and an object of derision among all peoples.
verses.textEn: then I will cut off Israel from the land I have given them and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. Israel will then become a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.

verses.textZh: 这殿必成为废墟 ，经过的人都必惊讶，取笑说：耶和华为甚么向这地和这殿这样作啊？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这殿必成为废墟 ，经过的人都必惊讶，取笑说：耶和华为甚么向这地和这殿这样作啊？
verses.textZhCuv: 这殿虽然甚高，将来经过的人必惊讶、嗤笑，说：『耶和华为何向这地和这殿如此行呢？』
verses.textEnNiv: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
verses.textEnEsv: And this house will become a heap of ruins. Everyone passing by it will be astonished and will hiss, and they will say, ‘Why has the Lord done thus to this land and to this house?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And asfor this house, which is exalted, everyone who passes by it will be astonished and will hiss, and say, ‘Why has the Lord done thus to this land and to this house?’
verses.textEnNlt: And though this Temple is impressive now, all who pass by will be appalled and will gasp in horror. They will ask, ‘Why did the Lord do such terrible things to this land and to this Temple?’
verses.textEnNasb: And this house will become a heap of ruins; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and hiss and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and this house?’
verses.textEn: This temple will become a heap of rubble. All who pass by will be appalled and will scoff and say, ‘Why has the Lord done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’

verses.textZh: 人要回答说：是因为他们离弃了那把他们的列祖从埃及地领出来的耶和华他们的神，去亲近别的神，敬拜他们，事奉他们，因此耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人要回答说：是因为他们离弃了那把他们的列祖从埃及地领出来的耶和华他们的神，去亲近别的神，敬拜他们，事奉他们，因此耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 人必回答说：『是因此地的人离弃领他们列祖出埃及地之耶和华－他们的神，去亲近别神，事奉敬拜他，所以耶和华使这一切灾祸临到他们。』」
verses.textEnNiv: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the Lord their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why the Lord brought all this disaster on them.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Then they will say, ‘Because they abandoned the Lord their God who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt and laid hold on other gods and worshiped them and served them. Therefore the Lord has brought all this disaster on them.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will answer, ‘Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, and worshiped them and served them; therefore the Lord has brought all this calamity on them.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "And the answer will be, ‘Because his people abandoned the Lord their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt, and they worshiped other gods instead and bowed down to them. That is why the Lord has brought all these disasters on them.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And they will say, ‘Because they abandoned the Lord their God, who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and they adopted other gods and worshiped and served them, for that reason the Lord has brought all this adversity on them.’ "
verses.textEn: People will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the Lord their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—that is why the Lord brought all this disaster on them.’ "

verses.textZh: 所罗门用了二十年的时间来建造耶和华的殿和王宫这两座建筑物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门用了二十年的时间来建造耶和华的殿和王宫这两座建筑物。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建造耶和华殿和王宫，这两所二十年才完毕了。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built these two buildings—the temple of the Lord and the royal palace—
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the Lord and the king’s house,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the Lord and the king’s house
verses.textEnNlt: It took Solomon twenty years to build the Lord ’s Temple and his own royal palace. At the end of that time,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about at the end of twenty years in which Solomon had built the two houses, the house of the Lord and the king’s house
verses.textEn: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built these two buildings—the temple of the Lord and the royal palace—

verses.textZh: 因为推罗王希兰曾照着所罗门所喜爱的，以香柏木、松木和金子帮助他，于是所罗门王把加利利地的二十座城给了希兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为推罗王希兰曾照着所罗门所喜爱的，以香柏木、松木和金子帮助他，于是所罗门王把加利利地的二十座城给了希兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 泰尔王希兰曾照所罗门所要的，资助他香柏木、松木，和金子；所罗门王就把加利利地的二十座城给了希兰。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon gave twenty towns in Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, because Hiram had supplied him with all the cedar and juniper and gold he wanted.
verses.textEnEsv: and Hiram king of Tyre had supplied Solomon with cedar and cypress timber and gold, as much as he desired, King Solomon gave to Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.textEnNkjv: (Hiram the king of Tyre had supplied Solomon with cedar and cypress and gold, as much as he desired), that King Solomon then gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.textEnNlt: he gave twenty towns in the land of Galilee to King Hiram of Tyre. (Hiram had previously provided all the cedar and cypress timber and gold that Solomon had requested.)
verses.textEnNasb: (Hiram king of Tyre had supplied Solomon with cedar and juniper timber and gold, satisfying all his desire), that King Solomon then gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.textEn: King Solomon gave twenty towns in Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, because Hiram had supplied him with all the cedar and juniper and gold he wanted.

verses.textZh: 希兰从推罗出来，看看所罗门给他的这些城。他不喜欢这些城，
verses.textZhCnvs: 希兰从推罗出来，看看所罗门给他的这些城。他不喜欢这些城，
verses.textZhCuv: 希兰从泰尔出来，察看所罗门给他的城邑，就不喜悦，
verses.textEnNiv: But when Hiram went from Tyre to see the towns that Solomon had given him, he was not pleased with them.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Hiram came from Tyre to see the cities that Solomon had given him, they did not please him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hiram went from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him, but they did not please him.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Hiram came from Tyre to see the towns Solomon had given him, he was not at all pleased with them.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hiram left Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him, and they did not please him.
verses.textEn: But when Hiram went from Tyre to see the towns that Solomon had given him, he was not pleased with them.

verses.textZh: 他说："我的兄弟啊，这些就是你送给我的城吗？"于是他给这些城起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："我的兄弟啊，这些就是你送给我的城吗？"于是他给这些城起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我兄啊，你给我的是什么城邑呢？」他就给这城邑之地起名叫迦步勒，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: "What kind of towns are these you have given me, my brother?" he asked. And he called them the Land of Kabul, a name they have to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he said, "What kind of cities are these that you have given me, my brother?" So they are called the land of Cabul to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "What kindof cities are these which you have given me, my brother?" And he called them the land of Cabul, as they are to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: "What kind of towns are these, my brother?" he asked. So Hiram called that area Cabul (which means "worthless"), as it is still known today.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "What are these cities which you have given me, my brother?" So they have been called the land of Cabul to this day.
verses.textEn: "What kind of towns are these you have given me, my brother?" he asked. And he called them the Land of Kabul, a name they have to this day.

verses.textZh: 希兰送给所罗门约有四千公斤金子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希兰送给所罗门约有四千公斤金子。
verses.textZhCuv: 希兰给所罗门一百二十他连得金子。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Hiram had sent to the king 120 talents of gold.
verses.textEnEsv: Hiram had sent to the king 120 talents of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hiram sent the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Nevertheless, Hiram paid Solomon 9,000 pounds of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And Hiram sent to the king 120 talents of gold.
verses.textEn: Now Hiram had sent to the king 120 talents of gold.

verses.textZh: 这是所罗门王征召服劳役的建筑耶和华的殿和他自己的王宫，以及米罗、耶路撒冷的城墙、夏琐、米吉多和基色的记录。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是所罗门王征召服劳役的建筑耶和华的殿和他自己的王宫，以及米罗、耶路撒冷的城墙、夏琐、米吉多和基色的记录。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王挑取服苦的人，是为建造耶和华的殿、自己的宫、米罗、耶路撒冷的城墙、夏琐、米吉多，并基色。
verses.textEnNiv: Here is the account of the forced labor King Solomon conscripted to build the Lord ’s temple, his own palace, the terraces, the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, Megiddo and Gezer.
verses.textEnEsv: And this is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon drafted to build the house of the Lord and his own house and the Millo and the wall of Jerusalem and Hazor and Megiddo and Gezer
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the reason for the labor force which King Solomon raised: to build the house of the Lord, his own house, the Millo, the wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of the forced labor that King Solomon conscripted to build the Lord ’s Temple, the royal palace, the supporting terraces, the wall of Jerusalem, and the cities of Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this is the account of the forced labor which King Solomon conscripted to build the house of the Lord, his own house, the Millo, the wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.textEn: Here is the account of the forced labor King Solomon conscripted to build the Lord ’s temple, his own palace, the terraces, the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, Megiddo and Gezer.

verses.textZh: 先前埃及王法老上来攻取基色，放火烧城，杀了住在城里的迦南人，把城送给自己的女儿、所罗门的妻子作嫁妆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先前埃及王法老上来攻取基色，放火烧城，杀了住在城里的迦南人，把城送给自己的女儿、所罗门的妻子作嫁妆。
verses.textZhCuv: 先前埃及王法老上来攻取基色，用火焚烧，杀了城内居住的迦南人，将城赐给他女儿所罗门的妻作妆奁。
verses.textEnNiv: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire. He killed its Canaanite inhabitants and then gave it as a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
verses.textEnEsv: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up and captured Gezer and burned it with fire, and had killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and had given it as dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife;
verses.textEnNkjv: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up and taken Gezer and burned it with fire, had killed the Canaanites who dwelt in the city, and had given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.)
verses.textEnNlt: (Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, had attacked and captured Gezer, killing the Canaanite population and burning it down. He gave the city to his daughter as a wedding gift when she married Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up and overthrown Gezer and burned it with fire, and killed the Canaanites who lived in the city; and he had given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
verses.textEn: (Pharaoh king of Egypt had attacked and captured Gezer. He had set it on fire. He killed its Canaanite inhabitants and then gave it as a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

verses.textZh: 所以所罗门重建基色、下伯．和仑、
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以所罗门重建基色、下伯．和仑、
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门建造基色、下伯‧和仑、
verses.textEnNiv: And Solomon rebuilt Gezer.) He built up Lower Beth Horon,
verses.textEnEsv: so Solomon rebuilt Gezer) and Lower Beth-horon
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon built Gezer, Lower Beth Horon,
verses.textEnNlt: So Solomon rebuilt the city of Gezer.) He also built up the towns of Lower Beth-horon,
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon rebuilt Gezer and the lower Beth-horon,
verses.textEn: And Solomon rebuilt Gezer.) He built up Lower Beth Horon,

verses.textZh: 巴拉和在犹大地旷野里的他玛，
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴拉和在犹大地旷野里的他玛，
verses.textZhCuv: 巴拉，并国中旷野里的达莫，
verses.textEnNiv: Baalath, and Tadmor in the desert, within his land,
verses.textEnEsv: and Baalath and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land of Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land ofJudah,
verses.textEnNlt: Baalath, and Tamar in the wilderness within his land.
verses.textEnNasb: and Baalath and Tamar in the wilderness, in the land of Judah,
verses.textEn: Baalath, and Tadmor in the desert, within his land,

verses.textZh: 以及属于所罗门所有的一切积货城、屯车城、马兵城，与所罗门在耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩和他统治的各地他喜爱建造的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及属于所罗门所有的一切积货城、屯车城、马兵城，与所罗门在耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩和他统治的各地他喜爱建造的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又建造所有的积货城，并屯车和马兵的城，与耶路撒冷、黎巴嫩，以及自己治理的全国中所愿建造的。
verses.textEnNiv: as well as all his store cities and the towns for his chariots and for his horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.
verses.textEnEsv: and all the store cities that Solomon had, and the cities for his chariots, and the cities for his horsemen, and whatever Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.textEnNkjv: all the storage cities that Solomon had, cities for his chariots and cities for his cavalry, and whatever Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.textEnNlt: He built towns as supply centers and constructed towns where his chariots and horses could be stationed. He built everything he desired in Jerusalem and Lebanon and throughout his entire realm.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the storage cities which Solomon had, that is, the cities for his chariots and the cities for his horsemen, and everything that it pleased Solomon to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and in all the land under his rule.
verses.textEn: as well as all his store cities and the towns for his chariots and for his horses —whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.

verses.textZh: 所有亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人和耶布斯人余下的人，他们不是以色列人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人和耶布斯人余下的人，他们不是以色列人。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于国中所剩下不属以色列人的亚摩利人、赫人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人，
verses.textEnNiv: There were still people left from the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these peoples were not Israelites).
verses.textEnEsv: All the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the people of Israel—
verses.textEnNkjv: All the people whowere left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, who were not of the children of Israel—
verses.textEnNlt: There were still some people living in the land who were not Israelites, including Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
verses.textEnNasb: As for all the people who were left of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of the sons of Israel,
verses.textEn: There were still people left from the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these peoples were not Israelites).

verses.textZh: 他们的子孙仍然留在那地，以色列人不能灭绝他们。于是所罗门征召他们作苦工的奴仆，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的子孙仍然留在那地，以色列人不能灭绝他们。于是所罗门征召他们作苦工的奴仆，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是以色列人不能灭尽的，所罗门挑取他们的后裔作服苦的奴仆，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these peoples remaining in the land—whom the Israelites could not exterminate —to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: their descendants who were left after them in the land, whom the people of Israel were unable to devote to destruction — these Solomon drafted to be slaves, and so they are to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: that is, their descendants who were left in the land after them, whom the children of Israel had not been able to destroy completely— from these Solomon raised forced labor, as it is to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: These were descendants of the nations whom the people of Israel had not completely destroyed. So Solomon conscripted them as slaves, and they serve as forced laborers to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: their descendants who were left after them in the land, whom the sons of Israel were unable to completely eliminate, from them Solomon conscripted forced laborers, as they are to this day.
verses.textEn: Solomon conscripted the descendants of all these peoples remaining in the land—whom the Israelites could not exterminate —to serve as slave labor, as it is to this day.

verses.textZh: 至于以色列人，所罗门却没有使他们作奴仆，而是作他的战士、臣仆、统领、军长、战车长和骑兵长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于以色列人，所罗门却没有使他们作奴仆，而是作他的战士、臣仆、统领、军长、战车长和骑兵长。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有以色列人，所罗门不使他们作奴仆，乃是作他的战士、臣仆、统领、军长、车兵长、马兵长。
verses.textEnNiv: But Solomon did not make slaves of any of the Israelites; they were his fighting men, his government officials, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and charioteers.
verses.textEnEsv: But of the people of Israel Solomon made no slaves. They were the soldiers, they were his officials, his commanders, his captains, his chariot commanders and his horsemen.
verses.textEnNkjv: But of the children of Israel Solomon made no forced laborers, because they were men of war and his servants: his officers, his captains, commanders of his chariots, and his cavalry.
verses.textEnNlt: But Solomon did not conscript any of the Israelites for forced labor. Instead, he assigned them to serve as fighting men, government officials, officers and captains in his army, commanders of his chariots, and charioteers.
verses.textEnNasb: But Solomon did not make slaves of the sons of Israel; for they were men of war, his servants, his commanders, his charioteers, his chariot commanders, and his horsemen.
verses.textEn: But Solomon did not make slaves of any of the Israelites; they were his fighting men, his government officials, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and charioteers.

verses.textZh: 所罗门有督工五百五十人，负责管理作工的人和监督工程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门有督工五百五十人，负责管理作工的人和监督工程。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门有五百五十督工的，监管工人。
verses.textEnNiv: They were also the chief officials in charge of Solomon’s projects—550 officials supervising those who did the work.
verses.textEnEsv: These were the chief officers who were over Solomon’s work: 550 who had charge of the people who carried on the work.
verses.textEnNkjv: Others were chiefs of the officials who were over Solomon’s work: five hundred and fifty, who ruled over the people who did the work.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon appointed 550 of them to supervise the people working on his various projects.
verses.textEnNasb: These were the chief officers who were in charge of Solomon’s work, 550, who ruled over the people doing the work.
verses.textEn: They were also the chief officials in charge of Solomon’s projects—550 officials supervising those who did the work.

verses.textZh: 法老的女儿从大卫城搬到所罗门为她建造的宫里以后，所罗门才重建米罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的女儿从大卫城搬到所罗门为她建造的宫里以后，所罗门才重建米罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的女儿从大卫城搬到所罗门为她建造的宫里。那时，所罗门才建造米罗。
verses.textEnNiv: After Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace Solomon had built for her, he constructed the terraces.
verses.textEnEsv: But Pharaoh’s daughter went up from the city of David to her own house that Solomon had built for her. Then he built the Millo.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up from the City of David to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built the Millo.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon moved his wife, Pharaoh’s daughter, from the City of David to the new palace he had built for her. Then he constructed the supporting terraces.
verses.textEnNasb: As soon as Pharaoh’s daughter came up from the city of David to her house which Solomon had built for her, he then built the Millo.
verses.textEn: After Pharaoh’s daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace Solomon had built for her, he constructed the terraces.

verses.textZh: 所罗门每年三次在他为耶和华建造的祭坛上献上燔祭和平安祭；又在耶和华面前的坛上烧香，这样，他完成了建殿的工程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门每年三次在他为耶和华建造的祭坛上献上燔祭和平安祭；又在耶和华面前的坛上烧香，这样，他完成了建殿的工程。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门每年三次在他为耶和华所筑的坛上献燔祭和平安祭，又在耶和华面前的坛上烧香。这样，他建造殿的工程完毕了。
verses.textEnNiv: Three times a year Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar he had built for the Lord , burning incense before the Lord along with them, and so fulfilled the temple obligations.
verses.textEnEsv: Three times a year Solomon used to offer up burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar that he built to the Lord , making offerings with it before the Lord . So he finished the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he had built for the Lord, and he burned incense with them onthealtar that was before the Lord. So he finished the temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Three times each year Solomon presented burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he had built for the Lord . He also burned incense to the Lord . And so he finished the work of building the Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Now three times a year Solomon offered burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar which he had built for the Lord, burning incense with them on the altar which was before the Lord. So he finished the house.
verses.textEn: Three times a year Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar he had built for the Lord , burning incense before the Lord along with them, and so fulfilled the temple obligations.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王又在以东地、红海边，靠近以禄的以旬．迦别，建造船队。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王又在以东地、红海边，靠近以禄的以旬．迦别，建造船队。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王在以东地红海边，靠近以禄的以旬‧迦别制造船只。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon also built ships at Ezion Geber, which is near Elath in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.
verses.textEnEsv: King Solomon built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNkjv: King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Ezion Geber, which is near Elath on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, a port near Elath in the land of Edom, along the shore of the Red Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: King Solomon also built a fleet of ships in Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.textEn: King Solomon also built ships at Ezion Geber, which is near Elath in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.

verses.textZh: 希兰派遣他船队的仆人，就是熟悉航海的船员，与所罗门的仆人一同航海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希兰派遣他船队的仆人，就是熟悉航海的船员，与所罗门的仆人一同航海。
verses.textZhCuv: 希兰差遣他的仆人，就是熟悉泛海的船家，与所罗门的仆人一同坐船航海。
verses.textEnNiv: And Hiram sent his men—sailors who knew the sea—to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s men.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hiram sent with the fleet his servants, seamen who were familiar with the sea, together with the servants of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hiram sent his servants with the fleet, seamen who knew the sea, to work with the servants of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: Hiram sent experienced crews of sailors to sail the ships with Solomon’s men.
verses.textEnNasb: And Hiram sent his servants with the fleet, sailors who knew the sea, along with the servants of Solomon.
verses.textEn: And Hiram sent his men—sailors who knew the sea—to serve in the fleet with Solomon’s men.

verses.textZh: 他们到达了俄斐，从那里取得黄金约有一万四千公斤，运到所罗门王那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到达了俄斐，从那里取得黄金约有一万四千公斤，运到所罗门王那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了俄斐，从那里得了四百二十他连得金子，运到所罗门王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: They sailed to Ophir and brought back 420 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went to Ophir and brought from there gold, 420 talents, and they brought it to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they went to Ophir, and acquired four hundred and twenty talents of gold from there, and brought it to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: They sailed to Ophir and brought back to Solomon some sixteen tons of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: And they went to Ophir and received 420 talents of gold from there, and brought it to King Solomon.
verses.textEn: They sailed to Ophir and brought back 420 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.

verses.textZh: 示巴女王听到所罗门因耶和华的名所得的名声，就来要用难题试试他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴女王听到所罗门因耶和华的名所得的名声，就来要用难题试试他。
verses.textZhCuv: 示巴女王听见所罗门因耶和华之名所得的名声，就来要用难解的话试问所罗门。
verses.textEnNiv: When the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon and his relationship to the Lord , she came to test Solomon with hard questions.
verses.textEnEsv: Now when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the Lord , she came to test him with hard questions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the Lord, she came to test him with hard questions.
verses.textEnNlt: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon’s fame, which brought honor to the name of the Lord , she came to test him with hard questions.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon in relation to the name of the Lord, she came to test him with riddles.
verses.textEn: When the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon and his relationship to the Lord , she came to test Solomon with hard questions.

verses.textZh: 她带着大批随员到耶路撒冷来，又有骆驼驮着香料、许多金子和宝石。她来到所罗门那里，就把她心里所有的难题都对他说出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她带着大批随员到耶路撒冷来，又有骆驼驮着香料、许多金子和宝石。她来到所罗门那里，就把她心里所有的难题都对他说出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 跟随她到耶路撒冷的人甚多，又有骆驼驮着香料、宝石，和许多金子。她来见了所罗门王，就把心里所有的对所罗门都说出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Arriving at Jerusalem with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all that she had on her mind.
verses.textEnEsv: She came to Jerusalem with a very great retinue, with camels bearing spices and very much gold and precious stones. And when she came to Solomon, she told him all that was on her mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: She came to Jerusalem with a very great retinue, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she came to Solomon, she spoke with him about all that was in her heart.
verses.textEnNlt: She arrived in Jerusalem with a large group of attendants and a great caravan of camels loaded with spices, large quantities of gold, and precious jewels. When she met with Solomon, she talked with him about everything she had on her mind.
verses.textEnNasb: So she came to Jerusalem with a very large entourage, with camels carrying balsam oil and a very large quantity of gold and precious stones. When she came to Solomon, she spoke to him about everything that was in her heart.
verses.textEn: Arriving at Jerusalem with a very great caravan—with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones—she came to Solomon and talked with him about all that she had on her mind.

verses.textZh: 所罗门把她所有的问题都给她解说明白，没有一件事难倒王，使王不能回答她的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门把她所有的问题都给她解说明白，没有一件事难倒王，使王不能回答她的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王将她所问的都答上了，没有一句不明白、不能答的。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for the king to explain to her.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing hidden from the king that he could not explain to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing so difficult for the king that he could not explain it to her.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon had answers for all her questions; nothing was too hard for the king to explain to her.
verses.textEnNasb: And Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was concealed from the king which he did not explain to her.
verses.textEn: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for the king to explain to her.

verses.textZh: 示巴女王看见所罗门的一切智慧和他建造的宫殿、
verses.textZhCnvs: 示巴女王看见所罗门的一切智慧和他建造的宫殿、
verses.textZhCuv: 示巴女王见所罗门大有智慧，和他所建造的宫室，
verses.textEnNiv: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon and the palace he had built,
verses.textEnEsv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
verses.textEnNlt: When the queen of Sheba realized how very wise Solomon was, and when she saw the palace he had built,
verses.textEnNasb: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.textEn: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon and the palace he had built,

verses.textZh: 桌上的食物、臣仆的座位、仆人的侍候、他们的服饰、王的酒政和王在耶和华的殿献上的燔祭，就惊奇得不知所措。
verses.textZhCnvs: 桌上的食物、臣仆的座位、仆人的侍候、他们的服饰、王的酒政和王在耶和华的殿献上的燔祭，就惊奇得不知所措。
verses.textZhCuv: 席上的珍馐美味，群臣分列而坐，仆人两旁侍立，以及他们的衣服装饰和酒政的衣服装饰，又见他上耶和华殿的台阶 ，就诧异得神不守舍；
verses.textEnNiv: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.
verses.textEnEsv: the food of his table, the seating of his officials, and the attendance of his servants, their clothing, his cupbearers, and his burnt offerings that he offered at the house of the Lord , there was no more breath in her.
verses.textEnNkjv: the food on his table, the seating of his servants, the service of his waiters and their apparel, his cupbearers, and his entryway by which he went up to the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.
verses.textEnNlt: she was overwhelmed. She was also amazed at the food on his tables, the organization of his officials and their splendid clothing, the cup-bearers, and the burnt offerings Solomon made at the Temple of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: and the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the service of his waiters and their attire, his cupbearers, and his burnt offerings which he offered at the house of the Lord, she was breathless.
verses.textEn: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the Lord , she was overwhelmed.

verses.textZh: 于是她对王说："我在本国听见有关你的事和你的智慧，原来都是真的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是她对王说："我在本国听见有关你的事和你的智慧，原来都是真的；
verses.textZhCuv: 对王说：「我在本国里所听见论到你的事和你的智慧实在是真的！
verses.textEnNiv: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to the king, "The report was true that I heard in my own land of your words and of your wisdom,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she said to the king: "It was a true report which I heard in my own land about your words and your wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: She exclaimed to the king, "Everything I heard in my country about your achievements and wisdom is true!
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said to the king, "It was a true story that I heard in my own land about your words and your wisdom.
verses.textEn: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.

verses.textZh: 以前我并不相信那些话，等到我来了，亲眼看见，才知道人告诉我的还不到一半；你的智慧和财富，超过我所听闻的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以前我并不相信那些话，等到我来了，亲眼看见，才知道人告诉我的还不到一半；你的智慧和财富，超过我所听闻的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我先不信那些话，及至我来亲眼见了才知道人所告诉我的还不到一半。你的智慧和你的福分越过我所听见的风声。
verses.textEnNiv: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told me; in wisdom and wealth you have far exceeded the report I heard.
verses.textEnEsv: but I did not believe the reports until I came and my own eyes had seen it. And behold, the half was not told me. Your wisdom and prosperity surpass the report that I heard.
verses.textEnNkjv: However I did not believe the words until I came and saw with my own eyes; and indeed the half was not told me. Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame of which I heard.
verses.textEnNlt: I didn’t believe what was said until I arrived here and saw it with my own eyes. In fact, I had not heard the half of it! Your wisdom and prosperity are far beyond what I was told.
verses.textEnNasb: But I did not believe the stories until I came and my own eyes saw it all. And behold, the half of it was not reported to me. You have exceeded in wisdom and prosperity the report which I heard.
verses.textEn: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told me; in wisdom and wealth you have far exceeded the report I heard.

verses.textZh: 属你的人是有福的，你的这些臣仆是有福的，他们常常侍立在你面前，聆听你的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属你的人是有福的，你的这些臣仆是有福的，他们常常侍立在你面前，聆听你的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的臣子、你的仆人常侍立在你面前听你智慧的话是有福的！
verses.textEnNiv: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!
verses.textEnEsv: Happy are your men! Happy are your servants, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!
verses.textEnNkjv: Happy are your men and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
verses.textEnNlt: How happy your people must be! What a privilege for your officials to stand here day after day, listening to your wisdom!
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed are your men, and blessed are these servants of yours who stand before you continually and hear your wisdom!
verses.textEn: How happy your people must be! How happy your officials, who continually stand before you and hear your wisdom!

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐在以色列的王位上；因为耶和华永远喜爱以色列，所以立你作王，要你秉行公义。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐在以色列的王位上；因为耶和华永远喜爱以色列，所以立你作王，要你秉行公义。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你的神是应当称颂的！他喜悦你，使你坐以色列的国位；因为他永远爱以色列，所以立你作王，使你秉公行义。」
verses.textEnNiv: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on the throne of Israel. Because of the Lord ’s eternal love for Israel, he has made you king to maintain justice and righteousness."
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed be the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and set you on the throne of Israel! Because the Lord loved Israel forever, he has made you king, that you may execute justice and righteousness."
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed be the Lord your God, who delighted in you, setting you on the throne of Israel! Because the Lord has loved Israel forever, therefore He made you king, to do justice and righteousness."
verses.textEnNlt: Praise the Lord your God, who delights in you and has placed you on the throne of Israel. Because of the Lord ’s eternal love for Israel, he has made you king so you can rule with justice and righteousness."
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed be the Lord your God who delighted in you to put you on the throne of Israel; because the Lord loves Israel forever, He made you king, to do justice and righteousness."
verses.textEn: Praise be to the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on the throne of Israel. Because of the Lord ’s eternal love for Israel, he has made you king to maintain justice and righteousness."

verses.textZh: 于是示巴女王把约四千公斤金子、大批香料和宝石送给王；以后奉来的香料再也没有像示巴女王送给所罗门的那么多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是示巴女王把约四千公斤金子、大批香料和宝石送给王；以后奉来的香料再也没有像示巴女王送给所罗门的那么多。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，示巴女王将一百二十他连得金子和宝石，与极多的香料，送给所罗门王。她送给王的香料，以后奉来的不再有这样多。
verses.textEnNiv: And she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. Never again were so many spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices and precious stones. Never again came such an abundance of spices as these that the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great quantity, and precious stones. There never again came such abundance of spices as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she gave the king a gift of 9,000 pounds of gold, great quantities of spices, and precious jewels. Never again were so many spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, and a very large amount of balsam oil and precious stones. Never again did such a large quantity of balsam oil come in as that which the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon.
verses.textEn: And she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. Never again were so many spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

verses.textZh: 此外，从俄斐运金子来的希兰船队，又从俄斐运了大批檀香木和宝石来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此外，从俄斐运金子来的希兰船队，又从俄斐运了大批檀香木和宝石来。
verses.textZhCuv: 希兰的船只从俄斐运了金子来，又从俄斐运了许多檀香木 和宝石来。
verses.textEnNiv: (Hiram’s ships brought gold from Ophir; and from there they brought great cargoes of almugwood and precious stones.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the fleet of Hiram, which brought gold from Ophir, brought from Ophir a very great amount of almug wood and precious stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, the ships of Hiram, which brought gold from Ophir, brought great quantities of almug wood and precious stones from Ophir.
verses.textEnNlt: (In addition, Hiram’s ships brought gold from Ophir, and they also brought rich cargoes of red sandalwood and precious jewels.
verses.textEnNasb: And the ships of Hiram as well, which brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir a very great number of almug trees and precious stones.
verses.textEn: (Hiram’s ships brought gold from Ophir; and from there they brought great cargoes of almugwood and precious stones.

verses.textZh: 王用檀香木为耶和华的殿和王宫做栏杆，又为歌唱的做琴瑟。以后再也没有这样的檀香木运来，也没有人看见过，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王用檀香木为耶和华的殿和王宫做栏杆，又为歌唱的做琴瑟。以后再也没有这样的檀香木运来，也没有人看见过，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 王用檀香木为耶和华殿和王宫做栏杆，又为歌唱的人做琴瑟。以后再没有这样的檀香木进国来，也没有人看见过，直到如今。
