verses.textEnNiv: The king used the almugwood to make supports for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. So much almugwood has never been imported or seen since that day.)
verses.textEnEsv: And the king made of the almug wood supports for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, also lyres and harps for the singers. No such almug wood has come or been seen to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king made steps of the almug wood for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, also harps and stringed instruments for singers. There never again came such almug wood, nor has the like been seen to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: The king used the sandalwood to make railings for the Temple of the Lord and the royal palace, and to construct lyres and harps for the musicians. Never before or since has there been such a supply of sandalwood.)
verses.textEnNasb: The king made from the almug trees supports for the house of the Lord and for the king’s house, and lyres and harps for the singers; such almug trees have not come in again, nor have they been seen to this day.
verses.textEn: The king used the almugwood to make supports for the temple of the Lord and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. So much almugwood has never been imported or seen since that day.)

verses.textZh: 所罗门王照着示巴女王所愿所求的一切赐给她，另外又厚厚地馈赠她。于是女王和她的臣仆都返回本国去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王照着示巴女王所愿所求的一切赐给她，另外又厚厚地馈赠她。于是女王和她的臣仆都返回本国去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 示巴女王一切所要所求的，所罗门王都送给她，另外照自己的厚意馈送她。于是女王和她臣仆转回本国去了。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for, besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.
verses.textEnEsv: And King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all that she desired, whatever she asked besides what was given her by the bounty of King Solomon. So she turned and went back to her own land with her servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired, whatever she asked, besides what Solomon had given her according to the royal generosity. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba whatever she asked for, besides all the customary gifts he had so generously given. Then she and all her attendants returned to their own land.
verses.textEnNasb: And King Solomon granted the queen of Sheba everything she desired, whatever she requested, besides what he gave her in proportion to his royal bounty. Then she departed and went to her own land together with her servants.
verses.textEn: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for, besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.

verses.textZh: 所罗门每年收入的金子重两万三千公斤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门每年收入的金子重两万三千公斤。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门每年所得的金子共有六百六十六他连得。
verses.textEnNiv: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was 666 talents of gold,
verses.textEnNkjv: The weight of gold that came to Solomon yearly was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,
verses.textEnNlt: Each year Solomon received about 25 tons of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was 666 talents of gold,
verses.textEn: The weight of the gold that Solomon received yearly was 666 talents,

verses.textZh: 另外，还有从商人和行商的课税，阿拉伯诸王和国内省长的收入。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另外，还有从商人和行商的课税，阿拉伯诸王和国内省长的收入。
verses.textZhCuv: 另外还有商人和杂族 的诸王，与国中的省长所进的金子。
verses.textEnNiv: not including the revenues from merchants and traders and from all the Arabian kings and the governors of the territories.
verses.textEnEsv: besides that which came from the explorers and from the business of the merchants, and from all the kings of the west and from the governors of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: besides that from the traveling merchants, from the income of traders, from all the kings of Arabia, and from the governors of the country.
verses.textEnNlt: This did not include the additional revenue he received from merchants and traders, all the kings of Arabia, and the governors of the land.
verses.textEnNasb: besides that from the traders, and the wares of the merchants and all the kings of the Arabs and the governors of the country.
verses.textEn: not including the revenues from merchants and traders and from all the Arabian kings and the governors of the territories.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王用锤炼好的金子做了二百面大盾牌，每一面大盾牌用金子七公斤；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王用锤炼好的金子做了二百面大盾牌，每一面大盾牌用金子七公斤；
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王用锤出来的金子打成挡牌二百面，每面用金子六百舍客勒；
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.
verses.textEnEsv: King Solomon made 200 large shields of beaten gold; 600 shekels of gold went into each shield.
verses.textEnNkjv: And King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon made 200 large shields of hammered gold, each weighing more than fifteen pounds.
verses.textEnNasb: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold, using six hundred shekels of gold on each large shield.
verses.textEn: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred shekels of gold went into each shield.

verses.textZh: 又用锤炼好的金子做了三百面小盾牌，每一面小盾牌用金子两公斤。王把这些盾牌都放在黎巴嫩林宫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用锤炼好的金子做了三百面小盾牌，每一面小盾牌用金子两公斤。王把这些盾牌都放在黎巴嫩林宫。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用锤出来的金子打成盾牌三百面，每面用金子三弥那，都放在黎巴嫩林宫里。
verses.textEnNiv: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three minas of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made 300 shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went into each shield. And the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also made three hundred shields of hammered gold; three minas of gold went into each shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNlt: He also made 300 smaller shields of hammered gold, each weighing nearly four pounds. The king placed these shields in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made three hundred small shields of beaten gold, using three minas of gold on each shield; and the king put them in the house of the timber of Lebanon.
verses.textEn: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three minas of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.

verses.textZh: 王又做了一个象牙大宝座，贴上了精金。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王又做了一个象牙大宝座，贴上了精金。
verses.textZhCuv: 王用象牙制造一个宝座，用精金包裹。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with fine gold.
verses.textEnEsv: The king also made a great ivory throne and overlaid it with the finest gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king made a huge throne, decorated with ivory and overlaid with fine gold.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the king made a large throne of ivory and overlaid it with fine gold.
verses.textEn: Then the king made a great throne covered with ivory and overlaid with fine gold.

verses.textZh: 那宝座有六级台阶，宝座的后背有一个圆顶，座处的两旁有一个扶手。扶手的旁边各有一只狮子站立着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那宝座有六级台阶，宝座的后背有一个圆顶，座处的两旁有一个扶手。扶手的旁边各有一只狮子站立着。
verses.textZhCuv: 宝座有六层台阶，座的后背是圆的，两旁有扶手，靠近扶手有两个狮子站立。
verses.textEnNiv: The throne had six steps, and its back had a rounded top. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.
verses.textEnEsv: The throne had six steps, and the throne had a round top, and on each side of the seat were armrests and two lions standing beside the armrests,
verses.textEnNkjv: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round at the back; therewere armrests on either side of the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the armrests.
verses.textEnNlt: The throne had six steps and a rounded back. There were armrests on both sides of the seat, and the figure of a lion stood on each side of the throne.
verses.textEnNasb: There were six steps to the throne and a round top to the throne at its back, and armrests on each side of the seat, and two lions standing beside the armrests.
verses.textEn: The throne had six steps, and its back had a rounded top. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.

verses.textZh: 在六级台阶上共有十二只狮子站着，左边一只，右边一只。在列国中都没有这样做过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在六级台阶上共有十二只狮子站着，左边一只，右边一只。在列国中都没有这样做过。
verses.textZhCuv: 六层台阶上有十二个狮子站立，每层有两个：左边一个，右边一个；在列国中没有这样做的。
verses.textEnNiv: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: while twelve lions stood there, one on each end of a step on the six steps. The like of it was never made in any kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Twelve lions stood there, one on each side of the six steps; nothing like this had been made for any other kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: There were also twelve other lions, one standing on each end of the six steps. No other throne in all the world could be compared with it!
verses.textEnNasb: Twelve lions were standing there on the six steps on the one side and on the other; nothing like it was made for any other kingdom.
verses.textEn: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.

verses.textZh: 所罗门的一切饮器都是金子做的；黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿也都是精金做的，没有用银子做的；原来在所罗门王的时代，银子算不得甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的一切饮器都是金子做的；黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿也都是精金做的，没有用银子做的；原来在所罗门王的时代，银子算不得甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王一切的饮器都是金子的。黎巴嫩林宫里的一切器皿都是精金的。所罗门年间，银子算不了什么。
verses.textEnNiv: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s days.
verses.textEnEsv: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were of pure gold. None were of silver; silver was not considered as anything in the days of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: All King Solomon’s drinking vessels were gold, and all the vessels of the House of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Not onewas silver, for this was accounted as nothing in the days of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: All of King Solomon’s drinking cups were solid gold, as were all the utensils in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon. They were not made of silver, for silver was considered worthless in Solomon’s day!
verses.textEnNasb: Now all King Solomon’s drinking utensils were of gold, and all the utensils of the house of the timber of Lebanon were of pure gold. None was of silver; it was not considered as amounting to anything in the days of Solomon.
verses.textEn: All King Solomon’s goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon’s days.

verses.textZh: 因为王有他施船队与希兰船队一同在海上航行。他施船队三年一次运来金银、象牙、猿猴和孔雀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为王有他施船队与希兰船队一同在海上航行。他施船队三年一次运来金银、象牙、猿猴和孔雀。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为王有他施船只与希兰的船只一同航海，三年一次，装载金银、象牙、猿猴、孔雀回来。
verses.textEnNiv: The king had a fleet of trading ships at sea along with the ships of Hiram. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.
verses.textEnEsv: For the king had a fleet of ships of Tarshish at sea with the fleet of Hiram. Once every three years the fleet of ships of Tarshish used to come bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the king had merchant ships at sea with the fleet of Hiram. Once every three years the merchant ships came bringing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and monkeys.
verses.textEnNlt: The king had a fleet of trading ships of Tarshish that sailed with Hiram’s fleet. Once every three years the ships returned, loaded with gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
verses.textEnNasb: For the king had the ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s ships; once every three years the ships of Tarshish would come carrying gold and silver, ivory, monkeys, and peacocks.
verses.textEn: The king had a fleet of trading ships at sea along with the ships of Hiram. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王的财富和智慧，超过了世界上所有的君王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王的财富和智慧，超过了世界上所有的君王。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王的财宝与智慧胜过天下的列王。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus King Solomon excelled all the kings of the earth in riches and in wisdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: So King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
verses.textEnNlt: So King Solomon became richer and wiser than any other king on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: So King Solomon became greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and wisdom.
verses.textEn: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.

verses.textZh: 世上所有的人都要求晋见所罗门，聆听神赋予他心中的智慧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世上所有的人都要求晋见所罗门，聆听神赋予他心中的智慧。
verses.textZhCuv: 普天下的王都求见所罗门，要听神赐给他智慧的话。
verses.textEnNiv: The whole world sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.
verses.textEnEsv: And the whole earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put into his mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all the earth sought the presence of Solomon to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.textEnNlt: People from every nation came to consult him and to hear the wisdom God had given him.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the earth was seeking the attention of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
verses.textEn: The whole world sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.

verses.textZh: 他们各人都带着自己的贡物而来，就是银器、金器、衣裳、军械、香料、马和骡等，年年都是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人都带着自己的贡物而来，就是银器、金器、衣裳、军械、香料、马和骡等，年年都是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们各带贡物，就是金器、银器、衣服、军械、香料、骡马，每年有一定之例。
verses.textEnNiv: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.
verses.textEnEsv: Every one of them brought his present, articles of silver and gold, garments, myrrh, spices, horses, and mules, so much year by year.
verses.textEnNkjv: Each man brought his present: articles of silver and gold, garments, armor, spices, horses, and mules, at a set rate year by year.
verses.textEnNlt: Year after year everyone who visited brought him gifts of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.
verses.textEnNasb: And they were bringing, everyone, a gift: articles of silver and gold, garments, weapons, balsam oil, horses, and mules, so much year by year.
verses.textEn: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift—articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.

verses.textZh: 所罗门聚集战车和骑兵，他有战车一千四百辆，骑兵一万二千人，安置在屯车城和耶路撒冷，就是与王在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门聚集战车和骑兵，他有战车一千四百辆，骑兵一万二千人，安置在屯车城和耶路撒冷，就是与王在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门聚集战车马兵，有战车一千四百辆，马兵一万二千名，安置在屯车的城邑和耶路撒冷，就是王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon built up a huge force of chariots and horses. He had 1,400 chariots and 12,000 horses. He stationed some of them in the chariot cities and some near him in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; and he had 1,400 chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 王在耶路撒冷使银子好象石头一样，使香柏木好象平原的桑树那么多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王在耶路撒冷使银子好象石头一样，使香柏木好象平原的桑树那么多。
verses.textZhCuv: 王在耶路撒冷使银子多如石头，香柏木多如高原的桑树。
verses.textEnNiv: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stone, and he made cedar as plentiful as the sycamore of the Shephelah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king made silver ascommon in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedar trees as abundant as the sycamores which are in the lowland.
verses.textEnNlt: The king made silver as plentiful in Jerusalem as stone. And valuable cedar timber was as common as the sycamore-fig trees that grow in the foothills of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and he made cedars as plentiful as sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
verses.textEn: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

verses.textZh: 所罗门的马是从埃及和古厄运出来的，是王的商人从古厄按着定价买来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的马是从埃及和古厄运出来的，是王的商人从古厄按着定价买来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的马是从埃及带来的，是王的商人一群一群按着定价买来的。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue —the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon’s import of horses was from Egypt and Kue, and the king’s traders received them from Kue at a price.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Solomon had horses imported from Egypt and Keveh; the king’s merchants bought them in Keveh at the current price.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Cilicia ; the king’s traders acquired them from Cilicia at the standard price.
verses.textEnNasb: Also Solomon’s import of horses was from Egypt and Kue, and the king’s merchants acquired them from Kue for a price.
verses.textEn: Solomon’s horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue —the royal merchants purchased them from Kue at the current price.

verses.textZh: 从埃及运上来的车，每辆银子六千八百四十克，马每匹一千七百一十克。赫人众王和亚兰 诸王也都是这样经他们的手买来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从埃及运上来的车，每辆银子六千八百四十克，马每匹一千七百一十克。赫人众王和亚兰 诸王也都是这样经他们的手买来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从埃及买来的车，每辆价银六百舍客勒，马每匹一百五十舍客勒。赫人诸王和亚兰诸王所买的车马，也是按这价值经他们手买来的。
verses.textEnNiv: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.
verses.textEnEsv: A chariot could be imported from Egypt for 600 shekels of silver and a horse for 150, and so through the king’s traders they were exported to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a chariot that was imported from Egypt cost six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse one hundred and fifty; and thus, through their agents, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time chariots from Egypt could be purchased for 600 pieces of silver, and horses for 150 pieces of silver. They were then exported to the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
verses.textEnNasb: A chariot was imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for 150; and by the same means they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and to the kings of the Arameans.
verses.textEn: They imported a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty. They also exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and of the Arameans.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王除了法老的女儿以外，又宠爱许多外族女子，就是摩押女子、亚扪女子、以东女子、西顿女子和赫人女子等。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王除了法老的女儿以外，又宠爱许多外族女子，就是摩押女子、亚扪女子、以东女子、西顿女子和赫人女子等。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王在法老的女儿之外，又宠爱许多外邦女子，就是摩押女子、亚扪女子、以东女子、西顿女子、赫人女子。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women besides Pharaoh’s daughter—Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians and Hittites.
verses.textEnEsv: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women, along with the daughter of Pharaoh: Moabite, Ammonite, Edomite, Sidonian, and Hittite women,
verses.textEnNkjv: But King Solomon loved many foreign women, as well as the daughter of Pharaoh: women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites—
verses.textEnNlt: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women. Besides Pharaoh’s daughter, he married women from Moab, Ammon, Edom, Sidon, and from among the Hittites.
verses.textEnNasb: Now King Solomon loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh: Moabite, Ammonite, Edomite, Sidonian, and Hittite women,
verses.textEn: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women besides Pharaoh’s daughter—Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians and Hittites.

verses.textZh: 关于这些国家的人，耶和华曾经吩咐以色列人："你们不可与他们往来通婚，否则他们必会引诱你们的心，去随从他们的神。"但所罗门深深爱恋这些女子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于这些国家的人，耶和华曾经吩咐以色列人："你们不可与他们往来通婚，否则他们必会引诱你们的心，去随从他们的神。"但所罗门深深爱恋这些女子。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到这些国的人，耶和华曾晓谕以色列人说：「你们不可与她们往来相通，因为她们必诱惑你们的心去随从她们的神。」所罗门却恋爱这些女子。
verses.textEnNiv: They were from nations about which the Lord had told the Israelites, "You must not intermarry with them, because they will surely turn your hearts after their gods." Nevertheless, Solomon held fast to them in love.
verses.textEnEsv: from the nations concerning which the Lord had said to the people of Israel, "You shall not enter into marriage with them, neither shall they with you, for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods." Solomon clung to these in love.
verses.textEnNkjv: from the nations of whom the Lord had said to the children of Israel, "You shall not intermarry with them, nor they with you. Surely they will turn away your hearts after their gods." Solomon clung to these in love.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord had clearly instructed the people of Israel, "You must not marry them, because they will turn your hearts to their gods." Yet Solomon insisted on loving them anyway.
verses.textEnNasb: from the nations of which the Lord had said to the sons of Israel, "You shall not associate with them, nor shall they associate with you; they will certainly turn your heart away to follow their gods." Solomon clung to these in love.
verses.textEn: They were from nations about which the Lord had told the Israelites, "You must not intermarry with them, because they will surely turn your hearts after their gods." Nevertheless, Solomon held fast to them in love.

verses.textZh: 所罗门有妃七百，都是公主；有嫔三百。他的妃嫔使他的心偏离了神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门有妃七百，都是公主；有嫔三百。他的妃嫔使他的心偏离了神。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门有妃七百，都是公主；还有嫔三百。这些妃嫔诱惑他的心。
verses.textEnNiv: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines, and his wives led him astray.
verses.textEnEsv: He had 700 wives, who were princesses, and 300 concubines. And his wives turned away his heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines; and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.textEnNlt: He had 700 wives of royal birth and 300 concubines. And in fact, they did turn his heart away from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: He had seven hundred wives, who were princesses, and three hundred concubines; and his wives turned his heart away.
verses.textEn: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines, and his wives led him astray.

verses.textZh: 所罗门年老的时候，他的妃嫔诱惑他的心偏离了神去随从别的神。他的心不像他的父亲大卫那样完全归于耶和华他的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门年老的时候，他的妃嫔诱惑他的心偏离了神去随从别的神。他的心不像他的父亲大卫那样完全归于耶和华他的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门年老的时候，他的妃嫔诱惑他的心去随从别神，不效法他父亲大卫诚诚实实地顺服耶和华－他的神。
verses.textEnNiv: As Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods, and his heart was not fully devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father had been.
verses.textEnEsv: For when Solomon was old his wives turned away his heart after other gods, and his heart was not wholly true to the Lord his God, as was the heart of David his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it was so, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned his heart after other gods; and his heart was not loyal to the Lord his God, as was the heart of his father David.
verses.textEnNlt: In Solomon’s old age, they turned his heart to worship other gods instead of being completely faithful to the Lord his God, as his father, David, had been.
verses.textEnNasb: For when Solomon was old, his wives turned his heart away to follow other gods; and his heart was not wholly devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of his father David had been.
verses.textEn: As Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods, and his heart was not fully devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father had been.

verses.textZh: 因为所罗门随从西顿人的女神亚斯他录，和亚扪人可憎的偶像米勒公。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为所罗门随从西顿人的女神亚斯他录，和亚扪人可憎的偶像米勒公。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为所罗门随从西顿人的女神亚斯她录和亚扪人可憎的神米勒公。
verses.textEnNiv: He followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon worshiped Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Sidonians, and Molech, the detestable god of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: For Solomon became a follower of Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and of Milcom the abhorrent idol of the Ammonites.
verses.textEn: He followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 所罗门行耶和华看为恶的事，不效法他的父亲大卫完完全全跟从耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门行耶和华看为恶的事，不效法他的父亲大卫完完全全跟从耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不效法他父亲大卫专心顺从耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: So Solomon did evil in the eyes of the Lord ; he did not follow the Lord completely, as David his father had done.
verses.textEnEsv: So Solomon did what was evil in the sight of the Lord and did not wholly follow the Lord , as David his father had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon did evil in the sight of the Lord, and did not fully follow the Lord, as did his father David.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, Solomon did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight; he refused to follow the Lord completely, as his father, David, had done.
verses.textEnNasb: So Solomon did what was evil in the sight of the Lord, and did not follow the Lord fully, as his father David had done.
verses.textEn: So Solomon did evil in the eyes of the Lord ; he did not follow the Lord completely, as David his father had done.

verses.textZh: 那时，所罗门为摩押人可憎的偶像基抹和亚扪人可憎的偶像摩洛，在耶路撒冷东面的山上建造邱坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，所罗门为摩押人可憎的偶像基抹和亚扪人可憎的偶像摩洛，在耶路撒冷东面的山上建造邱坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门为摩押可憎的神基抹和亚扪人可憎的神摩洛，在耶路撒冷对面的山上建筑邱坛。
verses.textEnNiv: On a hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the detestable god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Molech the abomination of the Ammonites, on the mountain east of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, on the hill that is east of Jerusalem, and for Molech the abomination of the people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: On the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, he even built a pagan shrine for Chemosh, the detestable god of Moab, and another for Molech, the detestable god of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh, the abhorrent idol of Moab, on the mountain that is east of Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abhorrent idol of the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: On a hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the detestable god of Moab, and for Molek the detestable god of the Ammonites.

verses.textZh: 他为他娶自外族的妃嫔都这样作；她们都向自己的神烧香献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他为他娶自外族的妃嫔都这样作；她们都向自己的神烧香献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为那些向自己的神烧香献祭的外邦女子，就是他娶来的妃嫔也是这样行。
verses.textEnNiv: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and offered sacrifices to their gods.
verses.textEnEsv: And so he did for all his foreign wives, who made offerings and sacrificed to their gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did likewise for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon built such shrines for all his foreign wives to use for burning incense and sacrificing to their gods.
verses.textEnNasb: He also did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
verses.textEn: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and offered sacrifices to their gods.

verses.textZh: 耶和华向所罗门发怒，因为他的心偏离了曾经两次向他显现的耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华向所罗门发怒，因为他的心偏离了曾经两次向他显现的耶和华以色列的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向所罗门发怒，因为他的心偏离向他两次显现的耶和华－以色列的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord became angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the Lord , the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned away from the Lord , the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord became angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned from the Lord God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was very angry with Solomon, for his heart had turned away from the Lord , the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord was angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the Lord, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
verses.textEn: The Lord became angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the Lord , the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.

verses.textZh: 耶和华为了这事曾经吩咐他，不可随从别的神，可是他没有遵守耶和华吩咐的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华为了这事曾经吩咐他，不可随从别的神，可是他没有遵守耶和华吩咐的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华曾吩咐他不可随从别神，他却没有遵守耶和华所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: Although he had forbidden Solomon to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the Lord ’s command.
verses.textEnEsv: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods. But he did not keep what the Lord commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he did not keep what the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: He had warned Solomon specifically about worshiping other gods, but Solomon did not listen to the Lord ’s command.
verses.textEnNasb: and had commanded him regarding this thing, that he was not to follow other gods; but he did not comply with what the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEn: Although he had forbidden Solomon to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the Lord ’s command.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对所罗门说："你既然作了这事，不遵守我吩咐你的约和律例，我必夺去你的国，把国赐给你的一个臣子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对所罗门说："你既然作了这事，不遵守我吩咐你的约和律例，我必夺去你的国，把国赐给你的一个臣子。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华对他说：「你既行了这事，不遵守我所吩咐你守的约和律例，我必将你的国夺回，赐给你的臣子。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord said to Solomon, "Since this is your attitude and you have not kept my covenant and my decrees, which I commanded you, I will most certainly tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your subordinates.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord said to Solomon, "Since this has been your practice and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes that I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom from you and will give it to your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord said to Solomon, "Because you have done this, and have not kept My covenant and My statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: So now the Lord said to him, "Since you have not kept my covenant and have disobeyed my decrees, I will surely tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your servants.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord said to Solomon, "Since you have done this, and you have not kept My covenant and My statutes, which I have commanded you, I will certainly tear the kingdom away from you, and will give it to your servant.
verses.textEn: So the Lord said to Solomon, "Since this is your attitude and you have not kept my covenant and my decrees, which I commanded you, I will most certainly tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your subordinates.

verses.textZh: 然而，为了你父亲大卫的缘故，我不会在你有生之日作这事，我要从你儿子的手中把国夺去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，为了你父亲大卫的缘故，我不会在你有生之日作这事，我要从你儿子的手中把国夺去。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，因你父亲大卫的缘故，我不在你活着的日子行这事，必从你儿子的手中将国夺回。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, for the sake of David your father, I will not do it during your lifetime. I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet for the sake of David your father I will not do it in your days, but I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless I will not do it in your days, for the sake of your father David; I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
verses.textEnNlt: But for the sake of your father, David, I will not do this while you are still alive. I will take the kingdom away from your son.
verses.textEnNasb: However, I will not do it in your days, only for the sake of your father David; but I will tear it away from the hand of your son.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, for the sake of David your father, I will not do it during your lifetime. I will tear it out of the hand of your son.

verses.textZh: 只是我不把整个国家夺去，为了我的仆人大卫的缘故，又为了我所拣选的耶路撒冷的缘故，我要给你的儿子留下一个支派。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是我不把整个国家夺去，为了我的仆人大卫的缘故，又为了我所拣选的耶路撒冷的缘故，我要给你的儿子留下一个支派。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是我不将全国夺回，要因我仆人大卫和我所选择的耶路撒冷，还留一支派给你的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom from him, but will give him one tribe for the sake of David my servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen."
verses.textEnEsv: However, I will not tear away all the kingdom, but I will give one tribe to your son, for the sake of David my servant and for the sake of Jerusalem that I have chosen."
verses.textEnNkjv: However I will not tear away the whole kingdom; I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David, and for the sake of Jerusalem which I have chosen."
verses.textEnNlt: And even so, I will not take away the entire kingdom; I will let him be king of one tribe, for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, my chosen city."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet I will not tear away all the kingdom, but I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David, and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen."
verses.textEn: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom from him, but will give him one tribe for the sake of David my servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen."

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华兴起一个人敌挡所罗门，他是以东王的后裔以东人哈达。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华兴起一个人敌挡所罗门，他是以东王的后裔以东人哈达。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华使以东人哈达兴起，作所罗门的敌人；他是以东王的后裔。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite. He was of the royal house in Edom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite; he was a descendant of the king in Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord raised up Hadad the Edomite, a member of Edom’s royal family, to be Solomon’s adversary.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite; he was of the royal line in Edom.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.

verses.textZh: 从前大卫击败以东，元帅约押上去埋葬阵亡的人的时候，就把以东所有的男人都杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前大卫击败以东，元帅约押上去埋葬阵亡的人的时候，就把以东所有的男人都杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 先前大卫攻击以东，元帅约押上去葬埋阵亡的人，将以东的男丁都杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: Earlier when David was fighting with Edom, Joab the commander of the army, who had gone up to bury the dead, had struck down all the men in Edom.
verses.textEnEsv: For when David was in Edom, and Joab the commander of the army went up to bury the slain, he struck down every male in Edom
verses.textEnNkjv: For it happened, when David was in Edom, and Joab the commander of the army had gone up to bury the slain, after he had killed every male in Edom
verses.textEnNlt: Years before, David had defeated Edom. Joab, his army commander, had stayed to bury some of the Israelite soldiers who had died in battle. While there, they killed every male in Edom.
verses.textEnNasb: For it came about, when David was in Edom and Joab the commander of the army had gone up to bury those killed in battle, and had struck and killed every male in Edom
verses.textEn: Earlier when David was fighting with Edom, Joab the commander of the army, who had gone up to bury the dead, had struck down all the men in Edom.

verses.textZh: 约押和以色列人在那里住了六个月，直到把以东所有的男人都除灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约押和以色列人在那里住了六个月，直到把以东所有的男人都除灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约押和以色列众人在以东住了六个月，直到将以东的男丁尽都剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Joab and all the Israelites stayed there for six months, until they had destroyed all the men in Edom.
verses.textEnEsv: (for Joab and all Israel remained there six months, until he had cut off every male in Edom).
verses.textEnNkjv: (because for six months Joab remained there with all Israel, until he had cut down every male in Edom),
verses.textEnNlt: Joab and the army of Israel had stayed there for six months, killing them.
verses.textEnNasb: (for Joab and all Israel stayed there for six months, until he had eliminated every male in Edom),
verses.textEn: Joab and all the Israelites stayed there for six months, until they had destroyed all the men in Edom.

verses.textZh: 哈达与他父亲的几个以东臣仆一起逃往埃及，那时哈达还是一个小孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈达与他父亲的几个以东臣仆一起逃往埃及，那时哈达还是一个小孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时哈达还是幼童；他和他父亲的臣仆，几个以东人逃往埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: But Hadad, still only a boy, fled to Egypt with some Edomite officials who had served his father.
verses.textEnEsv: But Hadad fled to Egypt, together with certain Edomites of his father’s servants, Hadad still being a little child.
verses.textEnNkjv: that Hadad fled to go to Egypt, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him. Hadad was still a little child.
verses.textEnNlt: But Hadad and a few of his father’s royal officials escaped and headed for Egypt. (Hadad was just a boy at the time.)
verses.textEnNasb: that Hadad fled to Egypt, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, while Hadad was a young boy.
verses.textEn: But Hadad, still only a boy, fled to Egypt with some Edomite officials who had served his father.

verses.textZh: 他们从米甸动身，来到巴兰，又从巴兰带了几个人来到埃及，见埃及王法老。法老吩咐人给他一所房子，供应他粮食，又赐他一块田地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从米甸动身，来到巴兰，又从巴兰带了几个人来到埃及，见埃及王法老。法老吩咐人给他一所房子，供应他粮食，又赐他一块田地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从米甸起行，到了巴兰；从巴兰带着几个人来到埃及见埃及王法老；法老为他派定粮食，又给他房屋田地。
verses.textEnNiv: They set out from Midian and went to Paran. Then taking people from Paran with them, they went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.
verses.textEnEsv: They set out from Midian and came to Paran and took men with them from Paran and came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house and assigned him an allowance of food and gave him land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they arose from Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them from Paran and came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house, apportioned food for him, and gave him land.
verses.textEnNlt: They set out from Midian and went to Paran, where others joined them. Then they traveled to Egypt and went to Pharaoh, who gave them a home, food, and some land.
verses.textEnNasb: They set out from Midian and came to Paran; and they took men with them from Paran and came to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave him a house and assigned him food and gave him land.
verses.textEn: They set out from Midian and went to Paran. Then taking people from Paran with them, they went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.

verses.textZh: 哈达在法老面前十分蒙恩，以致法老把自己妻子的妹妹，就是王后答比匿的妹妹，赐给他作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈达在法老面前十分蒙恩，以致法老把自己妻子的妹妹，就是王后答比匿的妹妹，赐给他作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈达在法老面前大蒙恩惠，以致法老将王后答比匿的妹子赐他为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh was so pleased with Hadad that he gave him a sister of his own wife, Queen Tahpenes, in marriage.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him in marriage the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, that is, the sister of Queen Tahpenes.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh grew very fond of Hadad, and he gave him his wife’s sister in marriage—the sister of Queen Tahpenes.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him in marriage the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh was so pleased with Hadad that he gave him a sister of his own wife, Queen Tahpenes, in marriage.

verses.textZh: 答比匿的妹妹给他生了一个儿子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使他在法老的宫中长大，基努拔就与法老的众子一起住在法老的宫中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 答比匿的妹妹给他生了一个儿子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使他在法老的宫中长大，基努拔就与法老的众子一起住在法老的宫中。
verses.textZhCuv: 答比匿的妹子给哈达生了一个儿子，名叫基努拔。答比匿使基努拔在法老的宫里断奶，基努拔就与法老的众子一同住在法老的宫里。
verses.textEnNiv: The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son named Genubath, whom Tahpenes brought up in the royal palace. There Genubath lived with Pharaoh’s own children.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house. And Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house. And Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: She bore him a son named Genubath. Tahpenes raised him in Pharaoh’s palace among Pharaoh’s own sons.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sister of Tahpenes gave birth to his son Genubath, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son named Genubath, whom Tahpenes brought up in the royal palace. There Genubath lived with Pharaoh’s own children.

verses.textZh: 后来哈达在埃及听说大卫已经与他的列祖同睡，元帅约押也死了，哈达就对法老说："求你容我离去，我好回到本国去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来哈达在埃及听说大卫已经与他的列祖同睡，元帅约押也死了，哈达就对法老说："求你容我离去，我好回到本国去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 哈达在埃及听见大卫与他列祖同睡，元帅约押也死了，就对法老说：「求王容我回本国去。」
verses.textEnNiv: While he was in Egypt, Hadad heard that David rested with his ancestors and that Joab the commander of the army was also dead. Then Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me go, that I may return to my own country."
verses.textEnEsv: But when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers and that Joab the commander of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me depart, that I may go to my own country."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when Hadad heard in Egypt that David rested with his fathers, and that Joab the commander of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me depart, that I may go to my own country."
verses.textEnNlt: When the news reached Hadad in Egypt that David and his commander Joab were both dead, he said to Pharaoh, "Let me return to my own country."
verses.textEnNasb: But when Hadad heard in Egypt that David lay down with his fathers and that Joab the commander of the army was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me go, so that I may go to my own country."
verses.textEn: While he was in Egypt, Hadad heard that David rested with his ancestors and that Joab the commander of the army was also dead. Then Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me go, that I may return to my own country."

verses.textZh: 法老问他："你在我这里有甚么欠缺，竟要回到你本国去呢？"他回答："没有甚么欠缺，只求你无论如何让我离开。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老问他："你在我这里有甚么欠缺，竟要回到你本国去呢？"他回答："没有甚么欠缺，只求你无论如何让我离开。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对他说：「你在我这里有什么缺乏，你竟要回你本国去呢？」他回答说：「我没有缺乏什么，只是求王容我回去。」
verses.textEnNiv: "What have you lacked here that you want to go back to your own country?" Pharaoh asked. "Nothing," Hadad replied, "but do let me go!"
verses.textEnEsv: But Pharaoh said to him, "What have you lacked with me that you are now seeking to go to your own country?" And he said to him, "Only let me depart."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh said to him, "But what have you lacked with me, that suddenly you seek to go to your own country?" So he answered, "Nothing, but do let me go anyway."
verses.textEnNlt: "Why?" Pharaoh asked him. "What do you lack here that makes you want to go home?" "Nothing," he replied. "But even so, please let me return home."
verses.textEnNasb: However, Pharaoh said to him, "But what have you lacked with me that you are here, requesting to go to your own country?" And he answered, "Nothing; nevertheless you must let me go."
verses.textEn: "What have you lacked here that you want to go back to your own country?" Pharaoh asked. "Nothing," Hadad replied, "but do let me go!"

verses.textZh: 神又兴起一个人敌挡所罗门，就是以利亚大的儿子利逊。他是从他主人琐巴王哈大底谢那里逃出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神又兴起一个人敌挡所罗门，就是以利亚大的儿子利逊。他是从他主人琐巴王哈大底谢那里逃出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 神又使以利亚大的儿子利逊兴起，作所罗门的敌人。他先前逃避主人琐巴王哈大底谢。
verses.textEnNiv: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
verses.textEnEsv: God also raised up as an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master Hadadezer king of Zobah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God raised up another adversary against him, Rezon the son of Eliadah, who had fled from his lord, Hadadezer king of Zobah.
verses.textEnNlt: God also raised up Rezon son of Eliada as Solomon’s adversary. Rezon had fled from his master, King Hadadezer of Zobah,
verses.textEnNasb: God also raised up another adversary against him, Rezon the son of Eliada, who had fled from his master Hadadezer, king of Zobah.
verses.textEn: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

verses.textZh: 大卫击杀琐巴人的时候，利逊招聚了一些人，自己作了这些土匪的领袖。他前往大马士革，住在那里，又在大马士革作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫击杀琐巴人的时候，利逊招聚了一些人，自己作了这些土匪的领袖。他前往大马士革，住在那里，又在大马士革作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫击杀琐巴人的时候，利逊招聚了一群人，自己作他们的头目，往大马士革居住，在那里作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When David destroyed Zobah’s army, Rezon gathered a band of men around him and became their leader; they went to Damascus, where they settled and took control.
verses.textEnEsv: And he gathered men about him and became leader of a marauding band, after the killing by David. And they went to Damascus and lived there and made him king in Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he gathered men to him and became captain over a band ofraiders, when David killed those ofZobah. And they went to Damascus and dwelt there, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: and had become the leader of a gang of rebels. After David conquered Hadadezer, Rezon and his men fled to Damascus, where he became king.
verses.textEnNasb: And he gathered men to himself and became leader of a marauding band, after David killed those of Zobah; and they went to Damascus and stayed there, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.textEn: When David destroyed Zobah’s army, Rezon gathered a band of men around him and became their leader; they went to Damascus, where they settled and took control.

verses.textZh: 在所罗门一生的日子，利逊都敌挡以色列人。他恨恶以色列人，并且作了亚兰人的王。另外，哈达也不断为患。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在所罗门一生的日子，利逊都敌挡以色列人。他恨恶以色列人，并且作了亚兰人的王。另外，哈达也不断为患。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门活着的时候，哈达为患之外，利逊也作以色列的敌人。他恨恶以色列人，且作了亚兰人的王。
verses.textEnNiv: Rezon was Israel’s adversary as long as Solomon lived, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. So Rezon ruled in Aram and was hostile toward Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: He was an adversary of Israel all the days of Solomon, doing harm as Hadad did. And he loathed Israel and reigned over Syria.
verses.textEnNkjv: He was an adversary of Israel all the days of Solomon (besides the trouble that Hadad caused); and he abhorred Israel, and reigned over Syria.
verses.textEnNlt: Rezon was Israel’s bitter adversary for the rest of Solomon’s reign, and he made trouble, just as Hadad did. Rezon hated Israel intensely and continued to reign in Aram.
verses.textEnNasb: So he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon, along with the harm that Hadad inflicted; and he felt disgust for Israel and reigned over Aram.
verses.textEn: Rezon was Israel’s adversary as long as Solomon lived, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. So Rezon ruled in Aram and was hostile toward Israel.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王的臣仆，尼八的儿子耶罗波安也举手攻击王。他是洗利达的以法莲人，他母亲是个寡妇，名叫洗鲁雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王的臣仆，尼八的儿子耶罗波安也举手攻击王。他是洗利达的以法莲人，他母亲是个寡妇，名叫洗鲁雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的臣仆、尼八的儿子耶罗波安也举手攻击王。他是以法莲支派的洗利达人，他母亲是寡妇，名叫洗鲁阿。
verses.textEnNiv: Also, Jeroboam son of Nebat rebelled against the king. He was one of Solomon’s officials, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, and his mother was a widow named Zeruah.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon’s servant, Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite from Zereda, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also rebelled against the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Another rebel leader was Jeroboam son of Nebat, one of Solomon’s own officials. He came from the town of Zeredah in Ephraim, and his mother was Zeruah, a widow.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow, also rebelled against the king.
verses.textEn: Also, Jeroboam son of Nebat rebelled against the king. He was one of Solomon’s officials, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, and his mother was a widow named Zeruah.

verses.textZh: 他举手攻击王的情形是这样的：所罗门重建米罗，修补他父亲大卫城的破口；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他举手攻击王的情形是这样的：所罗门重建米罗，修补他父亲大卫城的破口；
verses.textZhCuv: 他举手攻击王的缘故，乃由先前所罗门建造米罗，修补他父亲大卫城的破口。
verses.textEnNiv: Here is the account of how he rebelled against the king: Solomon had built the terraces and had filled in the gap in the wall of the city of David his father.
verses.textEnEsv: And this was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king. Solomon built the Millo, and closed up the breach of the city of David his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is what caused him to rebel against the king: Solomon had built the Millo and repaired the damages to the City of David his father.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the story behind his rebellion. Solomon was rebuilding the supporting terraces and repairing the walls of the city of his father, David.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this was the reason why he rebelled against the king: Solomon built the Millo, and closed up the breach of the city of his father David.
verses.textEn: Here is the account of how he rebelled against the king: Solomon had built the terraces and had filled in the gap in the wall of the city of David his father.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安这个人原是个有才干的人。所罗门见这个年轻人作事殷勤，就派他管理约瑟家的所有奴工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安这个人原是个有才干的人。所罗门见这个年轻人作事殷勤，就派他管理约瑟家的所有奴工。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安是大有才能的人。所罗门见这少年人殷勤，就派他监管约瑟家的一切工程。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jeroboam was a man of standing, and when Solomon saw how well the young man did his work, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the tribes of Joseph.
verses.textEnEsv: The man Jeroboam was very able, and when Solomon saw that the young man was industrious he gave him charge over all the forced labor of the house of Joseph.
verses.textEnNkjv: The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon, seeing that the young man was industrious, made him the officer over all the labor force of the house of Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeroboam was a very capable young man, and when Solomon saw how industrious he was, he put him in charge of the labor force from the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh, the descendants of Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the man Jeroboam was a valiant warrior, and when Solomon saw that the young man was industrious, he appointed him over all the forced labor of the house of Joseph.
verses.textEn: Now Jeroboam was a man of standing, and when Solomon saw how well the young man did his work, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the tribes of Joseph.

verses.textZh: 有一次，耶罗波安从耶路撒冷出来，示罗人亚希雅先知在路上遇见他。亚希雅身上穿著一件新衣，那时田野里只有他们二人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，耶罗波安从耶路撒冷出来，示罗人亚希雅先知在路上遇见他。亚希雅身上穿著一件新衣，那时田野里只有他们二人。
verses.textZhCuv: 一日，耶罗波安出了耶路撒冷，示罗人先知亚希雅在路上遇见他；亚希雅身上穿着一件新衣。他们二人在田野，以外并无别人。
verses.textEnNiv: About that time Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, and Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh met him on the way, wearing a new cloak. The two of them were alone out in the country,
verses.textEnEsv: And at that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the road. Now Ahijah had dressed himself in a new garment, and the two of them were alone in the open country.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened at that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite met him on the way; and he had clothed himself with a new garment, and the two were alone in the field.
verses.textEnNlt: One day as Jeroboam was leaving Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh met him along the way. Ahijah was wearing a new cloak. The two of them were alone in a field,
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about at that time, when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the road. Now Ahijah had clothed himself with a new cloak; and both of them were alone in the field.
verses.textEn: About that time Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, and Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh met him on the way, wearing a new cloak. The two of them were alone out in the country,

verses.textZh: 亚希雅拿着自己身上所穿的新衣，把它撕成十二片，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚希雅拿着自己身上所穿的新衣，把它撕成十二片，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚希雅将自己穿的那件新衣撕成十二片，
verses.textEnNiv: and Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ahijah laid hold of the new garment that was on him, and tore it into twelve pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ahijah took hold of the new garment that was on him, and tore it into twelve pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: and Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ahijah took hold of the new cloak which was on him and tore it into twelve pieces.
verses.textEn: and Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.

verses.textZh: 对耶罗波安说："你拿十片去吧！因为耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪，我必从所罗门的手里把国夺去，把十个支派赐给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对耶罗波安说："你拿十片去吧！因为耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘看哪，我必从所罗门的手里把国夺去，把十个支派赐给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 对耶罗波安说：「你可以拿十片。耶和华－以色列的神如此说：『我必将国从所罗门手里夺回，将十个支派赐给你。（
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said to Jeroboam, "Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘See, I am going to tear the kingdom out of Solomon’s hand and give you ten tribes.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to Jeroboam, "Take for yourself ten pieces, for thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, ‘Behold, I am about to tear the kingdom from the hand of Solomon and will give you ten tribes
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to Jeroboam, "Take for yourself ten pieces, for thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon and will give ten tribes to you
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to Jeroboam, "Take ten of these pieces, for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I am about to tear the kingdom from the hand of Solomon, and I will give ten of the tribes to you!
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to Jeroboam, "Take for yourself ten pieces; for this is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘Behold, I am going to tear the kingdom away from the hand of Solomon and give you ten tribes
verses.textEn: Then he said to Jeroboam, "Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘See, I am going to tear the kingdom out of Solomon’s hand and give you ten tribes.

verses.textZh: 但是为了我的仆人大卫和为了我从以色列众支派中所拣选的耶路撒冷的缘故，所罗门仍然可以拥有一个支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是为了我的仆人大卫和为了我从以色列众支派中所拣选的耶路撒冷的缘故，所罗门仍然可以拥有一个支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因仆人大卫和我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷城的缘故，仍给所罗门留一个支派。）
verses.textEnNiv: But for the sake of my servant David and the city of Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, he will have one tribe.
verses.textEnEsv: (but he shall have one tribe, for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city that I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),
verses.textEnNkjv: (but he shall have one tribe for the sake of My servant David, and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel),
verses.textEnNlt: But I will leave him one tribe for the sake of my servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: (but he shall have one tribe, for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel),
verses.textEn: But for the sake of my servant David and the city of Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, he will have one tribe.

verses.textZh: 因为他们离弃了我，去敬拜西顿人的女神亚斯他录、摩押人的神基抹和亚扪人的神米勒公，没有遵行我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，谨守我的律例典章，像他的父亲大卫一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们离弃了我，去敬拜西顿人的女神亚斯他录、摩押人的神基抹和亚扪人的神米勒公，没有遵行我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，谨守我的律例典章，像他的父亲大卫一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他离弃我，敬拜西顿人的女神亚斯她录、摩押的神基抹，和亚扪人的神米勒公，没有遵从我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，守我的律例典章，像他父亲大卫一样。
verses.textEnNiv: I will do this because they have forsaken me and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Molek the god of the Ammonites, and have not walked in obedience to me, nor done what is right in my eyes, nor kept my decrees and laws as David, Solomon’s father, did.
verses.textEnEsv: because they have forsaken me and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the Ammonites, and they have not walked in my ways, doing what is right in my sight and keeping my statutes and my rules, as David his father did.
verses.textEnNkjv: because they have forsaken Me, and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the people of Ammon, and have not walked in My ways to do whatis right in My eyes and keep My statutes and My judgments, as did his father David.
verses.textEnNlt: For Solomon has abandoned me and worshiped Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Sidonians; Chemosh, the god of Moab; and Molech, the god of the Ammonites. He has not followed my ways and done what is pleasing in my sight. He has not obeyed my decrees and regulations as David his father did.
verses.textEnNasb: because they have abandoned Me, and have worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of the sons of Ammon; and they have not walked in My ways, doing what is right in My sight and keeping My statutes and My ordinances, as his father David did.
verses.textEn: I will do this because they have forsaken me and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Molek the god of the Ammonites, and have not walked in obedience to me, nor done what is right in my eyes, nor kept my decrees and laws as David, Solomon’s father, did.

verses.textZh: 但是，我不会把整个国家从他的手里夺去，我必使他终身作人君，是因我所拣选的仆人大卫谨守了我的诫命律例的缘故。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，我不会把整个国家从他的手里夺去，我必使他终身作人君，是因我所拣选的仆人大卫谨守了我的诫命律例的缘故。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我不从他手里将全国夺回；使他终身为君，是因我所拣选的仆人大卫谨守我的诫命律例。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand; I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David my servant, whom I chose and who obeyed my commands and decrees.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him ruler all the days of his life, for the sake of David my servant whom I chose, who kept my commandments and my statutes.
verses.textEnNkjv: However I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, because I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of My servant David, whom I chose because he kept My commandments and My statutes.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘But I will not take the entire kingdom from Solomon at this time. For the sake of my servant David, the one whom I chose and who obeyed my commands and decrees, I will keep Solomon as leader for the rest of his life.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand, but I will make him ruler all the days of his life, for the sake of My servant David whom I chose, who kept My commandments and My statutes;
verses.textEn: " ‘But I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand; I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David my servant, whom I chose and who obeyed my commands and decrees.

verses.textZh: 我要从他儿子的手中把国夺去，赐给你十个支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要从他儿子的手中把国夺去，赐给你十个支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从他儿子的手里将国夺回，以十个支派赐给你，
verses.textEnNiv: I will take the kingdom from his son’s hands and give you ten tribes.
verses.textEnEsv: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and will give it to you, ten tribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand and give it to you—ten tribes.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will take the kingdom away from his son and give ten of the tribes to you.
verses.textEnNasb: but I will take the kingdom from his son’s hand and give it to you; that is, ten tribes.
verses.textEn: I will take the kingdom from his son’s hands and give you ten tribes.

verses.textZh: 至于所罗门的儿子，我要给他一个支派，好使我的仆人大卫在我所拣选立我名的城耶路撒冷，在我面前常常有灯光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于所罗门的儿子，我要给他一个支派，好使我的仆人大卫在我所拣选立我名的城耶路撒冷，在我面前常常有灯光。
verses.textZhCuv: 还留一个支派给他的儿子，使我仆人大卫在我所选择立我名的耶路撒冷城里，在我面前长有灯光。
verses.textEnNiv: I will give one tribe to his son so that David my servant may always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put my Name.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet to his son I will give one tribe, that David my servant may always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city where I have chosen to put my name.
verses.textEnNkjv: And to his son I will give one tribe, that My servant David may always have a lamp before Me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen for Myself, to put My name there.
verses.textEnNlt: His son will have one tribe so that the descendants of David my servant will continue to reign, shining like a lamp in Jerusalem, the city I have chosen to be the place for my name.
verses.textEnNasb: But to his son I will give one tribe, so that My servant David may always have a lamp before Me in Jerusalem, the city where I have chosen for Myself to put My name.
verses.textEn: I will give one tribe to his son so that David my servant may always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put my Name.

verses.textZh: 我要拣选你，使你可以照心里想望的去统治。你必作以色列的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要拣选你，使你可以照心里想望的去统治。你必作以色列的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必拣选你，使你照心里一切所愿的，作王治理以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: However, as for you, I will take you, and you will rule over all that your heart desires; you will be king over Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will take you, and you shall reign over all that your soul desires, and you shall be king over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So I will take you, and you shall reign over all your heart desires, and you shall be king over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will place you on the throne of Israel, and you will rule over all that your heart desires.
verses.textEnNasb: However I will take you, and you shall reign over all that you desire, and you shall be king over Israel.
verses.textEn: However, as for you, I will take you, and you will rule over all that your heart desires; you will be king over Israel.

verses.textZh: 你若是听从我吩咐你的一切，遵行我的道，行我看为正的事，谨守我的律例诫命，像我的仆人大卫所行的一样，我就与你同在，为你建立一个巩固的朝代，像我为大卫建立的一样，并且我要把以色列赐给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若是听从我吩咐你的一切，遵行我的道，行我看为正的事，谨守我的律例诫命，像我的仆人大卫所行的一样，我就与你同在，为你建立一个巩固的朝代，像我为大卫建立的一样，并且我要把以色列赐给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若听从我一切所吩咐你的，遵行我的道，行我眼中看为正的事，谨守我的律例诫命，像我仆人大卫所行的，我就与你同在，为你立坚固的家，像我为大卫所立的一样，将以色列人赐给你。
verses.textEnNiv: If you do whatever I command you and walk in obedience to me and do what is right in my eyes by obeying my decrees and commands, as David my servant did, I will be with you. I will build you a dynasty as enduring as the one I built for David and will give Israel to you.
verses.textEnEsv: And if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do what is right in my eyes by keeping my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did, I will be with you and will build you a sure house, as I built for David, and I will give Israel to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it shall be, if you heed all that I command you, walk in My ways, and do whatis right in My sight, to keep My statutes and My commandments, as My servant David did, then I will be with you and build for you an enduring house, as I built for David, and will give Israel to you.
verses.textEnNlt: If you listen to what I tell you and follow my ways and do whatever I consider to be right, and if you obey my decrees and commands, as my servant David did, then I will always be with you. I will establish an enduring dynasty for you as I did for David, and I will give Israel to you.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it shall be, that if you listen to all that I command you and walk in My ways, and do what is right in My sight by keeping My statutes and My commandments, as My servant David did, then I will be with you and build you an enduring house as I built for David, and I will give Israel to you.
verses.textEn: If you do whatever I command you and walk in obedience to me and do what is right in my eyes by obeying my decrees and commands, as David my servant did, I will be with you. I will build you a dynasty as enduring as the one I built for David and will give Israel to you.

verses.textZh: 因此，我要使大卫的后裔遭受苦难，不过，却不是永远的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我要使大卫的后裔遭受苦难，不过，却不是永远的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必因所罗门所行的使大卫后裔受患难，但不至于永远。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I will humble David’s descendants because of this, but not forever.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And I will afflict the offspring of David because of this, but not forever.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will afflict the descendants of David because of this, but not forever.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Because of Solomon’s sin I will punish the descendants of David—though not forever.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So I will oppress the descendants of David for this, but not always.’ "
verses.textEn: I will humble David’s descendants because of this, but not forever.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是所罗门想要杀死耶罗波安，耶罗波安却逃往埃及去，到了埃及王示撒那里，就留在埃及，直等到所罗门死了为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是所罗门想要杀死耶罗波安，耶罗波安却逃往埃及去，到了埃及王示撒那里，就留在埃及，直等到所罗门死了为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门因此想要杀耶罗波安。耶罗波安却起身逃往埃及；到了埃及王示撒那里，就住在埃及，直到所罗门死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam fled to Egypt, to Shishak the king, and stayed there until Solomon’s death.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. But Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon therefore sought to kill Jeroboam. But Jeroboam arose and fled to Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but he fled to King Shishak of Egypt and stayed there until Solomon died.
verses.textEnNasb: Solomon sought therefore to put Jeroboam to death; but Jeroboam set out and fled to Egypt to Shishak king of Egypt, and he was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.textEn: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam fled to Egypt, to Shishak the king, and stayed there until Solomon’s death.

verses.textZh: 所罗门其余的事：他所行的和他的智慧，不是都写在《所罗门记》上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门其余的事：他所行的和他的智慧，不是都写在《所罗门记》上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门其余的事，凡他所行的和他的智慧都写在所罗门记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign—all he did and the wisdom he displayed—are they not written in the book of the annals of Solomon?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Solomon’s reign, including all his deeds and his wisdom, are recorded in The Book of the Acts of Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon and whatever he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the Book of the Acts of Solomon?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Solomon’s reign—all he did and the wisdom he displayed—are they not written in the book of the annals of Solomon?

verses.textZh: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门在耶路撒冷作以色列众人的王共四十年。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
verses.textEnEsv: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the period that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon ruled in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.
verses.textEnNasb: So the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
verses.textEn: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

verses.textZh: 所罗门与他的列祖同睡，埋葬在他父亲大卫的城里。他的儿子罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门与他的列祖同睡，埋葬在他父亲大卫的城里。他的儿子罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门与他列祖同睡，葬在他父亲大卫的城里。他儿子罗波安接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Solomon slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Solomon rested with his fathers, and was buried in the City of David his father. And Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When he died, he was buried in the City of David, named for his father. Then his son Rehoboam became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Solomon lay down with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David, and his son Rehoboam reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: Then he rested with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 罗波安往示剑去，因为以色列众人都到了示剑，要立他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安往示剑去，因为以色列众人都到了示剑，要立他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安往示剑去；因为以色列人都到了示剑要立他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.
verses.textEnEsv: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone to Shechem to make him king.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam went to Shechem, where all Israel had gathered to make him king.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rehoboam went to Shechem, because all Israel had come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all Israel had gone there to make him king.

verses.textZh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安那时因逃避所罗门的面，仍然住在埃及，他听见了这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安那时因逃避所罗门的面，仍然住在埃及，他听见了这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安先前躲避所罗门王，逃往埃及，住在那里（他听见这事。）
verses.textEnNiv: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard of it (for he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), then Jeroboam returned from Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it happened, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard it (he was still in Egypt, for he had fled from the presence of King Solomon and had been dwelling in Egypt ),
verses.textEnNlt: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard of this, he returned from Egypt, for he had fled to Egypt to escape from King Solomon.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Jeroboam the son of Nebat heard about this, he was living in Egypt (for he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon).
verses.textEn: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 以色列人就派遣人去请他来，于是耶罗波安和以色列全体会众都来见罗波安，告诉他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人就派遣人去请他来，于是耶罗波安和以色列全体会众都来见罗波安，告诉他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人打发人去请他来，他就和以色列会众都来见罗波安，对他说：
verses.textEnNiv: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and the whole assembly of Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:
verses.textEnEsv: And they sent and called him, and Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came and said to Rehoboam,
verses.textEnNkjv: that they sent and called him. Then Jeroboam and the whole assembly of Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The leaders of Israel summoned him, and Jeroboam and the whole assembly of Israel went to speak with Rehoboam.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they sent word and summoned him, and Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.textEn: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and the whole assembly of Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:

verses.textZh: "你父亲加给我们的重担，现在求你减轻你父亲使我们作的苦工和加在我们背上的重担，我们就服事你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你父亲加给我们的重担，现在求你减轻你父亲使我们作的苦工和加在我们背上的重担，我们就服事你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你父亲使我们负重轭，做苦工，现在求你使我们做的苦工、负的重轭轻松些，我们就事奉你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."
verses.textEnEsv: "Your father made our yoke heavy. Now therefore lighten the hard service of your father and his heavy yoke on us, and we will serve you."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Your father made our yoke heavy; now therefore, lighten the burdensome service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Your father was a hard master," they said. "Lighten the harsh labor demands and heavy taxes that your father imposed on us. Then we will be your loyal subjects."
verses.textEnNasb: "Your father made our yoke hard; but now, lighten the hard labor imposed by your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us, and we will serve you."
verses.textEn: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."

verses.textZh: 罗波安回答他们："你们暂时回去，三天以后再来见我。"众民就离开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安回答他们："你们暂时回去，三天以后再来见我。"众民就离开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安对他们说：「你们暂且去，第三日再来见我。」民就去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam answered, "Go away for three days and then come back to me." So the people went away.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Go away for three days, then come again to me." So the people went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to them, "Depart for three days, then come back to me." And the people departed.
verses.textEnNlt: Rehoboam replied, "Give me three days to think this over. Then come back for my answer." So the people went away.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to them, "Depart for three days, then return to me." So the people departed.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam answered, "Go away for three days and then come back to me." So the people went away.

verses.textZh: 罗波安王请教他父亲所罗门在世的时候，侍立在他面前的长老说："你们给我出个主意，我应该怎样回答这民呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王请教他父亲所罗门在世的时候，侍立在他面前的长老说："你们给我出个主意，我应该怎样回答这民呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安之父所罗门在世的日子，有侍立在他面前的老年人，罗波安王和他们商议，说：「你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复这民。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Rehoboam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Solomon his father while he was yet alive, saying, "How do you advise me to answer this people?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who stood before his father Solomon while he still lived, and he said, "How do you advise me to answer these people?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Rehoboam discussed the matter with the older men who had counseled his father, Solomon. "What is your advice?" he asked. "How should I answer these people?"
verses.textEnNasb: And King Rehoboam consulted with the elders who had served his father Solomon while he was still alive, saying, "How do you advise me to answer this people?"
verses.textEn: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.

verses.textZh: 长老对他说："今天如果王作这民的仆人，服事他们，用好话回答他们，他们就常作王的仆人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 长老对他说："今天如果王作这民的仆人，服事他们，用好话回答他们，他们就常作王的仆人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 老年人对他说：「现在王若服事这民如仆人，用好话回答他们，他们就永远作王的仆人。」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "If today you will be a servant to these people and serve them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to him, "If you will be a servant to this people today and serve them, and speak good words to them when you answer them, then they will be your servants forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they spoke to him, saying, "If you will be a servant to these people today, and serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever."
verses.textEnNlt: The older counselors replied, "If you are willing to be a servant to these people today and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your loyal subjects."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they spoke to him, saying, "If you will be a servant to this people today, and will serve them and grant them their request, and speak pleasant words to them, then they will be your servants always."
verses.textEn: They replied, "If today you will be a servant to these people and serve them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."

verses.textZh: 可是王拒绝了老年人给他出的主意，反去请教那些与他一起长大，侍立在他面前的年轻人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是王拒绝了老年人给他出的主意，反去请教那些与他一起长大，侍立在他面前的年轻人，
verses.textZhCuv: 王却不用老年人给他出的主意，就和那些与他一同长大、在他面前侍立的少年人商议，
verses.textEnNiv: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.
verses.textEnEsv: But he abandoned the counsel that the old men gave him and took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him and stood before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he rejected the advice which the elders had given him, and consulted the young men who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Rehoboam rejected the advice of the older men and instead asked the opinion of the young men who had grown up with him and were now his advisers.
verses.textEnNasb: But he ignored the advice of the elders which they had given him, and consulted with the young men who had grown up with him and served him.
verses.textEn: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.

verses.textZh: 问他们："你们的主意怎样，我应该怎样回复这民？他们对我说：‘请你减轻你父亲加在我们身上的重担。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 问他们："你们的主意怎样，我应该怎样回复这民？他们对我说：‘请你减轻你父亲加在我们身上的重担。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「这民对我说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。』你们给我出个什么主意，我好回复他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "What do you advise that we answer this people who have said to me, ‘Lighten the yoke that your father put on us’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them, "What advice do you give? How should we answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke which your father put on us’?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What is your advice?" he asked them. "How should I answer these people who want me to lighten the burdens imposed by my father?"
