verses.textEnNasb: He said to them, "What advice do you give, so that we may answer this people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke which your father put on us’?"
verses.textEn: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?"

verses.textZh: 那些与他一同长大的年轻人回答他："这民对王说：‘你父亲加重我们的重担，现在求你减轻我们的重担。’你要这样回答他们：‘我的小指头比我父亲的腰还粗！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些与他一同长大的年轻人回答他："这民对王说：‘你父亲加重我们的重担，现在求你减轻我们的重担。’你要这样回答他们：‘我的小指头比我父亲的腰还粗！
verses.textZhCuv: 那同他长大的少年人说：「这民对王说：『你父亲使我们负重轭，求你使我们轻松些。』王要对他们如此说：『我的小拇指头比我父亲的腰还粗。
verses.textEnNiv: The young men who had grown up with him replied, "These people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.
verses.textEnEsv: And the young men who had grown up with him said to him, "Thus shall you speak to this people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you lighten it for us,’ thus shall you say to them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s thighs.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, "Thus you should speak to this people who have spoken to you, saying, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you make it lighter on us’—thus you shall say to them: ‘My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s waist!
verses.textEnNlt: The young men replied, "This is what you should tell those complainers who want a lighter burden: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
verses.textEnNasb: And the young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, "This is what you should say to this people who spoke to you, saying: ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, now you make it lighter for us!’ You should speak this way to them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
verses.textEn: The young men who had grown up with him replied, "These people have said to you, ‘Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but make our yoke lighter.’ Now tell them, ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist.

verses.textZh: 我父亲把一个重担加在你们身上，我要使你们负更重的重担；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我父亲把一个重担加在你们身上，我要使你们负更重的重担；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭！我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们！』」
verses.textEnNiv: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And now, whereas my father laid on you a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, whereas my father put a heavy yoke on you, I will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scourges!’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, my father laid heavy burdens on you, but I’m going to make them even heavier! My father beat you with whips, but I will beat you with scorpions!’"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, my father loaded you with a heavy yoke; yet I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions!’ "
verses.textEn: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.’ "

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安和众民，照王所说"三天以后再来见我"的那话，第三天来见罗波安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安和众民，照王所说"三天以后再来见我"的那话，第三天来见罗波安。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安和众百姓遵着罗波安王所说「你们第三日再来见我」的那话，第三日他们果然来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."
verses.textEnEsv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king said, "Come to me again the third day."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had directed, saying, "Come back to me the third day."
verses.textEnNlt: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to hear Rehoboam’s decision, just as the king had ordered.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king had directed, saying, "Return to me on the third day."
verses.textEn: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."

verses.textZh: 王严厉地回答众人。他拒绝了老年人给他所出的主意，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王严厉地回答众人。他拒绝了老年人给他所出的主意，
verses.textZhCuv: 王用严厉的话回答百姓，不用老年人给他所出的主意，
verses.textEnNiv: The king answered the people harshly. Rejecting the advice given him by the elders,
verses.textEnEsv: And the king answered the people harshly, and forsaking the counsel that the old men had given him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king answered the people roughly, and rejected the advice which the elders had given him;
verses.textEnNlt: But Rehoboam spoke harshly to the people, for he rejected the advice of the older counselors
verses.textEnNasb: And the king answered the people harshly, for he ignored the advice of the elders which they had given him,
verses.textEn: The king answered the people harshly. Rejecting the advice given him by the elders,

verses.textZh: 却照着年轻人给他所出的主意，对他们说："我父亲加重你们所负的重担，我要使你们负更重的重担；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 却照着年轻人给他所出的主意，对他们说："我父亲加重你们所负的重担，我要使你们负更重的重担；我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 照着少年人所出的主意对民说：「我父亲使你们负重轭，我必使你们负更重的轭！我父亲用鞭子责打你们，我要用蝎子鞭责打你们！」
verses.textEnNiv: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."
verses.textEnEsv: he spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions."
verses.textEnNkjv: and he spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scourges!"
verses.textEnNlt: and followed the counsel of his younger advisers. He told the people, "My father laid heavy burdens on you, but I’m going to make them even heavier! My father beat you with whips, but I will beat you with scorpions!"
verses.textEnNasb: and he spoke to them according to the advice of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke; my father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions!"
verses.textEn: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."

verses.textZh: 王不肯听从民众的请求，因为这个转变是出于耶和华，为要应验他藉示罗人亚希雅对尼八的儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王不肯听从民众的请求，因为这个转变是出于耶和华，为要应验他藉示罗人亚希雅对尼八的儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 王不肯依从百姓，这事乃出于耶和华，为要应验他藉示罗人亚希雅对尼八的儿子耶罗波安所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from the Lord , to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.
verses.textEnEsv: So the king did not listen to the people, for it was a turn of affairs brought about by the Lord that he might fulfill his word, which the Lord spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king did not listen to the people; for the turn ofevents was from the Lord, that He might fulfill His word, which the Lord had spoken by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king paid no attention to the people. This turn of events was the will of the Lord , for it fulfilled the Lord ’s message to Jeroboam son of Nebat through the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king did not listen to the people; because it was a turn of events from the Lord, in order to establish His word which the Lord spoke through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEn: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from the Lord , to fulfill the word the Lord had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.

verses.textZh: 以色列众人见王不肯听从他们的请求，就回答王说： "我们在大卫里面有甚么分呢？ 我们在耶西的儿子里面也没有产业； 以色列人哪，回你们自己的家去吧！ 大卫啊，照顾你自己的家吧！" 于是以色列人都回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人见王不肯听从他们的请求，就回答王说： "我们在大卫里面有甚么分呢？ 我们在耶西的儿子里面也没有产业； 以色列人哪，回你们自己的家去吧！ 大卫啊，照顾你自己的家吧！" 于是以色列人都回自己的家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众民见王不依从他们，就对王说： 我们与大卫有什么分儿呢？ 与耶西的儿子并没有关涉。 以色列人哪，各回各家去吧！ 大卫家啊，自己顾自己吧！ 于是，以色列人都回自己家里去了，
verses.textEnNiv: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!" So the Israelites went home.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, "What portion do we have in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, David." So Israel went to their tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, the people answered the king, saying: "What share have we in David? Wehave no inheritance in the son of Jesse. To your tents, O Israel! Now, see to your own house, O David!" So Israel departed to their tents.
verses.textEnNlt: When all Israel realized that the king had refused to listen to them, they responded, "Down with the dynasty of David! We have no interest in the son of Jesse. Back to your homes, O Israel! Look out for your own house, O David!" So the people of Israel returned home.
verses.textEnNasb: When all Israel saw that the king had not listened to them, the people replied to the king, saying, "What share do we have in David? We have no inheritance in the son of Jesse; To your tents, Israel! Now look after your own house, David!" So Israel went away to their tents.
verses.textEn: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse’s son? To your tents, Israel! Look after your own house, David!" So the Israelites went home.

verses.textZh: 不过住在犹大各城的以色列人，罗波安仍然作他们的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过住在犹大各城的以色列人，罗波安仍然作他们的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独住犹大城邑的以色列人，罗波安仍作他们的王。
verses.textEnNiv: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.
verses.textEnEsv: But Rehoboam reigned over the people of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Rehoboam reigned over the children of Israel who dwelt in the cities of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: But Rehoboam continued to rule over the Israelites who lived in the towns of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for the sons of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.textEn: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.

verses.textZh: 罗波安王差派掌管作苦工之人的亚多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列众人却用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车逃回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王差派掌管作苦工之人的亚多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列众人却用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车逃回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安王差遣掌管服苦之人的亚多兰往以色列人那里去，以色列人就用石头打死他。罗波安王急忙上车，逃回耶路撒冷去了。
verses.textEnNiv: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was taskmaster over the forced labor, and all Israel stoned him to death with stones. And King Rehoboam hurried to mount his chariot to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was in charge of the revenue; but all Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. Therefore King Rehoboam mounted his chariot in haste to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: King Rehoboam sent Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, to restore order, but the people of Israel stoned him to death. When this news reached King Rehoboam, he quickly jumped into his chariot and fled to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was in charge of the forced labor, and all Israel stoned him to death. And King Rehoboam hurried to mount his chariot to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 这样，以色列人背叛了大卫家，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，以色列人背叛了大卫家，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，以色列人背叛大卫家，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
verses.textEnEsv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: And to this day the northern tribes of Israel have refused to be ruled by a descendant of David.
verses.textEnNasb: So Israel has broken with the house of David to this day.
verses.textEn: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.

verses.textZh: 以色列众人听说耶罗波安回来了，就派人去请他到会众面前，立他作以色列的王；除了犹大支派以外，没有跟随大卫家的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人听说耶罗波安回来了，就派人去请他到会众面前，立他作以色列的王；除了犹大支派以外，没有跟随大卫家的。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人听见耶罗波安回来了，就打发人去请他到会众面前，立他作以色列众人的王。除了犹大支派以外，没有顺从大卫家的。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the Israelites heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the house of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. There was none that followed the house of David but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had come back, they sent for him and called him to the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. There was none who followed the house of David, but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.textEnNlt: When the people of Israel learned of Jeroboam’s return from Egypt, they called an assembly and made him king over all Israel. So only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the family of David.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, that they sent word and called him to the assembly, and made him king over all Israel. None except the tribe of Judah alone followed the house of David.
verses.textEn: When all the Israelites heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the house of David.

verses.textZh: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，就召集了犹大全家和便雅悯支派精选的战士十八万人，要与以色列家争战，好把国夺回，重归所罗门的儿子罗波安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，就召集了犹大全家和便雅悯支派精选的战士十八万人，要与以色列家争战，好把国夺回，重归所罗门的儿子罗波安。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安来到耶路撒冷，招聚犹大全家和便雅悯支派的人共十八万，都是挑选的战士，要与以色列家争战，好将国夺回，再归所罗门的儿子罗波安。
verses.textEnNiv: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered all Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam son of Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: When Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, 180,000 chosen warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah with the tribe of Benjamin, one hundred and eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against the house of Israel, that he might restore the kingdom to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: When Rehoboam arrived at Jerusalem, he mobilized the men of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—180,000 select troops—to fight against the men of Israel and to restore the kingdom to himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, 180,000 chosen warriors, to fight against the house of Israel to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.textEn: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered all Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—a hundred and eighty thousand able young men—to go to war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam son of Solomon.

verses.textZh: 但是，神的话临到神人示玛雅，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，神的话临到神人示玛雅，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 但神的话临到神人示玛雅，说：
verses.textEnNiv: But this word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:
verses.textEnEsv: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:
verses.textEnNkjv: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: But God said to Shemaiah, the man of God,
verses.textEnNasb: But the word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.textEn: But this word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:

verses.textZh: "你去告诉所罗门王的儿子犹大王罗波安、犹大全家和便雅悯，以及其余的人民，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: "你去告诉所罗门王的儿子犹大王罗波安、犹大全家和便雅悯，以及其余的人民，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 「你去告诉所罗门的儿子犹大王罗波安和犹大、便雅悯全家，并其余的民说：
verses.textEnNiv: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, to all Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people,
verses.textEnEsv: "Say to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the people of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people,
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and the rest of the people, saying,
verses.textEn: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, to all Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people,

verses.textZh: ‘耶和华这样说：你们不可上去，不可与你们的兄弟以色列人争战。你们各自回家去吧！因为这事是出于我。’"众人就听从了耶和华的话，照着耶和华的话回家去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘耶和华这样说：你们不可上去，不可与你们的兄弟以色列人争战。你们各自回家去吧！因为这事是出于我。’"众人就听从了耶和华的话，照着耶和华的话回家去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 『耶和华如此说：你们不可上去与你们的弟兄以色列人争战。各归各家去吧！因为这事出于我。』」众人就听从耶和华的话，遵着耶和华的命回去了。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ " So they obeyed the word of the Lord and went home again, as the Lord had ordered.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Thus says the Lord , You shall not go up or fight against your relatives the people of Israel. Every man return to his home, for this thing is from me.’" So they listened to the word of the Lord and went home again, according to the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus says the Lord: "You shall not go up nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel. Let every man return to his house, for this thing is from Me." ’ " Therefore they obeyed the word of the Lord, and turned back, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not fight against your relatives, the Israelites. Go back home, for what has happened is my doing!’" So they obeyed the message of the Lord and went home, as the Lord had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what the Lord says: "You shall not go up nor fight against your relatives the sons of Israel; return, every man to his house, for this thing has come from Me." ’ " So they listened to the word of the Lord, and returned to go their way in accordance with the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: ‘This is what the Lord says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.’ " So they obeyed the word of the Lord and went home again, as the Lord had ordered.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安在以法莲山地修筑了示剑城，就住在城中，又从那里出去，修建了毘努伊勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安在以法莲山地修筑了示剑城，就住在城中，又从那里出去，修建了毘努伊勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安在以法莲山地建筑示剑，就住在其中；又从示剑出去，建筑毗努伊勒。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. From there he went out and built up Peniel.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. And he went out from there and built Penuel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the mountains of Ephraim, and dwelt there. Also he went out from there and built Penuel.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeroboam then built up the city of Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and it became his capital. Later he went and built up the town of Peniel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived there. And he went out from there and built Penuel.
verses.textEn: Then Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. From there he went out and built up Peniel.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安心里说："现在这国仍然要归回大卫家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安心里说："现在这国仍然要归回大卫家。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安心里说：「恐怕这国仍归大卫家；
verses.textEnNiv: Jeroboam thought to himself, "The kingdom will now likely revert to the house of David.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jeroboam said in his heart, "Now the kingdom will turn back to the house of David.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jeroboam said in his heart, "Now the kingdom may return to the house of David:
verses.textEnNlt: Jeroboam thought to himself, "Unless I am careful, the kingdom will return to the dynasty of David.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jeroboam said in his heart, "Now the kingdom will return to the house of David.
verses.textEn: Jeroboam thought to himself, "The kingdom will now likely revert to the house of David.

verses.textZh: 这民若是上去，在耶路撒冷耶和华的殿里献祭，这民的心就必归向他们的主犹大王罗波安，他们必把我杀了，然后回到犹大王罗波安那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这民若是上去，在耶路撒冷耶和华的殿里献祭，这民的心就必归向他们的主犹大王罗波安，他们必把我杀了，然后回到犹大王罗波安那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这民若上耶路撒冷去，在耶和华的殿里献祭，他们的心必归向他们的主－犹大王罗波安，就把我杀了，仍归犹大王罗波安。」
verses.textEnNiv: If these people go up to offer sacrifices at the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem, they will again give their allegiance to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah. They will kill me and return to King Rehoboam."
verses.textEnEsv: If this people go up to offer sacrifices in the temple of the Lord at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn again to their lord, to Rehoboam king of Judah, and they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah."
verses.textEnNkjv: If these people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn back to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah, and they will kill me and go back to Rehoboam king of Judah."
verses.textEnNlt: When these people go to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices at the Temple of the Lord , they will again give their allegiance to King Rehoboam of Judah. They will kill me and make him their king instead."
verses.textEnNasb: If this people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will return to their lord, to Rehoboam king of Judah; and they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah."
verses.textEn: If these people go up to offer sacrifices at the temple of the Lord in Jerusalem, they will again give their allegiance to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah. They will kill me and return to King Rehoboam."

verses.textZh: 王打定了主意，就做了两个金牛犊，对众民说："以色列人哪，你们上耶路撒冷去实在够了。看哪，这是你们的神，就是从埃及地领你们上来的那位。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王打定了主意，就做了两个金牛犊，对众民说："以色列人哪，你们上耶路撒冷去实在够了。看哪，这是你们的神，就是从埃及地领你们上来的那位。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安王就筹划定妥，铸造了两个金牛犊，对众民说：「以色列人哪，你们上耶路撒冷去实在是难；这就是领你们出埃及地的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves. He said to the people, "It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: So the king took counsel and made two calves of gold. And he said to the people, "You have gone up to Jerusalem long enough. Behold your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the king asked advice, made two calves of gold, and said to the people, "It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, O Israel, which brought you up from the land of Egypt!"
verses.textEnNlt: So on the advice of his counselors, the king made two gold calves. He said to the people, "It is too much trouble for you to worship in Jerusalem. Look, Israel, these are the gods who brought you out of Egypt!"
verses.textEnNasb: So the king consulted, and he made two golden calves; and he said to the people, "It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem; behold your gods, Israel, that brought you up from the land of Egypt."
verses.textEn: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves. He said to the people, "It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."

verses.textZh: 他就把一个牛犊安放在伯特利，一个安放在但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就把一个牛犊安放在伯特利，一个安放在但。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就把牛犊一只安在伯特利，一只安在但。
verses.textEnNiv: One he set up in Bethel, and the other in Dan.
verses.textEnEsv: And he set one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he set up one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
verses.textEnNlt: He placed these calf idols in Bethel and in Dan—at either end of his kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: And he set up one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
verses.textEn: One he set up in Bethel, and the other in Dan.

verses.textZh: 这事成了以色列人的罪，因为众民都到但那个牛犊面前敬拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事成了以色列人的罪，因为众民都到但那个牛犊面前敬拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事叫百姓陷在罪里，因为他们往但去拜那牛犊。
verses.textEnNiv: And this thing became a sin; the people came to worship the one at Bethel and went as far as Dan to worship the other.
verses.textEnEsv: Then this thing became a sin, for the people went as far as Dan to be before one.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this thing became a sin, for the people went toworship before the one as far as Dan.
verses.textEnNlt: But this became a great sin, for the people worshiped the idols, traveling as far north as Dan to worship the one there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now this thing became a sin, for the people went to worship before the one as far as Dan.
verses.textEn: And this thing became a sin; the people came to worship the one at Bethel and went as far as Dan to worship the other.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安在邱坛那里建殿，把不是利未子孙的平民立为祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安在邱坛那里建殿，把不是利未子孙的平民立为祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安在邱坛那里建殿，将那不属利未人的凡民立为祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: Jeroboam built shrines on high places and appointed priests from all sorts of people, even though they were not Levites.
verses.textEnEsv: He also made temples on high places and appointed priests from among all the people, who were not of the Levites.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made shrines on the high places, and made priests from every class of people, who were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeroboam also erected buildings at the pagan shrines and ordained priests from the common people—those who were not from the priestly tribe of Levi.
verses.textEnNasb: And he made houses on high places, and appointed priests from all the people who were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.textEn: Jeroboam built shrines on high places and appointed priests from all sorts of people, even though they were not Levites.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安又定了八月十五日为节期，像在犹大的节期一样，他自己在祭坛上献祭，他在伯特利也是这样向他所铸造的牛犊献祭；他又在伯特利为他所建造的邱坛设立祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安又定了八月十五日为节期，像在犹大的节期一样，他自己在祭坛上献祭，他在伯特利也是这样向他所铸造的牛犊献祭；他又在伯特利为他所建造的邱坛设立祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安定八月十五日为节期，像在犹大的节期一样，自己上坛献祭。他在伯特利也这样向他所铸的牛犊献祭，又将立为邱坛的祭司安置在伯特利。
verses.textEnNiv: He instituted a festival on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the festival held in Judah, and offered sacrifices on the altar. This he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves he had made. And at Bethel he also installed priests at the high places he had made.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jeroboam appointed a feast on the fifteenth day of the eighth month like the feast that was in Judah, and he offered sacrifices on the altar. So he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he made. And he placed in Bethel the priests of the high places that he had made.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jeroboam ordained a feast on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the feast that was in Judah, and offered sacrifices on the altar. So he did at Bethel, sacrificing to the calves that he had made. And at Bethel he installed the priests of the high places which he had made.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jeroboam instituted a religious festival in Bethel, held on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, in imitation of the annual Festival of Shelters in Judah. There at Bethel he himself offered sacrifices to the calves he had made, and he appointed priests for the pagan shrines he had made.
verses.textEnNasb: Jeroboam also instituted a feast in the eighth month on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast that is in Judah, and he went up to the altar. So he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves which he had made. And he stationed in Bethel the priests of the high places which he had made.
verses.textEn: He instituted a festival on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the festival held in Judah, and offered sacrifices on the altar. This he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves he had made. And at Bethel he also installed priests at the high places he had made.

verses.textZh: 八月十五日，就是他心里私定作为以色列人节期的日子，他在伯特利在自己所建的祭坛上献祭烧香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 八月十五日，就是他心里私定作为以色列人节期的日子，他在伯特利在自己所建的祭坛上献祭烧香。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在八月十五日，就是他私自所定的月日，为以色列人立作节期的日子，在伯特利上坛烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a month of his own choosing, he offered sacrifices on the altar he had built at Bethel. So he instituted the festival for the Israelites and went up to the altar to make offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: He went up to the altar that he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, in the month that he had devised from his own heart. And he instituted a feast for the people of Israel and went up to the altar to make offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he made offerings on the altar which he had made at Bethel on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, in the month which he had devised in his own heart. And he ordained a feast for the children of Israel, and offered sacrifices on the altar and burned incense.
verses.textEnNlt: So on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a day that he himself had designated, Jeroboam offered sacrifices on the altar at Bethel. He instituted a religious festival for Israel, and he went up to the altar to burn incense.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went up to the altar which he had made in Bethel on the fifteenth day in the eighth month, the month that he had devised in his own heart; and he instituted a feast for the sons of Israel and went up to the altar to burn incense.
verses.textEn: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a month of his own choosing, he offered sacrifices on the altar he had built at Bethel. So he instituted the festival for the Israelites and went up to the altar to make offerings.

verses.textZh: 有一个神人，奉耶和华的命令，从犹大来到伯特利；那时，耶罗波安正站在祭坛旁边烧香。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个神人，奉耶和华的命令，从犹大来到伯特利；那时，耶罗波安正站在祭坛旁边烧香。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，有一个神人奉耶和华的命从犹大来到伯特利。耶罗波安正站在坛旁要烧香；
verses.textEnNiv: By the word of the Lord a man of God came from Judah to Bethel, as Jeroboam was standing by the altar to make an offering.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a man of God came out of Judah by the word of the Lord to Bethel. Jeroboam was standing by the altar to make offerings.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, a man of God went from Judah to Bethel by the word of the Lord, and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
verses.textEnNlt: At the Lord ’s command, a man of God from Judah went to Bethel, arriving there just as Jeroboam was approaching the altar to burn incense.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, a man of God came from Judah to Bethel by the word of the Lord, while Jeroboam was standing at the altar to burn incense.
verses.textEn: By the word of the Lord a man of God came from Judah to Bethel, as Jeroboam was standing by the altar to make an offering.

verses.textZh: 神人奉耶和华的命令，向那祭坛喊叫，说："祭坛哪，祭坛哪，耶和华这样说：‘看哪，大卫家要生一个儿子，名叫约西亚；他要把邱坛的祭司，就是在你上面烧香的，作祭物献在你上面。人的骨头也要在你上面焚烧。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人奉耶和华的命令，向那祭坛喊叫，说："祭坛哪，祭坛哪，耶和华这样说：‘看哪，大卫家要生一个儿子，名叫约西亚；他要把邱坛的祭司，就是在你上面烧香的，作祭物献在你上面。人的骨头也要在你上面焚烧。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 神人奉耶和华的命向坛呼叫，说：「坛哪，坛哪！耶和华如此说：大卫家里必生一个儿子，名叫约西亚，他必将邱坛的祭司，就是在你上面烧香的，杀在你上面，人的骨头也必烧在你上面。」
verses.textEnNiv: By the word of the Lord he cried out against the altar: "Altar, altar! This is what the Lord says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the man cried against the altar by the word of the Lord and said, "O altar, altar, thus says the Lord : ‘Behold, a son shall be born to the house of David, Josiah by name, and he shall sacrifice on you the priests of the high places who make offerings on you, and human bones shall be burned on you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he cried out against the altar by the word of the Lord, and said, "O altar, altar! Thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, a child, Josiah by name, shall be born to the house of David; and on you he shall sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and men’s bones shall be burned on you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then at the Lord ’s command, he shouted, "O altar, altar! This is what the Lord says: A child named Josiah will be born into the dynasty of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests from the pagan shrines who come here to burn incense, and human bones will be burned on you."
verses.textEnNasb: And he cried out against the altar by the word of the Lord and said, "Altar, altar, this is what the Lord says: ‘Behold, a son shall be born to the house of David, Josiah by name; and on you he shall sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense on you, and human bones shall burn on you.’ "
verses.textEn: By the word of the Lord he cried out against the altar: "Altar, altar! This is what the Lord says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on you.’ "

verses.textZh: 那天，神人提出一个兆头，说："这是耶和华所说的兆头。看哪，这祭坛必破裂，祭坛上的灰必倾撒下来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天，神人提出一个兆头，说："这是耶和华所说的兆头。看哪，这祭坛必破裂，祭坛上的灰必倾撒下来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，神人设个预兆，说：「这坛必破裂，坛上的灰必倾撒，这是耶和华说的预兆。」
verses.textEnNiv: That same day the man of God gave a sign: "This is the sign the Lord has declared: The altar will be split apart and the ashes on it will be poured out."
verses.textEnEsv: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, "This is the sign that the Lord has spoken: ‘Behold, the altar shall be torn down, and the ashes that are on it shall be poured out.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, "This is the sign which the Lord has spoken: Surely the altar shall split apart, and the ashes on it shall be poured out."
verses.textEnNlt: That same day the man of God gave a sign to prove his message. He said, "The Lord has promised to give this sign: This altar will split apart, and its ashes will be poured out on the ground."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he gave a sign on the same day, saying, "This is the sign which the Lord has spoken: ‘Behold, the altar shall be torn to pieces and the ashes which are on it shall be poured out.’ "
verses.textEn: That same day the man of God gave a sign: "This is the sign the Lord has declared: The altar will be split apart and the ashes on it will be poured out."

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安王听见神人向伯特利的祭坛喊叫的话，就从祭坛上伸手，说："抓住他！"王向他伸出的手却瘫痪了，不能缩回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安王听见神人向伯特利的祭坛喊叫的话，就从祭坛上伸手，说："抓住他！"王向他伸出的手却瘫痪了，不能缩回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安王听见神人向伯特利的坛所呼叫的话，就从坛上伸手，说：「拿住他吧！」王向神人所伸的手就枯干了，不能弯回；
verses.textEnNiv: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, "Seize him!" But the hand he stretched out toward the man shriveled up, so that he could not pull it back.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the king heard the saying of the man of God, which he cried against the altar at Bethel, Jeroboam stretched out his hand from the altar, saying, "Seize him." And his hand, which he stretched out against him, dried up, so that he could not draw it back to himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came to pass when King Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God, who cried out against the altar in Bethel, that he stretched out his hand from the altar, saying, "Arrest him!" Then his hand, which he stretched out toward him, withered, so that he could not pull it back to himself.
verses.textEnNlt: When King Jeroboam heard the man of God speaking against the altar at Bethel, he pointed at him and shouted, "Seize that man!" But instantly the king’s hand became paralyzed in that position, and he couldn’t pull it back.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the king heard the statement of the man of God which he cried out against the altar in Bethel, Jeroboam stretched out his hand from the altar, saying, "Seize him!" But his hand which he had stretched out toward him dried up, and he could not draw it back to himself.
verses.textEn: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, "Seize him!" But the hand he stretched out toward the man shriveled up, so that he could not pull it back.

verses.textZh: 祭坛也破裂了，灰从祭坛上倾撒下来，好象神人奉耶和华的命令所提出的预兆一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭坛也破裂了，灰从祭坛上倾撒下来，好象神人奉耶和华的命令所提出的预兆一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 坛也破裂了，坛上的灰倾撒了，正如神人奉耶和华的命所设的预兆。
verses.textEnNiv: Also, the altar was split apart and its ashes poured out according to the sign given by the man of God by the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The altar also was torn down, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign that the man of God had given by the word of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: The altar also was split apart, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: At the same time a wide crack appeared in the altar, and the ashes poured out, just as the man of God had predicted in his message from the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: The altar also was torn to pieces and the ashes were poured out from the altar, in accordance with the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Also, the altar was split apart and its ashes poured out according to the sign given by the man of God by the word of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 王对神人说："求你为我向耶和华你的神求情，又为我祷告，使我的手复原。"于是神人向耶和华求情，王的手就复了原，像起先一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对神人说："求你为我向耶和华你的神求情，又为我祷告，使我的手复原。"于是神人向耶和华求情，王的手就复了原，像起先一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 王对神人说：「请你为我祷告，求耶和华－你神的恩典使我的手复原。」于是神人祈祷耶和华，王的手就复了原，仍如寻常一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king said to the man of God, "Intercede with the Lord your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored." So the man of God interceded with the Lord , and the king’s hand was restored and became as it was before.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to the man of God, "Entreat now the favor of the Lord your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me." And the man of God entreated the Lord , and the king’s hand was restored to him and became as it was before.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king answered and said to the man of God, "Please entreat the favor of the Lord your God, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored to me." So the man of God entreated the Lord, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and became as before.
verses.textEnNlt: The king cried out to the man of God, "Please ask the Lord your God to restore my hand again!" So the man of God prayed to the Lord , and the king’s hand was restored and he could move it again.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king responded and said to the man of God, "Please appease the Lord your God and pray for me, so that my hand may be restored to me." So the man of God appeased the Lord, and the king’s hand was restored to him, and it became as it was before.
verses.textEn: Then the king said to the man of God, "Intercede with the Lord your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored." So the man of God interceded with the Lord , and the king’s hand was restored and became as it was before.

verses.textZh: 王对神人说："请与我一起回王宫去，吃点东西，加添心力，我还要赐给你一份礼物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对神人说："请与我一起回王宫去，吃点东西，加添心力，我还要赐给你一份礼物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对神人说：「请你同我回去吃饭，加添心力，我也必给你赏赐。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king said to the man of God, "Come home with me for a meal, and I will give you a gift."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to the man of God, "Come home with me, and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king said to the man of God, "Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king said to the man of God, "Come to the palace with me and have something to eat, and I will give you a gift."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to the man of God, "Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a gift."
verses.textEn: The king said to the man of God, "Come home with me for a meal, and I will give you a gift."

verses.textZh: 神人对王说："你就是把王宫的一半给我，我也不会与你回去，也不在这地方吃饭喝水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人对王说："你就是把王宫的一半给我，我也不会与你回去，也不在这地方吃饭喝水。
verses.textZhCuv: 神人对王说：「你就是把你的宫一半给我，我也不同你进去，也不在这地方吃饭喝水；
verses.textEnNiv: But the man of God answered the king, "Even if you were to give me half your possessions, I would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water here.
verses.textEnEsv: And the man of God said to the king, "If you give me half your house, I will not go in with you. And I will not eat bread or drink water in this place,
verses.textEnNkjv: But the man of God said to the king, "If you were to give me half your house, I would not go in with you; nor would I eat bread nor drink water in this place.
verses.textEnNlt: But the man of God said to the king, "Even if you gave me half of everything you own, I would not go with you. I would not eat or drink anything in this place.
verses.textEnNasb: But the man of God said to the king, "If you were to give me half your house, I would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.
verses.textEn: But the man of God answered the king, "Even if you were to give me half your possessions, I would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water here.

verses.textZh: 因为有耶和华的话吩咐我说：‘你不可吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有耶和华的话吩咐我说：‘你不可吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有耶和华的话嘱咐我，说不可在伯特利吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。」
verses.textEnNiv: For I was commanded by the word of the Lord : ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: for so was it commanded me by the word of the Lord , saying, ‘You shall neither eat bread nor drink water nor return by the way that you came.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For so it was commanded me by the word of the Lord, saying, ‘You shall not eat bread, nor drink water, nor return by the same way you came.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord gave me this command: ‘You must not eat or drink anything while you are there, and do not return to Judah by the same way you came.’"
verses.textEnNasb: For so it was commanded me by the word of the Lord, saying, ‘You shall not eat bread nor drink water, nor return by the way that you came.’ "
verses.textEn: For I was commanded by the word of the Lord : ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是神人从另一条路去了，没有从他来伯特利的原路回去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是神人从另一条路去了，没有从他来伯特利的原路回去。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是神人从别的路回去，不从伯特利来的原路回去。
verses.textEnNiv: So he took another road and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.
verses.textEnEsv: So he went another way and did not return by the way that he came to Bethel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went another way and did not return by the way he came to Bethel.
verses.textEnNlt: So he left Bethel and went home another way.
verses.textEnNasb: So he went another way and did not return by the way that he had come to Bethel.
verses.textEn: So he took another road and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.

verses.textZh: 有一个老先知住在伯特利，他的儿子们 来告诉他，那一天神人在伯特利所行的一切事。他们也把他对王所说的话，都告诉了他们的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个老先知住在伯特利，他的儿子们 来告诉他，那一天神人在伯特利所行的一切事。他们也把他对王所说的话，都告诉了他们的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个老先知住在伯特利，他儿子们来，将神人当日在伯特利所行的一切事和向王所说的话都告诉了父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there was a certain old prophet living in Bethel, whose sons came and told him all that the man of God had done there that day. They also told their father what he had said to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: Now an old prophet lived in Bethel. And his sons came and told him all that the man of God had done that day in Bethel. They also told to their father the words that he had spoken to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now an old prophet dwelt in Bethel, and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of God had done that day in Bethel; they also told their father the words which he had spoken to the king.
verses.textEnNlt: As it happened, there was an old prophet living in Bethel, and his sons came home and told him what the man of God had done in Bethel that day. They also told their father what the man had said to the king.
verses.textEnNasb: Now an old prophet was living in Bethel; and his sons came and told him all the deeds which the man of God had done that day in Bethel; the words which he had spoken to the king, these also they reported to their father.
verses.textEn: Now there was a certain old prophet living in Bethel, whose sons came and told him all that the man of God had done there that day. They also told their father what he had said to the king.

verses.textZh: 他们的父亲问他们："神人从哪条路走了呢？"他的儿子们就把从犹大来的神人所走的路，指给他看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的父亲问他们："神人从哪条路走了呢？"他的儿子们就把从犹大来的神人所走的路，指给他看。
verses.textZhCuv: 父亲问他们说：「神人从哪条路去了呢？」儿子们就告诉他；原来他们看见那从犹大来的神人所去的路。
verses.textEnNiv: Their father asked them, "Which way did he go?" And his sons showed him which road the man of God from Judah had taken.
verses.textEnEsv: And their father said to them, "Which way did he go?" And his sons showed him the way that the man of God who came from Judah had gone.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their father said to them, "Which way did he go?" For his sons had seen which way the man of God went who came from Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: The old prophet asked them, "Which way did he go?" So they showed their father which road the man of God had taken.
verses.textEnNasb: And their father said to them, " Which way did he go?" Now his sons had seen the way that the man of God who came from Judah had gone.
verses.textEn: Their father asked them, "Which way did he go?" And his sons showed him which road the man of God from Judah had taken.

verses.textZh: 他对儿子们说："给我备驴！"于是他们给他备驴，他就骑上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对儿子们说："给我备驴！"于是他们给他备驴，他就骑上，
verses.textZhCuv: 老先知就吩咐他儿子们说：「你们为我备驴。」他们备好了驴，他就骑上，
verses.textEnNiv: So he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." And when they had saddled the donkey for him, he mounted it
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." So they saddled the donkey for him and he mounted it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." So they saddled the donkey for him; and he rode on it,
verses.textEnNlt: "Quick, saddle the donkey," the old man said. So they saddled the donkey for him, and he mounted it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." So they saddled the donkey for him and he rode away on it.
verses.textEn: So he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." And when they had saddled the donkey for him, he mounted it

verses.textZh: 去追赶神人，遇见他正坐在橡树底下，就问他："你是从犹大来的神人吗？"他回答："是的！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 去追赶神人，遇见他正坐在橡树底下，就问他："你是从犹大来的神人吗？"他回答："是的！"
verses.textZhCuv: 去追赶神人，遇见他坐在橡树底下，就问他说：「你是从犹大来的神人不是？」他说：「是。」
verses.textEnNiv: and rode after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" "I am," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went after the man of God and found him sitting under an oak. And he said to him, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" And he said, "I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: and went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. Then he said to him, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" And he said, "I am."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he rode after the man of God and found him sitting under a great tree. The old prophet asked him, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" "Yes, I am," he replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So he went after the man of God and found him sitting under an oak; and he said to him, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" And he said, "I am."
verses.textEn: and rode after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" "I am," he replied.

verses.textZh: 老先知对他说："请你与我一起回家去吃饭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 老先知对他说："请你与我一起回家去吃饭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 老先知对他说：「请你同我回家吃饭。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the prophet said to him, "Come home with me and eat."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to him, "Come home with me and eat bread."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to him, "Come home with me and eat bread."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to the man of God, "Come home with me and eat some food."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to him, "Come home with me and eat bread."
verses.textEn: So the prophet said to him, "Come home with me and eat."

verses.textZh: 神人说："我不能与你回去，或是与你同行，也不能与你在这地方吃饭喝水，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神人说："我不能与你回去，或是与你同行，也不能与你在这地方吃饭喝水，
verses.textZhCuv: 神人说：「我不可同你回去进你的家，也不可在这里同你吃饭喝水；
verses.textEnNiv: The man of God said, "I cannot turn back and go with you, nor can I eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "I may not return with you, or go in with you, neither will I eat bread nor drink water with you in this place,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "I cannot return with you nor go in with you; neither can I eat bread nor drink water with you in this place.
verses.textEnNlt: "No, I cannot," he replied. "I am not allowed to eat or drink anything here in this place.
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "I cannot return with you, nor come with you, nor will I eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
verses.textEn: The man of God said, "I cannot turn back and go with you, nor can I eat bread or drink water with you in this place.

verses.textZh: 因为有耶和华的话对我说：‘你在那里不可吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为有耶和华的话对我说：‘你在那里不可吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为有耶和华的话嘱咐我说：『你在那里不可吃饭喝水，也不可从你去的原路回来。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I have been told by the word of the Lord : ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: for it was said to me by the word of the Lord , ‘You shall neither eat bread nor drink water there, nor return by the way that you came.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have been told by the word of the Lord, ‘You shall not eat bread nor drink water there, nor return by going the way you came.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord gave me this command: ‘You must not eat or drink anything while you are there, and do not return to Judah by the same way you came.’"
verses.textEnNasb: For a command came to me by the word of the Lord: ‘You shall not eat bread, nor drink water there; do not return by going the way that you came.’ "
verses.textEn: I have been told by the word of the Lord : ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’ "

verses.textZh: 老先知对他说："我也是先知，和你一样。有一位天使奉耶和华的命令告诉我说：‘你去带他与你一起回家，给他吃饭喝水。’"但是，老先知是欺骗他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 老先知对他说："我也是先知，和你一样。有一位天使奉耶和华的命令告诉我说：‘你去带他与你一起回家，给他吃饭喝水。’"但是，老先知是欺骗他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 老先知对他说：「我也是先知，和你一样。有天使奉耶和华的命对我说：『你去把他带回你的家，叫他吃饭喝水。』」这都是老先知诓哄他。
verses.textEnNiv: The old prophet answered, "I too am a prophet, as you are. And an angel said to me by the word of the Lord : ‘Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water.’ " (But he was lying to him.)
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "I also am a prophet as you are, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the Lord , saying, ‘Bring him back with you into your house that he may eat bread and drink water.’" But he lied to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to him, "I too am a prophet as you are, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the Lord, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, that he may eat bread and drink water.’ " (He was lying to him.)
verses.textEnNlt: But the old prophet answered, "I am a prophet, too, just as you are. And an angel gave me this command from the Lord : ‘Bring him home with you so he can have something to eat and drink.’" But the old man was lying to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to him, "I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the Lord, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’ " But he lied to him.
verses.textEn: The old prophet answered, "I too am a prophet, as you are. And an angel said to me by the word of the Lord : ‘Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water.’ " (But he was lying to him.)

verses.textZh: 于是神人与他一起回去，在他的家里吃饭喝水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是神人与他一起回去，在他的家里吃饭喝水。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是神人同老先知回去，在他家里吃饭喝水。
verses.textEnNiv: So the man of God returned with him and ate and drank in his house.
verses.textEnEsv: So he went back with him and ate bread in his house and drank water.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went back with him, and ate bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.textEnNlt: So they went back together, and the man of God ate and drank at the prophet’s home.
verses.textEnNasb: So he went back with him, and ate bread in his house and drank water.
verses.textEn: So the man of God returned with him and ate and drank in his house.

verses.textZh: 他们二人正在席上吃喝的时候，耶和华的话临到那把神人带回来的先知，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们二人正在席上吃喝的时候，耶和华的话临到那把神人带回来的先知，
verses.textZhCuv: 二人坐席的时候，耶和华的话临到那带神人回来的先知，
verses.textEnNiv: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the Lord came to the old prophet who had brought him back.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they sat at the table, the word of the Lord came to the prophet who had brought him back.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as they sat at the table, that the word of the Lord came to the prophet who had brought him back;
verses.textEnNlt: Then while they were sitting at the table, a command from the Lord came to the old prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, as they were sitting down at the table, that the word of the Lord came to the prophet who had brought him back;
verses.textEn: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the Lord came to the old prophet who had brought him back.

verses.textZh: 他就对那从犹大来的神人喊叫，说："耶和华这样说：‘你既然违背了耶和华的命令，没有谨守耶和华你的神吩咐你的诫命，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就对那从犹大来的神人喊叫，说："耶和华这样说：‘你既然违背了耶和华的命令，没有谨守耶和华你的神吩咐你的诫命，
verses.textZhCuv: 他就对那从犹大来的神人说：「耶和华如此说：你既违背耶和华的话，不遵守耶和华－你神的命令，
verses.textEnNiv: He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, "This is what the Lord says: ‘You have defied the word of the Lord and have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you.
verses.textEnEsv: And he cried to the man of God who came from Judah, "Thus says the Lord , ‘Because you have disobeyed the word of the Lord and have not kept the command that the Lord your God commanded you,
verses.textEnNkjv: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Because you have disobeyed the word of the Lord, and have not kept the commandment which the Lord your God commanded you,
verses.textEnNlt: He cried out to the man of God from Judah, "This is what the Lord says: You have defied the word of the Lord and have disobeyed the command the Lord your God gave you.
verses.textEnNasb: and he cried out to the man of God who came from Judah, saying, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Because you have disobeyed the command of the Lord, and have not kept the commandment which the Lord your God commanded you,
verses.textEn: He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, "This is what the Lord says: ‘You have defied the word of the Lord and have not kept the command the Lord your God gave you.

verses.textZh: 反倒回来，在耶和华吩咐你不可吃饭喝水的地方，吃了饭喝了水，因此，你的尸体不能入葬你列祖的坟墓里。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 反倒回来，在耶和华吩咐你不可吃饭喝水的地方，吃了饭喝了水，因此，你的尸体不能入葬你列祖的坟墓里。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 反倒回来，在耶和华禁止你吃饭喝水的地方吃了喝了，因此你的尸身不得入你列祖的坟墓。」
verses.textEnNiv: You came back and ate bread and drank water in the place where he told you not to eat or drink. Therefore your body will not be buried in the tomb of your ancestors.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: but have come back and have eaten bread and drunk water in the place of which he said to you, "Eat no bread and drink no water," your body shall not come to the tomb of your fathers.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: but you came back, ate bread, and drank water in the place of which theLord said to you, "Eat no bread and drink no water," your corpse shall not come to the tomb of your fathers.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You came back to this place and ate and drank where he told you not to eat or drink. Because of this, your body will not be buried in the grave of your ancestors."
verses.textEnNasb: but have returned and eaten bread and drunk water in the place of which He said to you, "You are not to eat bread nor drink water"; your dead body will not come to the grave of your fathers.’ "
verses.textEn: You came back and ate bread and drank water in the place where he told you not to eat or drink. Therefore your body will not be buried in the tomb of your ancestors.’ "

verses.textZh: 吃了饭喝了水之后，老先知为他带回来的先知备驴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃了饭喝了水之后，老先知为他带回来的先知备驴。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃喝完了，老先知为所带回来的先知备驴。
verses.textEnNiv: When the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the prophet who had brought him back saddled his donkey for him.
verses.textEnEsv: And after he had eaten bread and drunk, he saddled the donkey for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, after he had eaten bread and after he had drunk, that he saddled the donkey for him, the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.textEnNlt: After the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the old prophet saddled his own donkey for him,
verses.textEnNasb: It came about after he had eaten bread and after he had drunk, that he saddled the donkey for him, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.textEn: When the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the prophet who had brought him back saddled his donkey for him.

verses.textZh: 他就去了；在路上有一只狮子遇见了他，就把他咬死了。他的尸体被丢在路上，驴子站在尸体旁边，狮子也站在尸体旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就去了；在路上有一只狮子遇见了他，就把他咬死了。他的尸体被丢在路上，驴子站在尸体旁边，狮子也站在尸体旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就去了，在路上有个狮子遇见他，将他咬死，尸身倒在路上，驴站在尸身旁边，狮子也站在尸身旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him, and his body was left lying on the road, with both the donkey and the lion standing beside it.
verses.textEnEsv: And as he went away a lion met him on the road and killed him. And his body was thrown in the road, and the donkey stood beside it; the lion also stood beside the body.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he was gone, a lion met him on the road and killed him. And his corpse was thrown on the road, and the donkey stood by it. The lion also stood by the corpse.
verses.textEnNlt: and the man of God started off again. But as he was traveling along, a lion came out and killed him. His body lay there on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when he had gone, a lion met him on the way and killed him, and his body was thrown on the road, with the donkey standing beside it; the lion also was standing beside the body.
verses.textEn: As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him, and his body was left lying on the road, with both the donkey and the lion standing beside it.

verses.textZh: 有人从那里经过，看见尸体被丢在路上，狮子站在尸体旁边，就来到老先知所住的城里，述说这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人从那里经过，看见尸体被丢在路上，狮子站在尸体旁边，就来到老先知所住的城里，述说这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人从那里经过，看见尸身倒在路上，狮子站在尸身旁边，就来到老先知所住的城里述说这事。
verses.textEnNiv: Some people who passed by saw the body lying there, with the lion standing beside the body, and they went and reported it in the city where the old prophet lived.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown in the road and the lion standing by the body. And they came and told it in the city where the old prophet lived.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there, men passed by and saw the corpse thrown on the road, and the lion standing by the corpse. Then they went and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.textEnNlt: People who passed by saw the body lying in the road and the lion standing beside it, and they went and reported it in Bethel, where the old prophet lived.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, men passed by and saw the body thrown on the road, and the lion standing beside the body; so they came and told about it in the city where the old prophet had lived.
verses.textEn: Some people who passed by saw the body lying there, with the lion standing beside the body, and they went and reported it in the city where the old prophet lived.

verses.textZh: 那把神人从路上带回来的先知听见了这事，就说："这是那违背了耶和华命令的神人；耶和华把他交给狮子，狮子就把他撕裂，咬死了他，正如耶和华对他说过的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那把神人从路上带回来的先知听见了这事，就说："这是那违背了耶和华命令的神人；耶和华把他交给狮子，狮子就把他撕裂，咬死了他，正如耶和华对他说过的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那带神人回来的先知听见这事，就说：「这是那违背了耶和华命令的神人，所以耶和华把他交给狮子；狮子抓伤他，咬死他，是应验耶和华对他说的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard of it, he said, "It is the man of God who defied the word of the Lord . The Lord has given him over to the lion, which has mauled him and killed him, as the word of the Lord had warned him."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the prophet who had brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, "It is the man of God who disobeyed the word of the Lord ; therefore the Lord has given him to the lion, which has torn him and killed him, according to the word that the Lord spoke to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the prophet who had brought him back from the way heard it, he said, "It is the man of God who was disobedient to the word of the Lord. Therefore the Lord has delivered him to the lion, which has torn him and killed him, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke to him."
verses.textEnNlt: When the prophet heard the report, he said, "It is the man of God who disobeyed the Lord ’s command. The Lord has fulfilled his word by causing the lion to attack and kill him."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the prophet who had brought him back from the way heard about it, he said, "It is the man of God, who disobeyed the command of the Lord; therefore the Lord has given him to the lion, which has torn him and killed him, in accordance with the word of the Lord which He spoke to him."
verses.textEn: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard of it, he said, "It is the man of God who defied the word of the Lord . The Lord has given him over to the lion, which has mauled him and killed him, as the word of the Lord had warned him."

verses.textZh: 老先知又吩咐他的儿子们说："给我备驴。"他们就备了驴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 老先知又吩咐他的儿子们说："给我备驴。"他们就备了驴。
verses.textZhCuv: 老先知就吩咐他儿子们说：「你们为我备驴。」他们就备了驴。
verses.textEnNiv: The prophet said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me," and they did so.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." And they saddled it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he spoke to his sons, saying, "Saddle the donkey for me." So they saddled it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the prophet said to his sons, "Saddle a donkey for me." So they saddled a donkey,
verses.textEnNasb: Then he spoke to his sons, saying, "Saddle the donkey for me." And they saddled it.
verses.textEn: The prophet said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me," and they did so.

verses.textZh: 于是他去了，看见神人的尸体被丢在路上，驴子和狮子都站在尸体旁边，那狮子并没有吃掉尸体，也没有撕裂驴子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他去了，看见神人的尸体被丢在路上，驴子和狮子都站在尸体旁边，那狮子并没有吃掉尸体，也没有撕裂驴子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他去了，看见神人的尸身倒在路上，驴和狮子站在尸身旁边，狮子却没有吃尸身，也没有抓伤驴。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he went out and found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it. The lion had neither eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went and found his body thrown in the road, and the donkey and the lion standing beside the body. The lion had not eaten the body or torn the donkey.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went and found his corpse thrown on the road, and the donkey and the lion standing by the corpse. The lion had not eaten the corpse nor torn the donkey.
verses.textEnNlt: and he went out and found the body lying in the road. The donkey and lion were still standing there beside it, for the lion had not eaten the body nor attacked the donkey.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he went and found his body thrown on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside the body; the lion had not eaten the body nor harmed the donkey.
verses.textEn: Then he went out and found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it. The lion had neither eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

verses.textZh: 老先知把神人的尸体抱起来，放在驴子上，带回自己的城里，要为他举哀，要埋葬他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 老先知把神人的尸体抱起来，放在驴子上，带回自己的城里，要为他举哀，要埋葬他。
verses.textZhCuv: 老先知就把神人的尸身驮在驴上，带回自己的城里，要哀哭他，葬埋他；
verses.textEnNiv: So the prophet picked up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.
verses.textEnEsv: And the prophet took up the body of the man of God and laid it on the donkey and brought it back to the city to mourn and to bury him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the prophet took up the corpse of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back. So the old prophet came to the city to mourn, and to bury him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the prophet laid the body of the man of God on the donkey and took it back to the town to mourn over him and bury him.
verses.textEnNasb: So the prophet picked up the body of the man of God and laid it on the donkey and brought it back; and he came to the city of the old prophet to mourn and to bury him.
verses.textEn: So the prophet picked up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.

verses.textZh: 老先知把他的尸体埋葬在自己的坟墓里；人们为他举哀，说："哀哉，我兄啊！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 老先知把他的尸体埋葬在自己的坟墓里；人们为他举哀，说："哀哉，我兄啊！"
verses.textZhCuv: 就把他的尸身葬在自己的坟墓里，哀哭他，说：「哀哉！我兄啊。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he laid the body in his own tomb, and they mourned over him and said, "Alas, my brother!"
verses.textEnEsv: And he laid the body in his own grave. And they mourned over him, saying, "Alas, my brother!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he laid the corpse in his own tomb; and they mourned over him, saying, "Alas, my brother!"
verses.textEnNlt: He laid the body in his own grave, crying out in grief, "Oh, my brother!"
verses.textEnNasb: He laid his body in his own grave, and they mourned over him, saying, "Oh, my brother!"
verses.textEn: Then he laid the body in his own tomb, and they mourned over him and said, "Alas, my brother!"

verses.textZh: 埋葬他以后，老先知就对儿子们说："我死了以后，你们要把我埋葬在神人的坟墓里，把我的骸骨放在他的骸骨旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埋葬他以后，老先知就对儿子们说："我死了以后，你们要把我埋葬在神人的坟墓里，把我的骸骨放在他的骸骨旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 安葬之后，老先知对他儿子们说：「我死了，你们要葬我在神人的坟墓里，使我的尸骨靠近他的尸骨，
verses.textEnNiv: After burying him, he said to his sons, "When I die, bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.
verses.textEnEsv: And after he had buried him, he said to his sons, "When I die, bury me in the grave in which the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, after he had buried him, that he spoke to his sons, saying, "When I am dead, then bury me in the tomb where the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward the prophet said to his sons, "When I die, bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones.
verses.textEnNasb: And after he had buried him, he talked to his sons, saying, "When I die, bury me in the grave in which the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.
verses.textEn: After burying him, he said to his sons, "When I die, bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.

verses.textZh: 因为他奉耶和华的命令，攻击伯特利的坛和在撒玛利亚各城邱坛上的殿所喊叫的话，必定应验。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他奉耶和华的命令，攻击伯特利的坛和在撒玛利亚各城邱坛上的殿所喊叫的话，必定应验。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他奉耶和华的命指着伯特利的坛和撒马利亚各城有邱坛之殿所说的话必定应验。」
verses.textEnNiv: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true."
verses.textEnEsv: For the saying that he called out by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the houses of the high places that are in the cities of Samaria shall surely come to pass."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the saying which he cried out by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel, and against all the shrines on the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, will surely come to pass."
verses.textEnNlt: For the message the Lord told him to proclaim against the altar in Bethel and against the pagan shrines in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true."
verses.textEnNasb: For the thing will certainly come to pass which he cried out by the word of the Lord against the altar that is in Bethel, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria."
verses.textEn: For the message he declared by the word of the Lord against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true."

verses.textZh: 这事以后，耶罗波安还不从他的恶道转回，竟然把平民立为邱坛的祭司；愿意的，他都把他们分别为圣，立他们为邱坛的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，耶罗波安还不从他的恶道转回，竟然把平民立为邱坛的祭司；愿意的，他都把他们分别为圣，立他们为邱坛的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，耶罗波安仍不离开他的恶道，将凡民立为邱坛的祭司；凡愿意的，他都分别为圣，立为邱坛的祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: Even after this, Jeroboam did not change his evil ways, but once more appointed priests for the high places from all sorts of people. Anyone who wanted to become a priest he consecrated for the high places.
verses.textEnEsv: After this thing Jeroboam did not turn from his evil way, but made priests for the high places again from among all the people. Any who would, he ordained to be priests of the high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this event Jeroboam did not turn from his evil way, but again he made priests from every class of people for the high places; whoever wished, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.textEnNlt: But even after this, Jeroboam did not turn from his evil ways. He continued to choose priests from the common people. He appointed anyone who wanted to become a priest for the pagan shrines.
verses.textEnNasb: After this event, Jeroboam did not abandon his evil way, but he again appointed priests of the high places from all the people; anyone who wanted, he ordained, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.textEn: Even after this, Jeroboam did not change his evil ways, but once more appointed priests for the high places from all sorts of people. Anyone who wanted to become a priest he consecrated for the high places.

verses.textZh: 这事成为耶罗波安的家的罪，以致他的家从地上被涂抹与除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事成为耶罗波安的家的罪，以致他的家从地上被涂抹与除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事叫耶罗波安的家陷在罪里，甚至他的家从地上除灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: This was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its downfall and to its destruction from the face of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And this thing became sin to the house of Jeroboam, so as to cut it off and to destroy it from the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this thing was the sin of the house of Jeroboam, so as to exterminate and destroy it from the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: This became a great sin and resulted in the utter destruction of Jeroboam’s dynasty from the face of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: This event also became a sin of the house of Jeroboam, even to wipe it out and eliminate it from the face of the earth.
verses.textEn: This was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its downfall and to its destruction from the face of the earth.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶罗波安的儿子亚比雅病了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶罗波安的儿子亚比雅病了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，耶罗波安的儿子亚比雅病了。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became ill,
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time Jeroboam’s son Abijah became very sick.
verses.textEnNasb: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam became sick.
verses.textEn: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became ill,

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安对他的妻子说："你起来改装，使人认不出你是耶罗波安的妻子。到示罗去，有亚希雅先知在那里，他曾对我说，我必作这民的王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安对他的妻子说："你起来改装，使人认不出你是耶罗波安的妻子。到示罗去，有亚希雅先知在那里，他曾对我说，我必作这民的王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安对他的妻说：「你可以起来改装，使人不知道你是耶罗波安的妻，往示罗去，在那里有先知亚希雅。他曾告诉我说，你必作这民的王。
verses.textEnNiv: and Jeroboam said to his wife, "Go, disguise yourself, so you won’t be recognized as the wife of Jeroboam. Then go to Shiloh. Ahijah the prophet is there—the one who told me I would be king over this people.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jeroboam said to his wife, "Arise, and disguise yourself, that it not be known that you are the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said of me that I should be king over this people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jeroboam said to his wife, "Please arise, and disguise yourself, that they may not recognize you as the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh. Indeed, Ahijah the prophet is there, who told me that Iwouldbe king over this people.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jeroboam told his wife, "Disguise yourself so that no one will recognize you as my wife. Then go to the prophet Ahijah at Shiloh—the man who told me I would become king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jeroboam said to his wife, "Now arise and disguise yourself so that they will not know that you are the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh. Behold, Ahijah the prophet is there, who said regarding me that I would be king over this people.
verses.textEn: and Jeroboam said to his wife, "Go, disguise yourself, so you won’t be recognized as the wife of Jeroboam. Then go to Shiloh. Ahijah the prophet is there—the one who told me I would be king over this people.

verses.textZh: 你要带十个饼，一些饼干和一瓶蜜去见他，他会告诉你孩子将要怎样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要带十个饼，一些饼干和一瓶蜜去见他，他会告诉你孩子将要怎样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你要带十个饼，与几个薄饼，和一瓶蜜去见他，他必告诉你儿子将要怎样。」
verses.textEnNiv: Take ten loaves of bread with you, some cakes and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy."
verses.textEnEsv: Take with you ten loaves, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what shall happen to the child."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also take with you ten loaves, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him; he will tell you what will become of the child."
verses.textEnNlt: Take him a gift of ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and ask him what will happen to the boy."
verses.textEnNasb: Take ten loaves with you, some pastries, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy."
verses.textEn: Take ten loaves of bread with you, some cakes and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy."

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安的妻子就这样行了。她动身往示罗去，到了亚希雅的家；亚希雅因为年纪老迈，眼睛昏花，不能看见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安的妻子就这样行了。她动身往示罗去，到了亚希雅的家；亚希雅因为年纪老迈，眼睛昏花，不能看见。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安的妻就这样行，起身往示罗去，到了亚希雅的家。亚希雅因年纪老迈，眼目发直，不能看见。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jeroboam’s wife did what he said and went to Ahijah’s house in Shiloh. Now Ahijah could not see; his sight was gone because of his age.
verses.textEnEsv: Jeroboam’s wife did so. She arose and went to Shiloh and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were dim because of his age.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jeroboam’s wife did so; she arose and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see, for his eyes were glazed by reason of his age.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jeroboam’s wife went to Ahijah’s home at Shiloh. He was an old man now and could no longer see.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and set out and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah could not see because his eyes were glossy from his old age.
verses.textEn: So Jeroboam’s wife did what he said and went to Ahijah’s house in Shiloh. Now Ahijah could not see; his sight was gone because of his age.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚希雅说："看哪，耶罗波安的妻子要来向你求问关于她儿子的事，因为他病了。你要这样这样告诉她。她进来的时候，必装作别的妇人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚希雅说："看哪，耶罗波安的妻子要来向你求问关于她儿子的事，因为他病了。你要这样这样告诉她。她进来的时候，必装作别的妇人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华先晓谕亚希雅说：「耶罗波安的妻要来问你，因她儿子病了，你当如此如此告诉她。她进来的时候必装作别的妇人。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord had told Ahijah, "Jeroboam’s wife is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill, and you are to give her such and such an answer. When she arrives, she will pretend to be someone else."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to Ahijah, "Behold, the wife of Jeroboam is coming to inquire of you concerning her son, for he is sick. Thus and thus shall you say to her." When she came, she pretended to be another woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord had said to Ahijah, "Here is the wife of Jeroboam, coming to ask you something about her son, for he is sick. Thus and thus you shall say to her; for it will be, when she comes in, that she will pretend tobe another woman."
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord had told Ahijah, "Jeroboam’s wife will come here, pretending to be someone else. She will ask you about her son, for he is very sick. Give her the answer I give you."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord had said to Ahijah, "Behold, the wife of Jeroboam is coming to inquire of you about her son, because he is sick. You shall say such and such to her, for it will be when she arrives, that she is going to make herself unrecognizable."
verses.textEn: But the Lord had told Ahijah, "Jeroboam’s wife is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill, and you are to give her such and such an answer. When she arrives, she will pretend to be someone else."

verses.textZh: 她刚进门的时候，亚希雅就听见她的脚步声，就说："耶罗波安的妻子啊！进来吧！你为甚么要这样改装呢？我奉差派要把凶信告诉你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她刚进门的时候，亚希雅就听见她的脚步声，就说："耶罗波安的妻子啊！进来吧！你为甚么要这样改装呢？我奉差派要把凶信告诉你。
verses.textZhCuv: 她刚进门，亚希雅听见她脚步的响声，就说：「耶罗波安的妻，进来吧！你为何装作别的妇人呢？我奉差遣将凶事告诉你。
verses.textEnNiv: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her footsteps at the door, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why this pretense? I have been sent to you with bad news.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why do you pretend to be another? For I am charged with unbearable news for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when Ahijah heard the sound of her footsteps as she came through the door, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why do you pretend tobe another person? For I havebeen sent to you with bad news.
verses.textEnNlt: So when Ahijah heard her footsteps at the door, he called out, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam! Why are you pretending to be someone else?" Then he told her, "I have bad news for you.
verses.textEnNasb: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet coming in the doorway, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam; why do you make yourself unrecognizable? Nevertheless, I am sent to you with a harsh message.
verses.textEn: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her footsteps at the door, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why this pretense? I have been sent to you with bad news.

verses.textZh: 你去告诉耶罗波安：‘耶和华以色列的神这样说：我从人民中提拔了你，又立了你作治理我的子民以色列的领袖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你去告诉耶罗波安：‘耶和华以色列的神这样说：我从人民中提拔了你，又立了你作治理我的子民以色列的领袖。
verses.textZhCuv: 你回去告诉耶罗波安说：『耶和华－以色列的神如此说：我从民中将你高举，立你作我民以色列的君，
verses.textEnNiv: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I raised you up from among the people and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: "Because I exalted you from among the people and made you leader over my people Israel
