verses.textEnNkjv: Go, tell Jeroboam, ‘Thus says the Lord God of Israel: "Because I exalted you from among the people, and made you ruler over My people Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: Give your husband, Jeroboam, this message from the Lord , the God of Israel: ‘I promoted you from the ranks of the common people and made you ruler over my people Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Go, say to Jeroboam, ‘This is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: "Because I exalted you from among the people and made you leader over My people Israel,
verses.textEn: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘I raised you up from among the people and appointed you ruler over my people Israel.

verses.textZh: 我把国从大卫家夺过来，赏赐给你；你却不像我仆人大卫那样谨守我的诫命，一心跟从我，行我看为正的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把国从大卫家夺过来，赏赐给你；你却不像我仆人大卫那样谨守我的诫命，一心跟从我，行我看为正的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 将国从大卫家夺回赐给你；你却不效法我仆人大卫，遵守我的诫命，一心顺从我，行我眼中看为正的事。
verses.textEnNiv: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, but you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commands and followed me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: and tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, and yet you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commandments and followed me with all his heart, doing only that which was right in my eyes,
verses.textEnNkjv: and tore the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it to you; and yet you have not been as My servant David, who kept My commandments and who followed Me with all his heart, to do only whatwas right in My eyes;
verses.textEnNlt: I ripped the kingdom away from the family of David and gave it to you. But you have not been like my servant David, who obeyed my commands and followed me with all his heart and always did whatever I wanted.
verses.textEnNasb: and tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you—yet you have not been like My servant David, who kept My commandments and followed Me with all his heart, to do only that which was right in My sight;
verses.textEn: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, but you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commands and followed me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.

verses.textZh: 你反倒行恶，比那些在你以前的更坏；又去为自己制造了别的神和铸造偶像惹我发怒，把我丢在背后。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你反倒行恶，比那些在你以前的更坏；又去为自己制造了别的神和铸造偶像惹我发怒，把我丢在背后。
verses.textZhCuv: 你竟行恶，比那在你以先的更甚，为自己立了别神，铸了偶像，惹我发怒，将我丢在背后。
verses.textEnNiv: You have done more evil than all who lived before you. You have made for yourself other gods, idols made of metal; you have aroused my anger and turned your back on me.
verses.textEnEsv: but you have done evil above all who were before you and have gone and made for yourself other gods and metal images, provoking me to anger, and have cast me behind your back,
verses.textEnNkjv: but you have done more evil than all who were before you, for you have gone and made for yourself other gods and molded images to provoke Me to anger, and have cast Me behind your back—
verses.textEnNlt: You have done more evil than all who lived before you. You have made other gods for yourself and have made me furious with your gold calves. And since you have turned your back on me,
verses.textEnNasb: you also have done more evil than all who were before you, and you have gone and made for yourself other gods and cast metal images to provoke Me to anger, and have thrown Me behind your back—
verses.textEn: You have done more evil than all who lived before you. You have made for yourself other gods, idols made of metal; you have aroused my anger and turned your back on me.

verses.textZh: 因此，我必使灾祸临到耶罗波安的家；我必剪除以色列中所有属于耶罗波安的男丁，无论是自由的或是不自由的；我必铲除耶罗波安的家，像人扫除粪土一样，直到完全除尽为止。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我必使灾祸临到耶罗波安的家；我必剪除以色列中所有属于耶罗波安的男丁，无论是自由的或是不自由的；我必铲除耶罗波安的家，像人扫除粪土一样，直到完全除尽为止。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我必使灾祸临到耶罗波安的家，将属耶罗波安的男丁，无论困住的、自由的都从以色列中剪除，必除尽耶罗波安的家，如人除尽粪土一般。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘Because of this, I am going to bring disaster on the house of Jeroboam. I will cut off from Jeroboam every last male in Israel—slave or free. I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns dung, until it is all gone.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore behold, I will bring harm upon the house of Jeroboam and will cut off from Jeroboam every male, both bond and free in Israel, and will burn up the house of Jeroboam, as a man burns up dung until it is all gone.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore behold! I will bring disaster on the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam every male in Israel, bond and free; I will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as one takes away refuse until it is all gone.
verses.textEnNlt: I will bring disaster on your dynasty and will destroy every one of your male descendants, slave and free alike, anywhere in Israel. I will burn up your royal dynasty as one burns up trash until it is all gone.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore behold, I am bringing disaster on the house of Jeroboam, and I will eliminate from Jeroboam every male person, both bond and free in Israel, and I will make a clean sweep of the house of Jeroboam, just as one sweeps away dung until it is all gone.
verses.textEn: " ‘Because of this, I am going to bring disaster on the house of Jeroboam. I will cut off from Jeroboam every last male in Israel—slave or free. I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns dung, until it is all gone.

verses.textZh: 属于耶罗波安的人，死在城里的，必被狗吃掉；死在田野的，必给空中的飞鸟吃掉。因为这是耶和华说的。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 属于耶罗波安的人，死在城里的，必被狗吃掉；死在田野的，必给空中的飞鸟吃掉。因为这是耶和华说的。’
verses.textZhCuv: 凡属耶罗波安的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。这是耶和华说的。』
verses.textEnNiv: Dogs will eat those belonging to Jeroboam who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country. The Lord has spoken!’
verses.textEnEsv: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city the dogs shall eat, and anyone who dies in the open country the birds of the heavens shall eat, for the Lord has spoken it."’
verses.textEnNkjv: The dogs shall eat whoever belongs to Jeroboam and dies in the city, and the birds of the air shall eat whoever dies in the field; for the Lord has spoken!" ’
verses.textEnNlt: The members of Jeroboam’s family who die in the city will be eaten by dogs, and those who die in the field will be eaten by vultures. I, the Lord , have spoken.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city, the dogs will eat. And anyone who dies in the field, the birds of the sky will eat; for the Lord has spoken it." ’
verses.textEn: Dogs will eat those belonging to Jeroboam who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country. The Lord has spoken!’

verses.textZh: 所以你起来，回家去吧，你的脚一进城，你的孩子就必死亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你起来，回家去吧，你的脚一进城，你的孩子就必死亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以你起身回家去吧！你的脚一进城，你儿子就必死了。
verses.textEnNiv: "As for you, go back home. When you set foot in your city, the boy will die.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise therefore, go to your house. When your feet enter the city, the child shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise therefore, go to your own house. When your feet enter the city, the child shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ahijah said to Jeroboam’s wife, "Go on home, and when you enter the city, the child will die.
verses.textEnNasb: Now you, arise, go to your house. When your feet enter the city the child will die.
verses.textEn: "As for you, go back home. When you set foot in your city, the boy will die.

verses.textZh: 以色列众人要为他举哀，把他埋葬；属耶罗波安的人中，只有他可以入葬坟墓；因为在耶罗波安的家中，只有他向耶和华以色列的神显出善行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人要为他举哀，把他埋葬；属耶罗波安的人中，只有他可以入葬坟墓；因为在耶罗波安的家中，只有他向耶和华以色列的神显出善行。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人必为他哀哭，将他葬埋。凡属耶罗波安的人，惟有他得入坟墓；因为在耶罗波安的家中，只有他向耶和华－以色列的神显出善行。
verses.textEnNiv: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will be buried, because he is the only one in the house of Jeroboam in whom the Lord , the God of Israel, has found anything good.
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel shall mourn for him and bury him, for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found something pleasing to the Lord , the God of Israel, in the house of Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all Israel shall mourn for him and bury him, for he is the only one of Jeroboam who shall come to the grave, because in him there is found something good toward the Lord God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNlt: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only member of your family who will have a proper burial, for this child is the only good thing that the Lord , the God of Israel, sees in the entire family of Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all Israel will mourn for him and bury him, for he alone of Jeroboam’s family will come to the grave, because in him something good was found toward the Lord God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam.
verses.textEn: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will be buried, because he is the only one in the house of Jeroboam in whom the Lord , the God of Israel, has found anything good.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必为自己兴起一个王治理以色列，他必剪除耶罗波安家，今天就是时候了，就是现在！
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必为自己兴起一个王治理以色列，他必剪除耶罗波安家，今天就是时候了，就是现在！
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必另立一王治理以色列。到了日期，他必剪除耶罗波安的家；那日期已经到了。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord will raise up for himself a king over Israel who will cut off the family of Jeroboam. Even now this is beginning to happen.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the Lord will raise up for himself a king over Israel who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam today. And henceforth,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Moreover the Lord will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam; this is the day. What? Even now!
verses.textEnNlt: "In addition, the Lord will raise up a king over Israel who will destroy the family of Jeroboam. This will happen today, even now!
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the Lord will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who will eliminate the house of Jeroboam this day and from now on.
verses.textEn: "The Lord will raise up for himself a king over Israel who will cut off the family of Jeroboam. Even now this is beginning to happen.

verses.textZh: 耶和华必击打以色列人，他们就摆动，像芦苇在水中摆动一样。他要把以色列人从他赐给他们列祖的这块美地上拔出来，把他们分散在幼发拉底河那边，因为他们做了亚舍拉，惹耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必击打以色列人，他们就摆动，像芦苇在水中摆动一样。他要把以色列人从他赐给他们列祖的这块美地上拔出来，把他们分散在幼发拉底河那边，因为他们做了亚舍拉，惹耶和华发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必击打以色列人，使他们摇动，像水中的芦苇一般；又将他们从耶和华赐给他们列祖的美地上拔出来，分散在大河那边；因为他们做木偶，惹耶和华发怒。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord will strike Israel, so that it will be like a reed swaying in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that he gave to their ancestors and scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, because they aroused the Lord ’s anger by making Asherah poles.
verses.textEnEsv: the Lord will strike Israel as a reed is shaken in the water, and root up Israel out of this good land that he gave to their fathers and scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they have made their Asherim, provoking the Lord to anger.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Lord will strike Israel, as a reed is shaken in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land which He gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the River, because they have made their wooden images, provoking the Lord to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord will shake Israel like a reed whipped about in a stream. He will uproot the people of Israel from this good land that he gave their ancestors and will scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, for they have angered the Lord with the Asherah poles they have set up for worship.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the Lord will strike Israel, just as a reed sways in the water; and He will uproot Israel from this good land which He gave to their fathers, and will scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, because they have made their Asherim, provoking the Lord to anger.
verses.textEn: And the Lord will strike Israel, so that it will be like a reed swaying in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that he gave to their ancestors and scatter them beyond the Euphrates River, because they aroused the Lord ’s anger by making Asherah poles.

verses.textZh: 为了耶罗波安所犯的罪，又为了他使以色列人所犯的罪，耶和华必丢弃以色列人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了耶罗波安所犯的罪，又为了他使以色列人所犯的罪，耶和华必丢弃以色列人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶罗波安所犯的罪，又使以色列人陷在罪里，耶和华必将以色列人交给仇敌。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he will give Israel up because of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit."
verses.textEnEsv: And he will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he sinned and made Israel to sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who sinned and who made Israel sin."
verses.textEnNlt: He will abandon Israel because Jeroboam sinned and made Israel sin along with him."
verses.textEnNasb: He will give up Israel because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he committed and with which he misled Israel into sin."
verses.textEn: And he will give Israel up because of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit."

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安的妻子动身离去，回到得撒；她一踏进门槛，孩子就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安的妻子动身离去，回到得撒；她一踏进门槛，孩子就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安的妻起身回去，到了得撒，刚到门槛，儿子就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and left and went to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed and came to Tirzah. And as she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. When she came to the threshold of the house, the child died.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jeroboam’s wife returned to Tirzah, and the child died just as she walked through the door of her home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jeroboam’s wife arose and departed, and came to Tirzah. As she was entering the threshold of the house, the child died.
verses.textEn: Then Jeroboam’s wife got up and left and went to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.

verses.textZh: 以色列众人把他埋葬了，又为他举哀，好象耶和华借着他的仆人亚希雅先知所说的话一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人把他埋葬了，又为他举哀，好象耶和华借着他的仆人亚希雅先知所说的话一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人将他葬埋，为他哀哭，正如耶和华藉他仆人先知亚希雅所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, as the Lord had said through his servant the prophet Ahijah.
verses.textEnEsv: And all Israel buried him and mourned for him, according to the word of the Lord , which he spoke by his servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they buried him; and all Israel mourned for him, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke through His servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.textEnNlt: And all Israel buried him and mourned for him, as the Lord had promised through the prophet Ahijah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all Israel buried him and mourned for him, in accordance with the word of the Lord which He had spoken through His servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.textEn: They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, as the Lord had said through his servant the prophet Ahijah.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安其余的事迹，他怎样争战，怎样作王，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安其余的事迹，他怎样争战，怎样作王，都写在以色列诸王的年代志上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安其余的事，他怎样争战，怎样作王，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, his wars and how he ruled, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he made war and how he reigned, indeed they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jeroboam’s reign, including all his wars and how he ruled, are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he made war and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: The other events of Jeroboam’s reign, his wars and how he ruled, are written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel.

verses.textZh: 耶罗波安作王的日子共二十二年，就与他的列祖同睡。他的儿子拿答接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶罗波安作王的日子共二十二年，就与他的列祖同睡。他的儿子拿答接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶罗波安作王二十二年，就与他列祖同睡。他儿子拿答接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: He reigned for twenty-two years and then rested with his ancestors. And Nadab his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And the time that Jeroboam reigned was twenty-two years. And he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: The period that Jeroboam reigned was twenty-two years. So he rested with his fathers. Then Nadab his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Jeroboam reigned in Israel twenty-two years. When Jeroboam died, his son Nadab became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And the time that Jeroboam reigned was twenty-two years; and he lay down with his fathers, and his son Nadab reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: He reigned for twenty-two years and then rested with his ancestors. And Nadab his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 所罗门的儿子罗波安在犹大作王。他登基的时候，是四十一岁；他在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列各支派中所拣选，在那里立他名的城，作王十七年。他的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的儿子罗波安在犹大作王。他登基的时候，是四十一岁；他在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列各支派中所拣选，在那里立他名的城，作王十七年。他的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的儿子罗波安作犹大王。他登基的时候年四十一岁，在耶路撒冷，就是耶和华从以色列众支派中所选择立他名的城，作王十七年。罗波安的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。
verses.textEnNiv: Rehoboam son of Solomon was king in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king. He reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put His name there. His mother’s name was Naamah, an Ammonitess.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Rehoboam son of Solomon was king in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen from among all the tribes of Israel as the place to honor his name. Rehoboam’s mother was Naamah, an Ammonite woman.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which the Lord had chosen from all the tribes of Israel to put His name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
verses.textEn: Rehoboam son of Solomon was king in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.

verses.textZh: 犹大人行耶和华看为恶的事；他们所犯的罪，惹动他的妒忿比他们的列祖更厉害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大人行耶和华看为恶的事；他们所犯的罪，惹动他的妒忿比他们的列祖更厉害。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大人行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，犯罪触动他的愤恨，比他们列祖更甚。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah did evil in the eyes of the Lord . By the sins they committed they stirred up his jealous anger more than those who were before them had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins that they committed, more than all that their fathers had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Judah did evil in the sight of the Lord, and they provoked Him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, more than all that their fathers had done.
verses.textEnNlt: During Rehoboam’s reign, the people of Judah did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, provoking his anger with their sin, for it was even worse than that of their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people of Judah did evil in the sight of the Lord, and they provoked Him to jealousy with their sins which they committed, more than all that their fathers had done.
verses.textEn: Judah did evil in the eyes of the Lord . By the sins they committed they stirred up his jealous anger more than those who were before them had done.

verses.textZh: 他们又为自己在各高冈上，各茂盛树下建造邱坛、神柱和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又为自己在各高冈上，各茂盛树下建造邱坛、神柱和亚舍拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他们在各高冈上，各青翠树下筑坛，立柱像和木偶。
verses.textEnNiv: They also set up for themselves high places, sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.
verses.textEnEsv: For they also built for themselves high places and pillars and Asherim on every high hill and under every green tree,
verses.textEnNkjv: For they also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and wooden images on every high hill and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNlt: For they also built for themselves pagan shrines and set up sacred pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
verses.textEnNasb: For they, too, built for themselves high places, memorial stones, and Asherim on every high hill and under every luxuriant tree.
verses.textEn: They also set up for themselves high places, sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.

verses.textZh: 国内又有男妓，他们仿效耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的外族人，行了一切可憎的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 国内又有男妓，他们仿效耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的外族人，行了一切可憎的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 国中也有娈童。犹大人效法耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的外邦人，行一切可憎恶的事。
verses.textEnNiv: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land; the people engaged in all the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: and there were also male cult prostitutes in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations that the Lord drove out before the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there were also perverted persons in the land. They did according to all the abominations of the nations which the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: There were even male and female shrine prostitutes throughout the land. The people imitated the detestable practices of the pagan nations the Lord had driven from the land ahead of the Israelites.
verses.textEnNasb: There were also male cult prostitutes in the land. They committed all the same abominations of the nations which the Lord dispossessed before the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land; the people engaged in all the detestable practices of the nations the Lord had driven out before the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻打耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安王第五年，埃及王示撒上来攻取耶路撒冷，
verses.textEnNiv: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: It happened in the fifth year of King Rehoboam that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam’s reign, King Shishak of Egypt came up and attacked Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened in the fifth year of King Rehoboam, that Shishak the king of Egypt marched against Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 他夺去了耶和华的宝物和王宫的宝物，并且把所有的东西都夺去了；又把所罗门所做的一切金盾牌都夺了去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他夺去了耶和华的宝物和王宫的宝物，并且把所有的东西都夺去了；又把所罗门所做的一切金盾牌都夺了去。
verses.textZhCuv: 夺了耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物，尽都带走，又夺去所罗门制造的金盾牌。
verses.textEnNiv: He carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including all the gold shields Solomon had made.
verses.textEnEsv: He took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house. He took away everything. He also took away all the shields of gold that Solomon had made,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house; he took away everything. He also took away all the gold shields which Solomon had made.
verses.textEnNlt: He ransacked the treasuries of the Lord ’s Temple and the royal palace; he stole everything, including all the gold shields Solomon had made.
verses.textEnNasb: And he took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house, and he took everything; he even took all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.textEn: He carried off the treasures of the temple of the Lord and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including all the gold shields Solomon had made.

verses.textZh: 罗波安王做了铜盾牌代替那些金盾牌；交给看守宫门的卫兵队长看管。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安王做了铜盾牌代替那些金盾牌；交给看守宫门的卫兵队长看管。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安王制造铜盾牌代替那金盾牌，交给守王宫门的护卫长看守。
verses.textEnNiv: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.
verses.textEnEsv: and King Rehoboam made in their place shields of bronze, and committed them to the hands of the officers of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Rehoboam made bronze shields in their place, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who guarded the doorway of the king’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: King Rehoboam later replaced them with bronze shields as substitutes, and he entrusted them to the care of the commanders of the guard who protected the entrance to the royal palace.
verses.textEnNasb: So King Rehoboam made shields of bronze in their place, and entrusted them to the care of the commanders of the guard who guarded the doorway of the king’s house.
verses.textEn: So King Rehoboam made bronze shields to replace them and assigned these to the commanders of the guard on duty at the entrance to the royal palace.

verses.textZh: 王每次进耶和华殿的时候，卫兵就拿着这些盾牌，随后又把盾牌送回护卫室里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王每次进耶和华殿的时候，卫兵就拿着这些盾牌，随后又把盾牌送回护卫室里。
verses.textZhCuv: 王每逢进耶和华的殿，护卫兵就拿这盾牌，随后仍将盾牌送回，放在护卫房。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the king went to the Lord ’s temple, the guards bore the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.
verses.textEnEsv: And as often as the king went into the house of the Lord , the guard carried them and brought them back to the guardroom.
verses.textEnNkjv: And whenever the king entered the house of the Lord, the guards carried them, then brought them back into the guardroom.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the king went to the Temple of the Lord , the guards would also take the shields and then return them to the guardroom.
verses.textEnNasb: And it happened as often as the king entered the house of the Lord, that the guards would carry them and would bring them back into the guards’ room.
verses.textEn: Whenever the king went to the Lord ’s temple, the guards bore the shields, and afterward they returned them to the guardroom.

verses.textZh: 罗波安其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Rehoboam’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Rehoboam’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Rehoboam and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Rehoboam’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 罗波安与耶罗波安之间常有战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安与耶罗波安之间常有战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安与耶罗波安时常争战。
verses.textEnNiv: There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
verses.textEnNlt: There was constant war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.textEn: There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

verses.textZh: 罗波安与他的列祖同睡，与他的列祖一同埋葬在大卫的城里。他的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人；他的儿子亚比央接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗波安与他的列祖同睡，与他的列祖一同埋葬在大卫的城里。他的母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人；他的儿子亚比央接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他母亲名叫拿玛，是亚扪人。他儿子亚比央 接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: And Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite. And Abijam his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Rehoboam rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David. His mother’s name was Naamah, an Ammonitess. Then Abijam his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Rehoboam died, he was buried among his ancestors in the City of David. His mother was Naamah, an Ammonite woman. Then his son Abijam became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Rehoboam lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and his mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. And his son Abijam became king in his place.
verses.textEn: And Rehoboam rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the City of David. His mother’s name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安王第十八年，亚比央登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安王第十八年，亚比央登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼八的儿子耶罗波安王十八年，亚比央登基作犹大王，
verses.textEnNiv: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijah became king of Judah,
verses.textEnEsv: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam began to reign over Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam the son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Abijam began to rule over Judah in the eighteenth year of Jeroboam’s reign in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.
verses.textEn: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijah became king of Judah,

verses.textZh: 他在耶路撒冷作王三年，他的母亲名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在耶路撒冷作王三年，他的母亲名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷作王三年。他母亲名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.
verses.textEnEsv: He reigned for three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.textEnNkjv: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maachah the granddaughter of Abishalom.
verses.textEnNlt: He reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother was Maacah, the granddaughter of Absalom.
verses.textEnNasb: He reigned for three years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.textEn: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.

verses.textZh: 亚比央行他父亲在他以前所行的一切罪恶。他的心不完完全全归向耶和华他的神，像他先祖大卫的心一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比央行他父亲在他以前所行的一切罪恶。他的心不完完全全归向耶和华他的神，像他先祖大卫的心一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比央行他父亲在他以前所行的一切恶，他的心不像他祖大卫的心，诚诚实实地顺服耶和华－他的神。
verses.textEnNiv: He committed all the sins his father had done before him; his heart was not fully devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his forefather had been.
verses.textEnEsv: And he walked in all the sins that his father did before him, and his heart was not wholly true to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; his heart was not loyal to the Lord his God, as was the heart of his father David.
verses.textEnNlt: He committed the same sins as his father before him, and he was not faithful to the Lord his God, as his ancestor David had been.
verses.textEnNasb: He walked in all the sins of his father which he had committed before him; and his heart was not wholly devoted to the Lord his God, like the heart of his father David.
verses.textEn: He committed all the sins his father had done before him; his heart was not fully devoted to the Lord his God, as the heart of David his forefather had been.

verses.textZh: 然而，耶和华他的神却因大卫的缘故，使他在耶路撒冷仍然有灯光，兴起他的儿子接续他作王，并且坚立耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，耶和华他的神却因大卫的缘故，使他在耶路撒冷仍然有灯光，兴起他的儿子接续他作王，并且坚立耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而耶和华－他的神因大卫的缘故，仍使他在耶路撒冷有灯光，叫他儿子接续他作王，坚立耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, for David’s sake the Lord his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem by raising up a son to succeed him and by making Jerusalem strong.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, for David’s sake the Lord his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, setting up his son after him, and establishing Jerusalem,
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless for David’s sake the Lord his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, by setting up his son after him and by establishing Jerusalem;
verses.textEnNlt: But for David’s sake, the Lord his God allowed his descendants to continue ruling, shining like a lamp, and he gave Abijam a son to rule after him in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: But for David’s sake the Lord his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem, to raise up his son after him and to establish Jerusalem,
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, for David’s sake the Lord his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem by raising up a son to succeed him and by making Jerusalem strong.

verses.textZh: 因为除了赫人乌利亚那事以外，大卫都行耶和华看为正的事，一生之中从来没有偏离耶和华所吩咐他的一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为除了赫人乌利亚那事以外，大卫都行耶和华看为正的事，一生之中从来没有偏离耶和华所吩咐他的一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为大卫除 了赫人乌利亚那件事，都是行耶和 华眼中看为正的事，一生没有违背 耶和华一切所吩咐的。
verses.textEnNiv: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the Lord and had not failed to keep any of the Lord ’s commands all the days of his life—except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.textEnEsv: because David did what was right in the eyes of the Lord and did not turn aside from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.textEnNkjv: because David did whatwas right in the eyes of the Lord, and had not turned aside from anything that He commanded him all the days of his life, except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.textEnNlt: For David had done what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight and had obeyed the Lord ’s commands throughout his life, except in the affair concerning Uriah the Hittite.
verses.textEnNasb: because David did what was right in the sight of the Lord, and did not deviate from anything that He commanded him all the days of his life, except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.textEn: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the Lord and had not failed to keep any of the Lord ’s commands all the days of his life—except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.

verses.textZh: 亚比央一生的日子中，罗波安与耶罗波安之间常有战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比央一生的日子中，罗波安与耶罗波安之间常有战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗波安在 世的日子常与耶罗波安争战。
verses.textEnNiv: There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam throughout Abijah’s lifetime.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.textEnNlt: There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam throughout Abijam’s reign.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.textEn: There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam throughout Abijah’s lifetime.

verses.textZh: 亚比央其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？亚比央与耶罗波安之间常有战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比央其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？亚比央与耶罗波安之间常有战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比央其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。亚比央常与耶罗波安争战。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Abijah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnEsv: The rest of the acts of Abijam and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Abijam’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah. There was constant war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Abijam and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Abijah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

verses.textZh: 亚比央与他的列祖同睡，人们把他埋葬在大卫城里，他的儿子亚撒继承他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比央与他的列祖同睡，人们把他埋葬在大卫城里，他的儿子亚撒继承他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比央与他列祖同睡， 葬在大卫的城里。他儿子亚撒接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Asa his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abijam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David. And Asa his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abijam rested with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David. Then Asa his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abijam died, he was buried in the City of David. Then his son Asa became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Abijam lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David; and his son Asa became king in his place.
verses.textEn: And Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. And Asa his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 以色列王耶罗波安第二十年，亚撒登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王耶罗波安第二十年，亚撒登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王耶罗波安二十年，亚撒登基作犹大王，
verses.textEnNiv: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king of Judah,
verses.textEnEsv: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa began to reign over Judah,
verses.textEnNkjv: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king over Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: Asa began to rule over Judah in the twentieth year of Jeroboam’s reign in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So in the twentieth year of Jeroboam the king of Israel, Asa began to reign as king of Judah.
verses.textEn: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king of Judah,

verses.textZh: 他在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他的祖母名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他的祖母名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 在耶路撒冷作王四十一年。他祖母名叫玛迦，是押沙龙的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.
verses.textEnEsv: and he reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he reigned forty-one years in Jerusalem. His grandmother’s name was Maachah the granddaughter of Abishalom.
verses.textEnNlt: He reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother was Maacah, the granddaughter of Absalom.
verses.textEnNasb: He reigned for forty-one years in Jerusalem; and his mother’s name was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.textEn: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother’s name was Maakah daughter of Abishalom.

verses.textZh: 亚撒行耶和华看为正的事，像他祖大卫一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒行耶和华看为正的事，像他祖大卫一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒效法他祖大卫行耶和华眼中看为正的事，
verses.textEnNiv: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , as his father David had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , as David his father had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: Asa did whatwas right in the eyes of the Lord, as did his father David.
verses.textEnNlt: Asa did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight, as his ancestor David had done.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Asa did what was right in the sight of the Lord, like his father David.
verses.textEn: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord , as his father David had done.

verses.textZh: 他从国中除去庙妓，又除掉他列祖所做的一切偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从国中除去庙妓，又除掉他列祖所做的一切偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 从国中除去娈童，又除掉他列祖所造的一切偶像；
verses.textEnNiv: He expelled the male shrine prostitutes from the land and got rid of all the idols his ancestors had made.
verses.textEnEsv: He put away the male cult prostitutes out of the land and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he banished the perverted persons from the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
verses.textEnNlt: He banished the male and female shrine prostitutes from the land and got rid of all the idols his ancestors had made.
verses.textEnNasb: He also removed the male cult prostitutes from the land and removed all the idols which his fathers had made.
verses.textEn: He expelled the male shrine prostitutes from the land and got rid of all the idols his ancestors had made.

verses.textZh: 并且废除他祖母玛迦太后的后位，因为她为亚舍拉做了可怕的偶像。亚撒把她那可怕的偶像砍下来，在汲沦溪旁烧掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且废除他祖母玛迦太后的后位，因为她为亚舍拉做了可怕的偶像。亚撒把她那可怕的偶像砍下来，在汲沦溪旁烧掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且贬了他祖母玛迦太后的位，因她造了可憎的偶像亚舍拉。亚撒砍下她的偶像，烧在汲沦溪边，
verses.textEnNiv: He even deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnEsv: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen mother because she had made an abominable image for Asherah. And Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also he removed Maachah his grandmother from being queen mother, because she had made an obscene image of Asherah. And Asa cut down her obscene image and burned it by the Brook Kidron.
verses.textEnNlt: He even deposed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made an obscene Asherah pole. He cut down her obscene pole and burned it in the Kidron Valley.
verses.textEnNasb: And even his mother Maacah, he also removed her from the position of queen mother, because she had made an abominable image as an Asherah; and Asa cut down her abominable image and burned it at the brook Kidron.
verses.textEn: He even deposed his grandmother Maakah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive image for the worship of Asherah. Asa cut it down and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

verses.textZh: 只是邱坛还没有废去；不过亚撒一生都完完全全归向耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是邱坛还没有废去；不过亚撒一生都完完全全归向耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是邱坛还没有废去。亚撒一生却向耶和华存诚实的心。
verses.textEnNiv: Although he did not remove the high places, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the Lord all his life.
verses.textEnEsv: But the high places were not taken away. Nevertheless, the heart of Asa was wholly true to the Lord all his days.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the high places were not removed. Nevertheless Asa’s heart was loyal to the Lord all his days.
verses.textEnNlt: Although the pagan shrines were not removed, Asa’s heart remained completely faithful to the Lord throughout his life.
verses.textEnNasb: But the high places were not eliminated; nevertheless Asa’s heart was wholly devoted to the Lord all his days.
verses.textEn: Although he did not remove the high places, Asa’s heart was fully committed to the Lord all his life.

verses.textZh: 亚撒把他父亲所分别为圣和他自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿，都带到耶和华的殿里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒把他父亲所分别为圣和他自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿，都带到耶和华的殿里。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒将他父亲所分别为圣与自己所分别为圣的金银和器皿都奉到耶和华的殿里。
verses.textEnNiv: He brought into the temple of the Lord the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought into the house of the Lord the sacred gifts of his father and his own sacred gifts, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also brought into the house of the Lord the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which he himself had dedicated: silver and gold and utensils.
verses.textEnNlt: He brought into the Temple of the Lord the silver and gold and the various items that he and his father had dedicated.
verses.textEnNasb: And he brought into the house of the Lord the holy gifts of his father and his own holy gifts: silver, gold, and valuable utensils.
verses.textEn: He brought into the temple of the Lord the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.

verses.textZh: 亚撒与以色列王巴沙在世的日子，双方常有战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒与以色列王巴沙在世的日子，双方常有战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常争战。
verses.textEnNiv: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.textEnNlt: There was constant war between King Asa of Judah and King Baasha of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.textEn: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.

verses.textZh: 以色列王巴沙上来攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不准人进出到犹大王亚撒那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王巴沙上来攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不准人进出到犹大王亚撒那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王巴沙上来要攻击犹大，修筑拉玛，不许人从犹大王亚撒那里出入。
verses.textEnNiv: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEnEsv: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and built Ramah, that he might permit no one to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: King Baasha of Israel invaded Judah and fortified Ramah in order to prevent anyone from entering or leaving King Asa’s territory in Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Baasha king of Israel marched against Judah and fortified Ramah in order to prevent anyone from going out or coming in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.textEn: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

verses.textZh: 于是亚撒把耶和华殿和王宫的府库里所剩下的金银，都交在他臣仆的手中。亚撒王差派他们到大马士革的亚兰王，希旬的孙子、他伯利们的儿子便．哈达那里去，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚撒把耶和华殿和王宫的府库里所剩下的金银，都交在他臣仆的手中。亚撒王差派他们到大马士革的亚兰王，希旬的孙子、他伯利们的儿子便．哈达那里去，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚撒将耶和华殿和王宫府库里所剩下的金银都交在他臣仆手中，打发他们往住大马士革的亚兰王－希旬的孙子、他伯利们的儿子便‧哈达那里去，
verses.textEnNiv: Asa then took all the silver and gold that was left in the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple and of his own palace. He entrusted it to his officials and sent them to Ben-Hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house and gave them into the hands of his servants. And King Asa sent them to Ben-hadad the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who lived in Damascus, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Asa took all the silver and gold thatwas left in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and the treasuries of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants. And King Asa sent them to Ben-Hadad the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, who dwelt in Damascus, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Asa responded by removing all the silver and gold that was left in the treasuries of the Temple of the Lord and the royal palace. He sent it with some of his officials to Ben-hadad son of Tabrimmon, son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus, along with this message:
verses.textEnNasb: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that was left in the treasuries of the house of the Lord and the treasuries of the king’s house, and handed it over to his servants. And King Asa sent them to Ben-hadad the son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, king of Aram, who lived in Damascus, saying,
verses.textEn: Asa then took all the silver and gold that was left in the treasuries of the Lord ’s temple and of his own palace. He entrusted it to his officials and sent them to Ben-Hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.

verses.textZh: "你父与我父之间曾经立过约，我也要与你立约。现在我把金银送给你作礼物，请你去废除与以色列王巴沙所立的约，好使他离开我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你父与我父之间曾经立过约，我也要与你立约。现在我把金银送给你作礼物，请你去废除与以色列王巴沙所立的约，好使他离开我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「你父曾与我父立约，我与你也要立约。现在我将金银送你为礼物，求你废掉你与以色列王巴沙所立的约，使他离开我。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Let there be a treaty between me and you," he said, "as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you a gift of silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me."
verses.textEnEsv: "Let there be a covenant between me and you, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I am sending to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your covenant with Baasha king of Israel, that he may withdraw from me."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lettherebe a treaty between you and me, as there was between my father and your father. See, I have sent you a present of silver and gold. Come and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Let there be a treaty between you and me like the one between your father and my father. See, I am sending you a gift of silver and gold. Break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel so that he will leave me alone."
verses.textEnNasb: "Let’s make a treaty between you and me, as there was between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent you a gift of silver and gold; go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so that he will withdraw from me."
verses.textEn: "Let there be a treaty between me and you," he said, "as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you a gift of silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me."

verses.textZh: 便．哈达听从亚撒王的话，派遣他的众军长去攻击以色列的各城。他们攻破了以云、但、亚伯．伯．玛迦、基尼烈全境和拿弗他利全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．哈达听从亚撒王的话，派遣他的众军长去攻击以色列的各城。他们攻破了以云、但、亚伯．伯．玛迦、基尼烈全境和拿弗他利全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 便‧哈达听从亚撒王的话，派军长去攻击以色列的城邑；他们就攻破以云、但、亚伯‧伯‧玛迦、基尼烈全境、拿弗他利全境。
verses.textEnNiv: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. He conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maakah and all Kinnereth in addition to Naphtali.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel and conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ben-Hadad heeded King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel. He attacked Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maachah, and all Chinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-hadad agreed to King Asa’s request and sent the commanders of his army to attack the towns of Israel. They conquered the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and all Kinnereth, and all the land of Naphtali.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ben-hadad listened to King Asa and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel, and conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth, besides all the land of Naphtali.
verses.textEn: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. He conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maakah and all Kinnereth in addition to Naphtali.

verses.textZh: 巴沙听见了，就停止修筑拉玛，仍然留在得撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴沙听见了，就停止修筑拉玛，仍然留在得撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴沙听见，就停工不修筑拉玛了，仍住在得撒。
verses.textEnNiv: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and he lived in Tirzah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, when Baasha heard it, that he stopped building Ramah, and remained in Tirzah.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Baasha of Israel heard what was happening, he abandoned his project of fortifying Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.
verses.textEnNasb: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped fortifying Ramah and remained in Tirzah.
verses.textEn: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.

verses.textZh: 于是亚撒王通告犹大众人，没有一个人例外。他们就把巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头和木料运走；亚撒王用那些材料来修筑便雅悯的迦巴和米斯巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚撒王通告犹大众人，没有一个人例外。他们就把巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头和木料运走；亚撒王用那些材料来修筑便雅悯的迦巴和米斯巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚撒王宣告犹大众人，不准一个推辞，吩咐他们将巴沙修筑拉玛所用的石头、木头都运去，用以修筑便雅悯的迦巴和米斯巴。
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Asa issued an order to all Judah—no one was exempt—and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using there. With them King Asa built up Geba in Benjamin, and also Mizpah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah, none was exempt, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and its timber, with which Baasha had been building, and with them King Asa built Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted. And they took away the stones and timber of Ramah, which Baasha had used for building; and with them King Asa built Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Asa sent an order throughout Judah, requiring that everyone, without exception, help to carry away the building stones and timbers that Baasha had been using to fortify Ramah. Asa used these materials to fortify the town of Geba in Benjamin and the town of Mizpah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Asa made a proclamation to all Judah—no one was exempt—and they carried away the stones of Ramah and its timber with which Baasha had built fortifications. And King Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah.
verses.textEn: Then King Asa issued an order to all Judah—no one was exempt—and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using there. With them King Asa built up Geba in Benjamin, and also Mizpah.

verses.textZh: 亚撒其余的一切事迹，他的英勇事迹，他所行的一切和他所建造的众城，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？可是他年老的时候，脚上却患了病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒其余的一切事迹，他的英勇事迹，他所行的一切和他所建造的众城，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？可是他年老的时候，脚上却患了病。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒其余的事，凡他所行的，并他的勇力与他所建筑的城邑，都写在犹大列王记上。亚撒年老的时候，脚上有病。
verses.textEnNiv: As for all the other events of Asa’s reign, all his achievements, all he did and the cities he built, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? In his old age, however, his feet became diseased.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of all the acts of Asa, all his might, and all that he did, and the cities that he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? But in his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.textEnNkjv: The rest of all the acts of Asa, all his might, all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Asa’s reign—the extent of his power, everything he did, and the names of the cities he built—are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah. In his old age his feet became diseased.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of all the acts of Asa and all his might, and all that he did and the cities which he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah? But in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.textEn: As for all the other events of Asa’s reign, all his achievements, all he did and the cities he built, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? In his old age, however, his feet became diseased.

verses.textZh: 亚撒与他的列祖同睡，与他的列祖一同埋葬在他祖大卫的城里，他的儿子约沙法接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒与他的列祖同睡，与他的列祖一同埋葬在他祖大卫的城里，他的儿子约沙法接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约沙法接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Asa rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of his father David. And Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Asa slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father, and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Asa rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father. Then Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Asa died, he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Then Jehoshaphat, Asa’s son, became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Asa lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of his father David; and his son Jehoshaphat reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: Then Asa rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of his father David. And Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒第二年，耶罗波安的儿子拿答登基作以色列王；他作以色列王共二年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒第二年，耶罗波安的儿子拿答登基作以色列王；他作以色列王共二年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒第二年，耶罗波安的儿子拿答登基作以色列王共二年，
verses.textEnNiv: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
verses.textEnEsv: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Nadab the son of Jeroboam became king over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
verses.textEnNlt: Nadab son of Jeroboam began to rule over Israel in the second year of King Asa’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Israel two years.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Nadab the son of Jeroboam became king over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel for two years.
verses.textEn: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.

verses.textZh: 拿答行耶和华看为恶的事，跟随他父亲的路，犯他父亲使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿答行耶和华看为恶的事，跟随他父亲的路，犯他父亲使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿答行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行他父亲所行的，犯他父亲使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the ways of his father and committing the same sin his father had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin which he made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin by which he had made Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight and followed the example of his father, continuing the sins that Jeroboam had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father and in his sin into which he misled Israel.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the ways of his father and committing the same sin his father had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textZh: 以萨迦家族亚希雅的儿子巴沙密谋背叛拿答。拿答和以色列众人正在围攻非利士地的基比顿的时候，巴沙在基比顿把拿答杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以萨迦家族亚希雅的儿子巴沙密谋背叛拿答。拿答和以色列众人正在围攻非利士地的基比顿的时候，巴沙在基比顿把拿答杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以萨迦人亚希雅的儿子巴沙背叛拿答，在非利士的基比顿杀了他。那时拿答和以色列众人正围困基比顿。
verses.textEnNiv: Baasha son of Ahijah from the tribe of Issachar plotted against him, and he struck him down at Gibbethon, a Philistine town, while Nadab and all Israel were besieging it.
verses.textEnEsv: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him. And Baasha struck him down at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines, for Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to Gibbethon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him. And Baasha killed him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines, while Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Baasha son of Ahijah, from the tribe of Issachar, plotted against Nadab and assassinated him while he and the Israelite army were laying siege to the Philistine town of Gibbethon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Baasha the son of Ahijah of the house of Issachar conspired against him, and Baasha struck and killed him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines, while Nadab and all Israel were laying siege to Gibbethon.
verses.textEn: Baasha son of Ahijah from the tribe of Issachar plotted against him, and he struck him down at Gibbethon, a Philistine town, while Nadab and all Israel were besieging it.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒第三年，巴沙杀死了拿答接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒第三年，巴沙杀死了拿答接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 在犹大王亚撒第三年巴沙杀了他，篡了他的位。
verses.textEnNiv: Baasha killed Nadab in the third year of Asa king of Judah and succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: So Baasha killed him in the third year of Asa king of Judah and reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Baasha killed him in the third year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Baasha killed Nadab in the third year of King Asa’s reign in Judah, and he became the next king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Baasha killed him in the third year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
verses.textEn: Baasha killed Nadab in the third year of Asa king of Judah and succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 巴沙一作王，就击杀了耶罗波安的全家。凡有气息的，他都没有留下一个，直到灭尽了，正如耶和华借着他的仆人示罗人亚希雅所说的话一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴沙一作王，就击杀了耶罗波安的全家。凡有气息的，他都没有留下一个，直到灭尽了，正如耶和华借着他的仆人示罗人亚希雅所说的话一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴沙一作王就杀了耶罗波安的全家，凡有气息的没有留下一个，都灭尽了，正应验耶和华藉他仆人示罗人亚希雅所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as he began to reign, he killed Jeroboam’s whole family. He did not leave Jeroboam anyone that breathed, but destroyed them all, according to the word of the Lord given through his servant Ahijah the Shilonite.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as he was king, he killed all the house of Jeroboam. He left to the house of Jeroboam not one that breathed, until he had destroyed it, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was so, when he became king, that he killed all the house of Jeroboam. He did not leave to Jeroboam anyone that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according to the word of the Lord which He had spoken by His servant Ahijah the Shilonite,
verses.textEnNlt: He immediately slaughtered all the descendants of King Jeroboam, so that not one of the royal family was left, just as the Lord had promised concerning Jeroboam by the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh.
verses.textEnNasb: And as soon as he was king, he struck and killed all the household of Jeroboam. He did not leave Jeroboam any persons alive, but kept killing until he had eliminated them, in accordance with the word of the Lord which He spoke by His servant Ahijah the Shilonite,
verses.textEn: As soon as he began to reign, he killed Jeroboam’s whole family. He did not leave Jeroboam anyone that breathed, but destroyed them all, according to the word of the Lord given through his servant Ahijah the Shilonite.

verses.textZh: 这是因为耶罗波安所犯的罪，和他使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪，又因为他惹动耶和华以色列的神的怒气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为耶罗波安所犯的罪，和他使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪，又因为他惹动耶和华以色列的神的怒气。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是因为耶罗波安所犯的罪使以色列人陷在罪里，惹动耶和华－以色列神的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: This happened because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: It was for the sins of Jeroboam that he sinned and that he made Israel to sin, and because of the anger to which he provoked the Lord , the God of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he had sinned and by which he had made Israel sin, because of his provocation with which he had provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger.
verses.textEnNlt: This was done because Jeroboam had provoked the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by the sins he had committed and the sins he had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: and because of the sins of Jeroboam which he committed, and into which he misled Israel, because of his provocation with which he provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger.
verses.textEn: This happened because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel.

verses.textZh: 拿答其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿答其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 拿答其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Nadab’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Nadab’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Nadab and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Nadab’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 亚撒与以色列王巴沙在世的日子，双方常常有争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚撒与以色列王巴沙在世的日子，双方常常有争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚撒和以色列王巴沙在世的日子常常争战。
verses.textEnNiv: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.textEnNlt: There was constant war between King Asa of Judah and King Baasha of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.textEn: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒第三年，亚希雅的儿子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列的王，共二十四年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒第三年，亚希雅的儿子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列的王，共二十四年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒第三年，亚希雅的儿子巴沙在得撒登基作以色列众人的王共二十四年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned twenty-four years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah began to reign over all Israel at Tirzah, and he reigned twenty-four years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah became king over all Israel in Tirzah, and reigned twenty-four years.
verses.textEnNlt: Baasha son of Ahijah began to rule over all Israel in the third year of King Asa’s reign in Judah. Baasha reigned in Tirzah twenty-four years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha the son of Ahijah became king over all Israel at Tirzah, and he reigned for twenty-four years.
verses.textEn: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned twenty-four years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，行耶罗波安的路，犯了耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，行耶罗波安的路，犯了耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行耶罗波安所行的道，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord and walked in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin which he made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin by which he had made Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight and followed the example of Jeroboam, continuing the sins that Jeroboam had led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: And he did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin into which he misled Israel.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu the son of Hanani, against Baasha, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: This message from the Lord was delivered to King Baasha by the prophet Jehu son of Hanani:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Jehu son of Hanani concerning Baasha:

verses.textZh: "我既然从尘埃中高举了你，立你作我的子民以色列的领袖；然而，你却走耶罗波安的路，使我的子民以色列犯罪，因他们的罪惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我既然从尘埃中高举了你，立你作我的子民以色列的领袖；然而，你却走耶罗波安的路，使我的子民以色列犯罪，因他们的罪惹我发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我既从尘埃中提拔你，立你作我民以色列的君，你竟行耶罗波安所行的道，使我民以色列陷在罪里，惹我发怒，
verses.textEnNiv: "I lifted you up from the dust and appointed you ruler over my people Israel, but you followed the ways of Jeroboam and caused my people Israel to sin and to arouse my anger by their sins.
verses.textEnEsv: "Since I exalted you out of the dust and made you leader over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, provoking me to anger with their sins,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Inasmuch as I lifted you out of the dust and made you ruler over My people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam, and have made My people Israel sin, to provoke Me to anger with their sins,
verses.textEnNlt: "I lifted you out of the dust to make you ruler of my people Israel, but you have followed the evil example of Jeroboam. You have provoked my anger by causing my people Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNasb: "Since I exalted you from the dust and made you leader over My people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have misled My people Israel into sin, provoking Me to anger with their sins,
verses.textEn: "I lifted you up from the dust and appointed you ruler over my people Israel, but you followed the ways of Jeroboam and caused my people Israel to sin and to arouse my anger by their sins.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我要除灭巴沙和他的家；我要使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我要除灭巴沙和他的家；我要使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必除尽你和你的家，使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家一样。
verses.textEnNiv: So I am about to wipe out Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
verses.textEnEsv: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEnNkjv: surely I will take away the posterity of Baasha and the posterity of his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEnNlt: So now I will destroy you and your family, just as I destroyed the descendants of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
verses.textEnNasb: behold, I am going to burn Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.textEn: So I am about to wipe out Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

verses.textZh: 属巴沙的人，死在城里的，必被狗吃掉；死在田野的，必被空中的飞鸟吃掉。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 属巴沙的人，死在城里的，必被狗吃掉；死在田野的，必被空中的飞鸟吃掉。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡属巴沙的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。」
verses.textEnNiv: Dogs will eat those belonging to Baasha who die in the city, and birds will feed on those who die in the country."
verses.textEnEsv: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city the dogs shall eat, and anyone of his who dies in the field the birds of the heavens shall eat."
verses.textEnNkjv: The dogs shall eat whoever belongs to Baasha and dies in the city, and the birds of the air shall eat whoever dies in the fields."
verses.textEnNlt: The members of Baasha’s family who die in the city will be eaten by dogs, and those who die in the field will be eaten by vultures."
verses.textEnNasb: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city, the dogs will eat; and anyone belonging to him who dies in the field, the birds of the sky will eat."
verses.textEn: Dogs will eat those belonging to Baasha who die in the city, and birds will feed on those who die in the country."

verses.textZh: 巴沙其余的事迹，他所行的，以及他的英勇事迹，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴沙其余的事迹，他所行的，以及他的英勇事迹，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 巴沙其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Baasha’s reign, what he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Baasha’s reign and the extent of his power are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Baasha and what he did and his might, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Baasha’s reign, what he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 巴沙与他的列祖同睡，埋葬在得撒；他的儿子以拉接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴沙与他的列祖同睡，埋葬在得撒；他的儿子以拉接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴沙与他列祖同睡，葬在得撒。他儿子以拉接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Baasha rested with his ancestors and was buried in Tirzah. And Elah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Baasha slept with his fathers and was buried at Tirzah, and Elah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Baasha rested with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. Then Elah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Baasha died, he was buried in Tirzah. Then his son Elah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Baasha lay down with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Baasha rested with his ancestors and was buried in Tirzah. And Elah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 再者，耶和华的话借着哈尼拿的儿子耶户先知指责巴沙和他的家，是因为他像耶罗波安的家一样，行了耶和华看为恶的事，以他手所作的惹耶和华发怒，又因为他击杀了耶罗波安的家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 再者，耶和华的话借着哈尼拿的儿子耶户先知指责巴沙和他的家，是因为他像耶罗波安的家一样，行了耶和华看为恶的事，以他手所作的惹耶和华发怒，又因为他击杀了耶罗波安的家。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到哈拿尼的儿子先知耶户，责备巴沙和他的家，因他行耶和华眼中看为恶的一切事，以他手所做的惹耶和华发怒，像耶罗波安的家一样，又因他杀了耶罗波安的全家。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani to Baasha and his house, because of all the evil he had done in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger by the things he did, becoming like the house of Jeroboam—and also because he destroyed it.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, the word of the Lord came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord , provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and also because he destroyed it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And also the word of the Lord came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and his house, because of all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord in provoking Him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he killed them.
verses.textEnNlt: The message from the Lord against Baasha and his family came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani. It was delivered because Baasha had done what was evil in the Lord ’s sight (just as the family of Jeroboam had done), and also because Baasha had destroyed the family of Jeroboam. The Lord ’s anger was provoked by Baasha’s sins.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the word of the Lord through the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came against Baasha and his household, both because of all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord, provoking Him to anger with the work of his hands, by being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck it.
verses.textEn: Moreover, the word of the Lord came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani to Baasha and his house, because of all the evil he had done in the eyes of the Lord , arousing his anger by the things he did, becoming like the house of Jeroboam—and also because he destroyed it.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒第二十六年，巴沙的儿子以拉在得撒登基作以色列的王，共二年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒第二十六年，巴沙的儿子以拉在得撒登基作以色列的王，共二年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒二十六年，巴沙的儿子以拉在得撒登基作以色列王共二年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah two years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned two years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha became king over Israel, andreigned two years in Tirzah.
verses.textEnNlt: Elah son of Baasha began to rule over Israel in the twenty-sixth year of King Asa’s reign in Judah. He reigned in the city of Tirzah for two years.
verses.textEnNasb: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha became king over Israel at Tirzah, and reigned for two years.
verses.textEn: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah two years.

verses.textZh: 他的臣仆心利，就是统率他一半战车的军长，密谋背叛他。那时他在得撒，在管理得撒王家的亚杂的家喝醉了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的臣仆心利，就是统率他一半战车的军长，密谋背叛他。那时他在得撒，在管理得撒王家的亚杂的家喝醉了，
verses.textZhCuv: 有管理他一半战车的臣子心利背叛他。当他在得撒家宰亚杂家里喝醉的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: Zimri, one of his officials, who had command of half his chariots, plotted against him. Elah was in Tirzah at the time, getting drunk in the home of Arza, the palace administrator at Tirzah.
verses.textEnEsv: But his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against him. When he was at Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against him as he was in Tirzah drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, steward of his house in Tirzah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zimri, who commanded half of the royal chariots, made plans to kill him. One day in Tirzah, Elah was getting drunk at the home of Arza, the supervisor of the palace.
verses.textEnNasb: And his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now Elah was in Tirzah drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was in charge of the household in Tirzah.
verses.textEn: Zimri, one of his officials, who had command of half his chariots, plotted against him. Elah was in Tirzah at the time, getting drunk in the home of Arza, the palace administrator at Tirzah.

verses.textZh: 心利就进去击打他，把他杀死了，接续他作王，这事发生在犹大王亚撒第二十七年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心利就进去击打他，把他杀死了，接续他作王，这事发生在犹大王亚撒第二十七年。
verses.textZhCuv: 心利就进去杀了他，篡了他的位。这是犹大王亚撒二十七年的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Zimri came in, struck him down and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah. Then he succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Zimri came in and struck him down and killed him, in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Zimri walked in and struck him down and killed him. This happened in the twenty-seventh year of King Asa’s reign in Judah. Then Zimri became the next king.
