verses.textEnNasb: Then Zimri came in and struck him and put him to death in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and he became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Zimri came in, struck him down and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah. Then he succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 心利一登基，坐了王位以后，就把巴沙的全家击杀了；连他的亲属和朋友，也没有留下一个男子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心利一登基，坐了王位以后，就把巴沙的全家击杀了；连他的亲属和朋友，也没有留下一个男子。
verses.textZhCuv: 心利一坐王位就杀了巴沙的全家，连他的亲属、朋友也没有留下一个男丁。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as he began to reign and was seated on the throne, he killed off Baasha’s whole family. He did not spare a single male, whether relative or friend.
verses.textEnEsv: When he began to reign, as soon as he had seated himself on his throne, he struck down all the house of Baasha. He did not leave him a single male of his relatives or his friends.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he was seated on his throne, that he killed all the household of Baasha; he did not leave him one male, neither of his relatives nor of his friends.
verses.textEnNlt: Zimri immediately killed the entire royal family of Baasha, leaving him not even a single male child. He even destroyed distant relatives and friends.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he became king, as soon as he sat on his throne, he killed all the household of Baasha; he did not leave a single male alive, either of his relatives or of his friends.
verses.textEn: As soon as he began to reign and was seated on the throne, he killed off Baasha’s whole family. He did not spare a single male, whether relative or friend.

verses.textZh: 心利这样灭绝巴沙的全家，是照着耶和华藉耶户先知责备巴沙所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心利这样灭绝巴沙的全家，是照着耶和华藉耶户先知责备巴沙所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 心利这样灭绝巴沙的全家，正如耶和华藉先知耶户责备巴沙的话。
verses.textEnNiv: So Zimri destroyed the whole family of Baasha, in accordance with the word of the Lord spoken against Baasha through the prophet Jehu—
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the Lord , which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Zimri destroyed all the household of Baasha, according to the word of the Lord, which He spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
verses.textEnNlt: So Zimri destroyed the dynasty of Baasha as the Lord had promised through the prophet Jehu.
verses.textEnNasb: So Zimri eliminated all the household of Baasha, in accordance with the word of the Lord which He spoke against Baasha through Jehu the prophet,
verses.textEn: So Zimri destroyed the whole family of Baasha, in accordance with the word of the Lord spoken against Baasha through the prophet Jehu—

verses.textZh: 这是因为巴沙和他的儿子以拉的一切罪，就是他们自己所犯，又使以色列人陷在罪中的那些罪，以虚无的神惹耶和华以色列的神发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为巴沙和他的儿子以拉的一切罪，就是他们自己所犯，又使以色列人陷在罪中的那些罪，以虚无的神惹耶和华以色列的神发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是因巴沙和他儿子以拉的一切罪，就是他们使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，以虚无的神惹耶和华－以色列神的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.
verses.textEnEsv: for all the sins of Baasha and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and which they made Israel to sin, provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: for all the sins of Baasha and the sins of Elah his son, by which they had sinned and by which they had made Israel sin, in provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their idols.
verses.textEnNlt: This happened because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed, and because of the sins they led Israel to commit. They provoked the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, with their worthless idols.
verses.textEnNasb: for all the sins of Baasha and the sins of his son Elah, which they committed and into which they misled Israel, provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their idols.
verses.textEn: because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.

verses.textZh: 以拉其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 以拉其余的事迹和他所行的一切，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 以拉其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Elah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Elah and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Elah’s reign and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Elah and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Elah’s reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒第二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那时，众人正在安营围攻非利士的基比顿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒第二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那时，众人正在安营围攻非利士的基比顿。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒二十七年，心利在得撒作王七日。那时民正安营围攻非利士的基比顿。
verses.textEnNiv: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned in Tirzah seven days. The army was encamped near Gibbethon, a Philistine town.
verses.textEnEsv: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the troops were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines,
verses.textEnNkjv: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri had reigned in Tirzah seven days. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: Zimri began to rule over Israel in the twenty-seventh year of King Asa’s reign in Judah, but his reign in Tirzah lasted only seven days. The army of Israel was then attacking the Philistine town of Gibbethon.
verses.textEnNasb: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned for seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were camped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.textEn: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned in Tirzah seven days. The army was encamped near Gibbethon, a Philistine town.

verses.textZh: 正在安营的众人听说："心利已经密谋背叛，又击杀了王。"于是以色列众人在那一天，就在营中立了军长暗利作以色列王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正在安营的众人听说："心利已经密谋背叛，又击杀了王。"于是以色列众人在那一天，就在营中立了军长暗利作以色列王。
verses.textZhCuv: 民在营中听说心利背叛，又杀了王，故此以色列众人当日在营中立元帅暗利作以色列王。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Israelites in the camp heard that Zimri had plotted against the king and murdered him, they proclaimed Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that very day there in the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: and the troops who were encamped heard it said, "Zimri has conspired, and he has killed the king." Therefore all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the people whowere encamped heard it said, "Zimri has conspired and also has killed the king." So all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: When they heard that Zimri had committed treason and had assassinated the king, that very day they chose Omri, commander of the army, as the new king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And the people who were camped heard it being said, "Zimri has conspired and has also struck and killed the king!" Therefore all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
verses.textEn: When the Israelites in the camp heard that Zimri had plotted against the king and murdered him, they proclaimed Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that very day there in the camp.

verses.textZh: 暗利和与他在一起的众人，从基比顿上去，围攻得撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗利和与他在一起的众人，从基比顿上去，围攻得撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗利率领以色列众人，从基比顿上去，围困得撒。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Omri and all the Israelites with him withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to Tirzah.
verses.textEnEsv: So Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Omri and all Israel with him went up from Gibbethon, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Omri led the entire army of Israel up from Gibbethon to attack Tirzah, Israel’s capital.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Omri and all Israel with him went up from Gibbethon and besieged Tirzah.
verses.textEn: Then Omri and all the Israelites with him withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to Tirzah.

verses.textZh: 心利看见城被攻占，就走进了王宫的城堡里，放火焚烧王宫，自焚而死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 心利看见城被攻占，就走进了王宫的城堡里，放火焚烧王宫，自焚而死。
verses.textZhCuv: 心利见城破失，就进了王宫的卫所，放火焚烧宫殿，自焚而死。
verses.textEnNiv: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the royal palace and set the palace on fire around him. So he died,
verses.textEnEsv: And when Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire and died,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the citadel of the king’s house and burned the king’s house down upon himself with fire, and died,
verses.textEnNlt: When Zimri saw that the city had been taken, he went into the citadel of the palace and burned it down over himself and died in the flames.
verses.textEnNasb: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over himself with fire, and died,
verses.textEn: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the royal palace and set the palace on fire around him. So he died,

verses.textZh: 这是因为他所犯的罪，行耶和华看为恶的事，走耶罗波安的路，犯了他使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为他所犯的罪，行耶和华看为恶的事，走耶罗波安的路，犯了他使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是因他犯罪，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，行耶罗波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
verses.textEnNiv: because of the sins he had committed, doing evil in the eyes of the Lord and following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.
verses.textEnEsv: because of his sins that he committed, doing evil in the sight of the Lord , walking in the way of Jeroboam, and for his sin which he committed, making Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: because of the sins which he had committed in doing evil in the sight of the Lord, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he had committed to make Israel sin.
verses.textEnNlt: For he, too, had done what was evil in the Lord ’s sight. He followed the example of Jeroboam in all the sins he had committed and led Israel to commit.
verses.textEnNasb: because of his sins which he committed, doing evil in the sight of the Lord, walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he committed, misleading Israel into sin.
verses.textEn: because of the sins he had committed, doing evil in the eyes of the Lord and following the ways of Jeroboam and committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

verses.textZh: 心利其余的事迹和他密谋背叛的事，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 心利其余的事迹和他密谋背叛的事，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 心利其余的事和他背叛的情形都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Zimri’s reign, and the rebellion he carried out, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and the conspiracy that he made, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and the treason he committed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Zimri’s reign and his conspiracy are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Zimri and his conspiracy which he carried out, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Zimri’s reign, and the rebellion he carried out, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 那时，以色列人分成两半：一半跟从基纳的儿子提比尼，要立他作王；一半跟从暗利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以色列人分成两半：一半跟从基纳的儿子提比尼，要立他作王；一半跟从暗利。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，以色列民分为两半：一半随从基纳的儿子提比尼，要立他作 王；一半随从暗利。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the people of Israel were split into two factions; half supported Tibni son of Ginath for king, and the other half supported Omri.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts. Half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
verses.textEnNlt: But now the people of Israel were split into two factions. Half the people tried to make Tibni son of Ginath their king, while the other half supported Omri.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; the other half followed Omri.
verses.textEn: Then the people of Israel were split into two factions; half supported Tibni son of Ginath for king, and the other half supported Omri.

verses.textZh: 跟从暗利的人胜过了跟从基纳的儿子提比尼的人。提比尼死了以后，暗利就作了王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟从暗利的人胜过了跟从基纳的儿子提比尼的人。提比尼死了以后，暗利就作了王。
verses.textZhCuv: 但随从暗利的民胜过随从基纳的儿子提比尼的民。提比尼死了，暗利就作了王。
verses.textEnNiv: But Omri’s followers proved stronger than those of Tibni son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri became king.
verses.textEnEsv: But the people who followed Omri overcame the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath. So Tibni died, and Omri became king.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the people who followed Omri prevailed over the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri reigned.
verses.textEnNlt: But Omri’s supporters defeated the supporters of Tibni. So Tibni was killed, and Omri became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: But the people who followed Omri prevailed over the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath. And Tibni died and Omri became king.
verses.textEn: But Omri’s followers proved stronger than those of Tibni son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri became king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒第三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年，在得撒作王六年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒第三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年，在得撒作王六年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒三十一年，暗利登基作以色列王共十二年；在得撒作王六年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel, and he reigned for twelve years; six years he reigned in Tirzah.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king over Israel, andreigned twelve years. Six years he reigned in Tirzah.
verses.textEnNlt: Omri began to rule over Israel in the thirty-first year of King Asa’s reign in Judah. He reigned twelve years in all, six of them in Tirzah.
verses.textEnNasb: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king over Israel and reigned for twelve years; he reigned for six years at Tirzah.
verses.textEn: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.

verses.textZh: 暗利用六十公斤银子，向撒玛购买了撒玛利亚山。他在山上建造一城，按山的原主撒玛的名，给他所建造的城起名叫撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗利用六十公斤银子，向撒玛购买了撒玛利亚山。他在山上建造一城，按山的原主撒玛的名，给他所建造的城起名叫撒玛利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗利用二他连得银子向撒玛买了撒马利亚山，在山上造城，就按着山的原主撒玛的名，给所造的城起名叫撒马利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city on the hill, calling it Samaria, after Shemer, the name of the former owner of the hill.
verses.textEnEsv: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver, and he fortified the hill and called the name of the city that he built Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver; then he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Omri bought the hill now known as Samaria from its owner, Shemer, for 150 pounds of silver. He built a city on it and called the city Samaria in honor of Shemer.
verses.textEnNasb: And he purchased the hill Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and named the city which he built Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.
verses.textEn: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city on the hill, calling it Samaria, after Shemer, the name of the former owner of the hill.

verses.textZh: 暗利行耶和华看为恶的事，比他以前所有的王更厉害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗利行耶和华看为恶的事，比他以前所有的王更厉害。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗利行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，比他以前的列王作恶更甚。
verses.textEnNiv: But Omri did evil in the eyes of the Lord and sinned more than all those before him.
verses.textEnEsv: Omri did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , and did more evil than all who were before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Omri did evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did worse than all who were before him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Omri did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, even more than any of the kings before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord, and acted more wickedly than all who were before him.
verses.textEn: But Omri did evil in the eyes of the Lord and sinned more than all those before him.

verses.textZh: 他行尼八的儿子耶罗波安的一切路，犯了耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪；以他们虚无的神惹耶和华以色列的神发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行尼八的儿子耶罗波安的一切路，犯了耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪中的那罪；以他们虚无的神惹耶和华以色列的神发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 因他行了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所行的，犯他使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，以虚无的神惹耶和华－以色列神的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: He followed completely the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.
verses.textEnEsv: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in the sins that he made Israel to sin, provoking the Lord , the God of Israel, to anger by their idols.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he walked in all the ways of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin by which he had made Israel sin, provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their idols.
verses.textEnNlt: He followed the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat in all the sins he had committed and led Israel to commit. The people provoked the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, with their worthless idols.
verses.textEnNasb: For he walked entirely in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat and in his sins into which he misled Israel, provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their idols.
verses.textEn: He followed completely the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, committing the same sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit, so that they aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, by their worthless idols.

verses.textZh: 暗利其余的事迹，他所行的和他所表现的英勇事迹，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗利其余的事迹，他所行的和他所表现的英勇事迹，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 暗利其余的事和他所显出的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Omri’s reign, what he did and the things he achieved, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Omri that he did, and the might that he showed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and the might that he showed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Omri’s reign, the extent of his power, and everything he did are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Omri which he did and his might which he displayed, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Omri’s reign, what he did and the things he achieved, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 暗利与他的列祖同睡，埋葬在撒玛利亚。他的儿子亚哈接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗利与他的列祖同睡，埋葬在撒玛利亚。他的儿子亚哈接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗利与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子亚哈接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Omri rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Ahab his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Omri slept with his fathers and was buried in Samaria, and Ahab his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Omri rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria. Then Ahab his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Omri died, he was buried in Samaria. Then his son Ahab became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Omri lay down with his fathers and was buried in Samaria; and his son Ahab became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Omri rested with his ancestors and was buried in Samaria. And Ahab his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王亚撒第三十八年，暗利的儿子亚哈登基作以色列王。暗利的儿子亚哈在撒玛利亚作以色列王，共二十二年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚撒第三十八年，暗利的儿子亚哈登基作以色列王。暗利的儿子亚哈在撒玛利亚作以色列王，共二十二年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王亚撒三十八年，暗利的儿子亚哈登基作了以色列王。暗利的儿子亚哈在撒马利亚作以色列王二十二年。
verses.textEnNiv: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria over Israel twenty-two years.
verses.textEnEsv: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel, and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri became king over Israel; and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahab son of Omri began to rule over Israel in the thirty-eighth year of King Asa’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria twenty-two years.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ahab the son of Omri became king over Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria for twenty-two years.
verses.textEn: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria over Israel twenty-two years.

verses.textZh: 暗利的儿子亚哈行耶和华看为恶的事，比他以前所有的王更厉害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 暗利的儿子亚哈行耶和华看为恶的事，比他以前所有的王更厉害。
verses.textZhCuv: 暗利的儿子亚哈行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，比他以前的列王更甚，
verses.textEnNiv: Ahab son of Omri did more evil in the eyes of the Lord than any of those before him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord , more than all who were before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord, more than all who were before him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Ahab son of Omri did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, even more than any of the kings before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord more than all who were before him.
verses.textEn: Ahab son of Omri did more evil in the eyes of the Lord than any of those before him.

verses.textZh: 亚哈犯了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所犯的罪，还以为是小事。他又娶了西顿王谒巴力的女儿耶洗别作妻子，去服事巴力，敬拜巴力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈犯了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所犯的罪，还以为是小事。他又娶了西顿王谒巴力的女儿耶洗别作妻子，去服事巴力，敬拜巴力。
verses.textZhCuv: 犯了尼八的儿子耶罗波安所犯的罪；他还以为轻，又娶了西顿王谒巴力的女儿耶洗别为妻，去事奉敬拜巴力，
verses.textEnNiv: He not only considered it trivial to commit the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, but he also married Jezebel daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and began to serve Baal and worship him.
verses.textEnEsv: And as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took for his wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, as though it had been a trivial thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal, king of the Sidonians; and he went and served Baal and worshiped him.
verses.textEnNlt: And as though it were not enough to follow the sinful example of Jeroboam, he married Jezebel, the daughter of King Ethbaal of the Sidonians, and he began to bow down in worship of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: And as though it had been a trivial thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he married Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshiped him.
verses.textEn: He not only considered it trivial to commit the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, but he also married Jezebel daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and began to serve Baal and worship him.

verses.textZh: 他在撒玛利亚建筑巴力庙，又在庙里为巴力立了一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在撒玛利亚建筑巴力庙，又在庙里为巴力立了一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 在撒马利亚建造巴力的庙，在庙里为巴力筑坛。
verses.textEnNiv: He set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he built in Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: He erected an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he built in Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: First Ahab built a temple and an altar for Baal in Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: So he erected an altar for Baal at the house of Baal, which he built in Samaria.
verses.textEn: He set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he built in Samaria.

verses.textZh: 亚哈又做了亚舍拉，亚哈所行的，惹耶和华以色列的神发怒，比他以前所有的以色列王更厉害。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈又做了亚舍拉，亚哈所行的，惹耶和华以色列的神发怒，比他以前所有的以色列王更厉害。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈又做亚舍拉，他所行的惹耶和华－以色列神的怒气，比他以前的以色列诸王更甚。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahab also made an Asherah pole and did more to arouse the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, than did all the kings of Israel before him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahab made an Asherah. Ahab did more to provoke the Lord , the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ahab made a wooden image. Ahab did more to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he set up an Asherah pole. He did more to provoke the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, than any of the other kings of Israel before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahab also made the Asherah. So Ahab did more to provoke the Lord God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.
verses.textEn: Ahab also made an Asherah pole and did more to arouse the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, than did all the kings of Israel before him.

verses.textZh: 亚哈在位的日子，伯特利人希伊勒重建耶利哥城。他立城的根基的时候，死了长子亚比兰，安放城门的时候，丧了幼子西割，正如耶和华借着嫩的儿子约书亚所说的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈在位的日子，伯特利人希伊勒重建耶利哥城。他立城的根基的时候，死了长子亚比兰，安放城门的时候，丧了幼子西割，正如耶和华借着嫩的儿子约书亚所说的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈在位的时候，有伯特利人希伊勒重修耶利哥城；立根基的时候，丧了长子亚比兰；安门的时候，丧了幼子西割，正如耶和华藉嫩的儿子约书亚所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: In Ahab’s time, Hiel of Bethel rebuilt Jericho. He laid its foundations at the cost of his firstborn son Abiram, and he set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, in accordance with the word of the Lord spoken by Joshua son of Nun.
verses.textEnEsv: In his days Hiel of Bethel built Jericho. He laid its foundation at the cost of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the Lord , which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEnNkjv: In his days Hiel of Bethel built Jericho. He laid its foundation with Abiram his firstborn, and with his youngest son Segub he set up its gates, according to the word of the Lord, which He had spoken through Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEnNlt: It was during his reign that Hiel, a man from Bethel, rebuilt Jericho. When he laid its foundations, it cost him the life of his oldest son, Abiram. And when he completed it and set up its gates, it cost him the life of his youngest son, Segub. This all happened according to the message from the Lord concerning Jericho spoken by Joshua son of Nun.
verses.textEnNasb: In his days Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho; he laid its foundations with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, in accordance with the word of the Lord, which He spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.textEn: In Ahab’s time, Hiel of Bethel rebuilt Jericho. He laid its foundations at the cost of his firstborn son Abiram, and he set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, in accordance with the word of the Lord spoken by Joshua son of Nun.

verses.textZh: 提斯比人以利亚，就是从基列的提斯比来的 ，对亚哈说："我指着我所事奉永活的耶和华以色列的神起誓，这几年若是没有我的命令，天必不降露，也不下雨。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 提斯比人以利亚，就是从基列的提斯比来的 ，对亚哈说："我指着我所事奉永活的耶和华以色列的神起誓，这几年若是没有我的命令，天必不降露，也不下雨。"
verses.textZhCuv: 基列寄居的提斯比人以利亚对亚哈说：「我指着所事奉永生耶和华－以色列的神起誓，这几年我若不祷告，必不降露，不下雨。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Elijah the Tishbite, from Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, whom I serve, there will be neither dew nor rain in the next few years except at my word."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Elijah the Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there shall be neither dew nor rain these years, except by my word."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elijah the Tishbite, of the inhabitants of Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the Lord God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, except at my word."
verses.textEnNlt: Now Elijah, who was from Tishbe in Gilead, told King Ahab, "As surely as the Lord , the God of Israel, lives—the God I serve—there will be no dew or rain during the next few years until I give the word!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the Lord, the God of Israel lives, before whom I stand, there shall certainly be neither dew nor rain during these years, except by my word."
verses.textEn: Now Elijah the Tishbite, from Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the Lord , the God of Israel, lives, whom I serve, there will be neither dew nor rain in the next few years except at my word."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到以利亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到以利亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到以利亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to him:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Elijah,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah:

verses.textZh: "你离开这里，向东方去，躲藏在约旦河东面的基立溪旁。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你离开这里，向东方去，躲藏在约旦河东面的基立溪旁。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你离开这里往东去，藏在约旦河东边的基立溪旁。
verses.textEnNiv: "Leave here, turn eastward and hide in the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan.
verses.textEnEsv: "Depart from here and turn eastward and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Get away from here and turn eastward, and hide by the Brook Cherith, which flows into the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go to the east and hide by Kerith Brook, near where it enters the Jordan River.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go away from here and turn eastward, and hide yourself by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
verses.textEn: "Leave here, turn eastward and hide in the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan.

verses.textZh: 你要喝那溪里的水，我已经吩咐乌鸦在那里供养你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要喝那溪里的水，我已经吩咐乌鸦在那里供养你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要喝那溪里的水，我已吩咐乌鸦在那里供养你。」
verses.textEnNiv: You will drink from the brook, and I have directed the ravens to supply you with food there."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it will be that you shall drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there."
verses.textEnNlt: Drink from the brook and eat what the ravens bring you, for I have commanded them to bring you food."
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall be that you will drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to provide food for you there."
verses.textEn: You will drink from the brook, and I have directed the ravens to supply you with food there."

verses.textZh: 于是以利亚去了，照着耶和华的话行了；他去住在约旦河东面的基立溪旁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以利亚去了，照着耶和华的话行了；他去住在约旦河东面的基立溪旁。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以利亚照着耶和华的话，去住在约旦河东的基立溪旁。
verses.textEnNiv: So he did what the Lord had told him. He went to the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan, and stayed there.
verses.textEnEsv: So he went and did according to the word of the Lord . He went and lived by the brook Cherith that is east of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went and did according to the word of the Lord, for he went and stayed by the Brook Cherith, which flows into the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: So Elijah did as the Lord told him and camped beside Kerith Brook, east of the Jordan.
verses.textEnNasb: So he went and did everything according to the word of the Lord, for he went and lived by the brook Cherith, which is east of the Jordan.
verses.textEn: So he did what the Lord had told him. He went to the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan, and stayed there.

verses.textZh: 乌鸦早晨给他送饼和肉来，晚上也送饼和肉来，他也喝那溪里的水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 乌鸦早晨给他送饼和肉来，晚上也送饼和肉来，他也喝那溪里的水。
verses.textZhCuv: 乌鸦早晚给他叼饼和肉来，他也喝那溪里的水。
verses.textEnNiv: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the brook.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the brook.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
verses.textEnNlt: The ravens brought him bread and meat each morning and evening, and he drank from the brook.
verses.textEnNasb: And the ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening, and he would drink from the brook.
verses.textEn: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the brook.

verses.textZh: 过了一些日子，那溪就干了，因为没有雨下在地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了一些日子，那溪就干了，因为没有雨下在地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了些日子，溪水就干了，因为雨没有下在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And after a while the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened after a while that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: But after a while the brook dried up, for there was no rainfall anywhere in the land.
verses.textEnNasb: But it happened after a while that the brook dried up, because there was no rain in the land.
verses.textEn: Some time later the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到以利亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到以利亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到他说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to him:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Elijah,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to him:

verses.textZh: "你起来，往西顿的撒勒法去，住在那里；我已经吩咐那里的一个寡妇供养你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你起来，往西顿的撒勒法去，住在那里；我已经吩咐那里的一个寡妇供养你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你起身往西顿的撒勒法 去，住在那里；我已吩咐那里的一个寡妇供养你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go at once to Zarephath in the region of Sidon and stay there. I have directed a widow there to supply you with food."
verses.textEnEsv: "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and dwell there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to feed you."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and dwell there. See, I have commanded a widow there to provide for you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and live in the village of Zarephath, near the city of Sidon. I have instructed a widow there to feed you."
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there; behold, I have commanded a widow there to provide food for you."
verses.textEn: "Go at once to Zarephath in the region of Sidon and stay there. I have directed a widow there to supply you with food."

verses.textZh: 于是以利亚起来，往撒勒法去了；他来到城门口的时候，就看见一个寡妇在那里捡柴；以利亚呼叫她，说："请你用器皿取点水来给我！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以利亚起来，往撒勒法去了；他来到城门口的时候，就看见一个寡妇在那里捡柴；以利亚呼叫她，说："请你用器皿取点水来给我！"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚就起身往撒勒法去。到了城门，见有一个寡妇在那里捡柴，以利亚呼叫她说：「求你用器皿取点水来给我喝。」
verses.textEnNiv: So he went to Zarephath. When he came to the town gate, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and asked, "Would you bring me a little water in a jar so I may have a drink?"
verses.textEnEsv: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, "Bring me a little water in a vessel, that I may drink."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, indeed a widow was there gathering sticks. And he called to her and said, "Please bring me a little water in a cup, that I may drink."
verses.textEnNlt: So he went to Zarephath. As he arrived at the gates of the village, he saw a widow gathering sticks, and he asked her, "Would you please bring me a little water in a cup?"
verses.textEnNasb: So he arose and went to Zarephath, and when he came to the entrance of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks; and he called to her and said, "Please get me a little water in a cup, so that I may drink."
verses.textEn: So he went to Zarephath. When he came to the town gate, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and asked, "Would you bring me a little water in a jar so I may have a drink?"

verses.textZh: 她去取水的时候，以利亚又叫她，说："请你也给我拿点饼来！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她去取水的时候，以利亚又叫她，说："请你也给我拿点饼来！"
verses.textZhCuv: 她去取水的时候，以利亚又呼叫她说：「也求你拿点饼来给我！」
verses.textEnNiv: As she was going to get it, he called, "And bring me, please, a piece of bread."
verses.textEnEsv: And as she was going to bring it, he called to her and said, "Bring me a morsel of bread in your hand."
verses.textEnNkjv: And as she was going to get it, he called to her and said, "Please bring me a morsel of bread in your hand."
verses.textEnNlt: As she was going to get it, he called to her, "Bring me a bite of bread, too."
verses.textEnNasb: As she was going to get it, he called to her and said, "Please bring me a piece of bread in your hand."
verses.textEn: As she was going to get it, he called, "And bring me, please, a piece of bread."

verses.textZh: 她说："我指着永活的耶和华你的神起誓，我没有饼，缸里只有一把面粉，瓶里只有一点油。你看我正在捡两根柴，然后回去，为自己和儿子做饼，我们吃完了，就等死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她说："我指着永活的耶和华你的神起誓，我没有饼，缸里只有一把面粉，瓶里只有一点油。你看我正在捡两根柴，然后回去，为自己和儿子做饼，我们吃完了，就等死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 她说：「我指着永生耶和华－你的神起誓，我没有饼，坛内只有一把面，瓶里只有一点油；我现在找两根柴，回家要为我和我儿子做饼；我们吃了，死就死吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: "As surely as the Lord your God lives," she replied, "I don’t have any bread—only a handful of flour in a jar and a little olive oil in a jug. I am gathering a few sticks to take home and make a meal for myself and my son, that we may eat it—and die."
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "As the Lord your God lives, I have nothing baked, only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. And now I am gathering a couple of sticks that I may go in and prepare it for myself and my son, that we may eat it and die."
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said, "As the Lord your God lives, I do not have bread, only a handful of flour in a bin, and a little oil in a jar; and see, I am gathering a couple of sticks that I may go in and prepare it for myself and my son, that we may eat it, and die."
verses.textEnNlt: But she said, "I swear by the Lord your God that I don’t have a single piece of bread in the house. And I have only a handful of flour left in the jar and a little cooking oil in the bottom of the jug. I was just gathering a few sticks to cook this last meal, and then my son and I will die."
verses.textEnNasb: But she said, "As the Lord your God lives, I have no food, only a handful of flour in the bowl and a little oil in the jar; and behold, I am gathering a few sticks so that I may go in and prepare it for me and my son, so that we may eat it and die."
verses.textEn: "As surely as the Lord your God lives," she replied, "I don’t have any bread—only a handful of flour in a jar and a little olive oil in a jug. I am gathering a few sticks to take home and make a meal for myself and my son, that we may eat it—and die."

verses.textZh: 以利亚对她说："不要惧怕，照着你所说的去作吧，不过要先为我做一个小饼，拿出来给我，然后才为你自己和儿子做饼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对她说："不要惧怕，照着你所说的去作吧，不过要先为我做一个小饼，拿出来给我，然后才为你自己和儿子做饼。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对她说：「不要惧怕！可以照你所说的去做吧！只要先为我做一个小饼拿来给我，然后为你和你的儿子做饼。
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah said to her, "Don’t be afraid. Go home and do as you have said. But first make a small loaf of bread for me from what you have and bring it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elijah said to her, "Do not fear; go and do as you have said. But first make me a little cake of it and bring it to me, and afterward make something for yourself and your son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elijah said to her, "Do not fear; go and do as you have said, but make me a small cake from it first, and bring it to me; and afterward make some for yourself and your son.
verses.textEnNlt: But Elijah said to her, "Don’t be afraid! Go ahead and do just what you’ve said, but make a little bread for me first. Then use what’s left to prepare a meal for yourself and your son.
verses.textEnNasb: However, Elijah said to her, "Do not fear; go, do as you have said. Just make me a little bread loaf from it first and bring it out to me, and afterward you may make one for yourself and for your son.
verses.textEn: Elijah said to her, "Don’t be afraid. Go home and do as you have said. But first make a small loaf of bread for me from what you have and bring it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘缸里的面粉必不会用完，瓶里的油决不会短缺，直等到耶和华降雨在地面上的日子。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华以色列的神这样说：‘缸里的面粉必不会用完，瓶里的油决不会短缺，直等到耶和华降雨在地面上的日子。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华－以色列的神如此说：坛内的面必不减少，瓶里的油必不缺短，直到耶和华使雨降在地上的日子。」
verses.textEnNiv: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be used up and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the Lord sends rain on the land.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: For thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, ‘The jar of flour shall not be spent, and the jug of oil shall not be empty, until the day that the Lord sends rain upon the earth.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For thus says the Lord God of Israel: ‘The bin of flour shall not be used up, nor shall the jar of oil run dry, until the day the Lord sends rain on the earth.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: There will always be flour and olive oil left in your containers until the time when the Lord sends rain and the crops grow again!"
verses.textEnNasb: For this is what the Lord, the God of Israel says: ‘The bowl of flour shall not be used up, nor shall the jar of oil become empty, until the day that the Lord provides rain on the face of the earth.’ "
verses.textEn: For this is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be used up and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the Lord sends rain on the land.’ "

verses.textZh: 她就去照着以利亚所说的作了。她和以利亚，以及她的家人，吃了许多日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她就去照着以利亚所说的作了。她和以利亚，以及她的家人，吃了许多日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人就照以利亚的话去行。她和她家中的人，并以利亚，吃了许多日子。
verses.textEnNiv: She went away and did as Elijah had told her. So there was food every day for Elijah and for the woman and her family.
verses.textEnEsv: And she went and did as Elijah said. And she and he and her household ate for many days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she went away and did according to the word of Elijah; and she and he and her household ate for many days.
verses.textEnNlt: So she did as Elijah said, and she and Elijah and her family continued to eat for many days.
verses.textEnNasb: So she went and did everything in accordance with the word of Elijah, and she and he and her household ate for many days.
verses.textEn: She went away and did as Elijah had told her. So there was food every day for Elijah and for the woman and her family.

verses.textZh: 缸里的面粉果然没有用完，瓶里的油也没有短缺，正像耶和华借着以利亚所说的话一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 缸里的面粉果然没有用完，瓶里的油也没有短缺，正像耶和华借着以利亚所说的话一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 坛内的面果不减少，瓶里的油也不缺短，正如耶和华藉以利亚所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: For the jar of flour was not used up and the jug of oil did not run dry, in keeping with the word of the Lord spoken by Elijah.
verses.textEnEsv: The jar of flour was not spent, neither did the jug of oil become empty, according to the word of the Lord that he spoke by Elijah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The bin of flour was not used up, nor did the jar of oil run dry, according to the word of the Lord which He spoke by Elijah.
verses.textEnNlt: There was always enough flour and olive oil left in the containers, just as the Lord had promised through Elijah.
verses.textEnNasb: The bowl of flour was not used up, nor did the jar of oil become empty, in accordance with the word of the Lord which He spoke through Elijah.
verses.textEn: For the jar of flour was not used up and the jug of oil did not run dry, in keeping with the word of the Lord spoken by Elijah.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，那妇人，就是那个家庭的女主人的儿子病了。他的病情十分严重，以致呼吸都停止了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，那妇人，就是那个家庭的女主人的儿子病了。他的病情十分严重，以致呼吸都停止了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，作那家主母的妇人，她儿子病了；病得甚重，以致身无气息。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later the son of the woman who owned the house became ill. He grew worse and worse, and finally stopped breathing.
verses.textEnEsv: After this the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became ill. And his illness was so severe that there was no breath left in him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened after these things that the son of the woman who owned the house became sick. And his sickness was so serious that there was no breath left in him.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later the woman’s son became sick. He grew worse and worse, and finally he died.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened after these things that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, became sick; and his condition became very grave, until at the end he was no longer breathing.
verses.textEn: Some time later the son of the woman who owned the house became ill. He grew worse and worse, and finally stopped breathing.

verses.textZh: 于是妇人对以利亚说："神人哪，我跟你有甚么关系呢？你竟到我这里来，使耶和华想起我的罪孽，杀死我的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是妇人对以利亚说："神人哪，我跟你有甚么关系呢？你竟到我这里来，使耶和华想起我的罪孽，杀死我的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人对以利亚说：「神人哪，我与你何干？你竟到我这里来，使神想念我的罪，以致我的儿子死呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: She said to Elijah, "What do you have against me, man of God? Did you come to remind me of my sin and kill my son?"
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to Elijah, "What have you against me, O man of God? You have come to me to bring my sin to remembrance and to cause the death of my son!"
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said to Elijah, "What have I to do with you, O man of God? Have you come to me to bring my sin to remembrance, and to kill my son?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then she said to Elijah, "O man of God, what have you done to me? Have you come here to point out my sins and kill my son?"
verses.textEnNasb: So she said to Elijah, " Why is my business any of yours, you man of God? Yet you have come to me to bring my wrongdoing to remembrance, and to put my son to death!"
verses.textEn: She said to Elijah, "What do you have against me, man of God? Did you come to remind me of my sin and kill my son?"

verses.textZh: 以利亚对她说："把你的儿子交给我吧！"以利亚就从她的怀中把孩子接过来，抱他上到自己所住的楼上去，放在自己的床上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对她说："把你的儿子交给我吧！"以利亚就从她的怀中把孩子接过来，抱他上到自己所住的楼上去，放在自己的床上。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对她说：「把你儿子交给我。」以利亚就从妇人怀中将孩子接过来，抱到他所住的楼中，放在自己的床上，
verses.textEnNiv: "Give me your son," Elijah replied. He took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his bed.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "Give me your son." And he took him from her arms and carried him up into the upper chamber where he lodged, and laid him on his own bed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to her, "Give me your son." So he took him out of her arms and carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his own bed.
verses.textEnNlt: But Elijah replied, "Give me your son." And he took the child’s body from her arms, carried him up the stairs to the room where he was staying, and laid the body on his bed.
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to her, "Give me your son." Then he took him from her arms and carried him up to the upstairs room where he was living, and laid him on his own bed.
verses.textEn: "Give me your son," Elijah replied. He took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his bed.

verses.textZh: 以利亚呼求耶和华说："耶和华我的神啊，我寄居在这寡妇的家里，你也降祸与她，使她的儿子死去吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚呼求耶和华说："耶和华我的神啊，我寄居在这寡妇的家里，你也降祸与她，使她的儿子死去吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 就求告耶和华说：「耶和华－我的神啊，我寄居在这寡妇的家里，你就降祸与她，使她的儿子死了吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he cried out to the Lord , " Lord my God, have you brought tragedy even on this widow I am staying with, by causing her son to die?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he cried to the Lord , "O Lord my God, have you brought calamity even upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by killing her son?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he cried out to the Lord and said, "O Lord my God, have You also brought tragedy on the widow with whom I lodge, by killing her son?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah cried out to the Lord , "O Lord my God, why have you brought tragedy to this widow who has opened her home to me, causing her son to die?"
verses.textEnNasb: And he called to the Lord and said, "Lord, my God, have You also brought catastrophe upon the widow with whom I am staying, by causing her son to die?"
verses.textEn: Then he cried out to the Lord , " Lord my God, have you brought tragedy even on this widow I am staying with, by causing her son to die?"

verses.textZh: 然后，以利亚三次伏在孩子的身上，向耶和华呼求说："耶和华我的神，求你恢复这孩子的生命吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，以利亚三次伏在孩子的身上，向耶和华呼求说："耶和华我的神，求你恢复这孩子的生命吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚三次伏在孩子的身上，求告耶和华说：「耶和华－我的神啊，求你使这孩子的灵魂仍入他的身体！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he stretched himself out on the boy three times and cried out to the Lord , " Lord my God, let this boy’s life return to him!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then he stretched himself upon the child three times and cried to the Lord , "O Lord my God, let this child’s life come into him again."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he stretched himself out on the child three times, and cried out to the Lord and said, "O Lord my God, I pray, let this child’s soul come back to him."
verses.textEnNlt: And he stretched himself out over the child three times and cried out to the Lord , "O Lord my God, please let this child’s life return to him."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he stretched himself out over the boy three times, and called to the Lord and said, "Lord, my God, please, let this boy’s life return to him."
verses.textEn: Then he stretched himself out on the boy three times and cried out to the Lord , " Lord my God, let this boy’s life return to him!"

verses.textZh: 耶和华垂听了以利亚的话，孩子的生命果然恢复，活过来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华垂听了以利亚的话，孩子的生命果然恢复，活过来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华应允以利亚的话，孩子的灵魂仍入他的身体，他就活了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord heard Elijah’s cry, and the boy’s life returned to him, and he lived.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord listened to the voice of Elijah. And the life of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came back to him, and he revived.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord heard Elijah’s prayer, and the life of the child returned, and he revived!
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord listened to the voice of Elijah, and the life of the boy returned to him and he revived.
verses.textEn: The Lord heard Elijah’s cry, and the boy’s life returned to him, and he lived.

verses.textZh: 以利亚把孩子抱起来，从楼上下到屋子里去，把孩子交给他的母亲；以利亚说："看，你的儿子活了！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚把孩子抱起来，从楼上下到屋子里去，把孩子交给他的母亲；以利亚说："看，你的儿子活了！"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚将孩子从楼上抱下来，进屋子交给他母亲，说：「看哪，你的儿子活了！」
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah picked up the child and carried him down from the room into the house. He gave him to his mother and said, "Look, your son is alive!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Elijah took the child and brought him down from the upper chamber into the house and delivered him to his mother. And Elijah said, "See, your son lives."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elijah took the child and brought him down from the upper room into the house, and gave him to his mother. And Elijah said, "See, your son lives!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah brought him down from the upper room and gave him to his mother. "Look!" he said. "Your son is alive!"
verses.textEnNasb: Elijah then took the boy and brought him down from the upstairs room into the house and gave him to his mother; and Elijah said, "See, your son is alive."
verses.textEn: Elijah picked up the child and carried him down from the room into the house. He gave him to his mother and said, "Look, your son is alive!"

verses.textZh: 妇人对以利亚说："现在我知道你是神人，耶和华借着你的口所说的话是真实的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人对以利亚说："现在我知道你是神人，耶和华借着你的口所说的话是真实的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人对以利亚说：「现在我知道你是神人，耶和华藉你口所说的话是真的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the Lord from your mouth is the truth."
verses.textEnEsv: And the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is truth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now by this I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is the truth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the woman told Elijah, "Now I know for sure that you are a man of God, and that the Lord truly speaks through you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you are a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is truth."
verses.textEn: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the Lord from your mouth is the truth."

verses.textZh: 过了许久，到第三年，耶和华的话临到以利亚说："你去在亚哈面前出现，我要降雨在地面上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了许久，到第三年，耶和华的话临到以利亚说："你去在亚哈面前出现，我要降雨在地面上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 过了许久，到第三年，耶和华的话临到以利亚说：「你去，使亚哈得见你；我要降雨在地上。」
verses.textEnNiv: After a long time, in the third year, the word of the Lord came to Elijah: "Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the land."
verses.textEnEsv: After many days the word of the Lord came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, "Go, show yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain upon the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass after many days that the word of the Lord came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, "Go, present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Later on, in the third year of the drought, the Lord said to Elijah, "Go and present yourself to King Ahab. Tell him that I will soon send rain!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened after many days that the word of the Lord came to Elijah in the third year, saying, "Go, present yourself to Ahab, and I will provide rain on the face of the earth."
verses.textEn: After a long time, in the third year, the word of the Lord came to Elijah: "Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the land."

verses.textZh: 于是以利亚去了，要在亚哈面前出现。那时撒玛利亚发生十分严重的饥荒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以利亚去了，要在亚哈面前出现。那时撒玛利亚发生十分严重的饥荒。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚就去，要使亚哈得见他。那时，撒马利亚有大饥荒；
verses.textEnNiv: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria,
verses.textEnEsv: So Elijah went to show himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab; and therewas a severe famine in Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: So Elijah went to appear before Ahab. Meanwhile, the famine had become very severe in Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria.
verses.textEn: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria,

verses.textZh: 亚哈把他的家宰俄巴底召了来。原来俄巴底是个非常敬畏耶和华的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈把他的家宰俄巴底召了来。原来俄巴底是个非常敬畏耶和华的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈将他的家宰俄巴底召了来。（俄巴底甚是敬畏耶和华，
verses.textEnNiv: and Ahab had summoned Obadiah, his palace administrator. (Obadiah was a devout believer in the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahab called Obadiah, who was over the household. (Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ahab had called Obadiah, who was in charge of his house. (Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahab summoned Obadiah, who was in charge of the palace. (Obadiah was a devoted follower of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Ahab summoned Obadiah, who was in charge of the household. (Now Obadiah feared the Lord greatly;
verses.textEn: and Ahab had summoned Obadiah, his palace administrator. (Obadiah was a devout believer in the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶洗别除灭耶和华众先知的时候，俄巴底带走了一百个先知，每五十个人一组，分散藏在山洞里，又用饼和水供养他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶洗别除灭耶和华众先知的时候，俄巴底带走了一百个先知，每五十个人一组，分散藏在山洞里，又用饼和水供养他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶洗别杀耶和华众先知的时候，俄巴底将一百个先知藏了，每五十人藏在一个洞里，拿饼和水供养他们。）
verses.textEnNiv: While Jezebel was killing off the Lord ’s prophets, Obadiah had taken a hundred prophets and hidden them in two caves, fifty in each, and had supplied them with food and water.)
verses.textEnEsv: and when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the Lord , Obadiah took a hundred prophets and hid them by fifties in a cave and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.textEnNkjv: For so it was, while Jezebel massacred the prophets of the Lord, that Obadiah had taken one hundred prophets and hidden them, fifty to a cave, and had fed them with bread and water.)
verses.textEnNlt: Once when Jezebel had tried to kill all the Lord ’s prophets, Obadiah had hidden 100 of them in two caves. He put fifty prophets in each cave and supplied them with food and water.)
verses.textEnNasb: for when Jezebel killed the prophets of the Lord, Obadiah took a hundred prophets and hid them by fifties in a cave, and provided them with bread and water.)
verses.textEn: While Jezebel was killing off the Lord ’s prophets, Obadiah had taken a hundred prophets and hidden them in two caves, fifty in each, and had supplied them with food and water.)

verses.textZh: 亚哈对俄巴底说："你走遍这地，到所有的水泉和溪水那里去看看，也许我们可以找到青草，使骡马能够生存，免得牲畜灭绝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈对俄巴底说："你走遍这地，到所有的水泉和溪水那里去看看，也许我们可以找到青草，使骡马能够生存，免得牲畜灭绝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈对俄巴底说：「我们走遍这地，到一切水泉旁和一切溪边，或者找得着青草，可以救活骡马，免得绝了牲畜。」
verses.textEnNiv: Ahab had said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs and valleys. Maybe we can find some grass to keep the horses and mules alive so we will not have to kill any of our animals."
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahab said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs of water and to all the valleys. Perhaps we may find grass and save the horses and mules alive, and not lose some of the animals."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ahab had said to Obadiah, "Go into the land to all the springs of water and to all the brooks; perhaps we may find grass to keep the horses and mules alive, so that we will not have to kill any livestock."
verses.textEnNlt: Ahab said to Obadiah, "We must check every spring and valley in the land to see if we can find enough grass to save at least some of my horses and mules."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ahab said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs of water and to all the river valleys; perhaps we will find grass and keep the horses and mules alive, and not have to kill some of the cattle."
verses.textEn: Ahab had said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs and valleys. Maybe we can find some grass to keep the horses and mules alive so we will not have to kill any of our animals."

verses.textZh: 于是他们分地巡视。亚哈独自走一路，俄巴底独自走另一路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们分地巡视。亚哈独自走一路，俄巴底独自走另一路。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是二人分地游行，亚哈独走一路，俄巴底独走一路。
verses.textEnNiv: So they divided the land they were to cover, Ahab going in one direction and Obadiah in another.
verses.textEnEsv: So they divided the land between them to pass through it. Ahab went in one direction by himself, and Obadiah went in another direction by himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they divided the land between them to explore it; Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.textEnNlt: So they divided the land between them. Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.textEnNasb: So they divided the land between them to survey it; Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.textEn: So they divided the land they were to cover, Ahab going in one direction and Obadiah in another.

verses.textZh: 俄巴底在路上走的时候，以利亚遇见了他。俄巴底认出他来，就脸伏在地，说："你真是我主以利亚吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄巴底在路上走的时候，以利亚遇见了他。俄巴底认出他来，就脸伏在地，说："你真是我主以利亚吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 俄巴底在路上恰与以利亚相遇，俄巴底认出他来，就俯伏在地，说：「你是我主以利亚不是？」
verses.textEnNiv: As Obadiah was walking along, Elijah met him. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down to the ground, and said, "Is it really you, my lord Elijah?"
verses.textEnEsv: And as Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him. And Obadiah recognized him and fell on his face and said, "Is it you, my lord Elijah?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as Obadiah was on his way, suddenly Elijah met him; and he recognized him, and fell on his face, and said, "Is that you, my lord Elijah?"
verses.textEnNlt: As Obadiah was walking along, he suddenly saw Elijah coming toward him. Obadiah recognized him at once and bowed low to the ground before him. "Is it really you, my lord Elijah?" he asked.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as Obadiah was on the way, behold, Elijah met him, and he recognized him and fell on his face and said, "Is it you, Elijah my master?"
verses.textEn: As Obadiah was walking along, Elijah met him. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down to the ground, and said, "Is it really you, my lord Elijah?"

verses.textZh: 以利亚对他说："我是。你去告诉你主人，说：‘以利亚在这里。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对他说："我是。你去告诉你主人，说：‘以利亚在这里。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 回答说：「是。你去告诉你主人说，以利亚在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Yes," he replied. "Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered him, "It is I. Go, tell your lord, ‘Behold, Elijah is here.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he answered him, "Itis I. Go, tell your master, ‘Elijah ishere.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, it is," Elijah replied. "Now go and tell your master, ‘Elijah is here.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, "It is I. Go, say to your master, ‘Behold, Elijah is here.’ "
verses.textEn: "Yes," he replied. "Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here.’ "

verses.textZh: 俄巴底说："我犯了甚么罪，你竟要把你仆人交在亚哈手里，使他杀死我呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄巴底说："我犯了甚么罪，你竟要把你仆人交在亚哈手里，使他杀死我呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 俄巴底说：「仆人有什么罪，你竟要将我交在亚哈手里，使他杀我呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "What have I done wrong," asked Obadiah, "that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to be put to death?
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "How have I sinned, that you would give your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "How have I sinned, that you are delivering your servant into the hand of Ahab, to kill me?
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, sir," Obadiah protested, "what harm have I done to you that you are sending me to my death at the hands of Ahab?
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "What sin have I committed, that you are handing your servant over to Ahab, to put me to death?
verses.textEn: "What have I done wrong," asked Obadiah, "that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to be put to death?

verses.textZh: 我指着永活的耶和华你的神起誓，没有一邦一国我主人不派人去找你的，人们若是说你不在那里，他就要那国邦起誓说实在找不到你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我指着永活的耶和华你的神起誓，没有一邦一国我主人不派人去找你的，人们若是说你不在那里，他就要那国邦起誓说实在找不到你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我指着永生耶和华－你的神起誓，无论哪一邦哪一国，我主都打发人去找你。若说你没有在那里，就必使那邦那国的人起誓说，实在是找不着你。
verses.textEnNiv: As surely as the Lord your God lives, there is not a nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to look for you. And whenever a nation or kingdom claimed you were not there, he made them swear they could not find you.
verses.textEnEsv: As the Lord your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. And when they would say, ‘He is not here,’ he would take an oath of the kingdom or nation, that they had not found you.
verses.textEnNkjv: As the Lord your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to hunt for you; and when they said, ‘Heis not here,’ he took an oath from the kingdom or nation that they could not find you.
verses.textEnNlt: For I swear by the Lord your God that the king has searched every nation and kingdom on earth from end to end to find you. And each time he was told, ‘Elijah isn’t here,’ King Ahab forced the king of that nation to swear to the truth of his claim.
verses.textEnNasb: As surely as the Lord your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom to which my master has not sent word to search for you; and whenever they say, ‘He is not here,’ he makes the kingdom or nation swear that they could not find you.
verses.textEn: As surely as the Lord your God lives, there is not a nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to look for you. And whenever a nation or kingdom claimed you were not there, he made them swear they could not find you.

verses.textZh: 现在你说：‘你去告诉你主人：以利亚在这里。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你说：‘你去告诉你主人：以利亚在这里。’
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你说，要去告诉你主人说，以利亚在这里；
verses.textEnNiv: But now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’
verses.textEnEsv: And now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, "Behold, Elijah is here."’
verses.textEnNkjv: And now you say, ‘Go, tell your master, "Elijah ishere" ’!
verses.textEnNlt: And now you say, ‘Go and tell your master, "Elijah is here."’
verses.textEnNasb: Yet now you are saying, ‘Go, say to your master, "Behold, Elijah is here!" ’
verses.textEn: But now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’

verses.textZh: 我一离开你，耶和华的灵就把你提到我不知道的地方去。这样，如果我去告诉亚哈，他找不到你，必定杀我。你仆人却是自幼敬畏耶和华的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我一离开你，耶和华的灵就把你提到我不知道的地方去。这样，如果我去告诉亚哈，他找不到你，必定杀我。你仆人却是自幼敬畏耶和华的。
verses.textZhCuv: 恐怕我一离开你，耶和华的灵就提你到我所不知道的地方去。这样，我去告诉亚哈，他若找不着你，就必杀我；仆人却是自幼敬畏耶和华的。
verses.textEnNiv: I don’t know where the Spirit of the Lord may carry you when I leave you. If I go and tell Ahab and he doesn’t find you, he will kill me. Yet I your servant have worshiped the Lord since my youth.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as I have gone from you, the Spirit of the Lord will carry you I know not where. And so, when I come and tell Ahab and he cannot find you, he will kill me, although I your servant have feared the Lord from my youth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass, assoonas I am gone from you, that the Spirit of the Lord will carry you to a place I do not know; so when I go and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he will kill me. But I your servant have feared the Lord from my youth.
verses.textEnNlt: But as soon as I leave you, the Spirit of the Lord will carry you away to who knows where. When Ahab comes and cannot find you, he will kill me. Yet I have been a true servant of the Lord all my life.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about when I leave you that the Spirit of the Lord will carry you to where I do not know; so when I come and inform Ahab and he cannot find you, he will kill me, though I, your servant, have feared the Lord from my youth.
verses.textEn: I don’t know where the Spirit of the Lord may carry you when I leave you. If I go and tell Ahab and he doesn’t find you, he will kill me. Yet I your servant have worshiped the Lord since my youth.

verses.textZh: 难道没有人把我所作的事告诉我主吗？就是耶洗别杀害耶和华众先知的时候，我把一百个先知，五十人一组的分别藏在山洞里，又用饼和水供养他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道没有人把我所作的事告诉我主吗？就是耶洗别杀害耶和华众先知的时候，我把一百个先知，五十人一组的分别藏在山洞里，又用饼和水供养他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶洗别杀耶和华众先知的时候，我将耶和华的一百个先知藏了，每五十人藏在一个洞里，拿饼和水供养他们，岂没有人将这事告诉我主吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Haven’t you heard, my lord, what I did while Jezebel was killing the prophets of the Lord ? I hid a hundred of the Lord ’s prophets in two caves, fifty in each, and supplied them with food and water.
verses.textEnEsv: Has it not been told my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the Lord , how I hid a hundred men of the Lord ’s prophets by fifties in a cave and fed them with bread and water?
verses.textEnNkjv: Was it not reported to my lord what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the Lord, how I hid one hundred men of the Lord’s prophets, fifty to a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.textEnNlt: Has no one told you, my lord, about the time when Jezebel was trying to kill the Lord ’s prophets? I hid 100 of them in two caves and supplied them with food and water.
verses.textEnNasb: Has it not been reported to my master what I did when Jezebel killed the prophets of the Lord, that I hid a hundred prophets of the Lord by fifties in a cave, and provided them with bread and water?
verses.textEn: Haven’t you heard, my lord, what I did while Jezebel was killing the prophets of the Lord ? I hid a hundred of the Lord ’s prophets in two caves, fifty in each, and supplied them with food and water.

verses.textZh: 现在你说：‘你去告诉你主人以利亚在这里！’他必定杀我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你说：‘你去告诉你主人以利亚在这里！’他必定杀我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你说，要去告诉你主人说，以利亚在这里，他必杀我。」
verses.textEnNiv: And now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’ He will kill me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And now you say, ‘Go, tell your lord, "Behold, Elijah is here"’; and he will kill me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And now you say, ‘Go, tell your master, "Elijah ishere." ’ He will kill me!"
verses.textEnNlt: And now you say, ‘Go and tell your master, "Elijah is here."’ Sir, if I do that, Ahab will certainly kill me."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet now you are saying, ‘Go, say to your master, "Behold, Elijah is here" ’; he will then kill me!"
verses.textEn: And now you tell me to go to my master and say, ‘Elijah is here.’ He will kill me!"

verses.textZh: 以利亚说："我指着我所服事永活的万军之耶和华起誓，今天我必在亚哈面前出现。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚说："我指着我所服事永活的万军之耶和华起誓，今天我必在亚哈面前出现。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚说：「我指着所事奉永生的万军之耶和华起誓，我今日必使亚哈得见我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah said, "As the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, I will surely present myself to Ahab today."
verses.textEnEsv: And Elijah said, "As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will surely show myself to him today."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elijah said, "As the Lord of hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will surely present myself to him today."
verses.textEnNlt: But Elijah said, "I swear by the Lord Almighty, in whose presence I stand, that I will present myself to Ahab this very day."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elijah said, "As surely as the Lord of armies lives, before whom I stand, I will certainly present myself to him today."
verses.textEn: Elijah said, "As the Lord Almighty lives, whom I serve, I will surely present myself to Ahab today."

verses.textZh: 于是俄巴底去见亚哈，把这事告诉他。亚哈就去见以利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是俄巴底去见亚哈，把这事告诉他。亚哈就去见以利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是俄巴底去迎着亚哈，告诉他；亚哈就去迎着以利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him, and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.textEnEsv: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him. And Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him; and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.textEnNlt: So Obadiah went to tell Ahab that Elijah had come, and Ahab went out to meet Elijah.
verses.textEnNasb: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and informed him; then Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.textEn: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab and told him, and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

verses.textZh: 亚哈看见了以利亚，就问他："给以色列惹麻烦的这个人就是你吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈看见了以利亚，就问他："给以色列惹麻烦的这个人就是你吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈见了以利亚，便说：「使以色列遭灾的就是你吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When he saw Elijah, he said to him, "Is that you, you troubler of Israel?"
verses.textEnEsv: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, "Is it you, you troubler of Israel?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said to him, "Isthat you, O troubler of Israel?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Ahab saw him, he exclaimed, "So, is it really you, you troublemaker of Israel?"
verses.textEnNasb: When Ahab saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, "Is this you, the cause of disaster to Israel?"
verses.textEn: When he saw Elijah, he said to him, "Is that you, you troubler of Israel?"

verses.textZh: 以利亚说："给以色列惹麻烦的，不是我，而是你和你父的家；因为你们离弃了耶和华的诫命，又去随从巴力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚说："给以色列惹麻烦的，不是我，而是你和你父的家；因为你们离弃了耶和华的诫命，又去随从巴力。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚说：「使以色列遭灾的不是我，乃是你和你父家；因为你们离弃耶和华的诫命，去随从巴力。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have not made trouble for Israel," Elijah replied. "But you and your father’s family have. You have abandoned the Lord ’s commands and have followed the Baals.
verses.textEnEsv: And he answered, "I have not troubled Israel, but you have, and your father’s house, because you have abandoned the commandments of the Lord and followed the Baals.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he answered, "I have not troubled Israel, but you and your father’s house have, in that you have forsaken the commandments of the Lord and have followed the Baals.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have made no trouble for Israel," Elijah replied. "You and your family are the troublemakers, for you have refused to obey the commands of the Lord and have worshiped the images of Baal instead.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "I have not brought disaster to Israel, but you and your father’s house have, because you have abandoned the commandments of the Lord and you have followed the Baals.
verses.textEn: "I have not made trouble for Israel," Elijah replied. "But you and your father’s family have. You have abandoned the Lord ’s commands and have followed the Baals.

verses.textZh: 现在你要派人去召集以色列众人和四百五十个巴力的先知，以及耶洗别供养的四百个亚舍拉的先知，都上迦密山来见我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要派人去召集以色列众人和四百五十个巴力的先知，以及耶洗别供养的四百个亚舍拉的先知，都上迦密山来见我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你当差遣人，招聚以色列众人和事奉巴力的那四百五十个先知，并耶洗别所供养事奉亚舍拉的那四百个先知，使他们都上迦密山去见我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now summon the people from all over Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel. And bring the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore send and gather all Israel to me at Mount Carmel, and the 450 prophets of Baal and the 400 prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, send and gather all Israel to me on Mount Carmel, the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal, and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table."
verses.textEnNlt: Now summon all Israel to join me at Mount Carmel, along with the 450 prophets of Baal and the 400 prophets of Asherah who are supported by Jezebel. "
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, send orders and gather to me all Israel at Mount Carmel, together with 450 prophets of Baal and four hundred prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table."
verses.textEn: Now summon the people from all over Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel. And bring the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table."

verses.textZh: 于是亚哈派人召集众以色列人和众先知上迦密山去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚哈派人召集众以色列人和众先知上迦密山去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈就差遣人招聚以色列众人和先知都上迦密山。
verses.textEnNiv: So Ahab sent word throughout all Israel and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.
verses.textEnEsv: So Ahab sent to all the people of Israel and gathered the prophets together at Mount Carmel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahab sent for all the children of Israel, and gathered the prophets together on Mount Carmel.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahab summoned all the people of Israel and the prophets to Mount Carmel.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ahab sent orders among all the sons of Israel and brought the prophets together at Mount Carmel.
verses.textEn: So Ahab sent word throughout all Israel and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.

verses.textZh: 以利亚走近众人说："你们三心两意，要到几时呢？如果耶和华是神，你们就应当随从耶和华；如果巴力是神，你们就应当随从巴力。"众人一句话也不回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚走近众人说："你们三心两意，要到几时呢？如果耶和华是神，你们就应当随从耶和华；如果巴力是神，你们就应当随从巴力。"众人一句话也不回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚前来对众民说：「你们心持两意要到几时呢？若耶和华是神，就当顺从耶和华；若巴力是神，就当顺从巴力。」众民一言不答。
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah went before the people and said, "How long will you waver between two opinions? If the Lord is God, follow him; but if Baal is God, follow him." But the people said nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elijah came near to all the people and said, "How long will you go limping between two different opinions? If the Lord is God, follow him; but if Baal, then follow him." And the people did not answer him a word.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elijah came to all the people, and said, "How long will you falter between two opinions? If the Lordis God, follow Him; but if Baal, follow him." But the people answered him not a word.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah stood in front of them and said, "How much longer will you waver, hobbling between two opinions? If the Lord is God, follow him! But if Baal is God, then follow him!" But the people were completely silent.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elijah approached all the people and said, "How long are you going to struggle with the two choices? If the Lord is God, follow Him; but if Baal, follow him." But the people did not answer him so much as a word.
verses.textEn: Elijah went before the people and said, "How long will you waver between two opinions? If the Lord is God, follow him; but if Baal is God, follow him." But the people said nothing.

verses.textZh: 以利亚对众人说："耶和华的先知只剩下我一个，巴力的先知却有四百五十个。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对众人说："耶和华的先知只剩下我一个，巴力的先知却有四百五十个。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对众民说：「作耶和华先知的只剩下我一个人；巴力的先知却有四百五十个人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elijah said to them, "I am the only one of the Lord ’s prophets left, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elijah said to the people, "I, even I only, am left a prophet of the Lord , but Baal’s prophets are 450 men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elijah said to the people, "I alone am left a prophet of the Lord; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah said to them, "I am the only prophet of the Lord who is left, but Baal has 450 prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elijah said to the people, "I alone am left as a prophet of the Lord, while Baal’s prophets are 450 men.
verses.textEn: Then Elijah said to them, "I am the only one of the Lord ’s prophets left, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.

verses.textZh: 现在，请给我们两头公牛。让巴力的先知自己挑选一头，把牠切成块子，放在柴上，但不要点火；我也预备一头公牛，摆在柴上，也不点火。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，请给我们两头公牛。让巴力的先知自己挑选一头，把牠切成块子，放在柴上，但不要点火；我也预备一头公牛，摆在柴上，也不点火。
verses.textZhCuv: 当给我们两只牛犊，巴力的先知可以挑选一只，切成块子，放在柴上，不要点火；我也预备一只牛犊放在柴上，也不点火。
verses.textEnNiv: Get two bulls for us. Let Baal’s prophets choose one for themselves, and let them cut it into pieces and put it on the wood but not set fire to it. I will prepare the other bull and put it on the wood but not set fire to it.
verses.textEnEsv: Let two bulls be given to us, and let them choose one bull for themselves and cut it in pieces and lay it on the wood, but put no fire to it. And I will prepare the other bull and lay it on the wood and put no fire to it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let them give us two bulls; and let them choose one bull for themselves, cut it in pieces, and lay it on the wood, but put no fire underit; and I will prepare the other bull, and lay it on the wood, but put no fire underit.
verses.textEnNlt: Now bring two bulls. The prophets of Baal may choose whichever one they wish and cut it into pieces and lay it on the wood of their altar, but without setting fire to it. I will prepare the other bull and lay it on the wood on the altar, but not set fire to it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now have them give us two oxen; and have them choose the one ox for themselves and cut it up, and place it on the wood, but put no fire under it; and I will prepare the other ox and lay it on the wood, and I will not put a fire under it.
verses.textEn: Get two bulls for us. Let Baal’s prophets choose one for themselves, and let them cut it into pieces and put it on the wood but not set fire to it. I will prepare the other bull and put it on the wood but not set fire to it.

verses.textZh: 你们呼求你们神的名，我也呼求耶和华的名。那降火来显示回答的神就是神了。"众人都回答："这话说得很好！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们呼求你们神的名，我也呼求耶和华的名。那降火来显示回答的神就是神了。"众人都回答："这话说得很好！"
