verses.textZhCuv: 你们求告你们神的名，我也求告耶和华的名。那降火显应的神，就是神。」众民回答说：「这话甚好。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then you call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the Lord . The god who answers by fire—he is God." Then all the people said, "What you say is good."
verses.textEnEsv: And you call upon the name of your god, and I will call upon the name of the Lord , and the God who answers by fire, he is God." And all the people answered, "It is well spoken."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you call on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of the Lord; and the God who answers by fire, He is God." So all the people answered and said, "It is well spoken."
verses.textEnNlt: Then call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the Lord . The god who answers by setting fire to the wood is the true God!" And all the people agreed.
verses.textEnNasb: Then you call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the Lord; and the God who answers by fire, He is God." And all the people replied, " That is a good idea."
verses.textEn: Then you call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the Lord . The god who answers by fire—he is God." Then all the people said, "What you say is good."

verses.textZh: 以利亚对巴力的众先知说："你们既然人多，可以先为自己选一头公牛；预备好了，就呼求你们神的名，但不要点火。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对巴力的众先知说："你们既然人多，可以先为自己选一头公牛；预备好了，就呼求你们神的名，但不要点火。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对巴力的先知说：「你们既是人多，当先挑选一只牛犊，预备好了，就求告你们神的名，却不要点火。」
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose one of the bulls and prepare it first, since there are so many of you. Call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose for yourselves one bull and prepare it first, for you are many, and call upon the name of your god, but put no fire to it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose one bull for yourselves and prepare it first, for you are many; and call on the name of your god, but put no fire underit."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "You go first, for there are many of you. Choose one of the bulls, and prepare it and call on the name of your god. But do not set fire to the wood."
verses.textEnNasb: So Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose the one ox for yourselves and prepare it first, since there are many of you, and call on the name of your god, but put no fire under the ox."
verses.textEn: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose one of the bulls and prepare it first, since there are so many of you. Call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire."

verses.textZh: 他们把人给他们的公牛牵了来，预备好了，就从早晨直到中午，呼求巴力的名，说："巴力啊，应允我们吧！"可是没有声音，也没有回应。他们就在所筑的祭坛周围跳舞。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把人给他们的公牛牵了来，预备好了，就从早晨直到中午，呼求巴力的名，说："巴力啊，应允我们吧！"可是没有声音，也没有回应。他们就在所筑的祭坛周围跳舞。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将所得的牛犊预备好了，从早晨到午间，求告巴力的名说：「巴力啊，求你应允我们！」却没有声音，没有应允的。他们在所筑的坛四围踊跳。
verses.textEnNiv: So they took the bull given them and prepared it. Then they called on the name of Baal from morning till noon. "Baal, answer us!" they shouted. But there was no response; no one answered. And they danced around the altar they had made.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took the bull that was given them, and they prepared it and called upon the name of Baal from morning until noon, saying, "O Baal, answer us!" But there was no voice, and no one answered. And they limped around the altar that they had made.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took the bull which was given them, and they prepared it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even till noon, saying, "O Baal, hear us!" But therewas no voice; no one answered. Then they leaped about the altar which they had made.
verses.textEnNlt: So they prepared one of the bulls and placed it on the altar. Then they called on the name of Baal from morning until noontime, shouting, "O Baal, answer us!" But there was no reply of any kind. Then they danced, hobbling around the altar they had made.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they took the ox which was given them and they prepared it, and they called on the name of Baal from morning until noon, saying, "O Baal, answer us!" But there was no voice and no one answered. And they limped about the altar which they had made.
verses.textEn: So they took the bull given them and prepared it. Then they called on the name of Baal from morning till noon. "Baal, answer us!" they shouted. But there was no response; no one answered. And they danced around the altar they had made.

verses.textZh: 到了中午，以利亚嘲笑他们，说："大声呼求吧，因为他是神，也许他正在默想，或事务繁忙，或正在旅行，或正在睡觉，你们要把他叫醒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了中午，以利亚嘲笑他们，说："大声呼求吧，因为他是神，也许他正在默想，或事务繁忙，或正在旅行，或正在睡觉，你们要把他叫醒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了正午，以利亚嬉笑他们，说：「大声求告吧！因为他是神，他或默想，或走到一边，或行路，或睡觉，你们当叫醒他。」
verses.textEnNiv: At noon Elijah began to taunt them. "Shout louder!" he said. "Surely he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or busy, or traveling. Maybe he is sleeping and must be awakened."
verses.textEnEsv: And at noon Elijah mocked them, saying, "Cry aloud, for he is a god. Either he is musing, or he is relieving himself, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he is asleep and must be awakened."
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, at noon, that Elijah mocked them and said, "Cry aloud, for he is a god; either he is meditating, or he is busy, or he is on a journey, or perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened."
verses.textEnNlt: About noontime Elijah began mocking them. "You’ll have to shout louder," he scoffed, "for surely he is a god! Perhaps he is daydreaming, or is relieving himself. Or maybe he is away on a trip, or is asleep and needs to be wakened!"
verses.textEnNasb: And at noon Elijah ridiculed them and said, "Call out with a loud voice, since he is a god; undoubtedly he is attending to business, or is on the way, or is on a journey. Perhaps he is asleep, and will awaken."
verses.textEn: At noon Elijah began to taunt them. "Shout louder!" he said. "Surely he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or busy, or traveling. Maybe he is sleeping and must be awakened."

verses.textZh: 他们就大声呼求，按着他们的规矩，用刀和枪刺自己，直到身体流血。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就大声呼求，按着他们的规矩，用刀和枪刺自己，直到身体流血。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们大声求告，按着他们的规矩，用刀枪自割、自刺，直到身体流血。
verses.textEnNiv: So they shouted louder and slashed themselves with swords and spears, as was their custom, until their blood flowed.
verses.textEnEsv: And they cried aloud and cut themselves after their custom with swords and lances, until the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they cried aloud, and cut themselves, as was their custom, with knives and lances, until the blood gushed out on them.
verses.textEnNlt: So they shouted louder, and following their normal custom, they cut themselves with knives and swords until the blood gushed out.
verses.textEnNasb: So they cried out with a loud voice, and cut themselves according to their custom with swords and lances until blood gushed out on them.
verses.textEn: So they shouted louder and slashed themselves with swords and spears, as was their custom, until their blood flowed.

verses.textZh: 中午过后，他们继续狂呼乱叫，直到献晚祭的时候；可是仍没有声音，没有回应，也没有理睬他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 中午过后，他们继续狂呼乱叫，直到献晚祭的时候；可是仍没有声音，没有回应，也没有理睬他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 从午后直到献晚祭的时候，他们狂呼乱叫，却没有声音，没有应允的，也没有理会的。
verses.textEnNiv: Midday passed, and they continued their frantic prophesying until the time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no response, no one answered, no one paid attention.
verses.textEnEsv: And as midday passed, they raved on until the time of the offering of the oblation, but there was no voice. No one answered; no one paid attention.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice. But therewas no voice; no one answered, no one paid attention.
verses.textEnNlt: They raved all afternoon until the time of the evening sacrifice, but still there was no sound, no reply, no response.
verses.textEnNasb: When midday was past, they raved until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice; but there was no voice, no one answered, and no one paid attention.
verses.textEn: Midday passed, and they continued their frantic prophesying until the time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no response, no one answered, no one paid attention.

verses.textZh: 以利亚对众人说："你们走近我这里来。"众人就都走近他面前。他重修已经毁坏了的耶和华的祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对众人说："你们走近我这里来。"众人就都走近他面前。他重修已经毁坏了的耶和华的祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对众民说：「你们到我这里来。」众民就到他那里。他便重修已经毁坏耶和华的坛。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come here to me." They came to him, and he repaired the altar of the Lord , which had been torn down.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come near to me." And all the people came near to him. And he repaired the altar of the Lord that had been thrown down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come near to me." So all the people came near to him. And he repaired the altar of the Lordthatwas broken down.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah called to the people, "Come over here!" They all crowded around him as he repaired the altar of the Lord that had been torn down.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come forward to me." So all the people came forward to him. And he repaired the altar of the Lord which had been torn down.
verses.textEn: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come here to me." They came to him, and he repaired the altar of the Lord , which had been torn down.

verses.textZh: 以利亚照着雅各子孙支派的数目，拿了十二块石头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚照着雅各子孙支派的数目，拿了十二块石头。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚照雅各子孙支派的数目，取了十二块石头（耶和华的话曾临到雅各说：「你的名要叫以色列」），
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah took twelve stones, one for each of the tribes descended from Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord had come, saying, "Your name shall be Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord came, saying, "Israel shall be your name,"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord had come, saying, "Israel shall be your name."
verses.textEnNlt: He took twelve stones, one to represent each of the tribes of Israel,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elijah took twelve stones, corresponding to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord had come, saying, "Israel shall be your name."
verses.textEn: Elijah took twelve stones, one for each of the tribes descended from Jacob, to whom the word of the Lord had come, saying, "Your name shall be Israel."

verses.textZh: 以利亚奉耶和华的名用这些石头筑了一座坛，在坛的四周挖沟，可容十四公升种籽，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚奉耶和华的名用这些石头筑了一座坛，在坛的四周挖沟，可容十四公升种籽，
verses.textZhCuv: 用这些石头为耶和华的名筑一座坛，在坛的四围挖沟，可容谷种二细亚，
verses.textEnNiv: With the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord , and he dug a trench around it large enough to hold two seahs of seed.
verses.textEnEsv: and with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord . And he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two seahs of seed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord; and he made a trench around the altar large enough to hold two seahs of seed.
verses.textEnNlt: and he used the stones to rebuild the altar in the name of the Lord . Then he dug a trench around the altar large enough to hold about three gallons.
verses.textEnNasb: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord; and he made a trench around the altar, large enough to hold two measures of seed.
verses.textEn: With the stones he built an altar in the name of the Lord , and he dug a trench around it large enough to hold two seahs of seed.

verses.textZh: 然后把柴排好，又把公牛切成块子，放在柴上，就说："你们盛满四桶水，倒在燔祭和柴上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后把柴排好，又把公牛切成块子，放在柴上，就说："你们盛满四桶水，倒在燔祭和柴上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又在坛上摆好了柴，把牛犊切成块子放在柴上，对众人说：「你们用四个桶盛满水，倒在燔祭和柴上」；
verses.textEnNiv: He arranged the wood, cut the bull into pieces and laid it on the wood. Then he said to them, "Fill four large jars with water and pour it on the offering and on the wood."
verses.textEnEsv: And he put the wood in order and cut the bull in pieces and laid it on the wood. And he said, "Fill four jars with water and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he put the wood in order, cut the bull in pieces, and laid it on the wood, and said, "Fill four waterpots with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice and on the wood."
verses.textEnNlt: He piled wood on the altar, cut the bull into pieces, and laid the pieces on the wood. Then he said, "Fill four large jars with water, and pour the water over the offering and the wood."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he laid out the wood, and he cut the ox in pieces and placed it on the wood.
verses.textEn: He arranged the wood, cut the bull into pieces and laid it on the wood. Then he said to them, "Fill four large jars with water and pour it on the offering and on the wood."

verses.textZh: 又说："倒第二次。"他们就倒第二次；又说："倒第三次。"他们就倒第三次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："倒第二次。"他们就倒第二次；又说："倒第三次。"他们就倒第三次。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「倒第二次。」他们就倒第二次；又说：「倒第三次。」他们就倒第三次。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do it again," he said, and they did it again. "Do it a third time," he ordered, and they did it the third time.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Do it a second time." And they did it a second time. And he said, "Do it a third time." And they did it a third time.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Do it a second time," and they did it a second time; and he said, "Do it a third time," and they did it a third time.
verses.textEnNlt: After they had done this, he said, "Do the same thing again!" And when they were finished, he said, "Now do it a third time!" So they did as he said,
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Fill four large jars with water and pour it on the burnt offering and on the wood." And he said, "Do it a second time," so they did it a second time. Then he said, "Do it a third time," so they did it a third time.
verses.textEn: "Do it again," he said, and they did it again. "Do it a third time," he ordered, and they did it the third time.

verses.textZh: 水流到祭坛的四周，甚至水沟里也满了水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水流到祭坛的四周，甚至水沟里也满了水。
verses.textZhCuv: 水流在坛的四围，沟里也满了水。
verses.textEnNiv: The water ran down around the altar and even filled the trench.
verses.textEnEsv: And the water ran around the altar and filled the trench also with water.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the water ran all around the altar; and he also filled the trench with water.
verses.textEnNlt: and the water ran around the altar and even filled the trench.
verses.textEnNasb: The water flowed around the altar, and he also filled the trench with water.
verses.textEn: The water ran down around the altar and even filled the trench.

verses.textZh: 到了献晚祭的时候，以利亚先知近前来，说："亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神耶和华，求你今天使人知道你是在以色列中的神，我是你的仆人，又是奉你的命令行这一切事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了献晚祭的时候，以利亚先知近前来，说："亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神耶和华，求你今天使人知道你是在以色列中的神，我是你的仆人，又是奉你的命令行这一切事。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了献晚祭的时候，先知以利亚近前来，说：「亚伯拉罕、以撒、以色列的神，耶和华啊，求你今日使人知道你是以色列的神，也知道我是你的仆人，又是奉你的命行这一切事。
verses.textEnNiv: At the time of sacrifice, the prophet Elijah stepped forward and prayed: " Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant and have done all these things at your command.
verses.textEnEsv: And at the time of the offering of the oblation, Elijah the prophet came near and said, "O Lord , God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that you are God in Israel, and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, at thetimeof the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near and said, "Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that You are God in Israel and I am Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your word.
verses.textEnNlt: At the usual time for offering the evening sacrifice, Elijah the prophet walked up to the altar and prayed, "O Lord , God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, prove today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant. Prove that I have done all this at your command.
verses.textEnNasb: Then at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, Elijah the prophet approached and said, "Lord, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, today let it be known that You are God in Israel and that I am Your servant, and that I have done all these things at Your word.
verses.textEn: At the time of sacrifice, the prophet Elijah stepped forward and prayed: " Lord , the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant and have done all these things at your command.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，应允我！使这民知道你耶和华是神，又知道是你使这民的心再回转过来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，应允我！使这民知道你耶和华是神，又知道是你使这民的心再回转过来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，应允我！使这民知道你－耶和华是神，又知道是你叫这民的心回转。」
verses.textEnNiv: Answer me, Lord , answer me, so these people will know that you, Lord , are God, and that you are turning their hearts back again."
verses.textEnEsv: Answer me, O Lord , answer me, that this people may know that you, O Lord , are God, and that you have turned their hearts back."
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear me, O Lord, hear me, that this people may know that You are the Lord God, and that You have turned their hearts back toYou again."
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , answer me! Answer me so these people will know that you, O Lord , are God and that you have brought them back to yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: Answer me, Lord, answer me, so that this people may know that You, Lord, are God, and that You have turned their heart back."
verses.textEn: Answer me, Lord , answer me, so these people will know that you, Lord , are God, and that you are turning their hearts back again."

verses.textZh: 于是有耶和华的火降下来，吞灭了燔祭、木柴、石头和尘土，连沟里的水也烧干了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是有耶和华的火降下来，吞灭了燔祭、木柴、石头和尘土，连沟里的水也烧干了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，耶和华降下火来，烧尽燔祭、木柴、石头、尘土，又烧干沟里的水。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the fire of the Lord fell and burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones and the soil, and also licked up the water in the trench.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt offering and the wood and the stones and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood and the stones and the dust, and it licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.textEnNlt: Immediately the fire of the Lord flashed down from heaven and burned up the young bull, the wood, the stones, and the dust. It even licked up all the water in the trench!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt offering and the wood, and the stones and the dust; and it licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.textEn: Then the fire of the Lord fell and burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones and the soil, and also licked up the water in the trench.

verses.textZh: 众人看见了，就面伏于地，说："耶和华是神！耶和华是神！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人看见了，就面伏于地，说："耶和华是神！耶和华是神！"
verses.textZhCuv: 众民看见了，就俯伏在地，说：「耶和华是神！耶和华是神！」
verses.textEnNiv: When all the people saw this, they fell prostrate and cried, "The Lord —he is God! The Lord —he is God!"
verses.textEnEsv: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces and said, "The Lord , he is God; the Lord , he is God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces; and they said, "The Lord, He is God! The Lord, He is God!"
verses.textEnNlt: And when all the people saw it, they fell face down on the ground and cried out, "The Lord —he is God! Yes, the Lord is God!"
verses.textEnNasb: When all the people saw this, they fell on their faces; and they said, "The Lord, He is God; the Lord, He is God!"
verses.textEn: When all the people saw this, they fell prostrate and cried, "The Lord —he is God! The Lord —he is God!"

verses.textZh: 以利亚对他们说："捉住巴力的先知，一个也不要让他们逃脱。"于是众人捉住他们。以利亚带他们下到基顺河边，在那里杀了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对他们说："捉住巴力的先知，一个也不要让他们逃脱。"于是众人捉住他们。以利亚带他们下到基顺河边，在那里杀了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对他们说：「拿住巴力的先知，不容一人逃脱！」众人就拿住他们。以利亚带他们到基顺河边，在那里杀了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Elijah commanded them, "Seize the prophets of Baal. Don’t let anyone get away!" They seized them, and Elijah had them brought down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered there.
verses.textEnEsv: And Elijah said to them, "Seize the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape." And they seized them. And Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon and slaughtered them there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Elijah said to them, "Seize the prophets of Baal! Do not let one of them escape!" So they seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the Brook Kishon and executed them there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah commanded, "Seize all the prophets of Baal. Don’t let a single one escape!" So the people seized them all, and Elijah took them down to the Kishon Valley and killed them there.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Elijah said to them, "Seize the prophets of Baal; do not let one of them escape." So they seized them; and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slaughtered them there.
verses.textEn: Then Elijah commanded them, "Seize the prophets of Baal. Don’t let anyone get away!" They seized them, and Elijah had them brought down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered there.

verses.textZh: 以利亚对亚哈说："你上去吃喝吧！因为已经有下大雨的响声了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对亚哈说："你上去吃喝吧！因为已经有下大雨的响声了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚对亚哈说：「你现在可以上去吃喝，因为有多雨的响声了。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Elijah said to Ahab, "Go, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain."
verses.textEnEsv: And Elijah said to Ahab, "Go up, eat and drink, for there is a sound of the rushing of rain."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Elijah said to Ahab, "Go up, eat and drink; for thereis the sound of abundance of rain."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Elijah said to Ahab, "Go get something to eat and drink, for I hear a mighty rainstorm coming!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now Elijah said to Ahab, "Go up, eat and drink; for there is the sound of the roar of a heavy shower."
verses.textEn: And Elijah said to Ahab, "Go, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain."

verses.textZh: 亚哈就上去吃喝。以利亚上了迦密山顶，屈身在地，把脸放在两膝之间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈就上去吃喝。以利亚上了迦密山顶，屈身在地，把脸放在两膝之间。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈就上去吃喝。以利亚上了迦密山顶，屈身在地，将脸伏在两膝之中；
verses.textEnNiv: So Ahab went off to eat and drink, but Elijah climbed to the top of Carmel, bent down to the ground and put his face between his knees.
verses.textEnEsv: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Mount Carmel. And he bowed himself down on the earth and put his face between his knees.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahab went up to eat and drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; then he bowed down on the ground, and put his face between his knees,
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahab went to eat and drink. But Elijah climbed to the top of Mount Carmel and bowed low to the ground and prayed with his face between his knees.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ahab went up to eat and drink. But Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he bent down to the earth and put his face between his knees.
verses.textEn: So Ahab went off to eat and drink, but Elijah climbed to the top of Carmel, bent down to the ground and put his face between his knees.

verses.textZh: 以利亚对自己的仆人说："你上去向海那边观看。"他就上去观看，说："甚么也没有。"以利亚说："你再回去观看。"这样说了七次。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚对自己的仆人说："你上去向海那边观看。"他就上去观看，说："甚么也没有。"以利亚说："你再回去观看。"这样说了七次。
verses.textZhCuv: 对仆人说：「你上去，向海观看。」仆人就上去观看，说：「没有什么。」他说：「你再去观看。」如此七次。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go and look toward the sea," he told his servant. And he went up and looked. "There is nothing there," he said. Seven times Elijah said, "Go back."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to his servant, "Go up now, look toward the sea." And he went up and looked and said, "There is nothing." And he said, "Go again," seven times.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to his servant, "Go up now, look toward the sea." So he went up and looked, and said, "Thereis nothing." And seven times he said, "Go again."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to his servant, "Go and look out toward the sea." The servant went and looked, then returned to Elijah and said, "I didn’t see anything." Seven times Elijah told him to go and look.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to his servant, "Go up now, look toward the sea." So he went up and looked, but he said, "There is nothing." Yet Elijah said, "Go back" seven times.
verses.textEn: "Go and look toward the sea," he told his servant. And he went up and looked. "There is nothing there," he said. Seven times Elijah said, "Go back."

verses.textZh: 到第七次，仆人说："我看到一小片乌云，好象人的手掌那么大，正在从海里升上来。"以利亚说："你上去告诉亚哈：‘赶快套车下山，免得被大雨所阻。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到第七次，仆人说："我看到一小片乌云，好象人的手掌那么大，正在从海里升上来。"以利亚说："你上去告诉亚哈：‘赶快套车下山，免得被大雨所阻。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 第七次仆人说：「我看见有一小片云从海里上来，不过如人手那样大。」以利亚说：「你上去告诉亚哈，当套车下去，免得被雨阻挡。」
verses.textEnNiv: The seventh time the servant reported, "A cloud as small as a man’s hand is rising from the sea." So Elijah said, "Go and tell Ahab, ‘Hitch up your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And at the seventh time he said, "Behold, a little cloud like a man’s hand is rising from the sea." And he said, "Go up, say to Ahab, ‘Prepare your chariot and go down, lest the rain stop you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass the seventh time, that he said, "There is a cloud, as small as a man’s hand, rising out of the sea!" So he said, "Go up, say to Ahab, ‘Prepare yourchariot, and go down before the rain stops you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Finally the seventh time, his servant told him, "I saw a little cloud about the size of a man’s hand rising from the sea." Then Elijah shouted, "Hurry to Ahab and tell him, ‘Climb into your chariot and go back home. If you don’t hurry, the rain will stop you!’"
verses.textEnNasb: And when he returned the seventh time, he said, "Behold, a cloud as small as a person’s hand is coming up from the sea." And Elijah said, "Go up, say to Ahab, ‘Harness your chariot horses and go down, so that the heavy shower does not stop you.’ "
verses.textEn: The seventh time the servant reported, "A cloud as small as a man’s hand is rising from the sea." So Elijah said, "Go and tell Ahab, ‘Hitch up your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’ "

verses.textZh: 霎时之间，天空因风云而变为黑暗，随着降下大雨来。于是亚哈坐上了车，往耶斯列去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 霎时之间，天空因风云而变为黑暗，随着降下大雨来。于是亚哈坐上了车，往耶斯列去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 霎时间，天因风云黑暗，降下大雨。亚哈就坐车往耶斯列去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, the sky grew black with clouds, the wind rose, a heavy rain started falling and Ahab rode off to Jezreel.
verses.textEnEsv: And in a little while the heavens grew black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode and went to Jezreel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened in the meantime that the sky became black with clouds and wind, and there was a heavy rain. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.
verses.textEnNlt: And soon the sky was black with clouds. A heavy wind brought a terrific rainstorm, and Ahab left quickly for Jezreel.
verses.textEnNasb: Meanwhile the sky became dark with clouds and wind came up, and there was a heavy shower. And Ahab rode and went to Jezreel.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, the sky grew black with clouds, the wind rose, a heavy rain started falling and Ahab rode off to Jezreel.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的能力临到以利亚的身上，以利亚就束上腰，跑在亚哈的前头，直跑到耶斯列的城门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的能力临到以利亚的身上，以利亚就束上腰，跑在亚哈的前头，直跑到耶斯列的城门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的灵 降在以利亚身上，他就束上腰，奔在亚哈前头，直到耶斯列的城门。
verses.textEnNiv: The power of the Lord came on Elijah and, tucking his cloak into his belt, he ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.
verses.textEnEsv: And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah, and he gathered up his garment and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the hand of the Lord came upon Elijah; and he girded up his loins and ran ahead of Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord gave special strength to Elijah. He tucked his cloak into his belt and ran ahead of Ahab’s chariot all the way to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the hand of the Lord was on Elijah, and he belted his cloak around his waist and outran Ahab to Jezreel.
verses.textEn: The power of the Lord came on Elijah and, tucking his cloak into his belt, he ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

verses.textZh: 亚哈把以利亚所行的一切，和他用刀杀死众先知的一切事，都告诉了耶洗别。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈把以利亚所行的一切，和他用刀杀死众先知的一切事，都告诉了耶洗别。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈将以利亚一切所行的和他用刀杀众先知的事都告诉耶洗别。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, also how he had executed all the prophets with the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: When Ahab got home, he told Jezebel everything Elijah had done, including the way he had killed all the prophets of Baal.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything that Elijah had done, and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
verses.textEn: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.

verses.textZh: 耶洗别就差派一个使者去见以利亚说："明天这个时候，如果我不使你的性命，像那些人一样，愿神明惩罚我，并且加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶洗别就差派一个使者去见以利亚说："明天这个时候，如果我不使你的性命，像那些人一样，愿神明惩罚我，并且加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶洗别就差遣人去见以利亚，告诉他说：「明日约在这时候，我若不使你的性命像那些人的性命一样，愿神明重重地降罚与我。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah to say, "May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if by this time tomorrow I do not make your life like that of one of them."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, "So may the gods do to me and more also, if I do not make your life as the life of one of them by this time tomorrow."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, "So let the gods do tome, and more also, if I do not make your life as the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time."
verses.textEnNlt: So Jezebel sent this message to Elijah: "May the gods strike me and even kill me if by this time tomorrow I have not killed you just as you killed them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah, saying, "So may the gods do to me and more so, if by about this time tomorrow I do not make your life like the life of one of them."
verses.textEn: So Jezebel sent a messenger to Elijah to say, "May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if by this time tomorrow I do not make your life like that of one of them."

verses.textZh: 以利亚害怕，就起来，逃命去了。他到了犹大的别是巴，就把自己的仆人留在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚害怕，就起来，逃命去了。他到了犹大的别是巴，就把自己的仆人留在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚见这光景就起来逃命，到了犹大的别是巴，将仆人留在那里，
verses.textEnNiv: Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. When he came to Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he was afraid, and he arose and ran for his life and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he saw that, he arose and ran for his life, and went to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant there.
verses.textEnNlt: Elijah was afraid and fled for his life. He went to Beersheba, a town in Judah, and he left his servant there.
verses.textEnNasb: And he was afraid, and got up and ran for his life and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah; and he left his servant there.
verses.textEn: Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. When he came to Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there,

verses.textZh: 他自己却在旷野走了一天的路，来到一棵罗腾树下，就坐在那里求死，说："耶和华啊，现在已经够了，求你取我的性命吧，因为我并不比我的列祖好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他自己却在旷野走了一天的路，来到一棵罗腾树下，就坐在那里求死，说："耶和华啊，现在已经够了，求你取我的性命吧，因为我并不比我的列祖好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 自己在旷野走了一日的路程，来到一棵罗腾树下 ，就坐在那里求死，说：「耶和华啊，罢了！求你取我的性命，因为我不胜于我的列祖。」
verses.textEnNiv: while he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a broom bush, sat down under it and prayed that he might die. "I have had enough, Lord ," he said. "Take my life; I am no better than my ancestors."
verses.textEnEsv: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness and came and sat down under a broom tree. And he asked that he might die, saying, "It is enough; now, O Lord , take away my life, for I am no better than my fathers."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a broom tree. And he prayed that he might die, and said, "It is enough! Now, Lord, take my life, for I am no better than my fathers!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he went on alone into the wilderness, traveling all day. He sat down under a solitary broom tree and prayed that he might die. "I have had enough, Lord ," he said. "Take my life, for I am no better than my ancestors who have already died."
verses.textEnNasb: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a broom tree; and he asked for himself to die, and said, "Enough! Now, Lord, take my life, for I am no better than my fathers."
verses.textEn: while he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness. He came to a broom bush, sat down under it and prayed that he might die. "I have had enough, Lord ," he said. "Take my life; I am no better than my ancestors."

verses.textZh: 他躺在那棵罗腾树下，睡着了。忽然有一位天使拍他，说："起来，吃吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他躺在那棵罗腾树下，睡着了。忽然有一位天使拍他，说："起来，吃吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 他就躺在罗腾树下，睡着了。有一个天使拍他，说：「起来吃吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he lay down under the bush and fell asleep. All at once an angel touched him and said, "Get up and eat."
verses.textEnEsv: And he lay down and slept under a broom tree. And behold, an angel touched him and said to him, "Arise and eat."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then as he lay and slept under a broom tree, suddenly an angel touched him, and said to him, "Arise and eat."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he lay down and slept under the broom tree. But as he was sleeping, an angel touched him and told him, "Get up and eat!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he lay down and fell asleep under a broom tree; but behold, there was an angel touching him, and he said to him, "Arise, eat!"
verses.textEn: Then he lay down under the bush and fell asleep. All at once an angel touched him and said, "Get up and eat."

verses.textZh: 他张眼一看，只见头旁有用炭火烤的饼和一瓶水。他就起来吃喝，然后又躺下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他张眼一看，只见头旁有用炭火烤的饼和一瓶水。他就起来吃喝，然后又躺下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他观看，见头旁有一瓶水与炭火烧的饼，他就吃了喝了，仍然躺下。
verses.textEnNiv: He looked around, and there by his head was some bread baked over hot coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank and then lay down again.
verses.textEnEsv: And he looked, and behold, there was at his head a cake baked on hot stones and a jar of water. And he ate and drank and lay down again.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he looked, and there by his head was a cake baked on coals, and a jar of water. So he ate and drank, and lay down again.
verses.textEnNlt: He looked around and there beside his head was some bread baked on hot stones and a jar of water! So he ate and drank and lay down again.
verses.textEnNasb: And he looked, and behold, there was at his head a round loaf of bread baked on hot coals, and a pitcher of water. So he ate and drank, and lay down again.
verses.textEn: He looked around, and there by his head was some bread baked over hot coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank and then lay down again.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者第二次回来拍他，说："起来吃吧！因为你要走的路程太远了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者第二次回来拍他，说："起来吃吧！因为你要走的路程太远了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者第二次来拍他，说：「起来吃吧！因为你当走的路甚远。」
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord came back a second time and touched him and said, "Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you."
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord came again a second time and touched him and said, "Arise and eat, for the journey is too great for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the angel of the Lord came back the second time, and touched him, and said, "Arise and eat, because the journey is too great for you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the angel of the Lord came again and touched him and said, "Get up and eat some more, or the journey ahead will be too much for you."
verses.textEnNasb: But the angel of the Lord came back a second time and touched him, and said, "Arise, eat; because the journey is too long for you."
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord came back a second time and touched him and said, "Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you."

verses.textZh: 于是他起来吃喝，靠着那食物的力量，他走了四十昼夜，直走到神的山，就是何烈山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他起来吃喝，靠着那食物的力量，他走了四十昼夜，直走到神的山，就是何烈山。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就起来吃了喝了，仗着这饮食的力，走了四十昼夜，到了神的山，就是何烈山。
verses.textEnNiv: So he got up and ate and drank. Strengthened by that food, he traveled forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb, the mountain of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he arose and ate and drank, and went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights to Horeb, the mount of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he arose, and ate and drank; and he went in the strength of that food forty days and forty nights as far as Horeb, the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So he got up and ate and drank, and the food gave him enough strength to travel forty days and forty nights to Mount Sinai, the mountain of God.
verses.textEnNasb: So he arose and ate and drank, and he journeyed in the strength of that food for forty days and forty nights to Horeb, the mountain of God.
verses.textEn: So he got up and ate and drank. Strengthened by that food, he traveled forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb, the mountain of God.

verses.textZh: 他在那里进了一个洞，就在洞里过夜。耶和华的话临到他，说："以利亚啊，你在这里干甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在那里进了一个洞，就在洞里过夜。耶和华的话临到他，说："以利亚啊，你在这里干甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他在那里进了一个洞，就住在洞中。耶和华的话临到他说：「以利亚啊，你在这里做什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: There he went into a cave and spent the night. And the word of the Lord came to him: "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEnEsv: There he came to a cave and lodged in it. And behold, the word of the Lord came to him, and he said to him, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And there he went into a cave, and spent the night in that place; and behold, the word of the Lordcame to him, and He said to him, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEnNlt: There he came to a cave, where he spent the night. But the Lord said to him, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he came there to a cave and spent the night there; and behold, the word of the Lordcame to him, and He said to him, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEn: There he went into a cave and spent the night. And the word of the Lord came to him: "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

verses.textZh: 他说："我为耶和华万军的神大发热心，因为以色列人背弃了你的约，拆毁了你的祭坛，用刀杀死了你的众先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还在寻索，要取去我的性命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："我为耶和华万军的神大发热心，因为以色列人背弃了你的约，拆毁了你的祭坛，用刀杀死了你的众先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还在寻索，要取去我的性命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「我为耶和华－万军之神大发热心；因为以色列人背弃了你的约，毁坏了你的坛，用刀杀了你的先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "I have been very zealous for the Lord God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, torn down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "I have been very jealous for the Lord , the God of hosts. For the people of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword, and I, even I only, am left, and they seek my life, to take it away."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "I have been very zealous for the Lord God of hosts; for the children of Israel have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. I alone am left; and they seek to take my life."
verses.textEnNlt: Elijah replied, "I have zealously served the Lord God Almighty. But the people of Israel have broken their covenant with you, torn down your altars, and killed every one of your prophets. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me, too."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "I have been very zealous for the Lord, the God of armies; for the sons of Israel have abandoned Your covenant, torn down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. And I alone am left; and they have sought to take my life."
verses.textEn: He replied, "I have been very zealous for the Lord God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, torn down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："你出来站在山上，在我耶和华面前。"那时，耶和华从那里经过。在耶和华面前有强烈的大风，山崩石碎，但耶和华不在风中；风过以后有地震，但耶和华也不在地震中；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："你出来站在山上，在我耶和华面前。"那时，耶和华从那里经过。在耶和华面前有强烈的大风，山崩石碎，但耶和华不在风中；风过以后有地震，但耶和华也不在地震中；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「你出来站在山上，在我面前。」那时耶和华从那里经过，在他面前有烈风大作，崩山碎石，耶和华却不在风中；风后地震，耶和华却不在其中；
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said, "Go out and stand on the mountain in the presence of the Lord , for the Lord is about to pass by." Then a great and powerful wind tore the mountains apart and shattered the rocks before the Lord , but the Lord was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Go out and stand on the mount before the Lord ." And behold, the Lord passed by, and a great and strong wind tore the mountains and broke in pieces the rocks before the Lord , but the Lord was not in the wind. And after the wind an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said, "Go out, and stand on the mountain before the Lord." And behold, the Lord passed by, and a great and strong wind tore into the mountains and broke the rocks in pieces before the Lord, but the Lordwas not in the wind; and after the wind an earthquake, but the Lordwas not in the earthquake;
verses.textEnNlt: "Go out and stand before me on the mountain," the Lord told him. And as Elijah stood there, the Lord passed by, and a mighty windstorm hit the mountain. It was such a terrible blast that the rocks were torn loose, but the Lord was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.
verses.textEnNasb: So He said, "Go out and stand on the mountain before the Lord." And behold, the Lord was passing by! And a great and powerful wind was tearing out the mountains and breaking the rocks in pieces before the Lord; but the Lordwas not in the wind. And after the wind there was an earthquake, but the Lordwas not in the earthquake.
verses.textEn: The Lord said, "Go out and stand on the mountain in the presence of the Lord , for the Lord is about to pass by." Then a great and powerful wind tore the mountains apart and shattered the rocks before the Lord , but the Lord was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.

verses.textZh: 地震过后有火，耶和华也不在火中；火后有低微柔和的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地震过后有火，耶和华也不在火中；火后有低微柔和的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 地震后有火，耶和华也不在火中；火后有微小的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: After the earthquake came a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper.
verses.textEnEsv: And after the earthquake a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire the sound of a low whisper.
verses.textEnNkjv: and after the earthquake a fire, but the Lordwas not in the fire; and after the fire a still small voice.
verses.textEnNlt: And after the earthquake there was a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire there was the sound of a gentle whisper.
verses.textEnNasb: And after the earthquake, a fire, but the Lordwas not in the fire; and after the fire, a sound of a gentle blowing.
verses.textEn: After the earthquake came a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper.

verses.textZh: 以利亚听见了，就用自己的外衣蒙着脸，走出来，站在洞口。忽然有声音向他说："以利亚啊，你在这里干甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚听见了，就用自己的外衣蒙着脸，走出来，站在洞口。忽然有声音向他说："以利亚啊，你在这里干甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利亚听见，就用外衣蒙上脸，出来站在洞口。有声音向他说：「以利亚啊，你在这里做什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: When Elijah heard it, he pulled his cloak over his face and went out and stood at the mouth of the cave. Then a voice said to him, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEnEsv: And when Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his cloak and went out and stood at the entrance of the cave. And behold, there came a voice to him and said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle and went out and stood in the entrance of the cave. Suddenly a voice came to him, and said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his cloak and went out and stood at the entrance of the cave. And a voice said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEnNasb: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his cloak and went out and stood in the entrance of the cave. And behold, a voice came to him and said, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"
verses.textEn: When Elijah heard it, he pulled his cloak over his face and went out and stood at the mouth of the cave. Then a voice said to him, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

verses.textZh: 以利亚说："我为耶和华万军的神大发热心，因为以色列人背弃了你的约，拆毁了你的祭坛，用刀杀了你的众先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还在寻索，要取去我的性命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利亚说："我为耶和华万军的神大发热心，因为以色列人背弃了你的约，拆毁了你的祭坛，用刀杀了你的众先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还在寻索，要取去我的性命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「我为耶和华－万军之神大发热心；因为以色列人背弃了你的约，毁坏了你的坛，用刀杀了你的先知，只剩下我一个人，他们还要寻索我的命。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "I have been very zealous for the Lord God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, torn down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "I have been very jealous for the Lord , the God of hosts. For the people of Israel have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and killed your prophets with the sword, and I, even I only, am left, and they seek my life, to take it away."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "I have been very zealous for the Lord God of hosts; because the children of Israel have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. I alone am left; and they seek to take my life."
verses.textEnNlt: He replied again, "I have zealously served the Lord God Almighty. But the people of Israel have broken their covenant with you, torn down your altars, and killed every one of your prophets. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me, too."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "I have been very zealous for the Lord, the God of armies; for the sons of Israel have abandoned Your covenant, torn down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. And I alone am left; and they have sought to take my life."
verses.textEn: He replied, "I have been very zealous for the Lord God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, torn down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对他说："你离去吧，从你来的路回到大马士革的旷野去。你到了那里，就要膏哈薛作亚兰王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对他说："你离去吧，从你来的路回到大马士革的旷野去。你到了那里，就要膏哈薛作亚兰王。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对他说：「你回去，从旷野往大马士革去。到了那里，就要膏哈薛作亚兰王，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to him, "Go back the way you came, and go to the Desert of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael king over Aram.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, "Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus. And when you arrive, you shall anoint Hazael to be king over Syria.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to him: "Go, return on your way to the Wilderness of Damascus; and when you arrive, anoint Hazael as king over Syria.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told him, "Go back the same way you came, and travel to the wilderness of Damascus. When you arrive there, anoint Hazael to be king of Aram.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to him, "Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus; and when you have arrived, you shall anoint Hazael king over Aram.
verses.textEn: The Lord said to him, "Go back the way you came, and go to the Desert of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael king over Aram.

verses.textZh: 又要膏宁示的孙子耶户作以色列王，还要膏亚伯．米何拉人沙法的儿子以利沙接续你作先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又要膏宁示的孙子耶户作以色列王，还要膏亚伯．米何拉人沙法的儿子以利沙接续你作先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 又膏宁示的孙子耶户作以色列王，并膏亚伯‧米何拉人沙法的儿子以利沙作先知接续你。
verses.textEnNiv: Also, anoint Jehu son of Nimshi king over Israel, and anoint Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah to succeed you as prophet.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehu the son of Nimshi you shall anoint to be king over Israel, and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah you shall anoint to be prophet in your place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also you shall anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi as king over Israel. And Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel Meholah you shall anoint as prophet in your place.
verses.textEnNlt: Then anoint Jehu grandson of Nimshi to be king of Israel, and anoint Elisha son of Shaphat from the town of Abel-meholah to replace you as my prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall also anoint Jehu the son of Nimshi king over Israel; and you shall anoint Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah as prophet in your place.
verses.textEn: Also, anoint Jehu son of Nimshi king over Israel, and anoint Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah to succeed you as prophet.

verses.textZh: 将来逃得过哈薛的刀的，必被耶户杀死；逃得过耶户的刀的，必被以利沙杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 将来逃得过哈薛的刀的，必被耶户杀死；逃得过耶户的刀的，必被以利沙杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 将来躲避哈薛之刀的，必被耶户所杀；躲避耶户之刀的，必被以利沙所杀。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehu will put to death any who escape the sword of Hazael, and Elisha will put to death any who escape the sword of Jehu.
verses.textEnEsv: And the one who escapes from the sword of Hazael shall Jehu put to death, and the one who escapes from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha put to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be that whoever escapes the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill; and whoever escapes the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who escapes from Hazael will be killed by Jehu, and those who escape Jehu will be killed by Elisha!
verses.textEnNasb: And it shall come about that the one who escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu shall put to death, and the one who escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha shall put to death.
verses.textEn: Jehu will put to death any who escape the sword of Hazael, and Elisha will put to death any who escape the sword of Jehu.

verses.textZh: 但我在以色列人中留下七千人，他们全是未曾向巴力屈过膝的，也未曾与巴力亲过嘴的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我在以色列人中留下七千人，他们全是未曾向巴力屈过膝的，也未曾与巴力亲过嘴的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但我在以色列人中为自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的，未曾与巴力亲嘴的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I reserve seven thousand in Israel—all whose knees have not bowed down to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him."
verses.textEnEsv: Yet I will leave seven thousand in Israel, all the knees that have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I have reserved seven thousand in Israel, all whose knees have not bowed to Baal, and every mouth that has not kissed him."
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I will preserve 7,000 others in Israel who have never bowed down to Baal or kissed him!"
verses.textEnNasb: Yet I will leave seven thousand in Israel, all the knees that have not bowed to Baal and every mouth that has not kissed him."
verses.textEn: Yet I reserve seven thousand in Israel—all whose knees have not bowed down to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him."

verses.textZh: 于是以利亚离开那里去了。他遇见沙法的儿子以利沙正在耕田。在他面前有十二对牛，他自己正在赶着第十二对牛。以利亚走过他那里去，把自己的外衣披在以利沙身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以利亚离开那里去了。他遇见沙法的儿子以利沙正在耕田。在他面前有十二对牛，他自己正在赶着第十二对牛。以利亚走过他那里去，把自己的外衣披在以利沙身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，以利亚离开那里走了，遇见沙法的儿子以利沙耕地；在他前头有十二对牛，自己赶着第十二对。以利亚到他那里去，将自己的外衣搭在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: So Elijah went from there and found Elisha son of Shaphat. He was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen, and he himself was driving the twelfth pair. Elijah went up to him and threw his cloak around him.
verses.textEnEsv: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen in front of him, and he was with the twelfth. Elijah passed by him and cast his cloak upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he departed from there, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke ofoxen before him, and he was with the twelfth. Then Elijah passed by him and threw his mantle on him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Elijah went and found Elisha son of Shaphat plowing a field. There were twelve teams of oxen in the field, and Elisha was plowing with the twelfth team. Elijah went over to him and threw his cloak across his shoulders and then walked away.
verses.textEnNasb: So he departed from there and found Elisha the son of Shaphat while he was plowing, with twelve yoke of oxen in front of him, and he with the twelfth. And Elijah came over to him and threw his cloak on him.
verses.textEn: So Elijah went from there and found Elisha son of Shaphat. He was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen, and he himself was driving the twelfth pair. Elijah went up to him and threw his cloak around him.

verses.textZh: 以利沙就撇下那些牛，跑在以利亚的后面，说："请你允许我与父母亲吻别，然后我就跟随你。"以利亚对他说："你回去吧！我向你作了甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙就撇下那些牛，跑在以利亚的后面，说："请你允许我与父母亲吻别，然后我就跟随你。"以利亚对他说："你回去吧！我向你作了甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙就离开牛，跑到以利亚那里，说：「求你容我先与父母亲嘴，然后我便跟随你。」以利亚对他说：「你回去吧，我向你做了什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Elisha then left his oxen and ran after Elijah. "Let me kiss my father and mother goodbye," he said, "and then I will come with you." "Go back," Elijah replied. "What have I done to you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And he left the oxen and ran after Elijah and said, "Let me kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you." And he said to him, "Go back again, for what have I done to you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he left the oxen and ran after Elijah, and said, "Please let me kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you." And he said to him, "Go back again, for what have I done to you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Elisha left the oxen standing there, ran after Elijah, and said to him, "First let me go and kiss my father and mother good-bye, and then I will go with you!" Elijah replied, "Go on back, but think about what I have done to you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he left the oxen behind and ran after Elijah, and said, "Please let me kiss my father and my mother, then I will follow you." And he said to him, "Go back, for what have I done to you?"
verses.textEn: Elisha then left his oxen and ran after Elijah. "Let me kiss my father and mother goodbye," he said, "and then I will come with you." "Go back," Elijah replied. "What have I done to you?"

verses.textZh: 以利沙就离开他回去了。他牵了一对牛来宰了，用套牛的器具把牛煮熟，就分给众人，他们都吃了。然后以利沙就起来，跟随以利亚，服事他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利沙就离开他回去了。他牵了一对牛来宰了，用套牛的器具把牛煮熟，就分给众人，他们都吃了。然后以利沙就起来，跟随以利亚，服事他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利沙就离开他回去，宰了一对牛，用套牛的器具煮肉给民吃，随后就起身跟随以利亚，服事他。
verses.textEnNiv: So Elisha left him and went back. He took his yoke of oxen and slaughtered them. He burned the plowing equipment to cook the meat and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he set out to follow Elijah and became his servant.
verses.textEnEsv: And he returned from following him and took the yoke of oxen and sacrificed them and boiled their flesh with the yokes of the oxen and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he arose and went after Elijah and assisted him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Elisha turned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen and slaughtered them and boiled their flesh, using the oxen’s equipment, and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he arose and followed Elijah, and became his servant.
verses.textEnNlt: So Elisha returned to his oxen and slaughtered them. He used the wood from the plow to build a fire to roast their flesh. He passed around the meat to the townspeople, and they all ate. Then he went with Elijah as his assistant.
verses.textEnNasb: So he returned from following him, and took the pair of oxen and sacrificed them, and cooked their meat with the implements of the oxen, and gave it to the people and they ate. Then he got up and followed Elijah and served him.
verses.textEn: So Elisha left him and went back. He took his yoke of oxen and slaughtered them. He burned the plowing equipment to cook the meat and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he set out to follow Elijah and became his servant.

verses.textZh: 亚兰王便．哈达聚集他的全军，有三十二个王与他在一起，他带着战马和战车，上去围困撒玛利亚，攻打那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰王便．哈达聚集他的全军，有三十二个王与他在一起，他带着战马和战车，上去围困撒玛利亚，攻打那城。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王便‧哈达聚集他的全军，率领三十二个王，带着车马上来围攻撒马利亚；
verses.textEnNiv: Now Ben-Hadad king of Aram mustered his entire army. Accompanied by thirty-two kings with their horses and chariots, he went up and besieged Samaria and attacked it.
verses.textEnEsv: Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together. Thirty-two kings were with him, and horses and chariots. And he went up and closed in on Samaria and fought against it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Ben-Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his forces together; thirty-two kings were with him, with horses and chariots. And he went up and besieged Samaria, and made war against it.
verses.textEnNlt: About that time King Ben-hadad of Aram mobilized his army, supported by the chariots and horses of thirty-two allied kings. They went to besiege Samaria, the capital of Israel, and launched attacks against it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ben-hadad, king of Aram, gathered all his army, and there were thirty-two kings with him, and horses and chariots. And he went up and besieged Samaria, and fought against it.
verses.textEn: Now Ben-Hadad king of Aram mustered his entire army. Accompanied by thirty-two kings with their horses and chariots, he went up and besieged Samaria and attacked it.

verses.textZh: 他派遣一些使者进城去见以色列王亚哈，对他说："便．哈达这样说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他派遣一些使者进城去见以色列王亚哈，对他说："便．哈达这样说：
verses.textZhCuv: 又差遣使者进城见以色列王亚哈，对他说：「便‧哈达如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel, saying, "This is what Ben-Hadad says:
verses.textEnEsv: And he sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel and said to him, "Thus says Ben-hadad:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel, and said to him, "Thus says Ben-Hadad:
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-hadad sent messengers into the city to relay this message to King Ahab of Israel: "This is what Ben-hadad says:
verses.textEnNasb: Then he sent messengers to the city to Ahab, king of Israel, and said to him, "This is what Ben-hadad says:
verses.textEn: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel, saying, "This is what Ben-Hadad says:

verses.textZh: ‘你的银子，你的金子都是我的；你的妻子和你最健壮的儿女也是我的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你的银子，你的金子都是我的；你的妻子和你最健壮的儿女也是我的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的金银都要归我，你妻子儿女中最美的也要归我。」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘Your silver and gold are mine, and the best of your wives and children are mine.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine; your best wives and children also are mine.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine; your loveliest wives and children are mine.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: ‘Your silver and gold are mine, and so are your wives and the best of your children!’"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Your silver and your gold are mine; your most beautiful wives and children are also mine.’ "
verses.textEn: ‘Your silver and gold are mine, and the best of your wives and children are mine.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列王回答说："我主我王啊，就照着你所说的，我和我所有的一切都可以归你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王回答说："我主我王啊，就照着你所说的，我和我所有的一切都可以归你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王回答说：「我主我王啊，可以依着你的话，我与我所有的都归你。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel answered, "Just as you say, my lord the king. I and all I have are yours."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel answered, "As you say, my lord, O king, I am yours, and all that I have."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Israel answered and said, "My lord, O king, just as you say, I and all that I have are yours."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right, my lord the king," Israel’s king replied. "All that I have is yours!"
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Israel replied, "As you say, my lord, O king; I am yours, as well as all that I have."
verses.textEn: The king of Israel answered, "Just as you say, my lord the king. I and all I have are yours."

verses.textZh: 那些使者再来说："便．哈达这样说：‘我曾经差派人对你说：你要把你的银子，你的金子，你的妻子和你的儿女都给我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些使者再来说："便．哈达这样说：‘我曾经差派人对你说：你要把你的银子，你的金子，你的妻子和你的儿女都给我。
verses.textZhCuv: 使者又来说：「便‧哈达如此说：我已差遣人去见你，要你将你的金银、妻子、儿女都给我。
verses.textEnNiv: The messengers came again and said, "This is what Ben-Hadad says: ‘I sent to demand your silver and gold, your wives and your children.
verses.textEnEsv: The messengers came again and said, "Thus says Ben-hadad: ‘I sent to you, saying, "Deliver to me your silver and your gold, your wives and your children."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the messengers came back and said, "Thus speaks Ben-Hadad, saying, ‘Indeed I have sent to you, saying, "You shall deliver to me your silver and your gold, your wives and your children";
verses.textEnNlt: Soon Ben-hadad’s messengers returned again and said, "This is what Ben-hadad says: ‘I have already demanded that you give me your silver, gold, wives, and children.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the messengers returned and said, "Ben-hadad says this: ‘I did indeed send word to you, saying, "You shall give me your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children";
verses.textEn: The messengers came again and said, "This is what Ben-Hadad says: ‘I sent to demand your silver and gold, your wives and your children.

verses.textZh: 明天大约这个时间，我要差派我的臣仆到你那里去；他们要搜查你的王宫和你臣仆的家；凡是他们看为宝贵的，他们都要下手拿走。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 明天大约这个时间，我要差派我的臣仆到你那里去；他们要搜查你的王宫和你臣仆的家；凡是他们看为宝贵的，他们都要下手拿走。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 但明日约在这时候，我还要差遣臣仆到你那里，搜查你的家和你仆人的家，将你眼中一切所喜爱的都拿了去。」
verses.textEnNiv: But about this time tomorrow I am going to send my officials to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will seize everything you value and carry it away.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they shall search your house and the houses of your servants and lay hands on whatever pleases you and take it away.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: but I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, and they shall search your house and the houses of your servants. And it shall be, that whatever is pleasant in your eyes, they will put it in their hands and take it.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But about this time tomorrow I will send my officials to search your palace and the homes of your officials. They will take away everything you consider valuable!’"
verses.textEnNasb: but about this time tomorrow I will send my servants to you, and they will search your house and the houses of your servants; and they will take in their hands everything that is pleasing to your eyes, and take it all away.’ "
verses.textEn: But about this time tomorrow I am going to send my officials to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will seize everything you value and carry it away.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列王把国中所有的长老都召了来，对他们说："请你们想想，看这人怎样的麻烦，他曾经差派人来我这里要我的妻子、我的儿女、我的银子和我的金子，我都没有拒绝他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王把国中所有的长老都召了来，对他们说："请你们想想，看这人怎样的麻烦，他曾经差派人来我这里要我的妻子、我的儿女、我的银子和我的金子，我都没有拒绝他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王召了国中的长老来，对他们说：「请你们看看，这人是怎样地谋害我，他先差遣人到我这里来，要我的妻子、儿女，和金银，我并没有推辞他。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said to them, "See how this man is looking for trouble! When he sent for my wives and my children, my silver and my gold, I did not refuse him."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land and said, "Mark, now, and see how this man is seeking trouble, for he sent to me for my wives and my children, and for my silver and my gold, and I did not refuse him."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, "Notice, please, and see how this man seeks trouble, for he sent to me for my wives, my children, my silver, and my gold; and I did not deny him."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ahab summoned all the elders of the land and said to them, "Look how this man is stirring up trouble! I already agreed with his demand that I give him my wives and children and silver and gold."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said, "Please be aware and see that this man is looking for trouble; for he sent me his demand for my wives, my children, my silver, and my gold, and I did not refuse him."
verses.textEn: The king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said to them, "See how this man is looking for trouble! When he sent for my wives and my children, my silver and my gold, I did not refuse him."

verses.textZh: 众长老和人民对王说："不要听从他，也不要答应他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 众长老和人民对王说："不要听从他，也不要答应他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 长老和百姓对王说：「不要听从他，也不要应允他。」
verses.textEnNiv: The elders and the people all answered, "Don’t listen to him or agree to his demands."
verses.textEnEsv: And all the elders and all the people said to him, "Do not listen or consent."
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the elders and all the people said to him, "Do not listen or consent."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t give in to any more demands," all the elders and the people advised.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all the elders and all the people said to him, "Do not listen nor consent."
verses.textEn: The elders and the people all answered, "Don’t listen to him or agree to his demands."

verses.textZh: 于是亚哈对便．哈达的使者说："请你们告诉我主我王说：‘王第一次差派人来向你仆人所要的一切，我都必照办；可是这次所要的，我却不能照办。’"于是使者去了，把这些话回复便．哈达。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚哈对便．哈达的使者说："请你们告诉我主我王说：‘王第一次差派人来向你仆人所要的一切，我都必照办；可是这次所要的，我却不能照办。’"于是使者去了，把这些话回复便．哈达。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，以色列王对便‧哈达的使者说：「你们告诉我主我王说：王头一次差遣人向仆人所要的，仆人都依从；但这次所要的，我不能依从。」使者就去回复便‧哈达。
verses.textEnNiv: So he replied to Ben-Hadad’s messengers, "Tell my lord the king, ‘Your servant will do all you demanded the first time, but this demand I cannot meet.’ " They left and took the answer back to Ben-Hadad.
verses.textEnEsv: So he said to the messengers of Ben-hadad, "Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you first demanded of your servant I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’" And the messengers departed and brought him word again.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he said to the messengers of Ben-Hadad, "Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you sent for to your servant the first time I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’ " And the messengers departed and brought back word to him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahab told the messengers from Ben-hadad, "Say this to my lord the king: ‘I will give you everything you asked for the first time, but I cannot accept this last demand of yours.’" So the messengers returned to Ben-hadad with that response.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to the messengers of Ben-hadad, "Tell my lord the king, ‘Everything that you sent as a demand to your servant at the first, I will do; but this thing I cannot do.’ " Then the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
verses.textEn: So he replied to Ben-Hadad’s messengers, "Tell my lord the king, ‘Your servant will do all you demanded the first time, but this demand I cannot meet.’ " They left and took the answer back to Ben-Hadad.

verses.textZh: 便．哈达又差派人去见亚哈说："撒玛利亚的尘土若是足够跟从我的人每人捧一捧的话，愿神明惩罚我，并且加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．哈达又差派人去见亚哈说："撒玛利亚的尘土若是足够跟从我的人每人捧一捧的话，愿神明惩罚我，并且加倍惩罚我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 便‧哈达又差遣人去见亚哈说：「撒马利亚的尘土若够跟从我的人每人捧一捧的，愿神明重重地降罚与我！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Ben-Hadad sent another message to Ahab: "May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if enough dust remains in Samaria to give each of my men a handful."
verses.textEnEsv: Ben-hadad sent to him and said, "The gods do so to me and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people who follow me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ben-Hadad sent to him and said, "The gods do so to me, and more also, if enough dust is left of Samaria for a handful for each of the people who follow me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Ben-hadad sent this message to Ahab: "May the gods strike me and even kill me if there remains enough dust from Samaria to provide even a handful for each of my soldiers."
verses.textEnNasb: Ben-hadad sent word to him and said, "May the gods do so to me and more so, if the dust of Samaria will be enough for handfuls for all the people who follow me."
verses.textEn: Then Ben-Hadad sent another message to Ahab: "May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if enough dust remains in Samaria to give each of my men a handful."

verses.textZh: 以色列王回答说："你们去告诉他，佩戴武器的人，不可像解除武器的那样自夸。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王回答说："你们去告诉他，佩戴武器的人，不可像解除武器的那样自夸。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王说：「你告诉他说，才顶盔贯甲的，休要像摘盔卸甲的夸口。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel answered, "Tell him: ‘One who puts on his armor should not boast like one who takes it off.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel answered, "Tell him, ‘Let not him who straps on his armor boast himself as he who takes it off.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Israel answered and said, "Tell him, ‘Let not the one who puts on hisarmor boast like the one who takes itoff.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Israel sent back this answer: "A warrior putting on his sword for battle should not boast like a warrior who has already won."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel replied, "Tell him, ‘He who straps on his weapons had better not boast like one who takes them off.’ "
verses.textEn: The king of Israel answered, "Tell him: ‘One who puts on his armor should not boast like one who takes it off.’ "

verses.textZh: 便．哈达与众王正在帐棚里喝酒，一听见了这话，就对他的臣仆说："你们列队进攻。"他们就列队进攻那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．哈达与众王正在帐棚里喝酒，一听见了这话，就对他的臣仆说："你们列队进攻。"他们就列队进攻那城。
verses.textZhCuv: 便‧哈达和诸王正在帐幕里喝酒，听见这话，就对他臣仆说：「摆队吧！」他们就摆队攻城。
verses.textEnNiv: Ben-Hadad heard this message while he and the kings were drinking in their tents, and he ordered his men: "Prepare to attack." So they prepared to attack the city.
verses.textEnEsv: When Ben-hadad heard this message as he was drinking with the kings in the booths, he said to his men, "Take your positions." And they took their positions against the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened when Ben-Hadad heard this message, as he and the kings were drinking at the command post, that he said to his servants, "Get ready." And they got ready to attack the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahab’s reply reached Ben-hadad and the other kings as they were drinking in their tents. "Prepare to attack!" Ben-hadad commanded his officers. So they prepared to attack the city.
verses.textEnNasb: And when Ben-hadad heard this message, while he was drinking with the kings in the temporary shelters, he said to his servants, "Take your positions." So they took their positions against the city.
verses.textEn: Ben-Hadad heard this message while he and the kings were drinking in their tents, and he ordered his men: "Prepare to attack." So they prepared to attack the city.

verses.textZh: 这时，忽然有一个先知前来见以色列王亚哈，说："耶和华这样说：‘你看见这些强大的军兵吗？看啊，今天我必把他们交在你手里，你就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这时，忽然有一个先知前来见以色列王亚哈，说："耶和华这样说：‘你看见这些强大的军兵吗？看啊，今天我必把他们交在你手里，你就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个先知来见以色列王亚哈，说：「耶和华如此说：『这一大群人你看见了吗？今日我必将他们交在你手里，你就知道我是耶和华。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile a prophet came to Ahab king of Israel and announced, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Do you see this vast army? I will give it into your hand today, and then you will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a prophet came near to Ahab king of Israel and said, "Thus says the Lord , Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will give it into your hand this day, and you shall know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Suddenly a prophet approached Ahab king of Israel, saying, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand today, and you shall know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then a certain prophet came to see King Ahab of Israel and told him, "This is what the Lord says: Do you see all these enemy forces? Today I will hand them all over to you. Then you will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, a prophet approached Ahab king of Israel, and said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Have you seen all this great multitude? Behold, I am going to hand them over to you today, and you shall know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: Meanwhile a prophet came to Ahab king of Israel and announced, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Do you see this vast army? I will give it into your hand today, and then you will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 亚哈问："借着谁呢？"先知回答："耶和华这样说：‘借着跟从各省省长的年轻人。’"亚哈又问："谁先开战呢？"先知说："是你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈问："借着谁呢？"先知回答："耶和华这样说：‘借着跟从各省省长的年轻人。’"亚哈又问："谁先开战呢？"先知说："是你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈说：「藉着谁呢？」他回答说：「耶和华说，藉着跟从省长的少年人。」亚哈说：「要谁率领呢？」他说：「要你亲自率领。」
verses.textEnNiv: "But who will do this?" asked Ahab. The prophet replied, "This is what the Lord says: ‘The junior officers under the provincial commanders will do it.’ " "And who will start the battle?" he asked. The prophet answered, "You will."
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahab said, "By whom?" He said, "Thus says the Lord , By the servants of the governors of the districts." Then he said, "Who shall begin the battle?" He answered, "You."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahab said, "By whom?" And he said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘By the young leaders of the provinces.’ " Then he said, "Who will set the battle in order?" And he answered, "You."
verses.textEnNlt: Ahab asked, "How will he do it?" And the prophet replied, "This is what the Lord says: The troops of the provincial commanders will do it." "Should we attack first?" Ahab asked. "Yes," the prophet answered.
verses.textEnNasb: But Ahab said, "By whom?" So he said, "The Lord says this: ‘By the young men of the leaders of the provinces.’ " Then he said, "Who will begin the battle?" And he said, "You will."
verses.textEn: "But who will do this?" asked Ahab. The prophet replied, "This is what the Lord says: ‘The junior officers under the provincial commanders will do it.’ " "And who will start the battle?" he asked. The prophet answered, "You will."

verses.textZh: 于是亚哈数点了跟从各省省长的年轻人，共有二百三十二人。以后，他又数点所有的人民，以色列众民共有七千人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚哈数点了跟从各省省长的年轻人，共有二百三十二人。以后，他又数点所有的人民，以色列众民共有七千人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚哈数点跟从省长的少年人，共有二百三十二名，后又数点以色列的众兵，共有七千名。
verses.textEnNiv: So Ahab summoned the 232 junior officers under the provincial commanders. Then he assembled the rest of the Israelites, 7,000 in all.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he mustered the servants of the governors of the districts, and they were 232. And after them he mustered all the people of Israel, seven thousand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he mustered the young leaders of the provinces, and there were two hundred and thirty-two; and after them he mustered all the people, all the children of Israel—seven thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahab mustered the troops of the 232 provincial commanders. Then he called out the rest of the army of Israel, some 7,000 men.
verses.textEnNasb: So he mustered the young men of the leaders of the provinces, and there were 232; and after them he mustered all the people, all the sons of Israel: seven thousand.
verses.textEn: So Ahab summoned the 232 junior officers under the provincial commanders. Then he assembled the rest of the Israelites, 7,000 in all.

verses.textZh: 在正午，便．哈达与帮助他的三十二个王正在帐棚里痛饮的时候，他们出发了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在正午，便．哈达与帮助他的三十二个王正在帐棚里痛饮的时候，他们出发了。
verses.textZhCuv: 午间，他们就出城；便‧哈达和帮助他的三十二个王正在帐幕里痛饮。
verses.textEnNiv: They set out at noon while Ben-Hadad and the 32 kings allied with him were in their tents getting drunk.
verses.textEnEsv: And they went out at noon, while Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in the booths, he and the thirty-two kings who helped him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they went out at noon. Meanwhile Ben-Hadad and the thirty-two kings helping him were getting drunk at the command post.
verses.textEnNlt: About noontime, as Ben-hadad and the thirty-two allied kings were still in their tents drinking themselves into a stupor,
verses.textEnNasb: They went out at noon, while Ben-hadad was drinking himself drunk in the temporary shelters with the thirty-two kings who were helping him.
verses.textEn: They set out at noon while Ben-Hadad and the 32 kings allied with him were in their tents getting drunk.

verses.textZh: 跟从各省省长的年轻人首先出发。便．哈达派人去察看，他们回报他说："有人从撒玛利亚出来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 跟从各省省长的年轻人首先出发。便．哈达派人去察看，他们回报他说："有人从撒玛利亚出来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 跟从省长的少年人先出城；便‧哈达差遣人去探望，他们回报说：「有人从撒马利亚出来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The junior officers under the provincial commanders went out first. Now Ben-Hadad had dispatched scouts, who reported, "Men are advancing from Samaria."
verses.textEnEsv: The servants of the governors of the districts went out first. And Ben-hadad sent out scouts, and they reported to him, "Men are coming out from Samaria."
verses.textEnNkjv: The young leaders of the provinces went out first. And Ben-Hadad sent out apatrol, and they told him, saying, "Men are coming out of Samaria!"
verses.textEnNlt: the troops of the provincial commanders marched out of the city as the first contingent. As they approached, Ben-hadad’s scouts reported to him, "Some troops are coming from Samaria."
verses.textEnNasb: The young men of the leaders of the provinces went out first; and Ben-hadad sent out scouts, and they reported to him, saying, "Men have come out from Samaria."
verses.textEn: The junior officers under the provincial commanders went out first. Now Ben-Hadad had dispatched scouts, who reported, "Men are advancing from Samaria."

verses.textZh: 便．哈达说："如果他们是为了求和出来，你们要活捉他们；如果他们是为了争战出来，你们也要活捉他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．哈达说："如果他们是为了求和出来，你们要活捉他们；如果他们是为了争战出来，你们也要活捉他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「他们若为讲和出来，要活捉他们；若为打仗出来，也要活捉他们。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive; if they have come out for war, take them alive."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive. Or if they have come out for war, take them alive."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive; and if they have come out for war, take them alive."
verses.textEnNlt: "Take them alive," Ben-hadad commanded, "whether they have come for peace or for war."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive as well."
verses.textEn: He said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive; if they have come out for war, take them alive."

verses.textZh: 从城里出来的这些人，就是跟从各省省长的年轻人，军兵跟在他们后面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从城里出来的这些人，就是跟从各省省长的年轻人，军兵跟在他们后面。
verses.textZhCuv: 跟从省长的少年人出城，军兵跟随他们；
verses.textEnNiv: The junior officers under the provincial commanders marched out of the city with the army behind them
verses.textEnEsv: So these went out of the city, the servants of the governors of the districts and the army that followed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then these young leaders of the provinces went out of the city with the army which followed them.
verses.textEnNlt: But Ahab’s provincial commanders and the entire army had now come out to fight.
verses.textEnNasb: So these men went out from the city, the young men of the leaders of the provinces, and the army which followed them.
verses.textEn: The junior officers under the provincial commanders marched out of the city with the army behind them

verses.textZh: 他们各人遇见对手就杀。亚兰人逃跑，以色列人追赶他们。亚兰王便．哈达骑着马，与一些骑兵一起逃走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们各人遇见对手就杀。亚兰人逃跑，以色列人追赶他们。亚兰王便．哈达骑着马，与一些骑兵一起逃走。
verses.textZhCuv: 各人遇见敌人就杀。亚兰人逃跑，以色列人追赶他们；亚兰王便‧哈达骑着马和马兵一同逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: and each one struck down his opponent. At that, the Arameans fled, with the Israelites in pursuit. But Ben-Hadad king of Aram escaped on horseback with some of his horsemen.
verses.textEnEsv: And each struck down his man. The Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them, but Ben-hadad king of Syria escaped on a horse with horsemen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And each one killed his man; so the Syrians fled, and Israel pursued them; and Ben-Hadad the king of Syria escaped on a horse with the cavalry.
verses.textEnNlt: Each Israelite soldier killed his Aramean opponent, and suddenly the entire Aramean army panicked and fled. The Israelites chased them, but King Ben-hadad and a few of his charioteers escaped on horses.
