verses.textEnNasb: And they killed, each one, his man; and the Arameans fled and Israel pursued them, and Ben-hadad the king of Aram escaped on a horse with horsemen.
verses.textEn: and each one struck down his opponent. At that, the Arameans fled, with the Israelites in pursuit. But Ben-Hadad king of Aram escaped on horseback with some of his horsemen.

verses.textZh: 以色列王出来，攻打战马和战车，大大地击败了亚兰人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王出来，攻打战马和战车，大大地击败了亚兰人。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王出城攻打车马，大大击杀亚兰人。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel advanced and overpowered the horses and chariots and inflicted heavy losses on the Arameans.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and struck the Syrians with a great blow.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Israel went out and attacked the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.
verses.textEnNlt: However, the king of Israel destroyed the other horses and chariots and slaughtered the Arameans.
verses.textEnNasb: The king of Israel also went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Arameans in a great slaughter.
verses.textEn: The king of Israel advanced and overpowered the horses and chariots and inflicted heavy losses on the Arameans.

verses.textZh: 那先知前来见以色列王，对他说："你要自强，留意看看你所要预备的，因为明年春天亚兰王必再上来攻击你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那先知前来见以色列王，对他说："你要自强，留意看看你所要预备的，因为明年春天亚兰王必再上来攻击你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那先知来见以色列王，对他说：「你当自强，留心怎样防备；因为到明年这时候，亚兰王必上来攻击你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward, the prophet came to the king of Israel and said, "Strengthen your position and see what must be done, because next spring the king of Aram will attack you again."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the prophet came near to the king of Israel and said to him, "Come, strengthen yourself, and consider well what you have to do, for in the spring the king of Syria will come up against you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the prophet came to the king of Israel and said to him, "Go, strengthen yourself; take note, and see what you should do, for in the spring of the year the king of Syria will come up against you."
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward the prophet said to King Ahab, "Get ready for another attack. Begin making plans now, for the king of Aram will come back next spring. "
verses.textEnNasb: Then the prophet approached the king of Israel and said to him, "Go, show yourself courageous and be aware and see what you have to do; for at the turn of the year the king of Aram will march against you."
verses.textEn: Afterward, the prophet came to the king of Israel and said, "Strengthen your position and see what must be done, because next spring the king of Aram will attack you again."

verses.textZh: 亚兰王的臣仆对亚兰王说："以色列人的神是山神，所以他们比我们强；但我们若是在平原上与他们争战，我们必比他们强大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰王的臣仆对亚兰王说："以色列人的神是山神，所以他们比我们强；但我们若是在平原上与他们争战，我们必比他们强大。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰王的臣仆对亚兰王说：「以色列人的神是山神，所以他们胜过我们；但在平原与他们打仗，我们必定得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, the officials of the king of Aram advised him, "Their gods are gods of the hills. That is why they were too strong for us. But if we fight them on the plains, surely we will be stronger than they.
verses.textEnEsv: And the servants of the king of Syria said to him, "Their gods are gods of the hills, and so they were stronger than we. But let us fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the servants of the king of Syria said to him, "Their gods are gods of the hills. Therefore they were stronger than we; but if we fight against them in the plain, surely we will be stronger than they.
verses.textEnNlt: After their defeat, Ben-hadad’s officers said to him, "The Israelite gods are gods of the hills; that is why they won. But we can beat them easily on the plains.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the servants of the king of Aram said to him, "Their gods are gods of the mountains; for that reason they were stronger than we. But let us fight them in the plain, and we will certainly be stronger than they.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, the officials of the king of Aram advised him, "Their gods are gods of the hills. That is why they were too strong for us. But if we fight them on the plains, surely we will be stronger than they.

verses.textZh: 王应该这样作：把众王各人的职务解除，另立军官代替他们；
verses.textZhCnvs: 王应该这样作：把众王各人的职务解除，另立军官代替他们；
verses.textZhCuv: 王当这样行：把诸王革去，派军长代替他们，
verses.textEnNiv: Do this: Remove all the kings from their commands and replace them with other officers.
verses.textEnEsv: And do this: remove the kings, each from his post, and put commanders in their places,
verses.textEnNkjv: So do this thing: Dismiss the kings, each from his position, and put captains in their places;
verses.textEnNlt: Only this time replace the kings with field commanders!
verses.textEnNasb: Carry out this plan: remove the kings, each from his place, and put governors in their place,
verses.textEn: Do this: Remove all the kings from their commands and replace them with other officers.

verses.textZh: 又照着王损失的军兵的数目，招募一支新的军队，照数补充战马和战车。然后我们可以与他们在平原上作战，我们必定比他们强。"王听从他们的话，并且这样行了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又照着王损失的军兵的数目，招募一支新的军队，照数补充战马和战车。然后我们可以与他们在平原上作战，我们必定比他们强。"王听从他们的话，并且这样行了。
verses.textZhCuv: 又照着王丧失军兵之数，再招募一军，马补马，车补车，我们在平原与他们打仗，必定得胜。」王便听臣仆的话去行。
verses.textEnNiv: You must also raise an army like the one you lost—horse for horse and chariot for chariot—so we can fight Israel on the plains. Then surely we will be stronger than they." He agreed with them and acted accordingly.
verses.textEnEsv: and muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse, and chariot for chariot. Then we will fight against them in the plain, and surely we shall be stronger than they." And he listened to their voice and did so.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you shall muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. Then we will fight against them in the plain; surely we will be stronger than they." And he listened to their voice and did so.
verses.textEnNlt: Recruit another army like the one you lost. Give us the same number of horses, chariots, and men, and we will fight against them on the plains. There’s no doubt that we will beat them." So King Ben-hadad did as they suggested.
verses.textEnNasb: and muster an army like the army that you have lost, horse for horse and chariot for chariot. Then we will fight against them in the plain, and we will certainly be stronger than they." And he listened to their voice and did so.
verses.textEn: You must also raise an army like the one you lost—horse for horse and chariot for chariot—so we can fight Israel on the plains. Then surely we will be stronger than they." He agreed with them and acted accordingly.

verses.textZh: 过了年，便．哈达数点了亚兰人，就上到亚弗去，要与以色列人争战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了年，便．哈达数点了亚兰人，就上到亚弗去，要与以色列人争战。
verses.textZhCuv: 次年，便‧哈达果然点齐亚兰人上亚弗去，要与以色列人打仗。
verses.textEnNiv: The next spring Ben-Hadad mustered the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: In the spring, Ben-hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, in the spring of the year, that Ben-Hadad mustered the Syrians and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The following spring he called up the Aramean army and marched out against Israel, this time at Aphek.
verses.textEnNasb: So at the turn of the year Ben-hadad mustered the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.
verses.textEn: The next spring Ben-Hadad mustered the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel.

verses.textZh: 以色列人数点人数，预备了粮食，就去迎战亚兰人。以色列人对着他们安营，好象两小群山羊羔；亚兰人却满布了那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人数点人数，预备了粮食，就去迎战亚兰人。以色列人对着他们安营，好象两小群山羊羔；亚兰人却满布了那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人也点齐军兵，预备食物，迎着亚兰人出去，对着他们安营，好像两小群山羊羔；亚兰人却满了地面。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Israelites were also mustered and given provisions, they marched out to meet them. The Israelites camped opposite them like two small flocks of goats, while the Arameans covered the countryside.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Israel were mustered and were provisioned and went against them. The people of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of goats, but the Syrians filled the country.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the children of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and they went against them. Now the children of Israel encamped before them like two little flocks of goats, while the Syrians filled the countryside.
verses.textEnNlt: Israel then mustered its army, set up supply lines, and marched out for battle. But the Israelite army looked like two little flocks of goats in comparison to the vast Aramean forces that filled the countryside!
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Israel were mustered and given provisions, and they went to meet them; and the sons of Israel camped opposite them like two little flocks of goats, while the Arameans filled the country.
verses.textEn: When the Israelites were also mustered and given provisions, they marched out to meet them. The Israelites camped opposite them like two small flocks of goats, while the Arameans covered the countryside.

verses.textZh: 有一位神人前来对以色列王说："耶和华这样说：‘因为亚兰人说耶和华是山神，不是平原的神，所以我要把这些强大的军兵交在你手里，你们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一位神人前来对以色列王说："耶和华这样说：‘因为亚兰人说耶和华是山神，不是平原的神，所以我要把这些强大的军兵交在你手里，你们就知道我是耶和华。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 有神人来见以色列王，说：「耶和华如此说：『亚兰人既说我－耶和华是山神，不是平原的神，所以我必将这一大群人都交在你手中，你们就知道我是耶和华。』」
verses.textEnNiv: The man of God came up and told the king of Israel, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Because the Arameans think the Lord is a god of the hills and not a god of the valleys, I will deliver this vast army into your hands, and you will know that I am the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And a man of God came near and said to the king of Israel, "Thus says the Lord , ‘Because the Syrians have said, "The Lord is a god of the hills but he is not a god of the valleys," therefore I will give all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am the Lord .’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a man of God came and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Because the Syrians have said, "The Lordis God of the hills, but He is not God of the valleys," therefore I will deliver all this great multitude into your hand, and you shall know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man of God went to the king of Israel and said, "This is what the Lord says: The Arameans have said, ‘The Lord is a god of the hills and not of the plains.’ So I will defeat this vast army for you. Then you will know that I am the Lord ."
verses.textEnNasb: Then a man of God approached and spoke to the king of Israel, and said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Since the Arameans have said, "The Lord is a god of mountains, but He is not a god of valleys," therefore I will hand over to you all this great multitude, and you shall know that I am the Lord.’ "
verses.textEn: The man of God came up and told the king of Israel, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Because the Arameans think the Lord is a god of the hills and not a god of the valleys, I will deliver this vast army into your hands, and you will know that I am the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列人和亚兰人相对安营，共七天。到了第七日，两军终于接战了。那一天，以色列人杀了亚兰人步兵十万。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人和亚兰人相对安营，共七天。到了第七日，两军终于接战了。那一天，以色列人杀了亚兰人步兵十万。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人与亚兰人相对安营七日，到第七日两军交战；那一日以色列人杀了亚兰人步兵十万，
verses.textEnNiv: For seven days they camped opposite each other, and on the seventh day the battle was joined. The Israelites inflicted a hundred thousand casualties on the Aramean foot soldiers in one day.
verses.textEnEsv: And they encamped opposite one another seven days. Then on the seventh day the battle was joined. And the people of Israel struck down of the Syrians 100,000 foot soldiers in one day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they encamped opposite each other for seven days. So it was that on the seventh day the battle was joined; and the children of Israel killed one hundred thousand foot soldiers of the Syrians in one day.
verses.textEnNlt: The two armies camped opposite each other for seven days, and on the seventh day the battle began. The Israelites killed 100,000 Aramean foot soldiers in one day.
verses.textEnNasb: So they camped, one opposite the other, for seven days. And on the seventh day the battle was joined, and the sons of Israel killed of the Arameans a hundred thousand foot soldiers in a single day.
verses.textEn: For seven days they camped opposite each other, and on the seventh day the battle was joined. The Israelites inflicted a hundred thousand casualties on the Aramean foot soldiers in one day.

verses.textZh: 余下来的都逃入亚弗城里，城墙倒塌，压死了余下来的二万七千人。便．哈达也逃到城里来，躲进一间密室里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 余下来的都逃入亚弗城里，城墙倒塌，压死了余下来的二万七千人。便．哈达也逃到城里来，躲进一间密室里。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的逃入亚弗城；城墙塌倒，压死剩下的二万七千人。 便‧哈达也逃入城，藏在严密的屋子里。
verses.textEnNiv: The rest of them escaped to the city of Aphek, where the wall collapsed on twenty-seven thousand of them. And Ben-Hadad fled to the city and hid in an inner room.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rest fled into the city of Aphek, and the wall fell upon 27,000 men who were left. Ben-hadad also fled and entered an inner chamber in the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; then a wall fell on twenty-seven thousand of the men whowere left. And Ben-Hadad fled and went into the city, into an inner chamber.
verses.textEnNlt: The rest fled into the town of Aphek, but the wall fell on them and killed another 27,000. Ben-hadad fled into the town and hid in a secret room.
verses.textEnNasb: But the rest fled to Aphek into the city, and the wall fell on twenty-seven thousand men who were left. And Ben-hadad fled and came into the city, going from one inner room to another.
verses.textEn: The rest of them escaped to the city of Aphek, where the wall collapsed on twenty-seven thousand of them. And Ben-Hadad fled to the city and hid in an inner room.

verses.textZh: 他的臣仆对他说："我们听说以色列家的王都是仁慈的王；我们不如腰束麻布，头套绳索，出去投降以色列王，或许他会使你的性命存活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的臣仆对他说："我们听说以色列家的王都是仁慈的王；我们不如腰束麻布，头套绳索，出去投降以色列王，或许他会使你的性命存活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的臣仆对他说：「我们听说以色列王都是仁慈的王，现在我们不如腰束麻布，头套绳索，出去投降以色列王，或者他存留王的性命。」
verses.textEnNiv: His officials said to him, "Look, we have heard that the kings of Israel are merciful. Let us go to the king of Israel with sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads. Perhaps he will spare your life."
verses.textEnEsv: And his servants said to him, "Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Let us put sackcloth around our waists and ropes on our heads and go out to the king of Israel. Perhaps he will spare your life."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his servants said to him, "Look now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please, let us put sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads, and go out to the king of Israel; perhaps he will spare your life."
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-hadad’s officers said to him, "Sir, we have heard that the kings of Israel are merciful. So let’s humble ourselves by wearing burlap around our waists and putting ropes on our heads, and surrender to the king of Israel. Then perhaps he will let you live."
verses.textEnNasb: But his servants said to him, "Behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings. Please let’s put sackcloth around our waists and ropes on our heads, and go out to the king of Israel; perhaps he will let you live."
verses.textEn: His officials said to him, "Look, we have heard that the kings of Israel are merciful. Let us go to the king of Israel with sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads. Perhaps he will spare your life."

verses.textZh: 于是他们腰束麻布，头套绳索，来见以色列王，对他说："你的仆人便．哈达说：‘求你使我的性命存活！’"亚哈说："他还活着吗？他是我的兄弟！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们腰束麻布，头套绳索，来见以色列王，对他说："你的仆人便．哈达说：‘求你使我的性命存活！’"亚哈说："他还活着吗？他是我的兄弟！"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们腰束麻布，头套绳索，去见以色列王，说：「王的仆人便‧哈达说，求王存留我的性命。」亚哈说：「他还活着吗？他是我的兄弟。」
verses.textEnNiv: Wearing sackcloth around their waists and ropes around their heads, they went to the king of Israel and said, "Your servant Ben-Hadad says: ‘Please let me live.’ " The king answered, "Is he still alive? He is my brother."
verses.textEnEsv: So they tied sackcloth around their waists and put ropes on their heads and went to the king of Israel and said, "Your servant Ben-hadad says, ‘Please, let me live.’" And he said, "Does he still live? He is my brother."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they wore sackcloth around their waists and put ropes around their heads, and came to the king of Israel and said, "Your servant Ben-Hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’ " And he said, "Is he still alive? He is my brother."
verses.textEnNlt: So they put on burlap and ropes, and they went to the king of Israel and begged, "Your servant Ben-hadad says, ‘Please let me live!’" The king of Israel responded, "Is he still alive? He is my brother!"
verses.textEnNasb: So they put sackcloth around their waists and ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel and said, "Your servant Ben-hadad says, ‘Please let me live.’ " And Ahab said, "Is he still alive? He is my brother."
verses.textEn: Wearing sackcloth around their waists and ropes around their heads, they went to the king of Israel and said, "Your servant Ben-Hadad says: ‘Please let me live.’ " The king answered, "Is he still alive? He is my brother."

verses.textZh: 那些人认为这些话是个吉兆，急忙抓住他的话，说："便．哈达是王的兄弟！"亚哈说："你们去请他来。"便．哈达出来见王，亚哈就去请他上车。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人认为这些话是个吉兆，急忙抓住他的话，说："便．哈达是王的兄弟！"亚哈说："你们去请他来。"便．哈达出来见王，亚哈就去请他上车。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人留心探出他的口气来，便急忙就着他的话说：「便‧哈达是王的兄弟！」王说：「你们去请他来。」便‧哈达出来见王，王就请他上车。
verses.textEnNiv: The men took this as a good sign and were quick to pick up his word. "Yes, your brother Ben-Hadad!" they said. "Go and get him," the king said. When Ben-Hadad came out, Ahab had him come up into his chariot.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the men were watching for a sign, and they quickly took it up from him and said, "Yes, your brother Ben-hadad." Then he said, "Go and bring him." Then Ben-hadad came out to him, and he caused him to come up into the chariot.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the men were watching closely to see whether anysignofmercywouldcome from him; and they quickly grasped atthisword and said, "Your brother Ben-Hadad." So he said, "Go, bring him." Then Ben-Hadad came out to him; and he had him come up into the chariot.
verses.textEnNlt: The men took this as a good sign and quickly picked up on his words. "Yes," they said, "your brother Ben-hadad!" "Go and get him," the king of Israel told them. And when Ben-hadad arrived, Ahab invited him up into his chariot.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the men took this as a good omen, and quickly accepting it from him, they said, "Your brother Ben-hadad." Then he said, "Go, bring him." Then Ben-hadad came out to him, and he had him mount the chariot.
verses.textEn: The men took this as a good sign and were quick to pick up his word. "Yes, your brother Ben-Hadad!" they said. "Go and get him," the king said. When Ben-Hadad came out, Ahab had him come up into his chariot.

verses.textZh: 便．哈达对王说："我父亲从你父亲夺得的众城，我都必还给你；你可以为自己在大马士革设立市场，像我父亲在撒玛利亚设立市场一样。"亚哈说："我与你立了这样的约，就放你去。"于是他和便．哈达立了约，就放他走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便．哈达对王说："我父亲从你父亲夺得的众城，我都必还给你；你可以为自己在大马士革设立市场，像我父亲在撒玛利亚设立市场一样。"亚哈说："我与你立了这样的约，就放你去。"于是他和便．哈达立了约，就放他走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 便‧哈达对王说：「我父从你父那里所夺的城邑，我必归还。你可以在大马士革立街市，像我父在撒马利亚所立的一样。」亚哈说：「我照此立约，放你回去」，就与他立约，放他去了。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will return the cities my father took from your father," Ben-Hadad offered. "You may set up your own market areas in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria." Ahab said, "On the basis of a treaty I will set you free." So he made a treaty with him, and let him go.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ben-hadad said to him, "The cities that my father took from your father I will restore, and you may establish bazaars for yourself in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria." And Ahab said, "I will let you go on these terms." So he made a covenant with him and let him go.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ben-Hadad said to him, "The cities which my father took from your father I will restore; and you may set up marketplaces for yourself in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria." Then Ahabsaid, "I will send you away with this treaty." So he made a treaty with him and sent him away.
verses.textEnNlt: Ben-hadad told him, "I will give back the towns my father took from your father, and you may establish places of trade in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria." Then Ahab said, "I will release you under these conditions." So they made a new treaty, and Ben-hadad was set free.
verses.textEnNasb: And Ben-hadad said to him, "The cities which my father took from your father I will restore, and you can make streets for yourself in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria." Ahab said, "And I will let you go with this covenant." So he made a covenant with him and let him go.
verses.textEn: "I will return the cities my father took from your father," Ben-Hadad offered. "You may set up your own market areas in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria." Ahab said, "On the basis of a treaty I will set you free." So he made a treaty with him, and let him go.

verses.textZh: 先知门徒中有一个人奉耶和华的命令对他的一个同伴说："你打我吧！"可是，那人却不肯打他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知门徒中有一个人奉耶和华的命令对他的一个同伴说："你打我吧！"可是，那人却不肯打他。
verses.textZhCuv: 有先知的一个门徒奉耶和华的命对他的同伴说：「你打我吧！」那人不肯打他。
verses.textEnNiv: By the word of the Lord one of the company of the prophets said to his companion, "Strike me with your weapon," but he refused.
verses.textEnEsv: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his fellow at the command of the Lord , "Strike me, please." But the man refused to strike him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his neighbor by the word of the Lord, "Strike me, please." And the man refused to strike him.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Lord instructed one of the group of prophets to say to another man, "Hit me!" But the man refused to hit the prophet.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a man from the sons of the prophets said to another by the word of the Lord, "Please strike me." But the man refused to strike him.
verses.textEn: By the word of the Lord one of the company of the prophets said to his companion, "Strike me with your weapon," but he refused.

verses.textZh: 他就对那人说："因为你不听从耶和华的话，你一离开我，就必有狮子咬死你。"那人一离开他，果然遇见了狮子，把他咬死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就对那人说："因为你不听从耶和华的话，你一离开我，就必有狮子咬死你。"那人一离开他，果然遇见了狮子，把他咬死。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就对那人说：「你既不听从耶和华的话，你一离开我，必有狮子咬死你。」那人一离开他，果然遇见狮子，把他咬死了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the prophet said, "Because you have not obeyed the Lord , as soon as you leave me a lion will kill you." And after the man went away, a lion found him and killed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to him, "Because you have not obeyed the voice of the Lord , behold, as soon as you have gone from me, a lion shall strike you down." And as soon as he had departed from him, a lion met him and struck him down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to him, "Because you have not obeyed the voice of the Lord, surely, as soon as you depart from me, a lion shall kill you." And as soon as he left him, a lion found him and killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the prophet told him, "Because you have not obeyed the voice of the Lord , a lion will kill you as soon as you leave me." And when he had gone, a lion did attack and kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to him, "Because you have not listened to the voice of the Lord, behold, as soon as you leave me, a lion will kill you." And as soon as he left him a lion found him and killed him.
verses.textEn: So the prophet said, "Because you have not obeyed the Lord , as soon as you leave me a lion will kill you." And after the man went away, a lion found him and killed him.

verses.textZh: 先知的门徒又遇见另一个人，对他说："你打我吧！"那人就打他，把他打伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知的门徒又遇见另一个人，对他说："你打我吧！"那人就打他，把他打伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知的门徒又遇见一个人，对他说：「你打我吧！」那人就打他，将他打伤。
verses.textEnNiv: The prophet found another man and said, "Strike me, please." So the man struck him and wounded him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he found another man and said, "Strike me, please." And the man struck him—struck him and wounded him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he found another man, and said, "Strike me, please." So the man struck him, inflicting a wound.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the prophet turned to another man and said, "Hit me!" So he struck the prophet and wounded him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he found another man and said, "Please strike me." And the man struck him, injuring him.
verses.textEn: The prophet found another man and said, "Strike me, please." So the man struck him and wounded him.

verses.textZh: 于是那先知去了，在路旁等候王。他用头巾蒙住自己的眼睛，把自己改了装。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那先知去了，在路旁等候王。他用头巾蒙住自己的眼睛，把自己改了装。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就去了，用头巾蒙眼，改换面目，在路旁等候王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the prophet went and stood by the road waiting for the king. He disguised himself with his headband down over his eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the way, disguising himself with a bandage over his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the prophet departed and waited for the king by the road, and disguised himself with a bandage over his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: The prophet placed a bandage over his eyes to disguise himself and then waited beside the road for the king.
verses.textEnNasb: So the prophet departed and waited for the king by the road, and disguised himself with a bandage over his eyes.
verses.textEn: Then the prophet went and stood by the road waiting for the king. He disguised himself with his headband down over his eyes.

verses.textZh: 王从那里经过的时候，他向王呼叫说："你仆人出征，在战阵之中，忽然有一个人转过来，带了另一个人来见我，说：‘你看守这个人，他若是走失了，就要你替他偿命，否则你要支付三十公斤银子。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 王从那里经过的时候，他向王呼叫说："你仆人出征，在战阵之中，忽然有一个人转过来，带了另一个人来见我，说：‘你看守这个人，他若是走失了，就要你替他偿命，否则你要支付三十公斤银子。’
verses.textZhCuv: 王从那里经过，他向王呼叫说：「仆人在阵上的时候，有人带了一个人来，对我说：『你看守这人，若把他失了，你的性命必代替他的性命；不然，你必交出一他连得银子来。』
verses.textEnNiv: As the king passed by, the prophet called out to him, "Your servant went into the thick of the battle, and someone came to me with a captive and said, ‘Guard this man. If he is missing, it will be your life for his life, or you must pay a talent of silver.’
verses.textEnEsv: And as the king passed, he cried to the king and said, "Your servant went out into the midst of the battle, and behold, a soldier turned and brought a man to me and said, ‘Guard this man; if by any means he is missing, your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as the king passed by, he cried out to the king and said, "Your servant went out into the midst of the battle; and there, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man; if by any means he is missing, your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’
verses.textEnNlt: As the king passed by, the prophet called out to him, "Sir, I was in the thick of battle, and suddenly a man brought me a prisoner. He said, ‘Guard this man; if for any reason he gets away, you will either die or pay a fine of seventy-five pounds of silver!’
verses.textEnNasb: And as the king passed by, he cried out to the king and said, "Your servant went out into the midst of the battle; and behold, a man turned aside and brought a man to me and said, ‘Guard this man; if for any reason he goes missing, then your life shall be forfeited in place of his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’
verses.textEn: As the king passed by, the prophet called out to him, "Your servant went into the thick of the battle, and someone came to me with a captive and said, ‘Guard this man. If he is missing, it will be your life for his life, or you must pay a talent of silver.’

verses.textZh: 你仆人正在忙这忙那的时候，那人就不见了。"以色列王对他说："你的判案就是这样，你已经自己判决了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你仆人正在忙这忙那的时候，那人就不见了。"以色列王对他说："你的判案就是这样，你已经自己判决了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人正在忙乱之间，那人就不见了。」以色列王对他说：「你自己定妥了，必照样判断你。」
verses.textEnNiv: While your servant was busy here and there, the man disappeared." "That is your sentence," the king of Israel said. "You have pronounced it yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: And as your servant was busy here and there, he was gone." The king of Israel said to him, "So shall your judgment be; you yourself have decided it."
verses.textEnNkjv: While your servant was busy here and there, he was gone." Then the king of Israel said to him, "So shall your judgment be; you yourself have decided it."
verses.textEnNlt: But while I was busy doing something else, the prisoner disappeared!" "Well, it’s your own fault," the king replied. "You have brought the judgment on yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: Now while your servant was busy here and there, he disappeared." And the king of Israel said to him, "So shall your judgment be; you yourself determined it."
verses.textEn: While your servant was busy here and there, the man disappeared." "That is your sentence," the king of Israel said. "You have pronounced it yourself."

verses.textZh: 他急忙把蒙在眼上的头巾除下，以色列王就认出他是一个先知。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他急忙把蒙在眼上的头巾除下，以色列王就认出他是一个先知。
verses.textZhCuv: 他急忙除掉蒙眼的头巾，以色列王就认出他是一个先知。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the prophet quickly removed the headband from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he hurried to take the bandage away from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he hastened to take the bandage away from his eyes; and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the prophet quickly pulled the bandage from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he quickly took the bandage away from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him, that he was one of the prophets.
verses.textEn: Then the prophet quickly removed the headband from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.

verses.textZh: 先知对王说："耶和华这样说：因为你把我要灭绝的人从你手中放走，所以要你替他偿命。要你的人民抵偿他的人民。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 先知对王说："耶和华这样说：因为你把我要灭绝的人从你手中放走，所以要你替他偿命。要你的人民抵偿他的人民。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对王说：「耶和华如此说：『因你将我定要灭绝的人放去，你的命就必代替他的命，你的民也必代替他的民。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to the king, "This is what the Lord says: ‘You have set free a man I had determined should die. Therefore it is your life for his life, your people for his people.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "Thus says the Lord , ‘Because you have let go out of your hand the man whom I had devoted to destruction, therefore your life shall be for his life, and your people for his people.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to him, "Thus says the Lord: ‘Because you have let slip out of your hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore your life shall go for his life, and your people for his people.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: The prophet said to him, "This is what the Lord says: Because you have spared the man I said must be destroyed, now you must die in his place, and your people will die instead of his people."
verses.textEnNasb: And the prophet said to him, "This is what the Lord says: ‘Since you have let go from your hand the man I had designated for destruction, your life shall be forfeited in place of his life, and your people in place of his people.’ "
verses.textEn: He said to the king, "This is what the Lord says: ‘You have set free a man I had determined should die. Therefore it is your life for his life, your people for his people.’ "

verses.textZh: 于是以色列王闷闷不乐回到撒玛利亚，自己的王宫里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列王闷闷不乐回到撒玛利亚，自己的王宫里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列王闷闷不乐地回到撒马利亚，进了他的宫。
verses.textEnNiv: Sullen and angry, the king of Israel went to his palace in Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel went to his house vexed and sullen and came to Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Israel went to his house sullen and displeased, and came to Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Israel went home to Samaria angry and sullen.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king of Israel went to his house sullen and furious, and came to Samaria.
verses.textEn: Sullen and angry, the king of Israel went to his palace in Samaria.

verses.textZh: 耶斯列人拿伯在耶斯列有一个葡萄园，靠近撒玛利亚王亚哈的王宫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶斯列人拿伯在耶斯列有一个葡萄园，靠近撒玛利亚王亚哈的王宫。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，又有一事。耶斯列人拿伯在耶斯列有一个葡萄园，靠近撒马利亚王亚哈的宫。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later there was an incident involving a vineyard belonging to Naboth the Jezreelite. The vineyard was in Jezreel, close to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard in Jezreel, beside the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass after these things that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: Now there was a man named Naboth, from Jezreel, who owned a vineyard in Jezreel beside the palace of King Ahab of Samaria.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after these things that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel beside the palace of Ahab, the king of Samaria.
verses.textEn: Some time later there was an incident involving a vineyard belonging to Naboth the Jezreelite. The vineyard was in Jezreel, close to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

verses.textZh: 亚哈对拿伯说："把你的葡萄园让给我，我可以用作菜园，因为你的葡萄园靠近我的王宫。我要把一个更好的葡萄园与你交换。如果你喜欢，我也可以按市价给你银子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈对拿伯说："把你的葡萄园让给我，我可以用作菜园，因为你的葡萄园靠近我的王宫。我要把一个更好的葡萄园与你交换。如果你喜欢，我也可以按市价给你银子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈对拿伯说：「你将你的葡萄园给我作菜园，因为是靠近我的宫；我就把更好的葡萄园换给你，或是你要银子，我就按着价值给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Ahab said to Naboth, "Let me have your vineyard to use for a vegetable garden, since it is close to my palace. In exchange I will give you a better vineyard or, if you prefer, I will pay you whatever it is worth."
verses.textEnEsv: And after this Ahab said to Naboth, "Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a vegetable garden, because it is near my house, and I will give you a better vineyard for it; or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its value in money."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, "Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a vegetable garden, because it is near, next to my house; and for it I will give you a vineyard better than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money."
verses.textEnNlt: One day Ahab said to Naboth, "Since your vineyard is so convenient to my palace, I would like to buy it to use as a vegetable garden. I will give you a better vineyard in exchange, or if you prefer, I will pay you for it."
verses.textEnNasb: And Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, "Give me your vineyard so that I may have it for a vegetable garden, because it is close beside my house, and I will give you a better vineyard in place of it; if you prefer, I will give you what it is worth in money."
verses.textEn: Ahab said to Naboth, "Let me have your vineyard to use for a vegetable garden, since it is close to my palace. In exchange I will give you a better vineyard or, if you prefer, I will pay you whatever it is worth."

verses.textZh: 可是拿伯对亚哈说："耶和华绝对不容许我把祖业给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是拿伯对亚哈说："耶和华绝对不容许我把祖业给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拿伯对亚哈说：「我敬畏耶和华，万不敢将我先人留下的产业给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Naboth replied, "The Lord forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my ancestors."
verses.textEnEsv: But Naboth said to Ahab, "The Lord forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Naboth said to Ahab, "The Lord forbid that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!"
verses.textEnNlt: But Naboth replied, "The Lord forbid that I should give you the inheritance that was passed down by my ancestors."
verses.textEnNasb: But Naboth said to Ahab, "The Lord forbid me that I would give you the inheritance of my fathers!"
verses.textEn: But Naboth replied, "The Lord forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my ancestors."

verses.textZh: 亚哈因为耶斯列人拿伯对他说："我不能把祖业给你"，就闷闷不乐回到宫里。他躺在床上，脸朝向内，也不吃饭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈因为耶斯列人拿伯对他说："我不能把祖业给你"，就闷闷不乐回到宫里。他躺在床上，脸朝向内，也不吃饭。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈因耶斯列人拿伯说「我不敢将我先人留下的产业给你」，就闷闷不乐地回宫，躺在床上，转脸向内，也不吃饭。
verses.textEnNiv: So Ahab went home, sullen and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had said, "I will not give you the inheritance of my ancestors." He lay on his bed sulking and refused to eat.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ahab went into his house vexed and sullen because of what Naboth the Jezreelite had said to him, for he had said, "I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers." And he lay down on his bed and turned away his face and would eat no food.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahab went into his house sullen and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him; for he had said, "I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers." And he lay down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no food.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahab went home angry and sullen because of Naboth’s answer. The king went to bed with his face to the wall and refused to eat!
verses.textEnNasb: So Ahab entered his house sullen and furious because of the answer that Naboth the Jezreelite had given to him, since he said, "I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers." And he lay down on his bed and turned his face away, and ate no food.
verses.textEn: So Ahab went home, sullen and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had said, "I will not give you the inheritance of my ancestors." He lay on his bed sulking and refused to eat.

verses.textZh: 他的妻子耶洗别进来见他，问他说："你为甚么心里这么烦闷，连饭也不吃呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的妻子耶洗别进来见他，问他说："你为甚么心里这么烦闷，连饭也不吃呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 王后耶洗别来问他说：「你为什么心里这样忧闷，不吃饭呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: His wife Jezebel came in and asked him, "Why are you so sullen? Why won’t you eat?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Jezebel his wife came to him and said to him, "Why is your spirit so vexed that you eat no food?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, "Why is your spirit so sullen that you eat no food?"
verses.textEnNlt: "What’s the matter?" his wife Jezebel asked him. "What’s made you so upset that you’re not eating?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Jezebel his wife came to him and said to him, "How is it that your spirit is so sullen that you are not eating food?"
verses.textEn: His wife Jezebel came in and asked him, "Why are you so sullen? Why won’t you eat?"

verses.textZh: 亚哈回答她说："因为我对耶斯列人拿伯说：‘把你的葡萄园让给我，我付你银子；或者你喜欢的话，我可以用另一个葡萄园与你交换’；可是他说：‘我不能把我的葡萄园让给你。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈回答她说："因为我对耶斯列人拿伯说：‘把你的葡萄园让给我，我付你银子；或者你喜欢的话，我可以用另一个葡萄园与你交换’；可是他说：‘我不能把我的葡萄园让给你。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回答说：「因我向耶斯列人拿伯说：『你将你的葡萄园给我，我给你价银，或是你愿意，我就把别的葡萄园换给你』；他却说：『我不将我的葡萄园给你。』」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered her, "Because I said to Naboth the Jezreelite, ‘Sell me your vineyard; or if you prefer, I will give you another vineyard in its place.’ But he said, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to her, "Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money, or else, if it please you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ And he answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: He said to her, "Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ And he answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "I asked Naboth to sell me his vineyard or trade it, but he refused!" Ahab told her.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to her, "It is because I was speaking to Naboth the Jezreelite and saying to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you a vineyard in place of it.’ But he said, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’ "
verses.textEn: He answered her, "Because I said to Naboth the Jezreelite, ‘Sell me your vineyard; or if you prefer, I will give you another vineyard in its place.’ But he said, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’ "

verses.textZh: 他的妻子耶洗别对他说："你现在不是统治以色列的王吗？只管起来吃饭，心神畅快，我必能把耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的妻子耶洗别对他说："你现在不是统治以色列的王吗？只管起来吃饭，心神畅快，我必能把耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王后耶洗别对亚哈说：「你现在是治理以色列国不是？只管起来，心里畅畅快快地吃饭，我必将耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jezebel his wife said, "Is this how you act as king over Israel? Get up and eat! Cheer up. I’ll get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite."
verses.textEnEsv: And Jezebel his wife said to him, "Do you now govern Israel? Arise and eat bread and let your heart be cheerful; I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jezebel his wife said to him, "You now exercise authority over Israel! Arise, eat food, and let your heart be cheerful; I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite."
verses.textEnNlt: "Are you the king of Israel or not?" Jezebel demanded. "Get up and eat something, and don’t worry about it. I’ll get you Naboth’s vineyard!"
verses.textEnNasb: Jezebel his wife said to him, "Do you now reign over Israel? Arise, eat bread, and let your heart be joyful; I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite."
verses.textEn: Jezebel his wife said, "Is this how you act as king over Israel? Get up and eat! Cheer up. I’ll get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite."

verses.textZh: 于是耶洗别以亚哈的名义写了一些信，盖上王的印章，然后把这些信送给那些住在拿伯城里的长老和贵胄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶洗别以亚哈的名义写了一些信，盖上王的印章，然后把这些信送给那些住在拿伯城里的长老和贵胄。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是托亚哈的名写信，用王的印印上，送给那些与拿伯同城居住的长老贵胄。
verses.textEnNiv: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, placed his seal on them, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city with him.
verses.textEnEsv: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and she sent the letters to the elders and the leaders who lived with Naboth in his city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and the nobles who were dwelling in the city with Naboth.
verses.textEnNlt: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the elders and other leaders of the town where Naboth lived.
verses.textEnNasb: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were living with Naboth in his city.
verses.textEn: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name, placed his seal on them, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city with him.

verses.textZh: 她在信上写着说："你们要宣告禁食，使拿伯坐在民间的首位上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她在信上写着说："你们要宣告禁食，使拿伯坐在民间的首位上。
verses.textZhCuv: 信上写着说：「你们当宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民间的高位上，
verses.textEnNiv: In those letters she wrote: "Proclaim a day of fasting and seat Naboth in a prominent place among the people.
verses.textEnEsv: And she wrote in the letters, "Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth at the head of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: She wrote in the letters, saying, Proclaim a fast, and seat Naboth with high honor among the people;
verses.textEnNlt: In her letters she commanded: "Call the citizens together for a time of fasting, and give Naboth a place of honor.
verses.textEnNasb: Now she had written in the letters, saying, "Proclaim a fast and seat Naboth at the head of the people;
verses.textEn: In those letters she wrote: "Proclaim a day of fasting and seat Naboth in a prominent place among the people.

verses.textZh: 又叫两个匪徒坐在拿伯的对面，作见证控告他说：‘你曾经咒诅神和君王’；然后把他拉出去，用石头把他打死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又叫两个匪徒坐在拿伯的对面，作见证控告他说：‘你曾经咒诅神和君王’；然后把他拉出去，用石头把他打死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又叫两个匪徒坐在拿伯对面，作见证告他说：『你谤渎神和王了』；随后就把他拉出去用石头打死。」
verses.textEnNiv: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them bring charges that he has cursed both God and the king. Then take him out and stone him to death."
verses.textEnEsv: And set two worthless men opposite him, and let them bring a charge against him, saying, ‘You have cursed God and the king.’ Then take him out and stone him to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: and seat two men, scoundrels, before him to bear witness against him, saying, "You have blasphemed God and the king." Then take him out, and stone him, that he may die.
verses.textEnNlt: And then seat two scoundrels across from him who will accuse him of cursing God and the king. Then take him out and stone him to death."
verses.textEnNasb: and seat two worthless men opposite him, and have them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king.’ Then take him out and stone him to death."
verses.textEn: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them bring charges that he has cursed both God and the king. Then take him out and stone him to death."

verses.textZh: 于是拿伯城里的人，就是那些与拿伯同住一城的长老和贵胄，都照着耶洗别送给他们的信上所写的去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是拿伯城里的人，就是那些与拿伯同住一城的长老和贵胄，都照着耶洗别送给他们的信上所写的去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些与拿伯同城居住的长老贵胄得了耶洗别的信，就照信而行，
verses.textEnNiv: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city did as Jezebel directed in the letters she had written to them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the men of his city, the elders and the leaders who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had sent word to them. As it was written in the letters that she had sent to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: So the men of his city, the elders and nobles who were inhabitants of his city, did as Jezebel had sent to them, as it was written in the letters which she had sent to them.
verses.textEnNlt: So the elders and other town leaders followed the instructions Jezebel had written in the letters.
verses.textEnNasb: So the men of his city, the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did just as Jezebel had sent word to them, just as it was written in the letters which she had sent them.
verses.textEn: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city did as Jezebel directed in the letters she had written to them.

verses.textZh: 他们宣告禁食，使拿伯坐在民间的首席上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们宣告禁食，使拿伯坐在民间的首席上。
verses.textZhCuv: 宣告禁食，叫拿伯坐在民间的高位上。
verses.textEnNiv: They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth in a prominent place among the people.
verses.textEnEsv: they proclaimed a fast and set Naboth at the head of the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: They proclaimed a fast, and seated Naboth with high honor among the people.
verses.textEnNlt: They called for a fast and put Naboth at a prominent place before the people.
verses.textEnNasb: They proclaimed a fast, and seated Naboth at the head of the people.
verses.textEn: They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth in a prominent place among the people.

verses.textZh: 然后两个匪徒来坐在拿伯的对面。这两个流氓当众作见证控告拿伯，说："拿伯曾经咒诅神和君王。"众人就把拿伯拉出城外，用石头打他，把他打死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后两个匪徒来坐在拿伯的对面。这两个流氓当众作见证控告拿伯，说："拿伯曾经咒诅神和君王。"众人就把拿伯拉出城外，用石头打他，把他打死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有两个匪徒来，坐在拿伯的对面，当着众民作见证告他说：「拿伯谤渎神和王了！」众人就把他拉到城外，用石头打死。
verses.textEnNiv: Then two scoundrels came and sat opposite him and brought charges against Naboth before the people, saying, "Naboth has cursed both God and the king." So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death.
verses.textEnEsv: And the two worthless men came in and sat opposite him. And the worthless men brought a charge against Naboth in the presence of the people, saying, "Naboth cursed God and the king." So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death with stones.
verses.textEnNkjv: And two men, scoundrels, came in and sat before him; and the scoundrels witnessed against him, against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, "Naboth has blasphemed God and the king!" Then they took him outside the city and stoned him with stones, so that he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the two scoundrels came and sat down across from him. And they accused Naboth before all the people, saying, "He cursed God and the king." So he was dragged outside the town and stoned to death.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the two worthless men came in and sat opposite him; and the worthless men testified against him, against Naboth, before the people, saying, "Naboth cursed God and the king." So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death with stones.
verses.textEn: Then two scoundrels came and sat opposite him and brought charges against Naboth before the people, saying, "Naboth has cursed both God and the king." So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death.

verses.textZh: 于是他们派人去见耶洗别，说："拿伯已经被人用石头打死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们派人去见耶洗别，说："拿伯已经被人用石头打死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是打发人去见耶洗别，说：「拿伯被石头打死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they sent word to Jezebel: "Naboth has been stoned to death."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, "Naboth has been stoned; he is dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, "Naboth has been stoned and is dead."
verses.textEnNlt: The town leaders then sent word to Jezebel, "Naboth has been stoned to death."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they sent word to Jezebel, saying, "Naboth has been stoned and is dead."
verses.textEn: Then they sent word to Jezebel: "Naboth has been stoned to death."

verses.textZh: 耶洗别听见拿伯已经被人用石头打死了，就对亚哈说："你起来，去占有那耶斯列人拿伯从前不肯收银子给你的葡萄园，因为拿伯现在没有命了，他已经死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶洗别听见拿伯已经被人用石头打死了，就对亚哈说："你起来，去占有那耶斯列人拿伯从前不肯收银子给你的葡萄园，因为拿伯现在没有命了，他已经死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶洗别听见拿伯被石头打死，就对亚哈说：「你起来得耶斯列人拿伯不肯为价银给你的葡萄园吧！现在他已经死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, "Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite that he refused to sell you. He is no longer alive, but dead."
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, "Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money, for Naboth is not alive, but dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, that Jezebel said to Ahab, "Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead."
verses.textEnNlt: When Jezebel heard the news, she said to Ahab, "You know the vineyard Naboth wouldn’t sell you? Well, you can have it now! He’s dead!"
verses.textEnNasb: And when Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, "Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth, the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead."
verses.textEn: As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, "Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite that he refused to sell you. He is no longer alive, but dead."

verses.textZh: 亚哈听见拿伯已经死了，就起来，下到耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园那里去，要占有那园。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈听见拿伯已经死了，就起来，下到耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园那里去，要占有那园。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈听见拿伯死了，就起来，下去要得耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园。
verses.textEnNiv: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of Naboth’s vineyard.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab arose to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, that Ahab got up and went down to take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahab immediately went down to the vineyard of Naboth to claim it.
verses.textEnNasb: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab got up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.
verses.textEn: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of Naboth’s vineyard.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said to Elijah,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite:

verses.textZh: "你起来，下去迎见住在撒玛利亚的以色列王亚哈，他现在正在耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园里。他下到那里去，是要占有那个园。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你起来，下去迎见住在撒玛利亚的以色列王亚哈，他现在正在耶斯列人拿伯的葡萄园里。他下到那里去，是要占有那个园。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你起来，去见住撒马利亚的以色列王亚哈，他下去要得拿伯的葡萄园，现今正在那园里。
verses.textEnNiv: "Go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who rules in Samaria. He is now in Naboth’s vineyard, where he has gone to take possession of it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who is in Samaria; behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone to take possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who lives in Samaria. There heis, in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go down to meet King Ahab of Israel, who rules in Samaria. He will be at Naboth’s vineyard in Jezreel, claiming it for himself.
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who is in Samaria; behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.
verses.textEn: "Go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who rules in Samaria. He is now in Naboth’s vineyard, where he has gone to take possession of it.

verses.textZh: 你要对他说：‘耶和华这样说：你杀了人，又占有他的产业吗？’你又要对他说：‘耶和华这样说：狗在甚么地方舔拿伯的血，也必在甚么地方舔你的血。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要对他说：‘耶和华这样说：你杀了人，又占有他的产业吗？’你又要对他说：‘耶和华这样说：狗在甚么地方舔拿伯的血，也必在甚么地方舔你的血。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要对他说：『耶和华如此说：你杀了人，又得他的产业吗？』又要对他说：『耶和华如此说：狗在何处舔拿伯的血，也必在何处舔你的血。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Have you not murdered a man and seized his property?’ Then say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: In the place where dogs licked up Naboth’s blood, dogs will lick up your blood—yes, yours!’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And you shall say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord , "Have you killed and also taken possession?"’ And you shall say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord : "In the place where dogs licked up the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick your own blood."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: "Have you murdered and also taken possession?" ’ And you shall speak to him, saying, ‘Thus says the Lord: "In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs shall lick your blood, even yours." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Give him this message: ‘This is what the Lord says: Wasn’t it enough that you killed Naboth? Must you rob him, too? Because you have done this, dogs will lick your blood at the very place where they licked the blood of Naboth!’"
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall speak to him, saying, ‘This is what the Lord says: "Have you murdered and also taken possession?" ’ And you shall speak to him, saying, ‘The Lord says this: "In the place where the dogs licked up the blood of Naboth, the dogs will lick up your blood, yours as well." ’ "
verses.textEn: Say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: Have you not murdered a man and seized his property?’ Then say to him, ‘This is what the Lord says: In the place where dogs licked up Naboth’s blood, dogs will lick up your blood—yes, yours!’ "

verses.textZh: 亚哈对以利亚说："我的仇人哪，你找到了我吗？"以利亚说："我找到你了，因为你出卖了你自己，去行耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈对以利亚说："我的仇人哪，你找到了我吗？"以利亚说："我找到你了，因为你出卖了你自己，去行耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈对以利亚说：「我仇敌啊，你找到我吗？」他回答说：「我找到你了；因为你卖了自己，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahab said to Elijah, "So you have found me, my enemy!" "I have found you," he answered, "because you have sold yourself to do evil in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Ahab said to Elijah, "Have you found me, O my enemy?" He answered, "I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do what is evil in the sight of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahab said to Elijah, "Have you found me, O my enemy?" And he answered, "I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do evil in the sight of the Lord:
verses.textEnNlt: "So, my enemy, you have found me!" Ahab exclaimed to Elijah. "Yes," Elijah answered, "I have come because you have sold yourself to what is evil in the Lord ’s sight.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ahab said to Elijah, "Have you found me, enemy of mine?" And he answered, "I have found you, because you have given yourself over to do evil in the sight of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Ahab said to Elijah, "So you have found me, my enemy!" "I have found you," he answered, "because you have sold yourself to do evil in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华说：‘看哪，我必使灾祸临到你，除灭你的后代，在以色列中属亚哈的男丁，无论是自由的，或是不自由的，我都要除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说：‘看哪，我必使灾祸临到你，除灭你的后代，在以色列中属亚哈的男丁，无论是自由的，或是不自由的，我都要除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：『我必使灾祸临到你，将你除尽。凡属你的男丁，无论困住的、自由的，都从以色列中剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: He says, ‘I am going to bring disaster on you. I will wipe out your descendants and cut off from Ahab every last male in Israel—slave or free.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I will bring disaster upon you. I will utterly burn you up, and will cut off from Ahab every male, bond or free, in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Behold, I will bring calamity on you. I will take away your posterity, and will cut off from Ahab every male in Israel, both bond and free.
verses.textEnNlt: So now the Lord says, ‘I will bring disaster on you and consume you. I will destroy every one of your male descendants, slave and free alike, anywhere in Israel!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am bringing disaster upon you, and I will utterly sweep you away, and will eliminate from Ahab every male, both bond and free in Israel;
verses.textEn: He says, ‘I am going to bring disaster on you. I will wipe out your descendants and cut off from Ahab every last male in Israel—slave or free.

verses.textZh: 我要使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家，又像亚希雅的儿子巴沙的家，因为你惹我发怒，又因为你使以色列人陷在罪中。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家，又像亚希雅的儿子巴沙的家，因为你惹我发怒，又因为你使以色列人陷在罪中。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你的家像尼八的儿子耶罗波安的家，又像亚希雅的儿子巴沙的家；因为你惹我发怒，又使以色列人陷在罪里。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have aroused my anger and have caused Israel to sin.’
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the anger to which you have provoked me, and because you have made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, because of the provocation with which you have provoked Me to anger, and made Israel sin.’
verses.textEnNlt: I am going to destroy your family as I did the family of Jeroboam son of Nebat and the family of Baasha son of Ahijah, for you have made me very angry and have led Israel into sin.’
verses.textEnNasb: and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, because of the provocation with which you have provoked Me to anger, and because you have misled Israel into sin.
verses.textEn: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have aroused my anger and have caused Israel to sin.’

verses.textZh: 至于耶洗别，耶和华也说：‘狗必在耶斯列的地方吃耶洗别的肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于耶洗别，耶和华也说：‘狗必在耶斯列的地方吃耶洗别的肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 论到耶洗别，耶和华也说：『狗在耶斯列的外郭必吃耶洗别的肉。
verses.textEnNiv: "And also concerning Jezebel the Lord says: ‘Dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’
verses.textEnEsv: And of Jezebel the Lord also said, ‘The dogs shall eat Jezebel within the walls of Jezreel.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And concerning Jezebel the Lord also spoke, saying, ‘The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And regarding Jezebel, the Lord says, ‘Dogs will eat Jezebel’s body at the plot of land in Jezreel. ’
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has also spoken of Jezebel, saying, ‘The dogs will eat Jezebel in the territory of Jezreel.’
verses.textEn: "And also concerning Jezebel the Lord says: ‘Dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’

verses.textZh: 属亚哈的人，死在城里的，必被野狗吃掉；死在田野的，必被空中的飞鸟吃掉。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 属亚哈的人，死在城里的，必被野狗吃掉；死在田野的，必被空中的飞鸟吃掉。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡属亚哈的人，死在城中的必被狗吃，死在田野的必被空中的鸟吃。』」 （
verses.textEnNiv: "Dogs will eat those belonging to Ahab who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country."
verses.textEnEsv: Anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city the dogs shall eat, and anyone of his who dies in the open country the birds of the heavens shall eat."
verses.textEnNkjv: The dogs shall eat whoever belongs to Ahab and dies in the city, and the birds of the air shall eat whoever dies in the field."
verses.textEnNlt: "The members of Ahab’s family who die in the city will be eaten by dogs, and those who die in the field will be eaten by vultures."
verses.textEnNasb: The one belonging to Ahab, who dies in the city, the dogs will eat; and the one who dies in the field, the birds of the sky will eat."
verses.textEn: "Dogs will eat those belonging to Ahab who die in the city, and the birds will feed on those who die in the country."

verses.textZh: 只是从来没有人像亚哈的；他受了他妻子耶洗别的引诱，出卖了他自己，行耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是从来没有人像亚哈的；他受了他妻子耶洗别的引诱，出卖了他自己，行耶和华看为恶的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 从来没有像亚哈的，因他自卖，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，受了王后耶洗别的耸动；
verses.textEnNiv: (There was never anyone like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil in the eyes of the Lord , urged on by Jezebel his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: ( There was none who sold himself to do what was evil in the sight of the Lord like Ahab, whom Jezebel his wife incited.
verses.textEnNkjv: But there was no one like Ahab who sold himself to do wickedness in the sight of the Lord, because Jezebel his wife stirred him up.
verses.textEnNlt: (No one else so completely sold himself to what was evil in the Lord ’s sight as Ahab did under the influence of his wife Jezebel.
verses.textEnNasb: There certainly was no one like Ahab who gave himself over to do evil in the sight of the Lord, because Jezebel his wife incited him.
verses.textEn: (There was never anyone like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil in the eyes of the Lord , urged on by Jezebel his wife.

verses.textZh: 他按照耶和华在以色列人面前赶走的亚摩利人所行的一切，跟从偶像。行了非常可憎的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他按照耶和华在以色列人面前赶走的亚摩利人所行的一切，跟从偶像。行了非常可憎的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 就照耶和华在以色列人面前所赶出的亚摩利人，行了最可憎恶的事，信从偶像。）
verses.textEnNiv: He behaved in the vilest manner by going after idols, like the Amorites the Lord drove out before Israel.)
verses.textEnEsv: He acted very abominably in going after idols, as the Amorites had done, whom the Lord cast out before the people of Israel.)
verses.textEnNkjv: And he behaved very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites had done, whom the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: His worst outrage was worshiping idols just as the Amorites had done—the people whom the Lord had driven out from the land ahead of the Israelites.)
verses.textEnNasb: He also acted very despicably in following idols, conforming to everything that the Amorites had done, whom the Lord drove out from the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: He behaved in the vilest manner by going after idols, like the Amorites the Lord drove out before Israel.)

verses.textZh: 亚哈听见这些话，就撕裂自己的衣服，披上麻布，禁食，睡在麻布上，并且神色颓丧地行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈听见这些话，就撕裂自己的衣服，披上麻布，禁食，睡在麻布上，并且神色颓丧地行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈听见这话，就撕裂衣服，禁食，身穿麻布，睡卧也穿着麻布，并且缓缓而行。
verses.textEnNiv: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and fasted. He lay in sackcloth and went around meekly.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes and put sackcloth on his flesh and fasted and lay in sackcloth and went about dejectedly.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Ahab heard those words, that he tore his clothes and put sackcloth on his body, and fasted and lay in sackcloth, and went about mourning.
verses.textEnNlt: But when Ahab heard this message, he tore his clothing, dressed in burlap, and fasted. He even slept in burlap and went about in deep mourning.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet it came about, when Ahab heard these words, that he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and fasted, and he lay in sackcloth and went about despondently.
verses.textEn: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and fasted. He lay in sackcloth and went around meekly.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到提斯比人以利亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite:
verses.textEnEsv: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then another message from the Lord came to Elijah:
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite:

verses.textZh: "你看见了亚哈在我面前怎样谦卑自己，因为他在我面前谦卑自己，所以他还在世的日子，我必不降这灾祸；到他儿子的日子，我必降这灾祸与他的家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "你看见了亚哈在我面前怎样谦卑自己，因为他在我面前谦卑自己，所以他还在世的日子，我必不降这灾祸；到他儿子的日子，我必降这灾祸与他的家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「亚哈在我面前这样自卑，你看见了吗？因他在我面前自卑，他还在世的时候，我不降这祸；到他儿子的时候，我必降这祸与他的家。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Have you noticed how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has humbled himself, I will not bring this disaster in his day, but I will bring it on his house in the days of his son."
verses.textEnEsv: "Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has humbled himself before me, I will not bring the disaster in his days; but in his son’s days I will bring the disaster upon his house."
verses.textEnNkjv: "See how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the calamity in his days. In the days of his son I will bring the calamity on his house."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you see how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has done this, I will not do what I promised during his lifetime. It will happen to his sons; I will destroy his dynasty."
verses.textEnNasb: "Do you see how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the disaster in his days; I will bring the disaster upon his house in his son’s days."
verses.textEn: "Have you noticed how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has humbled himself, I will not bring this disaster in his day, but I will bring it on his house in the days of his son."

verses.textZh: 亚兰人和以色列人之间，连续三年没有战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰人和以色列人之间，连续三年没有战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰国和以色列国三年没有争战。
verses.textEnNiv: For three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: For three years Syria and Israel continued without war.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now three years passed without war between Syria and Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: For three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now three years passed without war between Aram and Israel.
verses.textEn: For three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.

verses.textZh: 到了第三年，犹大王约沙法下去见以色列王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第三年，犹大王约沙法下去见以色列王。
verses.textZhCuv: 到第三年，犹大王约沙法下去见以色列王。
verses.textEnNiv: But in the third year Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to see the king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the third year Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass, in the third year, that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went down to visit the king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then during the third year, King Jehoshaphat of Judah went to visit King Ahab of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: In the third year, Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel.
verses.textEn: But in the third year Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to see the king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 以色列王对他的臣仆说："你们知道吗？基列的拉末原属于我们，我们怎可静坐不动，不把它从亚兰王的手中夺回来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王对他的臣仆说："你们知道吗？基列的拉末原属于我们，我们怎可静坐不动，不把它从亚兰王的手中夺回来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王对臣仆说：「你们不知道基列的拉末是属我们的吗？我们岂可静坐不动，不从亚兰王手里夺回来吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel had said to his officials, "Don’t you know that Ramoth Gilead belongs to us and yet we are doing nothing to retake it from the king of Aram?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel said to his servants, "Do you know that Ramoth-gilead belongs to us, and we keep quiet and do not take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Israel said to his servants, "Do you know that Ramoth in Gilead is ours, but we hesitate to take it out of the hand of the king of Syria?"
verses.textEnNlt: During the visit, the king of Israel said to his officials, "Do you realize that the town of Ramoth-gilead belongs to us? And yet we’ve done nothing to recapture it from the king of Aram!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king of Israel said to his servants, "Are you aware that Ramoth-gilead belongs to us, yet we are hesitant to take it out of the hand of the king of Aram?"
verses.textEn: The king of Israel had said to his officials, "Don’t you know that Ramoth Gilead belongs to us and yet we are doing nothing to retake it from the king of Aram?"

verses.textZh: 亚哈问约沙法："你肯与我一起到基列的拉末去作战吗？"约沙法回答以色列王："你我不分彼此，我的人民就像是你的人民，我的战马就像是你的战马。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈问约沙法："你肯与我一起到基列的拉末去作战吗？"约沙法回答以色列王："你我不分彼此，我的人民就像是你的人民，我的战马就像是你的战马。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈问约沙法说：「你肯同我去攻取基列的拉末吗？」约沙法对以色列王说：「你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，我的马与你的马一样。」
verses.textEnNiv: So he asked Jehoshaphat, "Will you go with me to fight against Ramoth Gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied to the king of Israel, "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to Jehoshaphat, "Will you go with me to battle at Ramoth-gilead?" And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to Jehoshaphat, "Will you go with me to fight at Ramoth Gilead?" Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he turned to Jehoshaphat and asked, "Will you join me in battle to recover Ramoth-gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied to the king of Israel, "Why, of course! You and I are as one. My troops are your troops, and my horses are your horses."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to Jehoshaphat, "Will you go to battle with me at Ramoth-gilead?" And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, " Consider me yours, my people yours, and my horses yours!"
verses.textEn: So he asked Jehoshaphat, "Will you go with me to fight against Ramoth Gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied to the king of Israel, "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."

verses.textZh: 约沙法又对以色列王说："现在请你先求问耶和华。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法又对以色列王说："现在请你先求问耶和华。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法对以色列王说：「请你先求问耶和华。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First seek the counsel of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Inquire first for the word of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Please inquire for the word of the Lord today."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jehoshaphat added, "But first let’s find out what the Lord says."
verses.textEnNasb: However, Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, "Please request the word of the Lord first."
verses.textEn: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First seek the counsel of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 于是以色列王把众先知聚集了来，约有四百人，问他们："我可以去攻打基列的拉末吗？或是应当忍耐不去呢？"他们说："你可以上去，主必把那城交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是以色列王把众先知聚集了来，约有四百人，问他们："我可以去攻打基列的拉末吗？或是应当忍耐不去呢？"他们说："你可以上去，主必把那城交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列王招聚先知，约有四百人，问他们说：「我上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他们说：「可以上去，因为主必将那城交在王的手里。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets—about four hundred men—and asked them, "Shall I go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" "Go," they answered, "for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, "Shall I go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or shall I refrain?" And they said, "Go up, for the Lord will give it into the hand of the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, "Shall I go against Ramoth Gilead to fight, or shall I refrain?" So they said, "Go up, for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king."
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Israel summoned the prophets, about 400 of them, and asked them, "Should I go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should I hold back?" They all replied, "Yes, go right ahead! The Lord will give the king victory."
verses.textEnNasb: So the king of Israel assembled the prophets, about four hundred men, and said to them, "Should I go to battle against Ramoth-gilead or should I refrain?" And they said, "Go up, for the Lord will hand it over to the king."
verses.textEn: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets—about four hundred men—and asked them, "Shall I go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" "Go," they answered, "for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand."

verses.textZh: 约沙法说："这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法说："这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法说：「这里不是还有耶和华的先知，我们可以求问他吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no longer a prophet of the Lord here whom we can inquire of?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there not here another prophet of the Lord of whom we may inquire?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoshaphat said, "Isthere not still a prophet of the Lord here, that we may inquire of Him?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there not also a prophet of the Lord here? We should ask him the same question."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jehoshaphat said, "Is there no longer a prophet of the Lord here, that we may inquire of him?"
verses.textEn: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no longer a prophet of the Lord here whom we can inquire of?"

verses.textZh: 以色列王对约沙法说："还有一个人，我们可以托他求问耶和华。不过我憎恨他，因为他对我说的预言，都是凶话，不是吉话。这人就是音拉的儿子米该雅。"但约沙法说："请王不要这么说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王对约沙法说："还有一个人，我们可以托他求问耶和华。不过我憎恨他，因为他对我说的预言，都是凶话，不是吉话。这人就是音拉的儿子米该雅。"但约沙法说："请王不要这么说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王对约沙法说：「还有一个人，是音拉的儿子米该雅，我们可以托他求问耶和华。只是我恨他；因为他指着我所说的预言，不说吉语，单说凶言。」约沙法说：「王不必这样说。」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one prophet through whom we can inquire of the Lord , but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah." "The king should not say such a thing," Jehoshaphat replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the Lord , Micaiah the son of Imlah, but I hate him, for he never prophesies good concerning me, but evil." And Jehoshaphat said, "Let not the king say so."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Thereis still one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may inquire of the Lord; but I hate him, because he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil." And Jehoshaphat said, "Let not the king say such things!"
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Israel replied to Jehoshaphat, "There is one more man who could consult the Lord for us, but I hate him. He never prophesies anything but trouble for me! His name is Micaiah son of Imlah." Jehoshaphat replied, "That’s not the way a king should talk! Let’s hear what he has to say."
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man by whom we may inquire of the Lord, but I hate him, because he does not prophesy anything good regarding me, but only bad. He is Micaiah the son of Imlah." But Jehoshaphat said, "May the king not say so."
verses.textEn: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one prophet through whom we can inquire of the Lord , but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah." "The king should not say such a thing," Jehoshaphat replied.

verses.textZh: 于是王召了一位太监来，说："快去把音拉的儿子米该雅召来！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王召了一位太监来，说："快去把音拉的儿子米该雅召来！"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王就召了一个太监来，说：「你快去，将音拉的儿子米该雅召来。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, "Bring quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king of Israel called an officer and said, "Bring Micaiah the son of Imlah quickly!"
verses.textEnNlt: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Quick! Bring Micaiah son of Imlah."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel summoned an officer and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah quickly."
verses.textEn: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."

verses.textZh: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法穿著朝服，在撒玛利亚城门口的广场上，各人坐在自己的王位上；所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法穿著朝服，在撒玛利亚城门口的广场上，各人坐在自己的王位上；所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王和犹大王约沙法在撒马利亚城门前的空场上，各穿朝服，坐在位上，所有的先知都在他们面前说预言。
verses.textEnNiv: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting on their thrones, arrayed in their robes, at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria, and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, having put on their robes, sat each on his throne, at a threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.textEnNlt: King Ahab of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah, dressed in their royal robes, were sitting on thrones at the threshing floor near the gate of Samaria. All of Ahab’s prophets were prophesying there in front of them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah were sitting, each on his throne, dressed in their robes, at the threshing floor at the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets were prophesying before them.
verses.textEn: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

verses.textZh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家做了些铁角，说："耶和华这样说：‘你要用这些铁角抵触亚兰人，直到把他们完全消灭。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基拿拿的儿子西底家做了些铁角，说："耶和华这样说：‘你要用这些铁角抵触亚兰人，直到把他们完全消灭。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 基拿拿的儿子西底家造了两个铁角，说：「耶和华如此说：『你要用这角抵触亚兰人，直到将他们灭尽。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns and he declared, "This is what the Lord says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made for himself horns of iron and said, "Thus says the Lord , ‘With these you shall push the Syrians until they are destroyed.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made horns of iron for himself; and he said, "Thus says the Lord: ‘With these you shall gore the Syrians until they are destroyed.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: One of them, Zedekiah son of Kenaanah, made some iron horns and proclaimed, "This is what the Lord says: With these horns you will gore the Arameans to death!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah made horns of iron for himself and said, "This is what the Lord says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed!’ "
verses.textEn: Now Zedekiah son of Kenaanah had made iron horns and he declared, "This is what the Lord says: ‘With these you will gore the Arameans until they are destroyed.’ "

verses.textZh: 所有的先知也都这样预言说："你可以上基列的拉末去，必得胜利！因为耶和华必把那城交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的先知也都这样预言说："你可以上基列的拉末去，必得胜利！因为耶和华必把那城交在王的手里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所有的先知也都这样预言说：「可以上基列的拉末去，必然得胜，因为耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」
verses.textEnNiv: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. "Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious," they said, "for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnEsv: And all the prophets prophesied so and said, "Go up to Ramoth-gilead and triumph; the Lord will give it into the hand of the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, "Go up to Ramoth Gilead and prosper, for the Lord will deliver it into the king’s hand."
