verses.textEnNlt: All the other prophets agreed. "Yes," they said, "go up to Ramoth-gilead and be victorious, for the Lord will give the king victory!"
verses.textEnNasb: All the prophets were prophesying this as well, saying, "Go up to Ramoth-gilead and succeed, for the Lord will hand it over to the king."
verses.textEn: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. "Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious," they said, "for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand."

verses.textZh: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说："看哪，这里的众先知都异口同声地对王说吉话，请你与他们一样说吉话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅说："看哪，这里的众先知都异口同声地对王说吉话，请你与他们一样说吉话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那去召米该雅的使者对米该雅 说：「众先知一口同音地都向王说吉言，你不如与他们说一样的话，也说吉言。」
verses.textEnNiv: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, "Look, the other prophets without exception are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably."
verses.textEnEsv: And the messenger who went to summon Micaiah said to him, "Behold, the words of the prophets with one accord are favorable to the king. Let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak favorably."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the messenger who had gone to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, "Now listen, the words of the prophets with one accord encourage the king. Please, let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak encouragement."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah said to him, "Look, all the prophets are promising victory for the king. Be sure that you agree with them and promise success."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the messenger who went to summon Micaiah spoke to him saying, "Behold now, the words of the prophets are unanimously favorable to the king. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak favorably."
verses.textEn: The messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, "Look, the other prophets without exception are predicting success for the king. Let your word agree with theirs, and speak favorably."

verses.textZh: 米该雅说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，耶和华吩咐我甚么，我就说甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说："我指着永活的耶和华起誓，耶和华吩咐我甚么，我就说甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「我指着永生的耶和华起誓，耶和华对我说什么，我就说什么。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Micaiah said, "As surely as the Lord lives, I can tell him only what the Lord tells me."
verses.textEnEsv: But Micaiah said, "As the Lord lives, what the Lord says to me, that I will speak."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Micaiah said, "As the Lord lives, whatever the Lord says to me, that I will speak."
verses.textEnNlt: But Micaiah replied, "As surely as the Lord lives, I will say only what the Lord tells me to say."
verses.textEnNasb: But Micaiah said, "As the Lord lives, whatever the Lord says to me, I shall speak it."
verses.textEn: But Micaiah said, "As surely as the Lord lives, I can tell him only what the Lord tells me."

verses.textZh: 米该雅来到王那里的时候，王就问他："米该雅啊，我们可以到基列的拉末去作战吗？或是要忍耐不去呢？"米该雅回答亚哈："你可以上去，必得胜利，因为耶和华必把那城交在王的手里！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅来到王那里的时候，王就问他："米该雅啊，我们可以到基列的拉末去作战吗？或是要忍耐不去呢？"米该雅回答亚哈："你可以上去，必得胜利，因为耶和华必把那城交在王的手里！"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅到王面前，王问他说：「米该雅啊，我们上去攻取基列的拉末可以不可以？」他回答说：「可以上去，必然得胜，耶和华必将那城交在王的手中。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he arrived, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or not?" "Attack and be victorious," he answered, "for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand."
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had come to the king, the king said to him, "Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall we refrain?" And he answered him, "Go up and triumph; the Lord will give it into the hand of the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he came to the king; and the king said to him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall we refrain?" And he answered him, "Go and prosper, for the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Micaiah arrived before the king, Ahab asked him, "Micaiah, should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should we hold back?" Micaiah replied sarcastically, "Yes, go up and be victorious, for the Lord will give the king victory!"
verses.textEnNasb: When he came to the king, the king said to him, "Micaiah, should we go to battle against Ramoth-gilead, or should we refrain?" And he said, "Go up and succeed, for the Lord will hand it over to the king!"
verses.textEn: When he arrived, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or not?" "Attack and be victorious," he answered, "for the Lord will give it into the king’s hand."

verses.textZh: 王对他说："我要嘱咐你多少次，你才奉耶和华的名对我只说真话呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对他说："我要嘱咐你多少次，你才奉耶和华的名对我只说真话呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对他说：「我当嘱咐你几次，你才奉耶和华的名向我说实话呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the king said to him, "How many times shall I make you swear that you speak to me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king said to him, "How many times shall I make you swear that you tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord?"
verses.textEnNlt: But the king replied sharply, "How many times must I demand that you speak only the truth to me when you speak for the Lord ?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear that you will tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord?"
verses.textEn: The king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the Lord ?"

verses.textZh: 米该雅说： "我看见以色列人四散在山上，好象没有牧人的羊群一样； 耶和华说：‘这些人没有主人， 使他们平平安安各自回家吧！’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说： "我看见以色列人四散在山上，好象没有牧人的羊群一样； 耶和华说：‘这些人没有主人， 使他们平平安安各自回家吧！’"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「我看见以色列众民散在山上，如同没有牧人的羊群一般。耶和华说：『这民没有主人，他们可以平平安安地各归各家去。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Micaiah answered, "I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the Lord said, ‘These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. And the Lord said, ‘These have no master; let each return to his home in peace.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd. And the Lord said, ‘These have no master. Let each return to his house in peace.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Then Micaiah told him, "In a vision I saw all Israel scattered on the mountains, like sheep without a shepherd. And the Lord said, ‘Their master has been killed. Send them home in peace.’"
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "I saw all Israel Scattered on the mountains, Like sheep that have no shepherd. And the Lord said, ‘These people have no master. Each of them is to return to his house in peace.’ "
verses.textEn: Then Micaiah answered, "I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the Lord said, ‘These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列王对约沙法说："我不是告诉过你，这人对我说的预言，总不说吉话，只说凶话吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王对约沙法说："我不是告诉过你，这人对我说的预言，总不说吉话，只说凶话吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我岂没有告诉你，这人指着我所说的预言，不说吉语单说凶言吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Didn’t I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not tell you he would not prophesy good concerning me, but evil?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Didn’t I tell you?" the king of Israel exclaimed to Jehoshaphat. "He never prophesies anything but trouble for me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy anything good regarding me, but only bad?"
verses.textEn: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Didn’t I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?"

verses.textZh: 米该雅说："因此，你要听耶和华的话；我看见耶和华坐在他的宝座上，天上的万军都侍立在他的左右。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说："因此，你要听耶和华的话；我看见耶和华坐在他的宝座上，天上的万军都侍立在他的左右。
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「你要听耶和华的话！我看见耶和华坐在宝座上，天上的万军侍立在他左右。
verses.textEnNiv: Micaiah continued, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the multitudes of heaven standing around him on his right and on his left.
verses.textEnEsv: And Micaiah said, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing beside him on his right hand and on his left;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Micaiah said, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing by, on His right hand and on His left.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Micaiah continued, "Listen to what the Lord says! I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the armies of heaven around him, on his right and on his left.
verses.textEnNasb: And Micaiah said, "Therefore, hear the word of the Lord. I saw the Lord sitting on His throne, and all the angels of heaven standing by Him on His right and on His left.
verses.textEn: Micaiah continued, "Therefore hear the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne with all the multitudes of heaven standing around him on his right and on his left.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说：‘谁去引诱亚哈，使他上基列的拉末阵亡呢？’有说这样的，有说那样的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说：‘谁去引诱亚哈，使他上基列的拉末阵亡呢？’有说这样的，有说那样的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：『谁去引诱亚哈上基列的拉末去阵亡呢？』这个就这样说，那个就那样说。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?’ "One suggested this, and another that.
verses.textEnEsv: and the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one said one thing, and another said another.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, ‘Who will persuade Ahab to go up, that he may fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ So one spoke in this manner, and another spoke in that manner.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said, ‘Who can entice Ahab to go into battle against Ramoth-gilead so he can be killed?’ "There were many suggestions,
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab to go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one spirit said this, while another said that.
verses.textEn: And the Lord said, ‘Who will entice Ahab into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?’ "One suggested this, and another that.

verses.textZh: 后来有一个灵出来，站在耶和华面前，说：‘我去引诱他。’耶和华问他：‘你用甚么方法呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来有一个灵出来，站在耶和华面前，说：‘我去引诱他。’耶和华问他：‘你用甚么方法呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 随后有一个神灵出来，站在耶和华面前，说：『我去引诱他。』
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the Lord and said, ‘I will entice him.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then a spirit came forward and stood before the Lord , saying, ‘I will entice him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a spirit came forward and stood before the Lord, and said, ‘I will persuade him.’
verses.textEnNlt: and finally a spirit approached the Lord and said, ‘I can do it!’
verses.textEnNasb: Then a spirit came forward and stood before the Lord, and said, ‘I will entice him.’
verses.textEn: Finally, a spirit came forward, stood before the Lord and said, ‘I will entice him.’

verses.textZh: 他回答：‘我要出去，在亚哈所有先知的口中，作说谎的灵。’耶和华说：‘你可以去引诱他，你也必能成功，你去这样行吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答：‘我要出去，在亚哈所有先知的口中，作说谎的灵。’耶和华说：‘你可以去引诱他，你也必能成功，你去这样行吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华问他说：『你用何法呢？』他说：『我去，要在他众先知口中作谎言的灵。』耶和华说：『这样，你必能引诱他，你去如此行吧！』
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘By what means?’ the Lord asked. " ‘I will go out and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,’ he said. " ‘You will succeed in enticing him,’ said the Lord . ‘Go and do it.’
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to him, ‘By what means?’ And he said, ‘I will go out, and will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ And he said, ‘You are to entice him, and you shall succeed; go out and do so.’
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord said to him, ‘In what way?’ So he said, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets.’ And the Lord said, ‘You shall persuade him, and also prevail. Go out and do so.’
verses.textEnNlt: "‘How will you do this?’ the Lord asked. "And the spirit replied, ‘I will go out and inspire all of Ahab’s prophets to speak lies.’ "‘You will succeed,’ said the Lord . ‘Go ahead and do it.’
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to him, ‘How?’ And he said, ‘I will go out and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’ Then He said, ‘You shall entice him, and you will also prevail. Go and do so.’
verses.textEn: " ‘By what means?’ the Lord asked. " ‘I will go out and be a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,’ he said. " ‘You will succeed in enticing him,’ said the Lord . ‘Go and do it.’

verses.textZh: 现在，耶和华已经把说谎的灵放在你这些先知的口中，耶和华已经命定灾祸临到你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，耶和华已经把说谎的灵放在你这些先知的口中，耶和华已经命定灾祸临到你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在耶和华使谎言的灵入了你这些先知的口，并且耶和华已经命定降祸与你。」
verses.textEnNiv: "So now the Lord has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all these prophets of yours. The Lord has decreed disaster for you."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore behold, the Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets; the Lord has declared disaster for you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore look! The Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these prophets of yours, and the Lord has declared disaster against you."
verses.textEnNlt: "So you see, the Lord has put a lying spirit in the mouths of all your prophets. For the Lord has pronounced your doom."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, behold, the Lord has put a deceiving spirit in the mouth of all these prophets of yours; and the Lord has declared disaster against you."
verses.textEn: "So now the Lord has put a deceiving spirit in the mouths of all these prophets of yours. The Lord has decreed disaster for you."

verses.textZh: 基拿拿的儿子西底家近前来，打米该雅的脸颊说："耶和华的灵怎样离开了我，去与你说话呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 基拿拿的儿子西底家近前来，打米该雅的脸颊说："耶和华的灵怎样离开了我，去与你说话呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 基拿拿的儿子西底家前来，打米该雅的脸，说：「耶和华的灵从哪里离开我与你说话呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. "Which way did the spirit from the Lord go when he went from me to speak to you?" he asked.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek and said, "How did the Spirit of the Lord go from me to speak to you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, "Which way did the spirit from the Lord go from me to speak to you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah walked up to Micaiah and slapped him across the face. "Since when did the Spirit of the Lord leave me to speak to you?" he demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah approached and struck Micaiah on the cheek; and he said, "How did the Spirit of the Lord pass from me to speak to you?"
verses.textEn: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. "Which way did the spirit from the Lord go when he went from me to speak to you?" he asked.

verses.textZh: 米该雅说："你进密室躲藏的那一天，就必看见了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说："你进密室躲藏的那一天，就必看见了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「你进严密的屋子藏躲的那日，就必看见了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Micaiah replied, "You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room."
verses.textEnEsv: And Micaiah said, "Behold, you shall see on that day when you go into an inner chamber to hide yourself."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Micaiah said, "Indeed, you shall see on that day when you go into an inner chamber to hide!"
verses.textEnNlt: And Micaiah replied, "You will find out soon enough when you are trying to hide in some secret room!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Micaiah said, "Behold, you are going to see how on that day when you go from one inner room to another trying to hide yourself."
verses.textEn: Micaiah replied, "You will find out on the day you go to hide in an inner room."

verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Israel said, "Take Micaiah and return him to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

verses.textZh: 说：‘王这样吩咐：把这人囚在监里，少给他食物和水，直到我平平安安回来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说：‘王这样吩咐：把这人囚在监里，少给他食物和水，直到我平平安安回来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 王如此说，把这个人下在监里，使他受苦，吃不饱喝不足，等候我平平安安地回来。」

verses.textZh: 米该雅说："如果你真的可以平平安安回来，那么耶和华就没有借着我说话了。"他又说："众民啊，你们都要听。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 米该雅说："如果你真的可以平平安安回来，那么耶和华就没有借着我说话了。"他又说："众民啊，你们都要听。"
verses.textZhCuv: 米该雅说：「你若能平平安安地回来，那就是耶和华没有藉我说这话了」；又说：「众民哪，你们都要听！」
verses.textEnNiv: Micaiah declared, "If you ever return safely, the Lord has not spoken through me." Then he added, "Mark my words, all you people!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Micaiah said, "If you return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me." And he said, "Hear, all you peoples!"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Micaiah said, "If you ever return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me." And he said, "Take heed, all you people!"
verses.textEnNlt: But Micaiah replied, "If you return safely, it will mean that the Lord has not spoken through me!" Then he added to those standing around, "Everyone mark my words!"
verses.textEnNasb: But Micaiah said, "If you actually return safely, the Lord has not spoken by me." And he said, "Listen, all you people!"
verses.textEn: Micaiah declared, "If you ever return safely, the Lord has not spoken through me." Then he added, "Mark my words, all you people!"

verses.textZh: 于是，以色列王和犹大王约沙法上基列的拉末去了。

verses.textEnNasb: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up against Ramoth-gilead.
verses.textEn: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

verses.textZh: 以色列王对约沙法说："我要改装上战场去了；你可以仍穿自己的朝服。"于是以色列王改装到战场去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王对约沙法说："我要改装上战场去了；你可以仍穿自己的朝服。"于是以色列王改装到战场去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王对约沙法说：「我要改装上阵，你可以仍穿王服。」以色列王就改装上阵。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your robes." And the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into battle; but you put on your robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "As we go into battle, I will disguise myself so no one will recognize me, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself, and they went into battle.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will disguise myself and go into the battle, but you put on your robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into the battle.
verses.textEn: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.

verses.textZh: 亚兰王曾经嘱咐他的三十二个战车长说："无论大小将兵，你们都不要与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰王曾经嘱咐他的三十二个战车长说："无论大小将兵，你们都不要与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。"
verses.textZhCuv: 先是亚兰王吩咐他的三十二个车兵长说：「他们的兵将，无论大小，你们都不可与他们争战，只要与以色列王争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the king of Aram had ordered his thirty-two chariot commanders, "Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel."
verses.textEnEsv: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, "Fight with neither small nor great, but only with the king of Israel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, "Fight with no one small or great, but only with the king of Israel."
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the king of Aram had issued these orders to his thirty-two chariot commanders: "Attack only the king of Israel. Don’t bother with anyone else!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the king of Aram had commanded the thirty-two commanders of his chariots, saying, "Do not fight with the small or great, but only with the king of Israel."
verses.textEn: Now the king of Aram had ordered his thirty-two chariot commanders, "Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel."

verses.textZh: 战车长们看见约沙法的时候，就说："这人必是以色列王。"他们就转过去与他争战，约沙法便喊叫起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 战车长们看见约沙法的时候，就说："这人必是以色列王。"他们就转过去与他争战，约沙法便喊叫起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 车兵长看见约沙法，便说：「这必是以色列王！」就转过去与他争战，约沙法便呼喊。
verses.textEnNiv: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, "Surely this is the king of Israel." So they turned to attack him, but when Jehoshaphat cried out,
verses.textEnEsv: And when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, "It is surely the king of Israel." So they turned to fight against him. And Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, "Surely it is the king of Israel!" Therefore they turned aside to fight against him, and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.textEnNlt: So when the Aramean chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat in his royal robes, they went after him. "There is the king of Israel!" they shouted. But when Jehoshaphat called out,
verses.textEnNasb: So when the commanders of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, "Surely he is the king of Israel!" And they turned aside to fight against him, and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.textEn: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, "Surely this is the king of Israel." So they turned to attack him, but when Jehoshaphat cried out,

verses.textZh: 战车长们一见他不是以色列王，就转回来，不追赶他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 战车长们一见他不是以色列王，就转回来，不追赶他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 车兵长见不是以色列王，就转去不追他了。
verses.textEnNiv: the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel and stopped pursuing him.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.textEnNlt: the chariot commanders realized he was not the king of Israel, and they stopped chasing him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then, when the commanders of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.textEn: the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel and stopped pursuing him.

verses.textZh: 有一个人随便射了一箭，竟射中了以色列王铁甲与护胸甲之间的地方。王对驾车的说："你把车转过来，载我离开战场吧！我受了重伤。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个人随便射了一箭，竟射中了以色列王铁甲与护胸甲之间的地方。王对驾车的说："你把车转过来，载我离开战场吧！我受了重伤。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一人随便开弓，恰巧射入以色列王的甲缝里。王对赶车的说：「我受了重伤，你转过车来，拉我出阵吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the sections of his armor. The king told his chariot driver, "Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded."
verses.textEnEsv: But a certain man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel between the scale armor and the breastplate. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and carry me out of the battle, for I am wounded."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain man drew a bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of his armor. So he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am wounded."
verses.textEnNlt: An Aramean soldier, however, randomly shot an arrow at the Israelite troops and hit the king of Israel between the joints of his armor. "Turn the horses and get me out of here!" Ahab groaned to the driver of his chariot. "I’m badly wounded!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now one man drew his bow at random and struck the king of Israel in a joint of the armor. So he said to the driver of his chariot, "Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded."
verses.textEn: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the sections of his armor. The king told his chariot driver, "Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I’ve been wounded."

verses.textZh: 那一天战争不断升级，有人扶着王站在车上抵挡亚兰人。到了黄昏，王就死了；血从伤口流到战车的底下去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天战争不断升级，有人扶着王站在车上抵挡亚兰人。到了黄昏，王就死了；血从伤口流到战车的底下去。
verses.textZhCuv: 那日，阵势越战越猛，有人扶王站在车上，抵挡亚兰人。到晚上，王就死了，血从伤处流在车中。
verses.textEnNiv: All day long the battle raged, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. The blood from his wound ran onto the floor of the chariot, and that evening he died.
verses.textEnEsv: And the battle continued that day, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Syrians, until at evening he died. And the blood of the wound flowed into the bottom of the chariot.
verses.textEnNkjv: The battle increased that day; and the king was propped up in his chariot, facing the Syrians, and died at evening. The blood ran out from the wound onto the floor of the chariot.
verses.textEnNlt: The battle raged all that day, and the king remained propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. The blood from his wound ran down to the floor of his chariot, and as evening arrived he died.
verses.textEnNasb: The battle raged on that day, and the king was propped up in his chariot in front of the Arameans, and he died at evening, and the blood from the wound ran into the bottom of the chariot.
verses.textEn: All day long the battle raged, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. The blood from his wound ran onto the floor of the chariot, and that evening he died.

verses.textZh: 约在日落的时候，有命令传遍军中说："各归各城，各归各地吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约在日落的时候，有命令传遍军中说："各归各城，各归各地吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约在日落的时候，有号令传遍军中，说：「各归本城，各归本地吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: As the sun was setting, a cry spread through the army: "Every man to his town. Every man to his land!"
verses.textEnEsv: And about sunset a cry went through the army, "Every man to his city, and every man to his country!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then, as the sun was going down, a shout went throughout the army, saying, "Every man to his city, and every man to his own country!"
verses.textEnNlt: Just as the sun was setting, the cry ran through his troops: "We’re done for! Run for your lives!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the word passed throughout the army close to sunset, saying, "Every man to his city, and every man to his country!"
verses.textEn: As the sun was setting, a cry spread through the army: "Every man to his town. Every man to his land!"

verses.textZh: 王死了以后，人们把他送回撒玛利亚，埋葬在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王死了以后，人们把他送回撒玛利亚，埋葬在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 王既死了，众人将他送到撒马利亚，就葬在那里；
verses.textEnNiv: So the king died and was brought to Samaria, and they buried him there.
verses.textEnEsv: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria. And they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria. And they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.textEnNlt: So the king died, and his body was taken to Samaria and buried there.
verses.textEnNasb: So the king died and was brought to Samaria, and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.textEn: So the king died and was brought to Samaria, and they buried him there.

verses.textZh: 他们在撒玛利亚的池旁，妓女洗澡的地方清洗战车，有狗来舔亚哈的血，正如耶和华说过的话一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在撒玛利亚的池旁，妓女洗澡的地方清洗战车，有狗来舔亚哈的血，正如耶和华说过的话一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有人把他的车洗在撒马利亚的池旁（妓女在那里洗澡），狗来舔他的血，正如耶和华所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: They washed the chariot at a pool in Samaria (where the prostitutes bathed), and the dogs licked up his blood, as the word of the Lord had declared.
verses.textEnEsv: And they washed the chariot by the pool of Samaria, and the dogs licked up his blood, and the prostitutes washed themselves in it, according to the word of the Lord that he had spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then someone washed the chariot at a pool in Samaria, and the dogs licked up his blood while the harlots bathed, according to the word of the Lord which He had spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: Then his chariot was washed beside the pool of Samaria, and dogs came and licked his blood at the place where the prostitutes bathed, just as the Lord had promised.
verses.textEnNasb: They washed out the chariot by the pool of Samaria, and the dogs licked up his blood (it was there that the prostitutes bathed themselves) in accordance with the word of the Lord which He had spoken.
verses.textEn: They washed the chariot at a pool in Samaria (where the prostitutes bathed), and the dogs licked up his blood, as the word of the Lord had declared.

verses.textZh: 亚哈其余的事迹，他所作的一切，他建造的象牙宫和他重建的一切城镇，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈其余的事迹，他所作的一切，他建造的象牙宫和他重建的一切城镇，不是都记在以色列诸王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈其余的事，凡他所行的和他所修造的象牙宫，并所建筑的一切城邑，都写在以色列诸王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Ahab’s reign, including all he did, the palace he built and adorned with ivory, and the cities he fortified, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab and all that he did, and the ivory house that he built and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, the ivory house which he built and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Ahab’s reign and everything he did, including the story of the ivory palace and the towns he built, are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Ahab and everything that he did, and the ivory house which he built and all the cities which he built, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Ahab’s reign, including all he did, the palace he built and adorned with ivory, and the cities he fortified, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

verses.textZh: 亚哈与他的列祖同睡，他的儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚哈与他的列祖同睡，他的儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈与他列祖同睡。他儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahab rested with his ancestors. And Ahaziah his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: So Ahab slept with his fathers, and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Ahab rested with his fathers. Then Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: So Ahab died, and his son Ahaziah became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ahab lay down with his fathers, and his son Ahaziah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Ahab rested with his ancestors. And Ahaziah his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 以色列王亚哈第四年，亚撒的儿子约沙法登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列王亚哈第四年，亚撒的儿子约沙法登基作犹大王。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列王亚哈第四年，亚撒的儿子约沙法登基作了犹大王。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa had become king over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat son of Asa began to rule over Judah in the fourth year of King Ahab’s reign in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jehoshaphat the son of Asa became king over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 约沙法登基的时候是三十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母亲名叫阿苏巴，是示利希的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法登基的时候是三十五岁；他在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母亲名叫阿苏巴，是示利希的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法登基的时候年三十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十五年。他母亲名叫阿苏巴，乃示利希的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned for twenty-five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

verses.textZh: 约沙法遵行他父亲亚撒所行的一切，总不偏离，行耶和华看为正的事。只是邱坛还没有废去，人民仍在邱坛上献祭烧香 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法遵行他父亲亚撒所行的一切，总不偏离，行耶和华看为正的事。只是邱坛还没有废去，人民仍在邱坛上献祭烧香 。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法行他父亲亚撒所行的道，不偏离左右，行耶和华眼中看为正的事；只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。
verses.textEnNiv: In everything he followed the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord . The high places, however, were not removed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.
verses.textEnEsv: He walked in all the way of Asa his father. He did not turn aside from it, doing what was right in the sight of the Lord . Yet the high places were not taken away, and the people still sacrificed and made offerings on the high places.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he walked in all the ways of his father Asa. He did not turn aside from them, doing whatwas right in the eyes of the Lord. Nevertheless the high places were not taken away, for the people offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat was a good king, following the example of his father, Asa. He did what was pleasing in the Lord ’s sight. During his reign, however, he failed to remove all the pagan shrines, and the people still offered sacrifices and burned incense there.
verses.textEnNasb: He walked entirely in the way of his father Asa; he did not turn aside from it, doing what was right in the sight of the Lord. However, the high places were not taken away; the people still sacrificed and burned incense on the high places.
verses.textEn: In everything he followed the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord . The high places, however, were not removed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

verses.textZh: 约沙法王与以色列王和平相处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法王与以色列王和平相处。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法与以色列王和好。
verses.textEnNiv: Jehoshaphat was also at peace with the king of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat also made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat also made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoshaphat also made peace with the king of Israel.
verses.textEn: Jehoshaphat was also at peace with the king of Israel.

verses.textZh: 约沙法其余的事迹，他作过的英勇的事和他怎样争战的事，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法其余的事迹，他作过的英勇的事和他怎样争战的事，不是都写在犹大列王的年代志上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法其余的事和他所显出的勇力，并他怎样争战，都写在犹大列王记上。
verses.textEnNiv: As for the other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, the things he achieved and his military exploits, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnEsv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he showed, and how he warred, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, the might that he showed, and how he made war, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
verses.textEnNlt: The rest of the events in Jehoshaphat’s reign, the extent of his power, and the wars he waged are recorded in The Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might which he showed and how he made war, are they not written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah?
verses.textEn: As for the other events of Jehoshaphat’s reign, the things he achieved and his military exploits, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

verses.textZh: 约沙法把父亲亚撒在世时遗留下来的庙妓都从国中除灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法把父亲亚撒在世时遗留下来的庙妓都从国中除灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法将他父亲亚撒在世所剩下的娈童都从国中除去了。
verses.textEnNiv: He rid the land of the rest of the male shrine prostitutes who remained there even after the reign of his father Asa.
verses.textEnEsv: And from the land he exterminated the remnant of the male cult prostitutes who remained in the days of his father Asa.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rest of the perverted persons, who remained in the days of his father Asa, he banished from the land.
verses.textEnNlt: He banished from the land the rest of the male and female shrine prostitutes, who still continued their practices from the days of his father, Asa.
verses.textEnNasb: And the remnant of the cult prostitutes who remained in the days of his father Asa, he eliminated from the land.
verses.textEn: He rid the land of the rest of the male shrine prostitutes who remained there even after the reign of his father Asa.

verses.textZh: 那时，以东没有王，由总督统治。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以东没有王，由总督统治。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时以东没有王，有总督治理。
verses.textEnNiv: There was then no king in Edom; a provincial governor ruled.
verses.textEnEsv: There was no king in Edom; a deputy was king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therewas then no king in Edom, only a deputy of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: (There was no king in Edom at that time, only a deputy.)
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was no king in Edom; a governor served as king.
verses.textEn: There was then no king in Edom; a provincial governor ruled.

verses.textZh: 约沙法建造了他施船只，要到俄斐去运金子，可是不能开船，因为船只在以旬．迦别坏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法建造了他施船只，要到俄斐去运金子，可是不能开船，因为船只在以旬．迦别坏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法制造他施船只，要往俄斐去，将金子运来；只是没有去，因为船在以旬‧迦别破坏了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jehoshaphat built a fleet of trading ships to go to Ophir for gold, but they never set sail—they were wrecked at Ezion Geber.
verses.textEnEsv: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they did not go, for the ships were wrecked at Ezion-geber.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jehoshaphat made merchant ships to go to Ophir for gold; but they never sailed, for the ships were wrecked at Ezion Geber.
verses.textEnNlt: Jehoshaphat also built a fleet of trading ships to sail to Ophir for gold. But the ships never set sail, for they met with disaster in their home port of Ezion-geber.
verses.textEnNasb: Jehoshaphat built ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold, but they did not go, because the ships were destroyed at Ezion-geber.
verses.textEn: Now Jehoshaphat built a fleet of trading ships to go to Ophir for gold, but they never set sail—they were wrecked at Ezion Geber.

verses.textZh: 那时亚哈的儿子亚哈谢对约沙法说："让我的仆人与你的仆人一同坐船去吧！"但是约沙法不肯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时亚哈的儿子亚哈谢对约沙法说："让我的仆人与你的仆人一同坐船去吧！"但是约沙法不肯。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚哈的儿子亚哈谢对约沙法说：「容我的仆人和你的仆人坐船同去吧！」约沙法却不肯。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my men sail with yours," but Jehoshaphat refused.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my servants go with your servants in the ships," but Jehoshaphat was not willing.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my servants go with your servants in the ships." But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.textEnNlt: At one time Ahaziah son of Ahab had proposed to Jehoshaphat, "Let my men sail with your men in the ships." But Jehoshaphat refused the request.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ahaziah the son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my servants go with your servants in the ships." But Jehoshaphat was not willing.
verses.textEn: At that time Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my men sail with yours," but Jehoshaphat refused.

verses.textZh: 约沙法与他的列祖同睡，与他的列祖一同埋葬在他先祖大卫的城里；他的儿子约兰接续他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约沙法与他的列祖同睡，与他的列祖一同埋葬在他先祖大卫的城里；他的儿子约兰接续他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约沙法与列祖同睡。葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约兰接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of David his father. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father, and Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jehoshaphat rested with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the City of David his father. Then Jehoram his son reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jehoshaphat died, he was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Then his son Jehoram became the next king.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jehoshaphat lay down with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of his father David, and his son Jehoram became king in his place.
verses.textEn: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his ancestors and was buried with them in the city of David his father. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 犹大王约沙法第十七年，亚哈的儿子亚哈谢在撒玛利亚登基作以色列王。他作以色列王两年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约沙法第十七年，亚哈的儿子亚哈谢在撒玛利亚登基作以色列王。他作以色列王两年。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约沙法十七年，亚哈的儿子亚哈谢在撒马利亚登基，作以色列王共二年。
verses.textEnNiv: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.
verses.textEnEsv: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ahaziah the son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned two years over Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Ahaziah son of Ahab began to rule over Israel in the seventeenth year of King Jehoshaphat’s reign in Judah. He reigned in Samaria two years.
verses.textEnNasb: Ahaziah the son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel for two years.
verses.textEn: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.

verses.textZh: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，行他父亲的道和他母亲的道，又行尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪中的道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他行耶和华看为恶的事，行他父亲的道和他母亲的道，又行尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪中的道。
verses.textZhCuv: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他的父母，又行尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的 事。
verses.textEnNiv: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , because he followed the ways of his father and mother and of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.
verses.textEnEsv: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord and walked in the way of his father and in the way of his mother and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: He did evil in the sight of the Lord, and walked in the way of his father and in the way of his mother and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who had made Israel sin;
verses.textEnNlt: But he did what was evil in the Lord ’s sight, following the example of his father and mother and the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had led Israel to sin.
verses.textEnNasb: He did evil in the sight of the Lord and walked in the way of his father and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who misled Israel into sin.
verses.textEn: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord , because he followed the ways of his father and mother and of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

verses.textZh: 他事奉巴力，敬拜巴力，照着他父亲所行的一切惹耶和华以色列的神发怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他事奉巴力，敬拜巴力，照着他父亲所行的一切惹耶和华以色列的神发怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 他照他父亲一切所行的，事奉敬拜巴力，惹耶和华－以色列神的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: He served and worshiped Baal and aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, just as his father had done.
verses.textEnEsv: He served Baal and worshiped him and provoked the Lord , the God of Israel, to anger in every way that his father had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: for he served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger, according to all that his father had done.
verses.textEnNlt: He served Baal and worshiped him, provoking the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, just as his father had done.
verses.textEnNasb: So he served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked the Lord God of Israel to anger, according to all that his father had done.
verses.textEn: He served and worshiped Baal and aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, just as his father had done.
